text: {i}How does one preserve and treasure memories?{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}Memories can be incredibly valuable, as some of us may want to remember certain moments of our lives.{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}It could be a good one that made you smile, or a bad thing that taught you a lesson.{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}Unfortunately, some of these wonderful moments can be forgotten.{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}Most things do not last forever. Everything is meant to change or fade away through time.{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}Memories are one of them.{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}What can I do to make mine last forever? Is it even possible? Is it a greedy request?{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}Some people say that all good things come to an end.{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}I don't want to accept that!{/i}
label: day1

text: {i}That's why I'll take the chance to find a way to keep all of my greatest memories!{/i}
label: day1

speaker: Natsumi
text: Of course! You might need your own sash soon too, Keitaro!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Congratulations! You two are the first to complete the badge-earning activity today!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I hope you two had fun while doing it!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: We sure did! Right, Natsumi?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Y-Yeah…!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I think everyone else should be finished with their activities by now! I’ll just go and check up on them!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Aiden is already cooking dinner as well, so you boys are free to relax until then!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, if you want, sir, I can go and help Sir Aiden cook! I’m sure he could use a hand with all the prepwork!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Excellent idea, Natsumi! I’m actually in a bit of a rush to conclude the activity because Aiden is expecting me to help him tonight.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don’t mind covering for you, sir!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I knew I could count on you, Natsumi!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, sir! I won’t let you down!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now, if you don’t mind, I’ll take my leave now and make sure everyone’s back in time for dinner! See you boys later!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro, I know what you're gonna say, but I promise I’m not feeling tired at all this time!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, haha! I wasn’t gonna say anything! I really don’t mind helping Sir Aiden with cooking dinner~!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Eh? You’re gonna help too, Keitaro?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, Natsumi. I don't have anything else to do right now, and I'm not tired yet either.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Phew… I was so worried you’d think I was overworking again.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, you did tell me you were trying to find some balance this morning~ So, I understand.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Besides, we just had a really relaxing time taking photos in the woods together.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Now, let’s go and help Sir Aiden out!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Alright!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Reporting for duty, sir!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa! You two finished with your activity already?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, sir! Keitaro and I were hoping could help you a little with preparing dinner!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Usually, I'd turn you boys down on that offer, but I really do need a few helping hands with tonight’s dish!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, what are you cooking, sir?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Beef and potato stew~! I figured it’d be nice to have something special for tonight!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wahhh~ That sounds really yummy!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: I know, right? Though, I’ve only just started cutting up the meat, and there’s still a lot of the vegetables I haven’t even prepped yet.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can help you with the cutting, sir!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Hehe, I won’t say no to that~
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, and it doesn't look like there's a campfire yet, sir! I can light one up for you!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Sure thing, buddy! That’d be really helpful!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro, there’s some firewood Scoutmaster Yoshi and I gathered this morning around the scoutmaster's tent. You can just use those!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright, Natsumi!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Hey, are you sure you’re not pushing yourself again with these chores, dude?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, not at all, sir! I got to relax doing the badge-earning activity today, so I’m not too tired at all.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Haha, that doesn’t sound like you at all, Natsumi! But I have kinda noticed you've learned to loosen up a little ever since you and Keitaro started getting close.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Ah, really, sir…? I hope that’s not a bad thing…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Of course not!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: It's just always been kinda strange to me how busy you always are with chores around the camp! You’re basically camp staff by now!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-Well, it’s nothing compared to all the tasks you’re in charge of here at camp, sir!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, that’s because it’s my job! They hired me for that!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Your job as a scout is to enjoy your stay here with us~
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah…! It's just I get so inspired seeing you fulfill your duties all the time no matter how hard it gets, sir.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: You're my role model when it comes to hard work!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Oho~ So, I’m a ‘model’ now too?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, sir! Sometimes, I just can’t help but wonder how you can stay motivated for so long and work so hard…!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, if there's one thing I can say for sure, it's that I love seeing people smile when they enjoy what I've worked hard for!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Some people might think I’m just doing this because this is my job, but that’s not it at all!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: I do it because I love doing it! It makes me and the people around me happy!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: I think that’s the main reason I enjoy my work here so much!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: It's gotta be why you do it too, right, Natsumi?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ve got the firewood, sir!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Ah, great! Natsumi and I just finished chopping up the veggies~
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: You two can set up the fire while I season the meat!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hehe~ Let’s get this campfire started!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: R-Right…!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I noticed Natsumi was a little quiet while we were preparing the campfire together, and I wondered if something was on his mind.{/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}As soon as everything was ready, Sir Aiden began cooking while Natsumi and I prepared the dining area.{/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Once we were finally done, everyone was called to dinner and we all ate Sir Aiden's delicious stew by the warm fireside.{/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: *BUUUUUUURRRRRP*
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! Finally some good food! Buttcheeks really hit the spot with this beef stew!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey, yesterday’s barbecue was just as good, Wolfboy! Can't you just say you like the food?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Weren’t you listening, Torch-head? How is that not a compliment?!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: *sigh* Let’s talk about something else before these two start arguing again…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, that’s right, guys! It's about time we show the badges we got! Let’s start with Hunter!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, me?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I got the art badge in my activity. I thought it would be nice to try and sketch up the ocean scenery!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, wow! I didn’t know you could draw, Hunter.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Ahh well, I’ve been doing it ever since I was a kid…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, I do see Hunter scribbling sometimes in the corner. I actually thought he was just writing then.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: So, you think you guys are the only ones with talent, huh~? Well, check this out!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You mean this stupid muscle badge Sheriff Brokeback gave us?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: H-Hey! You totally ruined my surprise, you stupid Wolfboy!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Huh? Yoichi and Hiro went for the same badge?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-Wait! Yoichi actually tried to join an activity?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: After all these camps terms, this is actually the first time I’ve ever seen you earn a badge!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey! It’s not like I got it ‘cuz I wanted to! I was just working out when Sheriff saw me and gave me this dumb piece of cloth.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: And stupid Torch-head here kept bugging me to help him earn it too!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey! I asked nicely, Wolfboy! Besides, when Keitaro said we’d show our badges after, I knew I had to surprise him with something!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, I kinda expected you’d go for the cooking badge, Hiro. I was surprised you weren’t with Sir Aiden a while ago.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: See? No one saw it coming. You probably went for the photography badge, right Keitaro?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, yes I did! In fact, Natsumi and I earned it together!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, wow! I didn’t expect Natsumi to try and earn the same badge.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I already have most of the badges, Hiro… So I wanted to earn something new! And I've never really tried photography before.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s a good thing Keitaro was there to guide me!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! I have to admit, though, I kinda got carried away taking so many photos!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh! Can we see them, you guys?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure, Hunter! They’re in my camera bag! I can show them to you guys tomorrow when the sun's up!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: And it’s almost curfew too. We should probably head to the tents and get some rest!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Well, I am kinda tired from working my muscles out today~
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Heh. What muscles?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Shut up, Wolfboy!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, alright, guys. Let's turn in.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Huh? Hold on, everyone… Is that Taiga coming out from our tent?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: What was he doing in there…?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh, uh… Hi, guys!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: What were you doing in our tent, Taiga?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: You must be up to something again!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: N-No! Of course not…! We’re all friends now, remember?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I was actually just looking for you guys… I figured you’d be in your tent still.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh really?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Well, we’re here! So what did you want to talk about?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I… um…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Actually, I wanted to talk to Keitaro alone if that’s alright…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… Me?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s just… I’ve been thinking a lot about what you said during the sportsfest…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: About how we should just be friends, and start over…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I think… you were right. We did get off on the wrong foot…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Do you think we could really start over?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: R-Really? Of course, that’s all I wanted from the start! I knew we could be friends!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: T-Thanks, Keitaro. I’ll see you guys around then.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… Are you sure you don’t wanna talk some more?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: N-No! It’s alright…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: R-Right! See you later, Taiga!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: That was… unexpected.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph! Something really, really feels off about him!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: That’s what I’ve been telling y’all. That little twerp is obviously up to something.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s true that it seems odd that Taiga would change his attitude so drastically…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, maybe Taiga is just adjusting to us being friends!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m just glad that Taiga said that – I think we can really get to be friends now!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Are you sure, Keitaro…?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes! We just have to forget about the past! Taiga deserves a second chance, after all!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I guess Keitaro’s right! There’s no reason to harbor any more bad feelings if Taiga really is sorry for what he did.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Of course YOU’D say that, Mr. Perfect.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: At any rate, it's already curfew for us. We should head inside the tent before the scoutmasters catch us.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s really nice that Taiga and I were finally able to be friends!{/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I was worried after the way he acted at the sports festival that he wouldn’t change…{/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But I’m glad he was able to let go of the past! {/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Now, I just need to let it go as well, and we can all move forward!{/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmm… For some reason, I’m not sleepy yet.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: And it’s actually much warmer and cozier tonight.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, summer weather's really weird, huh Hunter?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Gah! I can’t sleep like this!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Y-Yoichi…! Why are you stripping down?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: 'Cuz it's too hot to sleep in clothes! Duh!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Eew! Get away from me, Wolfboy! You’re so sticky!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You guys already pushed me to the freakin’ corner here! You move!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Well, it’s still a little early to sleep anyway…. Do you guys wanna do anything else? Like play a game or something?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmm… I kinda wanna go outside again to get a little fresh air. My tummy’s still rumbling from all that beef stew.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah. I'll do anything to get out of this tent. I'll even play with Torch-head!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Guys, we can't go outside. It’s already way past curfew, and we can't just disobey one of the few rules Sir Goro set for us here.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: GAH! Curfew, schmurfew! Who even invented that lame idea, anyway?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, it’s for our own safety, Yoichi! We can’t compromise our health or have campers suddenly missing at night.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: If you’re really that bored, we can just write in Keitaro’s journal together just like the other night!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh! No thanks! That sounds even more boring.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: How about we take a look at all the photos Keitaro’s taken for the vacation so far? That should be interesting!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Hmm… But Keitaro said that it’s better to look at them once the sun's up for better light.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah~ We can do that first thing in the morning! They're all just in my camera bag anyway~
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* I guess we just gotta stay in here, then. Keitaro, pull out your journal and-
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hey, campers!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh! Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I hope you guys still have some spare energy left! ‘Cuz we’re gonna have a little activity tonight for a job well done these past two days!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Is that why you're still in swimwear, sir?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Haha, well I wanted to invite you boys for a little night swimming! The waves are calm and the sky is so starry and clear!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And I just thought it’d be nice to have a little late-night fun!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, wow! That sounds awesome! Count me in!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! Who knew you could be cool for once, Sheriff Brokeback?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I think it'd be great to get some fresh air tonight too.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: H-Hold on, Scoutmaster Yoshi… Didn’t Sir Goro tell us night swimming wasn’t allowed?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-And it’s way past curfew as well…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, it’ll be our little secret! Besides, it’s just the few of us~!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Are you sure about this, Scoutmaster Yoshi? W-We might get in a lot of trouble!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Natsumi, if you’re worried about safety, please don’t. I will personally keep my eye on all of you while you guys have fun!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And besides, Aiden and Yuri said they’d be stalling Sir Goro for the time being~
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: This is going to be fun, so come on! I’ll wait for you boys outside!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Man, this is exactly what I need! I can't wait to take a dip right now!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hehe, me too, Wolfboy! Wanna race me to the water? Last one there's a rotten egg!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, you're on, Torch-head! No way are you getting the first cannonball!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: H-Hey! Wait for me, guys…!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Come on, Natsumi! It’ll be okay! Scoutmaster Yoshi is gonna be there to keep watch!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh* Alright… Let’s go get prepared, I guess.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! I should take pictures too! Let me just get my camera!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hmm… I can’t find my camera bag. Do you see it over there, Natsumi?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Umm… no, Keitaro. But I’m sure it’s just in here somewhere.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Besides, it might not be a good idea to bring that out.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I mean we’re already bending the rules a little too much now. The flashes from your camera might catch Sir Goro’s attention and get us all in trouble.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oops, you’re right about that, Natsumi. And besides, we’ll be swimming anyway! What was I thinking? Haha!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s just get changed and catch up with everyone!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ahh~! The evening breeze is so nice!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good evening, Keitaro! Aren’t you gonna join us for the swim?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, Scoutmaster Yoshi! I was about to. I was just enjoying the evening breeze for a minute!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It's just been really warm tonight. And I've been watching these calm waves for a while.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s exactly why I figured this was the perfect time for it. I made sure to check the tide schedule and the weather before inviting you all out.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, looks like you really prepared for this, sir. As usual!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Of course! Like I said a while ago, I really wanted to spend time with you boys!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know this might sound a little strange, but I am reminded a lot of my own experiences here from Camp Buddy by you and your friends.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I've felt something reignite in me as a scoutmaster ever since we had that talk before the sportsfest.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So, I really want to make sure I thank you for that.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, it’s no problem at all, sir. I was just there to help you however I could.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Haha, that’s right! You’ve been one of the few people I can trust with these kinds of things.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And speaking of, I've actually noticed that you and Natsumi have gotten much closer recently as well.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, yes, sir. It’s been really fun hanging out with him!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s honestly really surprising to see him so relaxed and simply enjoying his time with everyone. He was never like that in any of the previous terms...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: For the longest time, Natsumi has only really been focused on doing his best as a scout and always working tirelessly to impress everyone here at camp.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sometimes it really concerns me why he tries so hard... but as his scoutmaster, I have to support that kind of high-achieving character not just because it's productive...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But also because it seems to be what makes his experience here in camp complete!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh…? W-What do you mean, Scoutmaster Yoshi?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah! Don’t worry about it, Keitaro. I just blurt things out sometimes! You’re one of the few people I can talk about things like this with, after all.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Not only do you have a way with words, but you’re also a great listener too – Maybe one day you could become a scoutmaster like me!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’ll gladly pass the Camp Buddy torch to you when the time comes!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah! I don’t think I’m capable of following in your footsteps, Scoutmaster Yoshi… But I’m really honored to hear that from you.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But I really do mean it, Keitaro! You’ve helped me sort out my frustrations before, and now you’re helping your fellow campers too!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You truly are a model scout!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you, Scoutmaster Yoshi… I don’t think I deserve all this praise, though...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Of course, you do!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can't just let your efforts go unnoticed when you've done so much for both Natsumi and me.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Speaking of which, where is Natsumi right now, Keitaro? I'd thought he'd be with you.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, he's just by the seaside over there, trying to take in the breeze too, sir. He looked a little concerned earlier, so I decided to stick by and do the same.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, maybe you can fetch him for me. I'm sure a good night's swim will help clear his head of all his troubles.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I'll see you two in the water, alright? I'll just go check on Hiro and Yoichi to make sure they're not playing too rough.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright, sir!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Ah… There he is.){/i}
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hey there, Natsumi! Aren’t you gonna join in?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, it’s alright, Keitaro. I’m not really in the mood to swim for tonight.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Are you still worried about us getting in trouble for night swimming…?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Actually, yeah…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: …I’m kinda scared Sir Goro might see us at any moment.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-Is that why you’re hiding here?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: H-Haha… You really know how to read me, Keitaro…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, you can tell me what you’re thinking, and I’ll listen…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I just wonder why Scoutmaster Yoshi would break the few simple rules Sir Goro set over something like this…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: …up to the point that he made the other scoutmasters stall Sir Goro for him.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Doesn’t it bother you that Scoutmaster Yoshi is the one who always tells us to follow the rules, but decides to break them now?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well… we’ve always followed Scoutmaster Yoshi because we know he has his reasons.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sure he just wants to spend time with us and show that he can have fun too…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s kind of like how you hung out with us instead of doing chores, when you learned to relax a little.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I see…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But I do get why you feel that way, though...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: When I first joined camp, I always thought of Scoutmaster Yoshi as someone who always stuck to the rules no matter what.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But as the days went by, I slowly realized there was more to him than a leader we needed to follow. He was a person who had his own flaws too…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: And that’s perfectly fine! In fact, I respect him much more because of it!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Natsumi…?
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m so sorry, Keitaro… But I’m just so confused right now…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I mean, over the past few days of this vacation, there were so many times I needed to readjust myself…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I was overthinking… I was trying to follow rules too much… and now, I’m making a big deal over something so simple…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I feel like I’m going in circles because there’s no way I can keep things balanced…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: And I know it’s even more frustrating for you and everyone else to have to keep telling me to relax or not overthink things…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s really made me think about why I work this hard and why I’m so strict with myself in the first place….
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s really made me think about why I work this hard and why I’m so strict with myself in the first place….{fast}
label: day17_natsumi

text: Only you can answer that, Natsumi...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Only you can answer that, Natsumi…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro…
label: day17_natsumi

text: You must have a reason too...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sure you have your reasons, Natsumi… You probably just don’t know what they are yet…
label: day17_natsumi

text: I don't know either...
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m not sure either, Natsumi…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s something I have to figure out on my own, huh…?
label: day17_natsumi

text: There's no use thinking about it even more.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think there’s any point in thinking about it, Natsumi.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Look. You may not have the answers now, but that doesn’t mean you’re not trying hard enough…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Some things just take time to figure out… You shouldn’t be so hard on yourself.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: What you’re feeling right now is normal…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But I want you to realize that these moments are all a part of learning more about yourself.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh*
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don’t know how you never get tired of dealing with me, Keitaro…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: But, I really appreciate you listening to me and trying to give me advice…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, Natsumi. I’ll always be here for you to help you out.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: And I’m sure I’ll figure it out as long as I keep trying, just like you said…
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s right! We just keep at it together!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: If you want, you could always take your mind off things by helping me write in my journal.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I think that’s a good idea, Keitaro.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Great! Let me just go get it from the tent really quick and we can start writing right here.
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Sure thing!
label: day17_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah! There you are, you two!
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I was getting worried you two might’ve wandered off!
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh, we were just enjoying the breeze, sir!
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, the weather has gotten a bit colder, so I decided to cut our night swimming short and let you all get back to your tents before anyone catches a cold!
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, looks like we ended up not swimming at all, huh Natsumi?
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Ah, yeah…
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, you two looked like you had a relaxing time over here, at least! That’s what matters!
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thanks again for letting me spend time with you, boys!
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Once everyone quietly dried off from the swim, we all headed back to our tents for a goodnight’s rest.{/i}
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}My talk with Natsumi left him and I with a lot of things to think about…{/i}
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I know he’s still confused, but I just have to make sure I help him through it whenever I can…{/i}
label: day17natsumi_afterjournal

speaker: Goro
text: Alright, now that everyone’s here, I want a full report on the trip so far. Yuri, I hope you’re making sure we’re on schedule and following our itinerary well.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Yup! All is good and on schedule! It seems like the campers are handling themselves really well, and I don’t foresee any delays!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Good. Aiden, how about the supplies? Do we have enough for another day before we return to camp?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Yep! I’ve double-checked, and we’ve got plenty of food and water for one more night, and it’s all been packed and prepped!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Excellent. That just leaves the disassembly of the tents for our next trip. I want you to oversee that, Aiden.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, in the meantime, I want you to wake the scouts up and tell them to prepare.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Kyaa, I’m so excited! It’s been so long since we’ve been ‘there!’
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Me too! I'm surprised you wanted to go somewhere special like this, Gramps! Are you going soft on us?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: What did I tell you about calling me Gramps?! You both have your assignments, now get to it!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Hahaha! Yes, sir!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Alright, now that’s out of the way, I want to hear the report on your matter, Yoshinori.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Yoshinori?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah…!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Are you alright? It’s unlike you to be lost in your thoughts.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I-I’m fine, sir!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Hmmm… We have a lot in store today and I'll need you to be in your best shape.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Understood, sir!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Now let’s go on to your report. Since Yuri is in charge of scheduling and Aiden is on supplies, I need to hear your update about the campers.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-Well, everything is in order, sir! I’ll supervise the scouts extra strictly today to make sure nothing unplanned happens.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: What about Mr. Akatora? I still have concerns about his recent behavior since the sportsfest, and I wanted to know if he’s improved since then.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-You have nothing to worry about, sir! I’ve been personally seeing to his improvements!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Even yesterday, I made sure that he and Keitaro engaged in a team-building activity together, which they both succeeded in!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Excellent. I’m glad to hear that you’re taking care of the scouts, Yoshinori. I would like you to pay closer attention to him, however, just in case.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I don’t want any incidents on this trip. We are headed to a very special destination in Camp Buddy’s history, after all.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yes, sir! You can count on me!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: That’s what I like to hear from you.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Anyway, I’m really thrilled that you decided to take the campers to that spot, sir!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Haha, well we’ve all made many memories ‘there’. I would like these scouts to have the opportunity to make some of their own.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m glad to know that you believe the scouts have earned a trip like this!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: It’s not just for the scouts, Yoshinori, it’s for you as well.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: E-Eh? What do you mean, sir?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve been observing the way you interact with them since the sportsfest. You're doing an excellent job of creating engaging activities, and getting the most stubborn campers to participate.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: In addition, there have been no behavior incidents since the sportsfest, and I believe I have your efforts to thank for that.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: T-Thank you, sir! It’s my duty! I’ll keep doing my best to not let you down!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Good. For now, you can assist Aiden and Yuri with the departure preparations, as well as make an announcement to the scouts. I’m counting on you, Yoshinori!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yes, sir!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Good morning, boys~ It’s time to wake up!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hnnn… Ms. Yuri?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Ughh… It’s only like… 7:00 AM…
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Well, we have a special announcement for you boys! Hihihi~
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: I need you four to get dressed and assemble right away! Your scoutmasters will be waiting for you!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Huh, another announcement? I wonder what it could be!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Do you guys think it’ll be another activity?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Ugh, I hope not! These scoutmasters don’t know the meaning of vacation!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Indeed! They seem to be filling our trip with various interruptions as best they can.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, what do you think, Taiga?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(It seems like Taiga’s still a little upset about last night…){/i}
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: U-Umm… A-Anyway, I guess we should get dressed like Ms. Yuri said!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga, do you want me to get your uniform out for you?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Don’t bother, I got it.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: R-Right…!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Hmm… Taiga seems to be in distress again.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: What did you do this time, brunette?!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I didn’t do anything, I swear…!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Liar. You definitely know something, at least.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Keitaro seems to be telling the truth, Ed. Taiga would usually act hostile if he were angry at Keitaro.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Right now, he just appears to be melancholy. For reasons unknown.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: *sigh* I wish he’d just tell us what’s bothering him though… He’s been in a mood way more often lately!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-If you guys want, maybe I can try and talk to him about it…
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Don’t even attempt to. One wrong move and we will all be subjected to his wrath.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Like, yeah~ Talking about problems was never an option with Taiga.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Indeed. I am not attempting to be a pessimist, but Taiga has always been a closed book.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Alas, if only I dabbled in the field of psychology, I might be able to properly diagnose what is going on in his mind based on his behavior.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, we’re his friends too, you know? He should let us help him some too!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Hmmm... It is futile to wish for Taiga to seek our aid. We must maintain an open door for him, however, should the rare opportunity ever arise.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Oh well, I guess let’s just get dressed. Who knows, maybe today’s announcement will distract him.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Good morning, Keitaro!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh, hey guys…!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ms. Yuri told us there was some kind of announcement! Isn’t that exciting?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch, only if you didn’t want to sleep today. Why the hell does everything have to be so early in the morning?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, quit being a killjoy, Wolfboy! Ms. Yuri sounded super excited, so whatever it is must be something good!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Seriously? With that crazy lady involved, I bet it’s something creepy.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Do you have any idea what the announcement’s about, Keitaro?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh, not really, no…
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Hmm? Is everything alright, Keitaro?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, yeah…! I’m sorry, I’m just a little distracted today…
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Lemme guess, that little twerp did something to you again?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Wah! What did he do this time, Keitaro?!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s nothing like that at all, guys!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Attention!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Ah, that’s Scoutmaster Yoshi! Sorry, everyone, let’s pay attention for a moment!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, campers! Thank you all for getting up and ready so quickly!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’re sorry we had to wake you up so early again, but we, your scoutmasters, have prepared yet another special activity today!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know that all of you are thinking this was a vacation, but we assure you that this trip is part of it!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s right! Our trip has been extended by an extra day, and this time to a very special location!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: In the past, many scouts of Camp Buddy have visited this place and explored it during their time here, and it holds a special place in all of their hearts, including my own!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: The destination is deep in the forest, and once we’ve arrived there, we will camp for the night! As soon as we’re finished with the disassembly of the tents, we’ll head out immediately!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guarantee that none of you will be disappointed, so get excited, campers! Pack your things, and Sir Aiden will be there to assist you if needed!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Dismissed!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, wow! A secret destination! I wonder what it could be?!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Well, Scoutmaster Yoshi said that it’s somewhere that holds a special place in their hearts… Maybe it’s a traditional camping site?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Natsumi, do you know? You’ve been a scout here for years.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: I actually have no idea… All the past terms I’ve been here, we’ve never done anything like this.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Maybe Yoichi knows? He’s been here longer than me.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Don’t ask me. I don’t know what these scoutmasters are talking about.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Geez, you’re no help. Have you slept through every trip they’ve taken?!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: As if any of you are better!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: O-Oh! It seems Taiga has taken the initiative to begin disassembling our tent already!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Yeah, let’s go. I’m done hearing these dweebs fawn over this trip. We are NOT getting left behind here.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, sure thing! I can come and help right away!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll see you guys later, okay?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* There he goes again… Keitaro’s really got no time for us now…
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, Scoutmaster Yoshi did order us to take down the tents… It’s only natural that Keitaro would help disassemble the one he stayed in!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, whatever you have to tell yourself, Mr. Perfect. We all know that redhead has him on a tight leash.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Taiga was pretty quiet today, though… He didn’t get angry when we were chatting with Keitaro.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Maybe he won’t mind if Keitaro walks to this place with us?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Save it, Twinkerbell. I already know what he’s gonna say: “TrUsT Me GuYS, hE’s different nOw BlAh~ NyEhH~”
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, I can totally see Keitaro saying that… Minus Wolfboy’s annoying voice...
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Y-You guys might get mad at me for saying this, but I actually think Keitaro’s plan is working now…
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: When I reported to Scoutmaster Yoshi for my badge activity yesterday, he mentioned that Keitaro and Taiga earned their badges together!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh yeah... Maybe Keitaro’s really making progress with Taiga this time?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: And you two seriously took Sheriff Brokeback’s word for it? For all we know, he just made that up to save face.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Even if that’s true, I still can’t forgive Taiga for how crappy he’s been treating Keitaro since camp started!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: I swear, sooner or later Keitaro is gonna get hurt if we don’t separate them!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Hiro… Yoichi… Don’t you think maybe we’re overreacting about this…?
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Keitaro seemed fine the last couple days… And I’m sure he’d ask us for help if Taiga was doing something bad…
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: And besides, we already did our part by letting Scoutmaster Yoshi know… That seemed to work yesterday since Keitaro and Taiga were able to accomplish something together.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s right! Scoutmaster Yoshi has everything under control!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, you guys should think positively like Hunter!
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Fine, but don’t say I didn’t warn you when this blows up.
label: day17_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Anyway, let’s take down our tent and get packed up! We have an exciting adventure coming up~!

label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yuki isn’t just some pet to me… She’s family…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Both of us have come a long way, after all…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: A long time ago, Yuki and I met each other on the streets during a rainy day…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: She was in a box, all cold and alone… I couldn’t believe that someone would abandon something so small and helpless like that…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: But despite all of that, she just seemed so happy to see me… She was shivering, but her tail kept wagging at the sight of me…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: When she looked at me with those loving eyes, I felt a connection between the two of us… I just had to take her with me!
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: After just a short time, Yuki became my best and only friend. We depended on each other to survive.
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I doubt you’ll believe it, but Yuki is a serious prankster too!
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: She would always distract a vendor with those cute puppy eyes of hers, while I snatched some food for both of us!
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Even the one time I got caught, Yuki showed up and saved the day!
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: We’d been living like that for as long as I could remember…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Spending our nights in dark alleys, trying to get by as much as we can…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m so thankful that I have her by my side…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Until one day, I met that stupid scoutmaster… and he offered me a place to stay here at Camp Buddy…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Hearing Yoichi’s story, things have started to make more sense…){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I now understand what Scoutmaster Yoshi meant when he told me how Yoichi had a rough childhood that led him to take Yoichi in…){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But then… all this new information just makes me want to know more…){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But then… all this new information just makes me want to know more…){fast}{/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

text: Ask about his family.
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: B-But… where is your family, Yoichi? Did you run away from home?
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah… I’m sorry… I shouldn’t have asked that…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

text: Ask about his home.
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: B-But... why were you living in the streets in the first place? Didn’t you have a home?
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah… I’m sorry… I shouldn’t have asked that…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

text: Don't ask more.
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(That’s right… I should be more patient…){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(This isn’t the time to be asking him more. I’m sure all my questions about him will be answered someday…){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

text: I've heard more than enough.
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(That’s right… I should be grateful that Yoichi was willing to tell me what he did.){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’m sure all my questions about him will be answered someday…){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you for telling me all of that, Yoichi…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I haven’t told that to anyone else, you know…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I guess it kinda feels good to have someone to talk and listen like this…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Nobody has had the patience to handle me like you do…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Everyone usually gives up on me… but not you.
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But really, Yoichi. I’m just glad to hear you being true to yourself like this…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thanks to that, I really understand now why Yuki is special to you!
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: W-Well… You know, you’re kind of special to me now too…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Y-Yoichi…){/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Just saying it didn’t seem like enough…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: So listen… You better not leave me, alright?
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I won’t, Yoichi… I promise…
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Yoichi really is an unpredictable person… I can never completely tell what’s going on in that head of his…{/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}His past really was heartbreaking to hear, though… I didn’t know that he had gone through something like that…{/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}The fact that he was willing to tell me all of that means he must really trust me…{/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m so happy to know that I’m special in his eyes…{/i}
label: day17_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: *pant* *pant*
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: H-Here, Hunter… Have some water.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Thank you, Natsumi.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: If you’re tired, you can go back.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: N-No, sir… I’m alright…! I want to keep searching… I’m not going to give up until we find them…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Why would you boys go to these lengths to look for those troublemakers?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Again?! You’ve already asked that question three times, old man!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: They are not troublemakers, sir… They’re our friends… We know they’d never do something like that, especially to you, sir.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: I agree… We wouldn’t try to defend them so much if we didn’t believe that they were innocent…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Even if those boys were innocent, they still should have never ran away. Hiro's behavior was unacceptable as well!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Hiro was just protecting Keitaro from all of the accusations… He's that willing to fight for the sake of his friend…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Give us a break! We’re just telling the truth.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Don’t believe us if you don’t want to!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: C-Calm down, Yoichi... We won't accomplish anything if we just stay here arguing...
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Hmph. We are indeed wasting our time just standing here talking. Let's move.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: *sigh* I hope those two are okay…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: D-Don’t lose hope, Aiden! I have faith that Keitaro and Hiro will use what they’ve learned and stay safe in this kind of situation—
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Yoshi, look over there!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah! Sir Goro?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa! Don’t tell me you guys have been searching for them too?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, we are. This is a grave situation; we can’t afford to risk anyone’s safety.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: And it is only natural that I assist with the search, as I am partly responsible for this.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: What’s the progress of your pursuit?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’ve already searched the entire beach area. I am certain that they have not returned there after they ran off yesterday.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: While our team has searched all around the outskirts of Camp Buddy and the nearby forest...
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: The results are the same, unfortunately.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh no… Where else could we search for them then..?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Don’t fret. This field is the only passage that leads to Camp Buddy.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And assuming they’ve set up a camp… they couldn’t be anywhere else but the woods nearby the beach.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: When the sun comes up, they will continue making their way back to camp, and they can only end up either reaching this field or the beach.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: That makes perfect sense! When you and I began our search, we went straight ahead to the beach. We barely went around the woods before it, so it’s highly likely we’ll find them there!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now with more people searching, we’re definitely going to find them faster! Let’s split up!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Wait a minute, we can’t just leave! We need to have a plan!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m well aware of the situation, sir! My plan is to form three groups, with each group accompanied by a supervisor to avoid letting anyone else get lost.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: The first group will stay here in the fields on the lookout in case Keitaro or Hiro come this way.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hunter and I would like to volunteer for that group, sir.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: I agree… I’m not the most fit, so I might just slow a search party down if I try to go with one…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: You can count on me, sir! I’ll make sure we don’t move until all the groups are together again!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Very well then! The two of you will remain here and stay on the lookout.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Next we need a group to head to the beach. We can’t ignore the possibility that the two of them will have tried to go back where they last saw us.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: This will likely be the most difficult task, since the beach is a long hike from here.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: I can do that, no problem. I can try and track their scent along the way too.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s great, Yoichi! But I can’t let you go there alone. Aiden, would you—
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: I’ll go with him.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: S-Sir…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: I assume that your third plan is for someone to search within the forest while both ends of the path are blocked?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: R-Right…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: You’ll need all the strength you can get in that task. I believe you should be assisted by the most physically fit of us.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Sounds like that’s my cue~!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: U-Understood, sir! Aiden, you’ll be coming with me again then!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Oho! Now you’re sounding like a real scoutmaster, Gramps!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Stop. Calling me. Gramps.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: If we don't find them by sunrise, let's all meet back here in the fields.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Okay, now that we all know what needs to be done, let’s split up and find them! Good luck everyone!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: You heard the man! Let’s go!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: All
text: Yes, sir!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn* It’s morning already…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: And we’re still stuck here…
label: day18_hiro

text: Hiroooo!! Keitarooooo!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Huh? Am I hearing things?
label: day18_hiro

text: Little chef!! Can you hear me?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Those voices! Hiro!! Wake up!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: H-Huh…? What is it Keitaro?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I think I hear someone!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: R-Really?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: HEEEEY! WE’RE DOWN HERE!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: HELLOOOO!! WE’RE RIGHT OVER HERE!!!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Yoshi, did you hear that?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yeah! I think so!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Keitaro, Hiro!! If you can hear us, stay where you are! We’re coming for you!!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Be careful, Scoutmaster Yoshi! There’s a pit nearby! That’s where we are!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah! Here, Aiden! I think they fell down this hole!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa! How did you two end up down there?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Keitaro, Hiro! Are you two alright down there?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yes, we are, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Thank goodness you found us!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hold on, you two! We’re going to fetch you guys!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Aiden, can you climb down?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: I think so… Here, let me tie this rope around my waist. Hold on to the other end, will you?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Of course! Be careful down there, Aiden!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Right!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Good lord! How the heck did you two end up in a place like this?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I-It was my fault, bro… I wasn’t watching where I was running.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro tried to stop us both from falling but we had nothing to hold on to.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m so sorry… It’s because of me that you guys are all so worried…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Save those tears for later! What matters is that you two are safe now, okay?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Are you two injured? Can you walk?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: We’re not hurt at all, sir!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah! Nothing more than a few scrapes and bruises!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Good to hear that! Let’s get you two out of here, then!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: One at a time though, we don’t want to snap the rope, and all end up stuck down here!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank goodness, we were able to find you two! Are you both alright?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yes sir, we’re okay! I don’t think either of us is hurt!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you so much for rescuing us!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: We really thought that you guys wouldn’t be able to find us!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Don’t mention it, Keitaro. It’s our duty.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m sorry, Scoutmaster Yoshi! This wouldn’t have happened if I didn’t run off like that in the first place...!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Don’t worry about that, Hiro. What’s important is that the two of you are safe now.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Thankfully, your buddies all came out to search as well, so we were able to spread out our search more.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Natsumi, Hunter and Yoichi are helping look for us too?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah! Even Gramps was looking for you guys too! I’m sure he was worried sick – they’ll all be so relieved to see you both safe!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, if you two are both okay to walk, we should head back to camp! We can meet up with Sir Goro and the others on the way back!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m so glad Sir Aiden and Scoutmaster Yoshi were able to find us… I was really worried we’d be stuck in that hole for a while!{/i}
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}We started heading to the fields as soon as Scoutmaster Yoshi made sure Hiro and I could walk properly.{/i}
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}On the way there, I heard Scoutmaster Yoshi call Sir Goro on his cellphone... I guess they were all out looking too.{/i}
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Before long, the fields were in sight... I could see Sir Goro in the distance.{/i}
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I couldn’t help but be a little bit scared about what he would say…{/i}
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Look who we found trapped in a hole in the ground!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Hiro! Keitaro!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: F-Finally! I’m glad that you two are okay! We were so worried!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: WHAT THE HELL WERE YOU TWO IDIOTS THINKING?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: WE HAD TO SEARCH FOR YOU ALL NIGHT LONG BECAUSE YOU RAN AWAY LIKE LITTLE BABIES!!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Are you two injured at all?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: No, we’re really fine, Natsumi!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: HEY!! I WASN’T DONE SCOLDING THEM!!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now, now, Yoichi. Save it for later.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: These two must be exhausted! Come on, let’s get you both back to camp!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We need to attend to those injuries, get you something to eat, and get you two some proper rest!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Everyone… thank you so much…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Save your strength, Keitaro! We still have some more walking to do!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now all of you follow me this way!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Sir Goro..!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I’m sorry… I know we’ve caused you so much trouble…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I really didn’t mean to cause a huge fuss…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: It was really just an accident—
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Nevermind that. Just get yourself back to camp now.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: We can discuss it when we get there.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}And so, all of us marched back to Camp Buddy.{/i}
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I was surprised that Sir Goro came along to search for us despite what happened…{/i}
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: Keitaro! Hiro!! Oh, thank goodness! You’re both alright!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Scoutmaster Yuri!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: We’re really sorry, Ms. Yuri… We didn’t mean to make you worry so much…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: Don’t worry about it at all! I’m just so happy to see you both again!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Aiden, Yuri, I’d like you to help me prepare their food and lodging! These two must really be exhausted.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Gotcha!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: We’ll help prepare the cabin, sir!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Of course!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: Let’s all meet inside, everyone!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: As for you, Mr. Nagame and Mr. Akiba…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: I’d like you two to come to my office immediately.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh no…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: S-Sir Goro is probably still mad at us…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m worried he’ll just pin my mistakes on you, Keitaro…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t say that, Hiro! It’s my fault too. You don’t need to take all the blame on yourself!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Come on, we need to go see Sir Goro now. We can’t keep him waiting.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh*
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Do you two realize how much trouble you’ve caused us all? We were out all night looking for you!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: We’re really sorry, sir…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: M-Me too… This is all my fault, after all…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-Hiro…!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Sorry? Is that all you have to say?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Will your apology make up for how worried you made your friends and your scoutmasters?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Well?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: W-We didn’t mean to do it. We actually got lost and fell in the—
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: You're still trying to reason out your mistake?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: None of these things would’ve happened if you two hadn’t ran off in the first place!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* What am I going to do with the both of you…?
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: At this rate I’ll have no choice but to terminate your stay here at Camp Buddy.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: This is going nowhere. Go back to your cabins. I will need some time to think what punishment is best suited for you two.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro & Hiro
text: Yes, sir.
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Whew… Sir Goro is really scary…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m so sorry, Keitaro. This is all my fault…
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Huh? No, Hiro! Why do you keep saying it’s your fault?!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: If anything, I should be the one to blame for all of this..! None of this would’ve happened if that picture didn’t exist in the first place!
label: day18_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: N-No, Keitaro! Not about that, what I mean is… about this camp.

text: Hmm… I suppose we were incorrect in our assumptions that Taiga was getting along less with Keitaro than before.

text: The two of them have been spending a great deal of time together. And admittedly, even I have begun to enjoy Keitaro’s companionship.

text: I guess when you put it that way… I’m not as grossed out by Keitaro as I used to be either.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Either way, this change is purely for our benefit. I would much prefer to enjoy my time here with Taiga as opposed to planning complex revenge schemes.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: *sigh* That’s true.…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Eugh… I can’t wait to go back to Camp Buddy to just process all of this.
label: day18_taiga
