speaker: Goro
text: Welcome back to Camp Buddy, scouts! I hope you all enjoyed this vacation!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I am extremely proud of all of you for your good behavior. There were no major rule incidents during the entire trip, and everyone managed to get along well.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: In addition, both the beach and the falls were left in pristine condition, as I ordered. You have all done a great job and can take the rest of the day off to rest!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Yoshinori?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah, yes sir?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Would you like to say anything?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah, no sir!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Okay, then you’re all dismissed! We’ll see you tomorrow for another activity! Thank you again, and I am proud of you for not causing a fuss.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: …Alright. Now, scoutmasters, I need to speak with you all for a trip debriefing. Let’s head back to my office.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: …For the next item… Yuri, the itinerary you created for the trip worked perfectly. There was never a concern that we would run out of time for an activity or be late to a destination.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Hehe, thank you, Dad~
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Meanwhile, I am impressed with how well you managed to keep the scouts fed and the beach clean, Aiden. You performed above expectations.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Aww, thanks, Gramps! I could get used to compliments like that from you!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Will you stop calling me that godforsaken nickname?! I’m still plenty youthful, you know!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *ahem* And finally, Yoshinori, I’m pleased with the way you supervised the scouts. Outside of our one discussion, it seems that everyone got along fine.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Anyway, while I’ve dismissed the scouts for the day, there are still duties to be performed and work to be done around here.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: You all know your daily responsibilities. See to it they are completed while the scouts rest! Is that understood?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: You can count on me, Dad!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Yep! I’ll cook them up something special for today, now that I have a kitchen again!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Then that should be all for today. Go ahead and proceed with your normal routines.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Just drop by if you have any further inquiries. You are all dismissed.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Thanks, Dad!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: See ya later, Gramps!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* That Aiden…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Yoshinori, before you leave, a word? If I may?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, yes, sir?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: You still seem just as dazed as you were at the beach.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I can’t ignore when one of my scoutmasters is feeling distressed. Tell me what’s on your mind.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah… There’s just been a lot going on in my head recently, sir.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Does it have something to do with that camera incident involving Mr. Nagame and Mr. Akatora?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What?! You knew about that?!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Rumors spread quickly around the camp, Yoshinori. I overheard some of the scouts discussing it this morning.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: And Aiden warned me about it as well.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I see… I apologize for not reporting it to you immediately… I thought I could resolve the problem without telling you.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Everything was going so well the past few weeks, and I didn’t want to let you down.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* You still haven’t changed from before. You know all too well that you shouldn’t be burdening yourself with things you can’t handle on your own.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Anyway, I promised Aiden and Yuri to handle this calmly, unlike before.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: But you should be aware of the risk that was involved in that scenario. Luckily, nobody got hurt seriously, so we can just let bygones be bygones.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-Yes, sir.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: But I am more concerned about your relationship with your scouts… specifically Mr. Akatora.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I thought things were going smoothly with him? How did the situation get this carried away?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m really doing my best, but Taiga just isn’t willing to listen to me.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I don’t know what else to do… I’ve tried to guide him over and over again, but every time I do, he just does the opposite.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s like whatever I say goes in one ear and out the other…!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm… Here’s a word of advice, Yoshinori. Take it from someone who has gone through the same thing and handled different kinds of scouts in the past.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Ask yourself… Don’t you think that having such a stigma of him is what makes him feel isolated from everyone else?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Try to put yourself in his shoes and view the world from his eyes, because that’s the only way you’ll know where his emotions and actions are coming from.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Mr. Akatora has always been a troubled scout, struggling to get along with others.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: He misbehaves because his peers have decided that he is nothing more than a bully, and his counselors believe that he is difficult to handle, instead of trying to see past his problems.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I… never really thought of it that way…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: B-But… what else can I do? He keeps pushing me away when I try to help him…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Then maybe he doesn’t need any help.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I was cautious of Mr. Akatora after the incident with Mr. Nagame at the sportsfest, but to my surprise, he has slowly but surely been improving… Well, until yesterday…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: What caused such hostility between the two of you?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well... It came to my attention that his relationship with Keitaro was headed in an unhealthy direction ever since the sportsfest...
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Having observed Taiga's oppressive behavior and Keitaro's submissive personality, I didn't want to see such a negative cycle continue...
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I attempted to correct Taiga's behavior by presenting him opportunities to bond with Keitaro the right way.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: And therefore, you made assumptions about the two scouts, leading yourself to believe that their relationship was bad.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* I can't blame you, even I made that mistake the first time I met them when I came back this term.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: The only reason I'd think Mr. Akatora would push you away is because you might be forcing him to conform to your standards and turn him into what you perceive as the ideal scout.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I don't mean to be harsh or judgmental about the way you handle your scouts, but from how you were the past few days, it’s obvious you needed some advice.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Although, I should have stepped in and helped long before now instead of just observing.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: N-No, sir! I really do appreciate your advice!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: In any case, I know your intentions are good… But I want you and Mr. Akatora to resolve your issues with each other.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: The two of you need to come to an understanding, and as his scoutmaster and an authority figure, you are expected to be more patient and understanding with him.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Is that clear?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-Yes, sir!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Good.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I apologize for not trusting you on this matter sooner, sir… As the camp president, you had every right to know about important things like this…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: More importantly, I should’ve known that you’d understand my shortcomings and could give me the guidance I needed….
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: You don’t need to do everything alone, Yoshinori. I’m here to help you.
label: day18_taiga

text: *hugs Goro*
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank you, sir!

text: Uh-huh…

label: day18_taiga

text: I realized that he’s not been faking it this whole time, and that he really is just interested in being my friend…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Meanwhile, I’ve been a jerk and treated everyone, including you two, like crap just because I was insecure…

speaker: Taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: If I could convince him, maybe everyone else will listen to me too...!

text: But… there’s Yoshinori. After yesterday, I can’t imagine how upset I made him, calling him a terrible scoutmaster like that…

speaker: Taiga
text: *sigh* I don’t usually overthink stuff like this…

text: Maybe I should take a walk outside and get some air… That might clear my head a bit.

text: That’s simple. I don’t!

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *sigh* I should really talk to Sir Goro about your compensation.

text: A-Aiden…!

text: So, what did he say?

label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Y-You can go first if you want…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: N-No, go ahead! It’s alright!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: A-Alright… W-Well… I’m sorry for what I did back at the falls… I was wrong.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: You had every right to be mad at me, especially for breaking the rules… And I shouldn’t have disrespected you in front of Keitaro and Hunter like that either…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I know you were only trying to help me… And I just kept pushing you away…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: O-Oh… I didn’t expect this, Taiga…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I… I was kind of going to say the same thing…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want you to know that it’s not all your fault… I’m also to blame for persistently pushing you to your limit…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As your scoutmaster, I should’ve been more aware of how my scouts are feeling and how to help them get through difficult times…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Unfortunately, I let myself get carried away, and tried to force you and Keitaro to get along, while being too blind to see that you were both learning to work together on your own…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know that I should have trusted you more, Taiga, and instead I let you down again.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Most importantly, I never should’ve brought up something from the past, when I knew you were trying to move on from it.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m not asking you to forgive me, but I just wanted you to know that I regret my actions and am ready to give you the space you need.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: …I will also be here to support you along the way, not only as your scoutmaster, but also as your friend…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m the one who should be saying sorry for being so stubborn… You gave me a second chance to be back here, and I’ve been wasting it since camp started…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I shouldn’t have let what happened last year consume me…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Taiga…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I need to know if you still feel the same as you did when you asked me back then…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Do you still want to be here at Camp Buddy?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I still do…!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I-It’s just, when I met Keitaro, I let my bitterness and jealousy take over…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I saw him making all these friends and getting praised by the scoutmasters, and I convinced myself that he was just some jerk out to take what I came back here for.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: It turns out that it was me who was just trying for attention, while Keitaro was the one who just wanted to be friends…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: After being with him, I realized that’s what I wanted all along—just to be friends with everyone, and for them to accept me for who I am…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: But with how I’ve acted so far with everyone, I don’t know if that’s still possible.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You know it is, Taiga…! We both know how Keitaro never gave up on you, and that goes for the rest of us, too…!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You won’t be alone at Camp Buddy, and I’ll make sure that you can finally feel like you belong here!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: T-Thank you, but… that’s not your responsibility anymore… I have to do my part too.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m really grateful for everything you’ve done for me, but I have to convince everyone else here that I’ve changed for the better too.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Just knowing that you forgave me and are still looking out for me already means a lot.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Taiga…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You don’t know how proud I am to be hearing all of this from you…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m so glad you’re back here this term.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Thank you again… Scoutmaster Yoshi… for everything.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hahaha… You’re very welcome, Taiga. It’s my pleasure to guide you and learn from you.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now come on, let’s get you back to your friends. It’s getting late, and I’m sure they’re wondering where you are!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, there you are, Taiga! I just woke up and saw you were gone… I was about to come look for you.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Sorry, you were still sleeping, and I didn’t want to wake you.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright! Where did you go anyway?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Well… I actually went to go and talk to Scoutmaster Yoshi…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! H-How did it go?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: It… went well, actually. He was on his way to talk to me too when I ran into him.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I apologized for everything I’ve said and done, and he did the same… We both talked about why I’m back here…
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m really glad to know he didn’t give up on me either.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s great! See, you really are making up with everyone! First Eduard and Lee, and then Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sure my friends will feel the same way too!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Thanks, Keitaro. I hope so.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Anyway, I’m a little bit sticky from the nap and was about to take a bath. Want to join me?
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Sure, that sounds nice.
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright! Let’s go!
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m so glad that Taiga went and made up with Scoutmaster Yoshi. I knew the two of them would be able to come to an understanding together…{/i}
label: day18_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}He and I are finally friends too… With how well things are going so far... I just know it can only get better!{/i}
label: day18_taiga

text: *bark*
label: day18_yoichi

text: Wow! Your leg is all better now!

label: day18_yoichi

text: Huh? What’s wrong?

text: *cough* *cough* *cough*

text: Huh…?
label: day18_yoichi

text: *whimpers*

text: Hey, you okay?

text: Y-Yoichi…

text: Shit, you’re burning up…
label: day18_yoichi

text: Tsk… What should I do…?
label: day18_yoichi

text: *bark* *bark*
label: day18_yoichi

text: M-Medicine… I need some medicine…
label: day18_yoichi

text: But all of the meds are back in the camp…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh… I guess I don’t have a choice…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I have to get you back there, Keitaro.

text: *bark*
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Come on, Yuki!

text: *pant* *pant*
label: day18_yoichi

text: H-Here, Hunter… Have some water.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: Thank you, Natsumi.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: If you’re tired, you can go back.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: N-No, sir… I’m alright…! I want to keep searching… I’m not going to give up until we find them…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Why would you boys go to these lengths to look for those troublemakers?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro isn’t a troublemaker, sir! He's always done his best for the camp!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Not a troublemaker, you say?! Then explain that picture he took! None of this would have even happened if he had shown the slightest bit of moral restraint.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: We’ve been around Keitaro long enough to know that he’s not capable of doing anything like that, especially to you, sir.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah! We wouldn’t try to defend him if he wasn’t innocent!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Even if he was innocent, he didn’t have to run away with that other boy and the dog!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: And don’t get me started on him! The disrespect he showed me…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: S-Sir, I think he really was just trying to protect Keitaro… I don’t think he meant to cause so much trouble…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: We really aren’t trying to argue with you either, sir… We just want to express our thoughts about the situation…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don’t think this is the right time for us to talk about this… We won't accomplish anything if we just stay here...
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Hmph. We are indeed wasting our time just standing here talking. Let's move.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: *sigh* I hope those two are okay…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: D-Don’t lose hope, Aiden! I have faith that Yoichi and Keitaro will use what they’ve learned and stay safe in this kind of situation—
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Yoshi, look over there!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah! Sir Goro?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa! Don’t tell me you guys have been searching for them too?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, we are. This is a grave situation; we can’t afford to risk anyone’s safety.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: And it is only natural that I assist with the search, as I am partly responsible for this.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: What’s the progress of your pursuit?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’ve already searched the entire beach area. I am certain that they have not returned there after they ran off yesterday.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: While our team has searched all around the outskirts of Camp Buddy and the nearby forest.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: The results are the same, unfortunately.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh no… Where else could we search for them then..?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: K-Keitaro!!!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: You! What the hell did you do to Keitaro?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I-I…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, Keitaro! You’re burning up!!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Bro-Aiden! Do something!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Yikes! Let’s get him to the infirmary right away!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh, man. What have you gotten yourself into…?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hiro, I-
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Shut up. I don’t want to hear anything you have to say.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Natsumi, Hunter, please go with them. We appreciate all the help you’ve given us.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: R-Right.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Do you realize what you’ve done, boy?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: All of us were up the entire night looking for you two! You had the whole camp worried!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: What were you thinking, spending the night outside like this, without so much as a whisper to let us know?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I didn’t ask you guys to come look for me. I had everything under control.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: What?! A camper got sick because of you! How can you say that you had everything under control!?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Well?! Do you have anything to say for yourself?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: S-Sir… That’s enough… Maybe we can settle this better back at the camp.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Fine. Both of you will report to my office immediately when we get back.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Why did you let it come to this, Yoichi…?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: If you won't even try to understand, then maybe you shouldn't have taken me in in the first place…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: How’s Keitaro, Bro-Aiden…?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Looks like he’s in pretty bad shape. He definitely caught a strong fever.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: If he doesn’t drink medicine soon, he might be in a pinch.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: We really can’t do anything for now but try and regulate his body temperature.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: It’s best to let him rest, and give him his medicine as soon as he wakes up.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Poor boy must’ve caught a cold while staying the night in the forest… I just hope he’s not sick for too long…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, he’ll be fine. He just needs to rest, take his meds, and avoid any kind of stress!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: With that in mind, maybe you guys shouldn’t tell him what’s going on with Dad right now, alright?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: There’s no need for him to worry about that yet, after all.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Grr… This is all Wolfboy’s fault! If he hadn’t run away, Keitaro wouldn’t have followed him!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: I shouldn’t have let Keitaro out of my sight! I knew he would do something like this!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Now, now… I know Keitaro here was just worried about his friend. So please, let’s not point fingers, alright? It might just do more harm to Keitaro.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: Ms. Yuri is right, Hiro… Maybe we should focus on making Keitaro feel better…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: When he wakes up, we’ll be able to find out what really happened.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph, fine! But I don’t want that stupid Wolfboy going anywhere near Keitaro! He brings trouble wherever he goes!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Anyway, you guys just keep replacing the towels on his forehead, alright? That should be able to regulate his temperature for the time being.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: I’ll prepare something for Keitaro to nibble on as soon as he wakes up. See ya!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: I should also go and catch up with my dad to try and keep him calm while he talks with Yoshi and Yoichi…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: We’ll leave Keitaro in your hands, alright boys? Please inform us immediately if something happens.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Affirmative, Ms. Yuri! We’ll take things from here.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Good. And remember: absolutely no stress on Keitaro, alright?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Right…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Grrrr…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: Hiro… I know you’re still angry, but you have to calm down…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: This wouldn’t have happened if Yoichi just shut himself up for once instead of throwing a tantrum in front of Sir Goro like that!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m upset that Yoichi made this situation worse too, Hiro…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: He could have at least made Keitaro come back instead of forcing him to stay with him out there…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: He should know that Keitaro isn’t as unruly as him…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: I know, right?! That’s why I’m so mad!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: Didn’t we talk about this, guys? We haven’t even talked to Keitaro or Yoichi yet about what happened…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: There’s still the slight possibility that Yoichi was only doing it to protect Keitaro.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph! Well, I’ve given him enough chances! I’m not changing my mind anymore!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: …Hnn.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I think we should keep it down, guys… I know we’re all upset and confused but we shouldn’t be arguing like this, especially in front of Keitaro…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph. I’ll go get more towels then.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh* I wonder how long this will last…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I hope everything goes back to the way it used to be…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh*
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Since it seems you don’t understand how serious the situation is, let me point this out again, boy.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: You made fun of your supervisors with that photograph, and you kept a dangerous animal near the campsite.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: This led to said animal almost attacking me! Then you ran away and brought one of your fellow scouts into your delinquency.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I already know all of that, alright?! What else do you want from me?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: If you want to expel me, just do it already! I was fine by myself before anyways.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: You obviously haven’t learned a thing! You refuse to acknowledge any figure of authority, even now!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: I want you to take responsibility for your actions!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: And to think that, after all of this, you still have the nerve to talk back to me! I haven’t heard you sincerely apologize even once!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: I’m trying to be reasonable with you, boy, but you’re severely testing my patience.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-Yoichi, please just listen to Sir Goro… There's no need to keep arguing with him...
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why should I?! Neither of you have even bothered to hear me out, so why should I do the same for the two of you?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Neither of you even knows the whole story!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Regardless of your reasoning, your behavior is unacceptable!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: You’re leaving me no choice but to expel you and your friend from this camp.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch…!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: P-Please, sir. Don't make a rash decision based on Yoichi's reactions right now... I'm sure he's just exhausted... Let me at least try to clear things up with him—
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: No need.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Keep a close eye on that boy. I cannot afford him doing anything reckless again.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-Yes, sir…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Damn it!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I thought I’d find you here, Yoichi…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why are you following me? Leave me alone.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I just wanted to check up on you… make sure everything’s alright…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Does everything look fucking alright to you?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: P-Please calm down, Yoichi… I’m on your side.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Bullshit! How can you say you’re on my side when you haven’t even tried to defend me once?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You did nothing for me back at the beach, and you’re doing nothing for me now!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You’re supposed to know how important Yuki is to me!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You know the only reason I talked back to that old geezer was to protect her!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Instead you scared her away, which is exactly why I had to go after her!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: And you thought that keeping Yuki away from me was enough to make me miserable.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Now, you’re letting that old fuck expel the one person who actually cares about me!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: K-Keitaro… He… He came looking for me…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Even after I pushed him away so many times, he still insisted on staying with me to help find Yuki…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: And when he got sick… I knew we had to come back to camp. I didn’t want Keitaro getting hurt because of me…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: He cares about me and this whole damn place!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: But I’m sure you know that, don’t you? Didn’t he help you too, after all?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I-I understand, Yoichi… but I can’t just argue with Sir Goro nonstop. I have to try and reason with him!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Please be patient while I try to talk to Sir Goro about it.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch! Seems like you’re just gonna keep kissing that old man’s ass.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Whatever! I should’ve known better than to expect anything from you anyway.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: That stupid scoutmaster! What the hell does he mean he’s on my side?! He hasn’t done a damn thing to help me or Keitaro with that bullshit photo fiasco!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: *sigh*
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, Mr. Yukimura!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What? Are you gonna yell at me too?
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww… You’ve probably been yelled at enough by my father already today. So, no need for me to add to that!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: You know, you gave us quite the scare when you ran off yesterday. Yoshi was so worried about you.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, bet he was.
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: I just hope you aren’t being too hard on him… He does care about you, you know…
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch! If he cared at all about me, then why didn’t he stand up for me?!
label: day18_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: There’s a time and a place for everything. If Yoshi argued with my dad while he was angry, what do you think would happen?

text: So, yeah~ Like I said a while ago… we’re actually here to ask you guys a favor…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Huh? After all the trouble your sad excuse of a leader got us in, you’d dare to ask us a favor?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I get that you’re all still mad about that… But we’re telling you, we’re just as disappointed..!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Taiga was distressed that we’ve spread information about Sir Goro’s photograph to all of you…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: He said that we helped you bust him for that camera issue thingy!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I mean, like, we didn’t sell him out!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: We didn’t even know what he was doing in the first place! If we did, we’d even try and cover for him..!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: When he found out about that… he locked us out of our cabin…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: And what hurts more is that he’s now saying we’re no longer his friends…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Huh…? Why would he say something like that…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah… I don't get why you guys are friends with him in the first place…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: You see, our leader, Taiga, wasn’t at all like this when we first engaged in companionship with him.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Something about him has changed. He’s no longer the same Taiga that we’ve adored and respected...
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: It’s quite the complex narrative, really… It might take a while to properly explain.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: OKAY. BYE.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yoichi! I think we should at least give them a bit of our time. I mean, maybe we can actually learn more about what really happened to Taiga before all this.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, there must be a reason he’s changed so much this term…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: UGH. Fine…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t worry. We’re here to listen!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Alright. I assume that you all have the adequate time to listen to my complete and detailed narrative.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: On the day that I arrived in this outdoor complex, I initiated to disclose all my characteristics, accolades and educational background as scheduled to me by our superior, who is named Scout—
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: OKAY, WAIT! HOLD UP!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Can’t you talk like a normal person? I can’t understand a single word you’re saying with all these mumbo jumbo words flapping out of your mouth.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Ugh… He’s always like this when he’s nervous.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Just relax, Lee.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Y-You mean talk less like an intellectual…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well, just talk normally! No need to extend your sentences or add any unnecessary jargon.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Okay, now you’re starting to sound like him, Keitaro.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: R-Right… Okay, I will endeavor— I mean, I will try.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: So, umm… As I was saying, when I first arrived at this establishment, I introduced myself, like Scoutmaster Yoshi said…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: I memorized and rehearsed a script before I came, and I have to say, that I presented myself quite adequately and professionally!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Everybody applauded at my amazing introduction and awarded me for best thesis and presentation!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Okay, wait. Now you’re just messing with us! Why the hell would you be presenting a thesis to everyone who's meeting you for the first time?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Aren’t those the project-thingies you’re supposed to write in school?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: I think you’ve got it confused. The word ‘thesis’ is very versatile. It generally means, 'a statement or theory that is put forward as a premise to be maintained or proved' – in layman’s terms: an argument.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: And I’m proving and defending myself as a candidate worthy of this camp.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m getting a headache…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m pretty confused as well…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Lee! Come on! Stop fooling around!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: And that’s not what happened either! When you finished introducing yourself, everybody was just confused and quiet because nobody understood a word you said!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: It’s just like now!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Hngh! F-Fine!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: I was just adding some spice to my tale since... it’s actually a very unflattering story…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Just talk casually so it’ll be easier for all of us, please?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Well, Eduard was right about one thing… There was no applause… In fact, it was the complete opposite.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: After a long moment of silence, everyone just laughed at me because of all the big words I used…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: With such a bad introduction, I was very much avoided and labeled as a "nerd". Nobody wanted to be friends with me because I was too complex.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: It didn't take long for people to just start calling me names and bullying me to no end.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: That… sounds horrible…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don't understand. The scoutmasters managed to keep watch all over the camp. How could something like this just slip past them?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: You wanna try and pin this on the scoutmasters? Please. This kind of thing happens everywhere, with or without them keeping an eye on things.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Even I was picked on for being too feminine…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: But how did you two end up being friends with someone like Taiga then…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Like we stated a while ago, Taiga wasn’t always like this.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: One day, Eduard was getting picked on, like the daily routine it was…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: And that’s when we met Taiga… He stood up for Eduard and fought all his bullies off!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: It was just such a miracle! I was gonna cry so hard until my knight in shining armor, my hero – Taiga – arrived!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: He came in and beat the snot out of those bullies like it was nothing!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: And I’ll never forget the words that he said: “How dare you bully someone just because of who they are?!”
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: That’s true! I was there to witness it all! My eyes were in awe at how bravely Taiga stood up for Eduard the way he did.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: When the bullies came for me next, I thought to myself, "Maybe I could be like Taiga and fight back too!"
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: But… things only ended in reverse, and they beat me up instead…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: I… was devastated. Even though I believed in myself, tried to become like my hero… they all proved I was nothing close to him.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: And that’s when Taiga approached me and gave me a tap on the shoulder… He told me I had “guts” for telling my bullies off like I did.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: But he also told me that just barking like a dog wouldn’t get me anywhere… I needed to learn how to use my smarts to fight back!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: And ever since then, he's protected me and made sure I grew as a person under his wing.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: That doesn’t exactly sound like the Taiga we know…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah… What the heck happened to him?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Actually… When Taiga joined, he wasn’t anything like he is now…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: He was kind of like you, Keitaro.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Eh? He was like me…? What do you mean?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Well, he was just really friendly and kind… Even cheerful most of the time!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: I thought Natsumi and Yoichi would have told you this! They used to be roommates, after all!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: We did tell them what we knew about Taiga… But to be honest, I didn’t get to know Taiga well enough to understand why he’d end up doing these things…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Over the last few years, I’ve only been focusing on helping the scoutmasters however I could. I didn’t really make friends with the other campers until this year.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah. It was pretty much like that for me too… except for the helping part.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: It was only when Frogboy joined the camp that I started really getting to know people around me.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, you guys obviously missed out on a lot about Taiga. After he defended us from those bullies, Taiga really became our hero.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: But that made him some enemies too… Which led to that dreadful event last year…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well… I’ve heard the story from Natsumi and Yoichi...
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I remember Natsumi told us that Taiga was exposed as a cheater during last year’s event which ended up in a serious fistfight…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I still don’t understand what Taiga’s motives were for doing that… It doesn’t make sense that he’d go that far just for our team to win that prize…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, he did have a ton of guys who hated him before that based on Four-eyes and Spaghetti-boy’s stories.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I really want to know what happened from Taiga’s point of view.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s not fair to just listen to what one side has to say.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Lee and I promised Taiga that we wouldn’t let anyone know about it…but I think it would help him if you guys did.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: He just wants to be understood and accepted after all…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Is there something we still don’t know about Taiga?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Well… Taiga was really just a victim. At least if we’re talking about what happened last year.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: How is that so...? All of the campers were convinced of Taiga’s mishaps back then…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Well.. if you think about it, why did Scoutmaster Yoshi not take direct action to rebuke Taiga last year if he really was responsible for that scandal?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now that you mention it… If Taiga really was the one making trouble in the camp, Scoutmaster Yoshi would’ve done something about him…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: As I’ve said before, Taiga had made some enemies while defending Lee and I from our bullies…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: And that brings us to the time of the first sports competition. Remember how the five of us were in a group, Natsumi?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah. We were teammates with Taiga, Yoichi, and Lee. Taiga wanted our team to win so much, but then we didn’t even get to compete because we won by default...
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Heh. Then it turned out that the guy actually threatened and even beat up one of the members of the team we were up against.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: That’s where everyone was wrong…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: While it’s correct that Taiga did want to win the prize, he did not perpetrate the crimes he was accused of.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: R-Really? But everyone was so sure it was Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: That’s just it! They were so mean! They convinced everyone that it was Taiga, when he didn’t do anything wrong!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Those jerks even beat up their own teammate, and made it look like Taiga was the one who did it by forcing that poor guy to lie and say it was Taiga who did it to him!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Are you sure it really wasn’t Taiga? It seems like something he would do…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Ugh, no way! He would never hurt someone who didn’t deserve it! Back then, at least…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Anyways! To continue our story, everyone assumed that Taiga had cheated to win, and his enemies used that as yet another excuse to physically assault Taiga.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: We tried to defend Taiga back then, but unfortunately, they overpowered us with their brute strength.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: They attacked you both too?! That’s awful..!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I know, right?! And then Taiga - bless him - tried to fight back, but that just made it worse. He accidentally really hurt one of those jerks!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: They deserved it, but it was too late for Taiga at that point. Sir Goro was there and, oh my god did he start flipping out!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, yeah… I kinda remember the old man raging and yelling that day. It was way worse than he was at the beach, too.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Indeed. And to make matters worse, Sir Goro was hosting some visitors from the surrounding city, who were quick to spread the incident throughout the town.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Before we knew it, people were leaving the camp left and right…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: And then it seemed like the ones who were left blamed every bad thing that happened on Taiga! Like he was the one who messed everything up!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: We would constantly discover Taiga bandaged up and beaten, his body covered in marks and wounds....
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: We were certain that those bullies were assaulting him clandestinely, but he refused to allow us to inform the scoutmasters...
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Poor Taiga… I had no idea that had all happened…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Did nobody do anything to help him…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Unfortunately, these antagonists were quite clever. They were rarely present at the same time as the scoutmasters, and therefore were never caught.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: One time, finally, when we were attacked alongside Taiga, Scoutmaster Yoshinori was able to finally witness the assault.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: He immediately evicted the perpetrators, and apologized to Taiga for believing him to have committed the prior crimes.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: So that’s why Scoutmaster Yoshi is so lenient with Taiga… He knew the truth?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Yeah! We were there when he encouraged Taiga to get up and move past his bullies. Scoutmaster Yoshi saw that Taiga sincerely wanted to be a better person…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: It seemed that Scoutmaster Yoshinori would not allow Taiga to continue staying in the camp.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: He even forbade him from joining again at first, in order to spare him from the threat of the aggressors for his own good.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: But Taiga begged Scoutmaster Yoshi for one more chance, begging to let him enlist again for the next summer…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: We promised to come with him and help however we could…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I thought this year would be different, and Taiga would get a fresh start, but things turned out so differently… Taiga’s behavior started to change, and he became how he is now…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: And now, seeing Taiga like this… We couldn’t help but worry about him…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I’m afraid that now that he’s pushed even Lee and I away, he might do something stupid to hurt himself..!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: No matter what we say, he just won’t listen to us.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I know it's selfish to ask you for help, especially after all the harm Taiga has caused you and your friends... But we don't know who else to turn to…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: We’re hoping that you can talk some sense into Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: We genuinely just want to get along with everyone else too… We’re tired of going along with Taiga’s whims. We don’t want him to destroy himself and let everyone hate him like this…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: He’s our dear friend, and I’m sure all of you can understand how it feels to see a friend struggling this hard…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I understand... But as much as I want to help Taiga, I’m not sure if there’s anything I can do…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: He hates me so much… I’m afraid he won’t listen, or worse, he’ll try and do something to hurt me too…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I can totally get that… After all the things he did and said to you, it’s only natural you’d feel that way after all…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: But when we were informed that Taiga’s expulsion was lifted due to your request, we knew you sought to aid Taiga as much as we do!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: If somebody had tried to understand Taiga after last year’s incident, he wouldn’t be the way he is now…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I think Taiga enrolled at Camp Buddy again for a reason… Maybe he wanted to redeem himself and hoped everyone would accept him… But he just doesn’t know how to make it happen…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: We were really wrong from the start to have judged you so negatively!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m not sure about all of this…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: T-That’s okay. We can wait...! For now, we’ll be patient and let Taiga have time to think about what he’s done too..!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sure he’ll realize one day that all of us still care for him, despite everything he’s done!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: How I wish that would happen!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Thank you for hearing our concerns, Keitaro. We apologize for imposing on you!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Eduard, Lee. I’m glad that you both trusted us with this.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, we better get going now before Taiga actually sees us hanging out with you.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: He might get the wrong idea again…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: I agree… Thank you for listening, everyone.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What the hell just happened with those two…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah...! To think that Eduard and Lee would approach us for help!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess they finally figured things out… I just wish they had realized this stuff sooner so things wouldn’t be so messed up in the first place.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: But that still doesn’t change the fact that Taiga has caused so many problems for all of us!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s over now, Hiro. No one is going to be kicked out of the camp! Besides, isn’t this what Keitaro wanted for all of us?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re right, Natsumi! We’re finally starting to really get along with everyone! All that’s left is Taiga!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess it’s worth a shot if it means we can all have fun together for the rest of the summer!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: So? What’s the plan? Are you gonna go over there and tell Taiga off?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think so… storming over there and talking to him right off the bat won’t solve anything…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: And with Taiga locking Eduard and Lee out like that... I don’t think he’s even ready to talk with anyone, right now.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll just lay low for a while and let things be. I’ll talk to Taiga the next time I get the chance.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Although… I don’t even know what to talk to him about. I might need a little bit of time to try to understand what’s going on first.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: If that’s what you think is best, then it’s probably what we should do for now.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah. That and finish our food, so we can just enjoy the rest of the day.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Well, I’m already done with mine. What else do you guys wanna do today?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmm… I don’t think the scoutmasters have anything planned for us today.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I guess today is just gonna be our free day. We can do what we want for now.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: If that’s the case, maybe I’ll just go ahead and sketch a piece outside. Today’s a nice day for landscape drawing.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmm… then I guess I’ll just help Bro-Aiden wash the dishes…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Wanna join me, Wolfboy? Maybe you can be useful for once.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! No thanks! I’ve got better things to do with my time!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Like what? Roll in the mud?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Shut up, Torch-head!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Yoichi, do you want to relax with me while I sketch? If you feel like it, I mean.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Huh?! That sounds way boring!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: And why the hell are you inviting me too, Twinkerbell? Do I look like a playdate to you?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: W-Well, I just thought, with everyone else busy, you might be free for it.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Psh! I’ve got my own stuff to do! So, if you’re all done yapping, I’m heading out!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Catch you losers later!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Ugh, why did I expect any different from him?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Anyway, I’ll go ahead too! Bro-Aiden is probably in a pinch back at the kitchen by now.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: See you guys later!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll be on my way now as well, guys.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: A-And I’m sorry about what happened earlier! I swear I didn’t tell anyone about it.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Ahh, it’s okay, Hunter, really.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yeah, we were just helping each other change because of how tired we were last night, is all.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, s-sure.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Either way, I’ll head out for now. Bye guys!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I guess it’s just the two of us again, huh Keitaro?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmm? Are you okay, Keitaro?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, yeah… I was just thinking about what Eduard and Lee told us.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga really was so misunderstood before… It really changed him from who he was then.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, there’s really nothing we can do about it right now. Taiga’s closed his doors to everyone, just like you said.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: We have this whole day free to ourselves! We can do anything you want, Keitaro! You know, to get things off your mind!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: We have this whole day free to ourselves! We can do anything you want, Keitaro! You know, to get things off your mind!{fast}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

text: Anything with you.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, I don’t mind doing anything as long as it’s with you, Natsumi.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Maybe we can just continue with your daily routine!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! I know you’ll be really surprised about this… but I actually stopped following my daily checklist!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I figured I should just enjoy my time here without being so strict and doing whatever comes to mind, just like you taught me!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Whoa, Natsumi! I can’t believe you really did that…!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Of course! I want to show you guys I’m really listening to your advice~!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: But if you’re really curious about my schedule, we could follow it today. We don’t really have anything to do right now anyway! Haha!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Sure, Natsumi! That sounds good!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: What do you usually do around this time?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I usually pass by the camp garden to water the plants and check them for pests.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Sometimes, I plow the land to plant some seedlings too!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Then let’s go do that, Natsumi!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Are you sure, Keitaro? That can get really tiring to do!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t mind, Natsumi!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, alright then, Keitaro.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Let’s drop by the shed and get some tools for gardening!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whew! I just finished rooting out the weeds over here! This should be ready for ploughing!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro, can you hand me that rake over there?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmm…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Everything alright over here, Keitaro?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh! Natsumi! Yes?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: You seem to be spacing out a little. Are you okay?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: If you’re exhausted, we can take a break!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah! No, not at all, Natsumi…! I was just thinking about something…!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: …Is this about Taiga again?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I suppose I was expecting this.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, I’m sorry, Natsumi. I know I’m not supposed to…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: You know, Keitaro, you’ve always been selfless. It’s no surprise you’re still thinking about that.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: But try not to keep it all bottled up, okay? You can always tell me what’s on your mind.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m right here for that.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I… I guess I’m just a little pressured by Eduard and Lee counting on me to talk to Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m still trying to figure out how I should even approach him and what to say…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hearing his story, I couldn’t help but feel bad for how things turned out for him.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know he’s done a lot of wrong things, but they’re all just probably because of his pent-up anger over what happened last year.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmm… I understand… but remember, Keitaro, you can only do so much for him…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I mean… you’ve only got out of trouble yesterday because of what he’s done.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I think it’s only fair that Taiga reflect over the things he’s done.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: We should give him all the time and space he can get. Anything too rash might just aggravate him even more.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* You’re right, Natsumi. Sorry for making you worry. This was supposed to be our time together.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Don’t worry, Keitaro! I’m actually really happy you told me about this! It makes me feel that you trust me enough with whatever you’re going through.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you for listening, Natsumi!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, let’s finish up here, shall we?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Right!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Natsumi and I finished up planting some seedlings all over the garden to grow.{/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Then we packed all of the tools and moved everything back into the shed, deciding to call it a day. {/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! All stacked~
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whew, we managed to make the whole day productive in the end! That always feels great!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, it was really fun gardening with you, Natsumi.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: But we did get all dirty. Maybe we should head back and take a bath? I can give you a sponge bath to relax, if you’d like, Keitaro.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ooh! That sounds really nice! Thank you, Natsumi!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Alright, then! Let’s go!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

text: Help with chores.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

text: E-Eh? Are you sure, Keitaro…? You know we can relax if you want to.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It's fine, Natsumi. Besides, we've got nothing else to do today; we might as well use this time to help out around the camp.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hahaha! Keitaro, you're starting to sound a little like me when I talk about chores now.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: But sure, I don’t mind doing chores for today.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Sir Aiden should be in the kitchen.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright, Natsumi! Let's go!

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, actually sir, we wanted to help you with the cleanup!

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, that’s really nice, you guys! But I think Hiro and I got this.

label: day20_fsnatsumi

label: day20_fsnatsumi

text: Alright, boys. I'll take you up on your offer!

text: Awesome! I'll get cleaning in the mess hall then!

text: See ya, guys!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Roger that!

text: Haha, just when I thought you were learning to relax, you’re running around doing everybody's chores again, Natsumi!

speaker: Natsumi
text: O-Oh, actually, sir, it was Keitaro's idea to come see what we could do.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

text: And we didn’t have anything else planned, so we thought we'd help you out, sir!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Wow, Keitaro! Who'd have known? Guess you guys really are rubbing off on each other, huh?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-What? Sir, how did you know? Did you see us on top of each other at the pier?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Natsumi! Keep it down! T-That's not what Sir Aiden meant-
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Oho~ So, that's what's been goin’ on between you two, eh~? No wonder you two are always stickin’ around each other.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah! N-No, sir! It’s not what you think! Natsumi was just-
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: I always knew something clicked between you two. But then again, it's pretty normal to do that kind of stuff, anyway.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: And from the looks of it, I bet Natsumi here is the one who’s always in charge, if you know what I mean~!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wah! Sir Aiden…!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Say, Sir Aiden. Since you said the kind of stuff we've been doing is natural, does that mean you’re doing it with someone special too?

text: Whoa there! Why am I in the hot seat now? That kind of topic is off limits!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, Keitaro! You’re so red! I didn’t mean to embarrass you.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Don’t be shy, Keitaro! We’re just having some fun, man-to-man talk!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Plus, doing stuff like that can’t really be helped, haha!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Natsumi's totally the perfect, nice guy type with a jock bod, and Keitaro's our adorable crowdpleaser, after all.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: You guys are a total match!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, you're right about Keitaro, sir! He really is adorable!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

text: Not to mention, he’s the nicest guy here in camp too!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Nnn…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh, yeah! I even heard you convinced Gramps and Yoshi into letting Taiga stay when he was gonna get kicked out last night.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah…! Sir Aiden, I don’t think you should-
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Eh? Did I say something wrong?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah… N-No, Sir Aiden. It’s just I’m a little worried about how everything turned out after last night…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Huh? Shouldn’t you be celebrating now that you’re gonna be staying here at camp with us? Your friends even proved Taiga was the one who framed you!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But that's exactly what I'm worried about, sir. Taiga must be really upset by now. I think he needs someone to talk to...
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. First off, I think you've done a lot for him already, Keitaro.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: I mean… you just got out of trouble yourself, right?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yes, sir…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Second, Taiga should spend some time thinking about what he’s done too.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: You know how that guy can be. If anyone tried to talk to him right now, he’d be too stubborn to admit anything and just lash out.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: But even if that’s the case, it doesn’t mean the guy won’t learn. I bet he just needs some more time and space to let things settle down right now.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: And then the last thing… you should learn to give yourself a break from all this too!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: You’ve done hella great already, Keitaro~! Pat yourself on the back and take some time to let things go back to normal!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah... You’re right, sir…! I’m sorry for worrying so much about it…

label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro

speaker: Keitaro

speaker: Natsumi
text: E-Eh? Are you sure, Keitaro…? You know we can relax if you want to.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, well, I know I’m going to keep thinking about Taiga if I don’t do something to get my mind off of him…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

text: I figured if we’re doing something to distract me, I can at least make sure it's productive!

text: Haha, I never thought I’d be the one questioning doing chores, but sure, I don’t mind!

text: He’s been acting a lot more distant to everyone since then…
