speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s just leave…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Y-You’re pitying me still?! Why?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Why won't you just beat me up?! That's what you want to do, right?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Just… do something…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: No, Taiga. Keitaro’s right. There’s no point.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: You’re not even worth our time anymore…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: All you do is blame others for the bad things that happen to you. Just look at where it’s gotten you.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: You’re standing here, alone, hated by everyone at the camp… and you did it all to yourself.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t believe I thought you could change. It was never going to happen, was it?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Come on, Keitaro. Let’s go.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Graaahhhh!!!!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Dammit! I fucking hate everyone here!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Huh?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: We saw what happened…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Your behavior was truly disgraceful, Taiga.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: What do you care…? You traitors…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Taiga… Please don’t push us away, especially after everything we’ve been through together.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: We have been your faithful allies from the beginning.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Shut up! I don’t need to hear your shitty opinions!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Just go hang out with your new so-called ‘friend.’ See if I care!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Taiga, you ARE our friend! Do you really think we’d be standing here if we didn’t care about you?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: The reason why Lee and I came back to this camp was for YOU, even though it was a nightmare for us.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: That’s how much we care about you….
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: Eduard is correct. We only wanted to continue to engage in activities with you, our friend…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Tch. Now you two are starting to sound like that idiot!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Can you just please give yourself a moment to think and see who the real idiot is?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Keitaro isn’t really the person you think he is…!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: He’s kind and compassionate… He’s completely different from who you said he was!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: It’s true… Your judgment on Keitaro was incorrect. There is no reason to continue hostilities.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: You guys are beyond help. You’re already brainwashed by that little runt!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I’ve wasted my time being friends with you! I shouldn’t have wasted my time on you both—
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Not… another… word…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I really liked you, Taiga… More than you could have realized!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: To me, you were more than just a friend, especially after you saved me from those bullies!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: But now, look at you… You’ve become just as horrible as the ones who’ve hurt you last year! I’d even say you’re worse!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: You need to think about all the mistakes you’ve made at camp so far, instead of blaming it all on everyone else.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Maybe then you could realize why everyone loves Keitaro and not you.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: Pick yourself up, Taiga. I know you’re better than this.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: There are people who love you, even if you don’t realize it.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Kkh!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Lee
text: He didn’t seem to be responding positively to us, Eduard…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Eduard
text: I know… But I can only hope we knocked some sense into him at least…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Sheesh… There’s no way we can fix this. Just look how burnt it is.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well… some of the pictures are still intact, at least…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I can’t believe Taiga actually burned your journal, Keitaro… That’s terrible.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: This time he’s really gone too far! We really need to go and kick his ass!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah! I’m with you, Torch-head! If we just let this go, who knows what else he’ll try and do?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: As much as I wanted to do that… You guys know we can’t..
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Maybe we should tell the scoutmasters… Who knows what he’ll do next if we let him get away this time?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I understand why Keitaro didn’t want me to do anything to Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: We don’t want another issue like before. Especially not after just saving Keitaro from expulsion…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Gah! This is so annoying! We should’ve let that jerk get kicked out!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I really don’t think hurting Taiga or telling the scoutmasters to have him kicked out of camp will do us any good now…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: If you guys had seen the way he looked, you’d understand…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro, you’re seriously still going to forgive Taiga after this?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, come on, Frogboy! You gotta stand up for yourself this time!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I don't think we should use violence or anything, but I agree… We can't let this keep happening.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Please don’t get me wrong, guys… I’m really angry and upset about what Taiga did…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah… That journal really meant a lot to you, Keitaro…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch… Even I get how much it sucks to lose something that important…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I think I need some time alone to think about this. I’m gonna go outside and get some fresh air.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Keitaro just looked so… miserable… Should we go after him?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I-I don’t think so, Hunter. Keitaro needs some time to himself right now.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Are you sure, Natsumi? I don’t think I’ve ever seen him so upset…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I bet if you chased after him, you could get him to stop moping and make him feel better like last time.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: No, Yoichi... Keitaro said he needs to be alone to think. And we should all respect that and trust that he can handle himself for now…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: All we can do now is be there for Keitaro when he’s ready to talk to us…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can't believe I'm back here, after what just happened, but… the sound of the crickets and frogs really help calm me down…){/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe all of my precious memories are gone… just like that.){/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And here I thought… I would have something to look back to…){/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(What if I forget about this place…? The people I met here… and maybe even all the good times I’ve spent with everyone…){/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’m letting myself drown in my own thoughts… I just wanna yell and scream…){/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: K-Keitaro…!?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: What are you doing here?!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: I’m just getting some fresh air!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll just head back to my cabin…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Wait!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I… um…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Will you stay for a minute…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: P-Please…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: You must really hate me now, huh…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: After everything I’ve done to you…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Umm… Well…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I hate to say it, but… yeah, I am really upset…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can’t pretend to know what you’re going through because… maybe I really was wrong the whole time…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I tried so hard to change you… But maybe that was just a waste of time…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But… I really want to understand why you had to burn my journal… Especially when you knew how important it was to me.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Do you really hate me that much…?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I still forgive you for what you did… We all have our own monsters inside us, anyways…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Why, Keitaro…? Why would you still forgive me? Why can’t you hate me?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Any sane person would’ve despised me by now…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Like everyone else did back then…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess… everybody has a reason for the things they do…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I try to think about what I would do if I were in your shoes, and if I would act the same way…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I just really want to understand people more, so that I can see the way they see…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You might think that I’m just pretending to be nice… but… who would I be fooling? We’re the only ones here…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: No… I already know that you’re not trying to pretend anymore… Even back then…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: And I’ve been thinking about all the things you told me before…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: If… If I was in your shoes… I would be furious. I don’t think I’d ever forgive you if you’d done what I’ve done…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Eduard was right… I’m no better than the people who made me like this…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Can you tell me what happened to you...?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: M-Maybe if you told me the truth, I could really help you...
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: When I first joined Camp Buddy last year… I was so happy…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I met a lot of new people… I learned a lot of cool things and I got to have fun with everyone…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… everything just… fell apart…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I was blamed for something I didn’t do…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I had to defend myself and the friends who tried to protect me, but then everyone saw it so differently…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I didn’t want to hurt anyone… Everyone was so convinced I was the bad guy… And everyone hated me…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s why I tried so hard to prove to everyone I wasn’t like that…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: But… all my efforts weren’t enough… It just got worse every day…!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: When I was about to give up… Scoutmaster Yoshi and the friends I had left raised me up… That’s when I realized that I want to be here more than anything else…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I begged Scoutmaster Yoshi to let me join again this year, hoping things would turn out differently for me this time.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s just so unfair… The only thing I wanted was acceptance… I worked so hard to earn it and it all just went down the drain…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: But it was so easy for you… Everyone already loved and accepted you in just one day… I was so jealous!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… I slowly started to realize why…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I couldn’t forget all those things you did for me…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Just like how you saw through me during the sportsfest when we were competing against each other… Or when you stopped Sir Goro from expelling me…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Today, I did the worst thing I could possibly do to you… and you still defended me, even though I didn’t deserve it…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: And now you’re here beside me, choosing to listen to me, and forgiving me even before I can explain myself…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: You’ve always been optimistic about everyone here at camp. You’ve given me more chances than anyone else to be your friend…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I wanted to be like you so bad that I couldn’t see past my own anger…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I kept blaming everyone for my own mistakes… I was so stupid…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: *sniff*
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I… I’m really sorry, Keitaro…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry I tried to make your stay here a living hell…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Taiga… I still forgive you. There’s no reason to hate you, even now. It wouldn’t do either of us any good…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: N-Nobody’s ever talked to me like this before…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I don’t deserve your friendship, not after everything… but… I… I’m more than willing to be your friend…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m just so sorry for everything, Keitaro…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright… You don’t have to say you’re sorry, Taiga…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: *cries*
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But you don’t know how happy I am that you did.{/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hi, everyone… I’m back.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Welcome back, Keitaro…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: I really wanted to go after you, but Natsumi stopped me… He said you needed to sort it out yourself…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I know Natsumi was probably right, but I couldn’t help but worry the whole time you’ve been gone…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You haven’t been crying, have you?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: G-Guys, Keitaro just got back. Let’s all give him a little space.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m sure he just needed to take some time to breathe… Right, Keitaro?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, I’m fine… Thank you, guys.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Are you sure, Keitaro?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: If you ever need to rant about something, you can always talk to us!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yup! I’m alright – today was just tiring, and so many things happened.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It really sucks that my journal was burnt up like that but… there’s nothing we can do about it now!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Besides, we have plenty of time left at the camp for me take new pictures and start a new journal again!
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s amazing how you’re still so optimistic about all this, Keitaro…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: That’s right, Keitaro! You should think about the bright side! Now, what was the third buddy law again?
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh. Don’t start, Torch-head.
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m glad to see you’re okay, Keitaro. After all you’ve been through, I just knew you’d get through this…
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Thank you, everyone… *sniff*
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Everyone was really worried about me…{/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}They really do try so hard to make me feel better whenever I’m down… I don’t know what I would do without them…{/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Is this the warmth Taiga was yearning for so long…?{/i}
label: day20_fsnatsumi

speaker: Goro
text: Come in.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, sir! I brought Aiden with me as you requested.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’re sorry if it took us a while. We had to take care of some mail along the way.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: What’s up, Gramps? Are we in trouble?
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: N-No, none of you did anything wrong.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I’m just concerned with the state of the camp right now. If we don’t get more campers for the next summer season, this place is going to close.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Next summer season?! Does that mean-
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, Yoshinori. I’ve decided to continue Camp Buddy for the foreseeable future. Therefore, this year will not be the last batch.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What?! R-Really?!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa!? Gramps, are you for real?! This is really great news!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: What made you change your mind? I was so sure that it was time for me to pack my stuff after this term ends!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Haha! See, Dad? I told you they would like the surprise~
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yuri? You knew about this?
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Yes. Dad and I talked about it last night.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem…
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I think you all might have completely neglected the very first thing I said this meeting.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: To repeat, if we don’t get any new campers soon, we won’t be able to continue running the camp until next summer.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, the camp’s bills certainly aren’t getting any easier to manage. I can see where Sir Goro is coming from…
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: After some consideration, I’ve decided to be upfront with you all. So, listen up.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: This camp is in a dire financial situation. The fact of the matter is that we have lost too many scouts, and our reputation has plummeted too far down for us to reasonably expect to get more.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Is this because of the incident last year..?
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Believe it or not, that only played a small part in the current situation.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: As you may know, we have at least three branches of Camp Buddy, including this one with the other two managed by me and my business partners.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: But those two other branches did not open for this year’s summer season.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Our stockholders and sponsors have decided to end the contract, and any possibility of renewal.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What happened, sir?! I thought the other branches had been doing well all these years?!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s not true, Yoshi… It’s the reason why Dad let me help you out here in the first place. It’s because the other branches have already closed down, including the one I used to work in.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: What? And all this time it sounded like this place was the worst-performing one… Just what the heck happened?!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: As shameful as it is to admit, it is due to my own mismanagement. I was not able to oversee these camps properly.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: It seems that my business partners did not share the same vision I had for Camp Buddy. And another part of the problem is that I wasn’t as enthusiastic as I used to be.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: The lack of passion of the leaders and scoutmasters reflected the camps' performances, delivering an underwhelming experience for the campers.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: And this chain of negligence continued until our campers lost their interest, resulting in fewer and fewer recruits as the years went by.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Last year was the last batch for the two other branches. Continuing to host those camps was no longer feasible.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: The main reason we had so many visitors last year at the event that you organized was because I was trying to convince our sponsors to help us continue our cause.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I failed at that moment and disappointed everyone…
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: We’ve already talked about this, Yoshinori. You did the best you could, even without my guidance!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: What happened last year is not just your shortcoming. It’s mine as well. All of us are responsible for it.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s true… When Dad told me he was about to close down this branch as well, I just couldn’t let it end like that..!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: I knew I had to convince him not to give up on this dream.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Camp Buddy isn’t just your own dream anymore, sir! It’s ours too!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Right! And this place isn’t just our dream… It’s our home too!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’re a family here… Nothing can take away our home from us!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I have no words to describe how proud I am of all of you.
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Dad…
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Alright! Listen up!
label: day20_taiga

speaker: Goro

label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: R-Really? But everyone was so sure it was Taiga…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: That’s just it! They were so mean! They convinced everyone that it was Taiga, when he didn’t do anything wrong!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Those jerks even beat up their own teammate, and made it look like Taiga was the one who did it by forcing that poor guy to lie!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Are you sure it really wasn’t Taiga? It seems like something he would do…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Ugh, no way! He would never hurt someone who didn’t deserve it! Back then, at least…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: Anyways! To continue our story, everyone assumed that Taiga had cheated to win, and his enemies used that as yet another excuse to physically assault Taiga.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: We tried to defend Taiga back then, but unfortunately, they overpowered us with their brute strength.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: They attacked you both too?! That’s awful..!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: I know, right?! And then Taiga - bless him - tried to fight back, but that just made it worse. He accidentally really hurt one of those jerks!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: They deserved it, but it was too late for Taiga at that point. Sir Goro was there and oh my god, did he start flipping out!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, yeah… I kinda remember the old man raging and yelling that day. It was way worse than he was at the beach, too.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: Indeed. And to make matters worse, Sir Goro was hosting some visitors from the surrounding city, who were quick to spread the incident throughout the town.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Before we knew it, people were leaving the camp left and right…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: And then it seemed like the ones who were left blamed every bad thing that happened on Taiga! Like he was the one who messed everything up!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: We would constantly discover Taiga bandaged up and beaten, his body covered in marks and wounds....
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: We were certain that those bullies were assaulting him clandestinely, but he refused to allow us to inform the scoutmasters...
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: Poor Taiga… I had no idea that had all happened…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Did nobody do anything to help him…?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: Unfortunately, these antagonists were quite clever. They were rarely present at the same time as the scoutmasters, and therefore were never caught.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: One time, finally, when we were attacked alongside Taiga, Scoutmaster Yoshinori was able to finally witness the assault.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: He immediately evicted the perpetrators, and apologized to Taiga for believing him to have committed the prior crimes.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: So that’s why Scoutmaster Yoshi is so lenient with Taiga… He knew the truth?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Yeah! We were there when he encouraged Taiga to get up and move past his bullies. Scoutmaster Yoshi saw that Taiga sincerely wanted to be a better person…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: It seemed that Scoutmaster Yoshinori would not allow Taiga to continue staying in the camp.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: He even forbade him from joining again at first, in order to spare him from the threat of the aggressors for his own good.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: But Taiga begged Scoutmaster Yoshi for one more chance, begging to let him enlist again for the next summer…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: We promised to come with him and help however we could…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: I thought this year would be different, and Taiga would get a fresh start, but things turned out so differently…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Taiga’s behavior started to change, and he became who he is now…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: And now, seeing Taiga like this… We can't help but worry about him…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: I’m afraid that now that he’s pushed even Lee and I away, he might do something stupid to hurt himself..!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: No matter what we say, he just won’t listen to us.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: I know it's selfish to ask you for help, especially after all the harm Taiga has caused you and your friends... But we don't know who else to turn to…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: We’re hoping that you can talk some sense into Taiga…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: We genuinely just want to get along with everyone else too… We’re tired of going along with Taiga’s whims. We don’t want him to destroy himself and let everyone hate him like this…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: He’s our dear friend, and I’m sure all of you can understand how it feels to see a friend struggling this hard…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I understand... But as much as I want to help Taiga, I’m not sure if there’s anything I can do…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: He hates me so much… I’m afraid he won’t listen, or worse, he’ll try and do something to hurt me too…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: I can totally get that… After all the things he did and said to you, it’s only natural you’d feel that way after all…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: But when we were informed that Taiga’s expulsion was lifted due to your request, we knew you sought to aid Taiga as much as we do!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: If somebody had tried to understand Taiga after last year’s incident, he wouldn’t be the way he is now…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I think Taiga enrolled at Camp Buddy again for a reason… Maybe he wanted to redeem himself and hoped everyone would accept him… But he just doesn’t know how to make it happen…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But I can promise you that I will try to talk to him about all of this.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: T-Thank you, Keitaro! That means a lot to us...!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: We were wrong from the start to have judged you so negatively!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m not sure about all of this…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: T-That’s okay. We can wait...! For now, we’ll be patient and let Taiga have time to think about what he’s done too..!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sure he’ll realize one day that all of us still care for him, despite everything he’s done!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: How I wish that would happen!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Lee
text: Thank you for hearing our concerns, Keitaro. We'll let you guys indulge in your meal now! We apologize for imposing on you!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Eduard, Lee. I’m glad that you both trusted us with this.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Thank you again, Keitaro!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: I can’t believe that just happened…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah...! To think that Eduard and Lee would approach us for help!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I guess, now that they finally figured things out, those two aren’t completely stupid. I just wish they had realized this stuff sooner so things wouldn’t be so messed up in the first place.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Getting all sentimental like that doesn’t suit you at all, Wolfboy.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey! I’m not trying to be all cheesy or anything! All I’m saying is that this is what probably needed to happen for them to see that Keitaro really is in the right here!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: But that still doesn’t change the fact that Taiga has caused so many problems for all of us; especially for you two.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s over now, Hunter. No one is going to be kicked out of the camp! Besides, isn’t this what Keitaro wanted for all of us?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re right, Natsumi! We’re finally starting to really get along with everyone! All that’s left is Taiga!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess it’s worth a shot if it means we can all have fun together for the rest of the summer!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Ugh… There goes my tummy again… Can we go and have dinner now…? I’m starving…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, that’s right! Sir Aiden must have finished cooking the second batch of food! Let’s go. We can continue this talk while we eat!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Come in.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Excuse me, sir? Yuri told me to report to your office.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, I want to conduct a meeting with you all. Where are the others?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: They said that they'll catch up soon, sir. Yuri needed Aiden’s help with one of her collections.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, is the meeting about the camp’s current bills? If so, I have them here. They just came in the mail today.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Great, another problem to deal with…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Let’s just wait for the other scoutmasters before we start the meeting.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir… I don’t mean to intrude but… is there something wrong? You seem like you’re upset.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Are you still worried about what happened the past few days?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: No, this is about a separate matter.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: I’m just concerned with the state of the camp right now. If we don’t get more campers for the next summer season, this place is going to close.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Next summer season?! Does that mean-
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, Yoshinori. I’ve decided to continue Camp Buddy for the foreseeable future. Therefore, this year will not be the last batch.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: S-Sir Goro!!!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *hugs Goro tight*
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: H-Hey…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You don’t know how happy I am…!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Hey Gramps! We’re here for the meeti-
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: WHOA!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh my! Are we interrupting something?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yuri! Aiden..!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You guys aren’t gonna believe this! Sir Goro said he’ll keep the camp open for as long as he can!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: So you told him already, huh Dad?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yuri? You knew about this?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Yes. Dad and I talked about it last night.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: What happened, sir? What made you change your mind?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: I believe you can answer that yourself, Yoshinori.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Your performance as a scoutmaster these past few weeks has been nothing less than exceptional. You have more than redeemed yourself.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Not only have you actively guided the scouts and taught them valuable lessons of companionship, but you’ve also had the courage to stand up to me and prove just how deserving you are of your position.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: You’ve truly carried on the legacy, and I’m depending on you to pass it on for many generations to come.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir Goro…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *bows down*
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank you so much!!!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Congrats, Yoshi! Looks like all your hard work finally paid off, huh?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s all thanks to you and Yuri too! It wouldn’t have been possible without your help!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww~ Don’t mention it, Yoshi. You know we’re always here for you~
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Sup, Gramps? Wanna join the group hug?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve gathered you all here for more than just this good news.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: There’s something Yuri and I have not told you yet.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: After some consideration, I’ve decided to be upfront with you all. So listen up.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: This camp is in a dire financial situation. The fact of the matter is that we have lost too many scouts and our reputation has plummeted too far down for us to reasonably expect to get more.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Is this because of the incident last year..?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Believe it or not, that only played a small part in the current situation.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: As you may know, we have at least three branches of Camp Buddy including this one, with the other two managed by me and my business partners.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: But those two other branches did not open for this year’s summer season.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Our stockholders and sponsors have decided to end the contract, and any possibility of renewal.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What happened, sir?! I thought the other branches had been doing well all these years?!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s not true, Yoshi… It’s the reason why Dad let me help you out here in the first place. It’s because the other branches have already closed down, including the one I used to work in.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: What? And all this time it sounded like this place was the worst-performing one… Just what the heck happened?!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: As shameful as it is to admit, it is due to my own mismanagement. I was not able to oversee these camps properly.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: It seems that my business partners did not share the same vision I had for Camp Buddy. And another part of the problem is that I wasn’t as enthusiastic as I used to be.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: The lack of passion from the leaders and scoutmasters affected the camps' performances, delivering an underwhelming experience for the campers.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: And this chain of negligence continued until our campers lost their interest, resulting in fewer and fewer recruits as the years went by.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Last year was the last batch for the two other branches. Continuing to host those camps was no longer feasible.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: The main reason we had so many visitors last year at the event that you organized was because I was trying to convince our sponsors to help us continue our cause.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I failed at that moment and disappointed everyone…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: We’ve already talked about this, Yoshinori. You did the best you could, even without my guidance!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: What happened last year is not just your shortcoming. It’s mine as well. All of us are responsible for it.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s true… When Dad told me he was about to close down this branch as well, I just couldn’t let it end like that..!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: I knew I had to convince him not to give up on this dream.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Camp Buddy isn’t just your own dream anymore, sir! It’s ours too!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Right! And this place isn’t just our dream… It’s our home too!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’re a family here… Nothing can take away our home from us!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: I have no words to describe how proud I am of all of you.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuri
text: Dad…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Alright! Listen up!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve already made up my mind to continue Camp Buddy, and I’ve gathered you here for that reason!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: We’re going to do whatever it takes to keep our home and make this family as big as we can!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: We’ll have a comprehensive meeting first thing in the morning! I need all of you to have a clear mindset to come up with fresh ideas and a solid plan to achieve our goal!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Is that clear, my scoutmasters?!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: All
text: Yes, sir!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: *buuuuurp* Fwaaaah! I’m so full!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: I don’t think I could eat anything else even if I tried!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, you do always eat more than you should, Hiro.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: I can’t help it! You know how good Bro-Aiden’s cooking is!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: We've had quite a long day again today, haven’t we?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Want to call it a night, Keitaro?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Want to call it a night, Keitaro?{fast}
label: day20_yoichi

text: I want to visit Yuki.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You guys go ahead; I’ll just check up on Yuki real quick.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You’re not going there without me.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Alright, you two! We’ll wait for you back at the cabin!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey, are you sure you want to visit Yuki? She might still be in a bad mood like earlier.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, I don’t mind, Yoichi! I just want to make sure she’s doing fine before we go to sleep!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: *sigh* Alright. I warned you, though. Don’t blame me if she acts up again with you.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t worry! It’ll be fine!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Let’s go then.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah! There she is!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuki
text: *bark*
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh? Not that cranky tonight, are you?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuki
text: *whimper*
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww~ She’s so cute! Can I pet her, Yoichi?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmm… Sure.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Now, be nice to Keitaro. Alright, Yuki?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: There, there, Yuki.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuki
text: *licks*
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hmm…? What’s this?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I just noticed she has a key attached to her collar.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, that’s the key you can use to open this padlock thingy on my choker.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! I’ve always wondered why you had a lock on your necklace, Yoichi.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: For you to attach its key on Yuki’s collar… it must be really important to you!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmm… I wouldn’t say it’s that important.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: My mom threw that lockset away because she said it belonged to my father.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I just thought it looked cool, so I scavenged the trash and decided to wear it on me all the time.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(For some reason… I get the feeling that Yoichi really wishes he met his father…){/i}
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I know what you’re thinking, dummy.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: And no. I don’t care about my parents at all. Not anymore.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: So, don’t you dare try to do anything stupid because I’m telling you: I’m okay with what I’ve got now.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I have you, Yuki, and Camp Buddy. That’s more than I ever hoped to have.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha… You saw right through me, Yoichi.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yuki
text: *yawn*
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Looks like Yuki wants to sleep now.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah! Of course! Sorry for keeping you up, Yuki. We’ll go ahead now.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Let’s go back to the cabin. They’re probably waiting for us.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Right!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Hearing Yoichi say those things really reassured me…{/i}
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I now knew some of the things Yoichi has gone through, and realized how hard it must have been for him.{/i}
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But hearing Yoichi content with how things were showed me proof of how strong of a person he really was.{/i}
label: day20_yoichi

text: I want to relax here for a while.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hmm… I guess I’ll stay here for a while and relax.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s good, Keitaro! Heading to bed right away after a meal might give you nightmares, after all!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Not me~! Good night, guys!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hiro! Didn’t you listen to what I just said? Come back here!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hunter! Come help me chase Hiro!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: O-Okay..!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Guess that leaves the two of us here then, Yoichi.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Heh, yeah. It’s about time we could just sit around without getting yelled at.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re right… I guess this is the first evening after all the drama has finally calmed down!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you again for everything you did to prove I was innocent, Yoichi~
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I knew I could rely on you!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Kkh! I didn’t stay here so you could pull more of that mushy shit on me!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *ahem* Am I interrupting?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah! N-No, Scoutmaster Yoshi! We were just chatting, is all!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What the hell are you here for, Sheriff?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! I was just looking for someone! And I happened to pass by you two!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s quite nice to see you boys hanging out with each other like this. Especially you, Yoichi.
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh. Are you here to just ruin the mood?
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: No, Yoichi! It’s just that, I noticed over the past few weeks, the two of you have been spending more and more time together, reinforcing your bond!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: After observing you both, I think it’s safe to say that this bond isn’t just that of friendship!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: For a second there, Scoutmaster Yoshi sounded like Ms. Yuri…
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Look, Sheriff. We don’t need to hear all this romantic crap from you!
label: day20_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I disagree! It’s important that the two of you understand the foundations of a relationship if you’re going to be forming one soon!
label: day20_yoichi

text: I know what it feels like to be alone, Taiga. I used to think that nobody deserved to suffer like that. But maybe you do.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: Come on, Keitaro. Let’s go.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Graaahhhh!!!!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Dammit! I fucking hate everyone here!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Taiga…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Huh?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: We saw what happened…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Lee
text: Your behavior was truly disgraceful, Taiga.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: What do you care…? You traitors…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Taiga… Please don’t push us away, especially after everything we’ve been through together.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Lee
text: We have been your faithful allies from the beginning.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Shut up! I don’t need to hear your shitty opinions!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Just go hang out with your new so-called ‘friend.’ See if I care!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Taiga, you ARE our friend! Do you really think we’d be standing here if we didn’t care about you?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: The reason why Lee and I came back to this camp was for YOU, even though it was a nightmare for us.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: That’s how much we care about you….
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Lee
text: Eduard is correct. We only wanted to continue to engage in activities with you, our friend…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Tch. Now you two are starting to sound like that idiot!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Can you just please give yourself a moment to think and see who the real idiot is?!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Keitaro isn’t really the person you think he is…!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: He’s kind and compassionate… He’s completely different from who you said he was!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Lee
text: It’s true… Your judgment on Keitaro was incorrect. There is no reason to continue hostilities.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: You guys are beyond help. You’re already brainwashed by that little runt!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I’ve wasted my time being friends with you! I shouldn’t have wasted my time on you both—
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Not… another… word…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: I really liked you, Taiga… More than you could have realized!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: To me, you were more than just a friend, especially after you saved me from those bullies!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: But now, look at you… You’ve become just as horrible as the ones who’ve hurt you last year! I’d even say you’re worse!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: You need to think about all the mistakes you’ve made at camp so far, instead of blaming it all on everyone else.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Maybe then you could realize why everyone loves Keitaro and not you.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: Pick yourself up, Taiga. I know you’re better than this.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: There are people who love you, even if you don’t realize it.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Kkh!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Lee
text: He didn’t seem to be responding positively to us, Eduard…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Eduard
text: I know… But I can only hope we knocked some sense into him at least…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: Keitaro…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Sheesh… There’s no way we can fix this. Just look how burnt it is.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… some of the pictures are still intact at least…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t believe Taiga actually burned your journal, Keitaro… That’s terrible.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hiro
text: This time he’s really gone too far! We really need to go and kick his ass!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah! I’m with you, Torch-head! If we just let this go, who knows what else he’ll try and do?!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I don’t think that’s the solution, guys… And I know that’s definitely not what Keitaro wants…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: To be honest, the first thing I wanted to do was call the scoutmasters, but Keitaro stopped me…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I really don’t think hurting Taiga or getting him kicked out of camp will do us any good now…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: If you guys had seen the way he looked, you’d understand…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro, you’re seriously still going to forgive Taiga after this?!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, come on, Frogboy! You gotta stand up for yourself this time!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Although I don’t think we should use violence, I do agree something has to be done… We can’t let this kind of behavior to keep happening.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Please don’t get me wrong, guys… I’m really angry and upset about what Taiga did…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah… That journal really meant a lot to you, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch… Even I get how much it sucks to lose something that important…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I think I need some time alone to think about this. I’m gonna go outside and get some fresh air.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro is really disappointed… Should we go after him?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I-I don’t think we should. Keitaro needs some time to himself right now.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hiro
text: Are you sure, Hunter? He seems really upset…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: I bet if you chased after him, you could get him to stop moping and make him feel better like last time.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I don’t think so, Yoichi... Keitaro did say he needed to some time alone to think. And we should all respect that.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: All we can do now is be there for Keitaro when he’s ready to talk to us…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can't believe I'm back here, after what just happened, but… the sound of the crickets and frogs really help calm me down…){/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe all of my precious memories are gone… just like that.){/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And here I thought… I would have something to look back to…){/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(What if I forget about this place…? The people I met here… and maybe even all the good times I’ve spent with everyone…){/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’m letting myself drown in my own thoughts… I just wanna yell and scream…){/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: K-Keitaro…!?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: What are you doing here?!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: I’m just getting some fresh air!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll just head back to my cabin…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Wait!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I… um…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Will you stay for a minute…?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: P-Please…?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: You must really hate me now, huh…?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: After everything I’ve done to you…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Umm… Well…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I hate to say it, but… yeah, I am really upset…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can’t pretend to know what you’re going through because… maybe I really was wrong the whole time…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I tried so hard to change you… But maybe that was just a waste of time…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: But… I really want to understand why you had to burn my journal… Especially when you knew how important it was to me.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Do you really hate me that much…?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I still forgive you for what you did… We all have our own monsters inside us, anyways…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Why, Keitaro…? Why would you still forgive me? Why can’t you hate me?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Any sane person would’ve despised me by now…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Like everyone else did back then…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess… everybody has a reason for the things they do…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I try to think about what I would do if I were in your shoes, and if I would act the same way…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I just really want to understand people more, so that I can see the way they see…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: You might think that I’m just pretending to be nice… but… who would I be fooling? We’re the only ones here…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: No… I already know that you’re not trying to pretend anymore… Even back then…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: And I’ve been thinking about all the things you told me before…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: If… If I was in your shoes… I would be furious. I don’t think I’d ever forgive you if you’d done what I’ve done…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Eduard was right… I’m no better than the people who made me like this…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Can you tell me what happened to you...?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: M-Maybe if you told me the truth, I could really help you...
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: When I first joined Camp Buddy last year… I was so happy…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I met a lot of new people… I learned a lot of cool things and I got to have fun with everyone…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… everything just… fell apart…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I was blamed for something I didn’t do…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I had to defend myself and the friends who tried to protect me, but then everyone saw it so differently…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I didn’t want to hurt anyone… Everyone was so convinced I was the bad guy… And everyone hated me…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s why I tried so hard to prove to everyone I wasn’t like that…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: But… all my efforts weren’t enough… It just got worse every day…!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: When I was about to give up… Scoutmaster Yoshi and the friends I had left raised me up… That’s when I realized that I want to be here more than anything else…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I begged Scoutmaster Yoshi to let me join again this year, hoping things would turn out differently for me this time.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s just so unfair… The only thing I wanted was acceptance… I worked so hard to earn it and it all just went down the drain…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: But it was so easy for you… Everyone already loved and accepted you in just one day… I was so jealous!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… I slowly started to realize why…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I couldn’t forget all those things you did for me…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Just like how you saw through me during the sportsfest when we were competing against each other… Or when you stopped Sir Goro from expelling me…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: Today, I did the worst thing I could possibly do to you… and you still defended me, even though I didn’t deserve it…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: And now you’re here beside me, choosing to listen to me, and forgiving me even before I can explain myself…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: You’ve always been optimistic about everyone here at camp. You’ve given me more chances than anyone else to be your friend…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I wanted to be like you so bad that I couldn’t see past my own anger…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I kept blaming everyone for my own mistakes… I was so stupid…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: *sniff*
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I… I’m really sorry, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry I tried to make your stay here a living hell…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Taiga… I still forgive you. There’s no reason to hate you, even now. It wouldn’t do either of us any good…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: N-Nobody’s ever talked to me like this before…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I don’t deserve your friendship, not after everything… but… I… I’m more than willing to be your friend…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m just so sorry for everything, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright… You don’t have to say you’re sorry, Taiga…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Taiga
text: *cries*
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But you don’t know how happy I am that you did.{/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hi, everyone… I’m back.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: Welcome back, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hiro
text: I really wanted to go after you, but Hunter stopped me… He said you needed to sort it out yourself…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: I know Hunter was probably right, but I couldn’t help but worry the whole time you’ve been gone…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: You haven’t been crying, have you?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: G-Guys… Keitaro just got back. Let's all give him a little space…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m sure he just needed some time to calm down… Right, Keitaro?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, I’m fine… Thank you, guys.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Are you sure, Keitaro?
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hiro
text: If you ever need to rant about something, you can always talk to us!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yup! I’m alright – today was just tiring, and so many things happened.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: It really sucks that my journal was burnt up like that but… there’s nothing we can do about it now!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Besides, we have plenty of time left at the camp for me to take new pictures and start a new journal again!
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s amazing how you’re still so optimistic about all this, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Looks like Keitaro always remembers to keep the third Buddy Law: “A buddy always shows a bright smile on his face!”
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh. Don’t even get that started, Mr. Perfect.
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m glad to see you’re okay, Keitaro. After all you’ve been through, I just knew you’d get through this…
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Thank you, everyone… *sniff*
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Everyone was really worried about me…{/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}They really do try so hard to make me feel better whenever I’m down… I don’t know what I would do without them…{/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Is this the warmth Taiga was yearning for so long…?{/i}
label: day21_aftershowerhunter

speaker: Goro
text: Come in.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, sir! I brought Aiden with me as you requested.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’re sorry if it took us a while. We had to take care of some mail along the way.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: What’s up, Gramps? Are we having a meeting about the camp’s bills again? Because I’ve already told y'all to cut down on the air-conditioning!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: No, this is about a separate matter.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: I’m just concerned with the state of the camp right now. If we don’t get more campers for the next summer season, this place is going to close.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Next summer season?! Does that mean-
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, Yoshinori. I’ve decided to continue Camp Buddy for the foreseeable future. Therefore, this year will not be the last batch.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What?! R-Really?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa!? Gramps, are you for real?! This is really great news!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: What made you change your mind? I was so sure that it was time for me to pack my stuff after this term ended!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yuri
text: Haha! See, Dad? I told you they would like the surprise!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yuri? You knew about this?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yuri
text: Yes. Dad and I talked about it last night.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: I think you all might have completely neglected the very first thing I said this meeting.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: To repeat, if we don’t get any new campers soon, we won’t be able to continue running the camp until next summer.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, the camp’s bills certainly aren’t getting any easier to manage. I can see where Sir Goro is coming from…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: After some consideration, I’ve decided to be upfront with you all. So listen up.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: This camp is in a dire financial situation. The fact of the matter is that we have lost too many scouts and our reputation has plummeted too far down for us to reasonably expect to get more.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Is this because of the incident last year..?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: Believe it or not, that only played a small part in the current situation.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: As you may know, we have at least three branches of Camp Buddy including this one, with the other two managed by me and my business partners.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: But those two other branches did not open for this year’s summer season.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: Our stockholders and sponsors have decided to end the contract, and any possibility of renewal.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What happened, sir?! I thought the other branches had been doing well all these years?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s not true, Yoshi… It’s the reason why Dad let me help you out here in the first place. It’s because the other branches have already closed down, including the one I used to work in.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: What? And all this time it sounded like this place was the worst-performing one… Just what the heck happened?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: As shameful as it is to admit, it is due to my own mismanagement. I was not able to oversee these camps properly.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: It seems that my business partners did not share the same vision I had for Camp Buddy. And another part of the problem is that I wasn’t as enthusiastic as I used to be.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: The lack of passion of the leaders and scoutmasters reflected the camps' performances, delivering an underwhelming experience for the campers.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: And this chain of negligence continued until our campers lost their interest, resulting in fewer and fewer recruits as the years went by.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: Last year was the last batch for the two other branches. Continuing to host those camps was no longer feasible.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: The main reason we had so many visitors last year at the event that you organized was because I was trying to convince our sponsors to help us continue our cause.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I failed at that moment and disappointed everyone…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: We’ve already talked about this, Yoshinori. You did the best you could, even without my guidance!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: What happened last year is not just your shortcoming. It’s mine as well. All of us are responsible for it.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s true… When Dad told me he was about to close down this branch as well, I just couldn’t let it end like that..!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yuri
text: I knew I had to convince him not to give up on this dream.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Camp Buddy isn’t just your own dream anymore, sir! It’s ours too!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Aiden
text: Right! And this place isn’t just our dream… It’s our home too!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’re a family here… Nothing can take away our home from us!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: I have no words to describe how proud I am of all of you.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yuri
text: Dad…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: Alright! Listen up!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve already made up my mind to continue Camp Buddy, and I’ve gathered you here for that reason!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: We’re going to do whatever it takes to keep our home and make this family as big as we can!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: We’re all aware of the camp’s current situation. We have to make some changes around here if we want to keep this place open, and we need to make them fast.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Goro
text: The main problem lies with this camp’s financial standing. With no sponsors to back us up, we are barely holding this place together with the funds we have in reserve.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Aiden

text: But instead, we’ll be using the internet to reach a wider audience and a more modern age group for the camp.
