text: He actually approached me while we were working today and asked me to help him fix Keitaro’s journal…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What?! That sounds like a load of bullcrap!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I-It’s true! I really do want to fix it!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I know I’ve been a jerk to everyone here, especially Keitaro and Natsumi, and I just want to make up for all that I’ve done…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph. I’m not falling for that lame excuse again!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah! You’re seriously think we’re buying that shit?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s not as if I’m trusting him completely, you guys.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I’m doing this for Keitaro’s sake! You guys all saw how upset he was yesterday…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Y-Yeah… I’ve never seen Keitaro that sad before… It was even worse than when he was almost expelled…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: …Which is also this jerk’s fault!!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: B-But… maybe Natsumi has a point…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: What?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, you’ve gotta be kidding me, Twinkerbell!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… it is pretty hard to believe, considering all the things Taiga has done in the past…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: But think about it. If Keitaro and Natsumi trust him, there has to be a reason we should trust him as well.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I say we hear him out at least…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Thank you, Hunter…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I just thought that Keitaro would be really happy if we actually restored his journal…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: And besides, if Taiga does try anything sneaky again, he knows we won't let him off so easy.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: HMPH! Fine! But I’m only doing this for Keitaro, alright?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: What do you say, Yoichi…?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch. Fine! But I’ll be watching even closer than Torch-head! So, no funny business!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: If I sniff out even the slightest hint of bullshit from you, I’ll make sure you never see sunlight again!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: YOU GOT THAT?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: *gulp* R-Right…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: How do you plan on restoring Keitaro’s journal anyway, Taiga?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Well…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: This is my journal, and… I haven’t really put much into it yet, but…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I’ve started rewriting some of the moments I remember Keitaro had in the past…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I wanted to try and rewrite all of the memories he had here, from the moment he joined the camp.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: Besides, I could still read some of the journal's pages... so I was able get a little bit of info out of them.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I know there are lots of pages that are gone, though. That’s where I need your help… You guys were with Keitaro for most of the camp, so I know you remember all the experiences he’s had…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmm, that sounds like a good idea. I can still remember when I first met Keitaro and Hiro...
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I was surprised to see any new recruits then. Scoutmaster Yoshi even asked me to give you guys a tour.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I remember that day too. Keitaro approached me when I was reading a book in the cabin…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Wait! Hold up!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Even if we could rewrite everything, what’s the point? The photos are all burnt up, and that’s what he liked and worked hard on the most!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: That is true… most of the photos really are too damaged to be used again…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh! I have an idea! I could doodle miniature versions of ourselves to replace them! It’ll feel really special that way~!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: What do you think, Natsumi?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Natsumi?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, sorry. I was just reading the journal Taiga made so far… There’s already a lot of days written in this journal…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: There are even parts that I’m sure you weren’t around for!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: How did you know about us telling scary stories?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh? That’s in there?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, it’s all written down – even the part when Sir Goro showed up!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, you’re right… Even our conversation during the sunset in the fields is here….
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What?! How the hell did that happen?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: There’s no way you would have known about these! Explain yourself!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I… umm…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You better not be hiding something from us, or I’ll punch the hell out of you! I told you, no dirty tricks!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Well…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Spit it out already!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I was secretly reading Keitaro’s journal… whenever you guys left your cabin…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What?! You’re a freaking stalker!!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I know! I know! It was wrong, but that was the old me! I swear!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m trying to make up for acting like that…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, at least you’re owning up to your mistakes. I don’t think you’d be acting like this if you were lying, Taiga.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: The longer we talk, the more I’m convinced you’re telling the truth.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Even still, that’s creepy as hell! Do you have some sort of sick crush on Keitaro or something?!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Wha– N-No! Nothing like that!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Taiga
text: A-And besides, it’ll help us fix the journal, right?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: It wouldn’t have to be fixed if you didn’t burn it in the first place!
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Come on, guys! Cut it out! We aren’t getting anywhere just yelling at Taiga like this...
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: We have to try and move forward if we wanna get anything done together.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Besides, even though Taiga wrote most of the entries back in, there are still a lot of details missing.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Let’s just focus on fixing it, alright?
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Natsumi’s right! I guess we can each start with the individual experiences we’ve all had with Keitaro first.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* Fine… Let’s get this started before Keitaro catches us.
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now let’s see, on our first day at camp…
label: day21_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn*
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh, hey. Morning, Keitaro.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Nnn… You’re up early, Taiga…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Nah, you just wake up late. As always.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hehe, you’re right about that.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, I just noticed. Where are Eduard and Lee?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: They got up over an hour ago. Ever since we started getting along with everyone, they’ve been waking up earlier than usual to hang out.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww, that’s great!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah, they've been stuck to me for so long, so it’s nice to see them making new friends.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: And it's obviously because of you.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What? Why me?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Well, you’re the one who got them to start opening up.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Remember when we were hiking to the beach? That was the first time they really talked with someone else.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ack… B-But they talk like that with you too, right?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Unlike you, my patience’s pretty short. You know how those two can get annoying and obnoxious, so I shut ‘em down when I don’t feel like it.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Hehe. So, kudos to you.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I really don’t wanna take all the credit, Taiga. You helped them too!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I mean… You were their friend for so long, and even if things weren’t perfect, you three still enjoyed each other’s company! Just like real friends do!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Sheesh… You really can’t accept a compliment, can you?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: And how can you be so cheesy when you just woke up? Ugh..
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, you started it~
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: G-Gah…!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ahehe…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: A-Anyway, we should get dressed and figure out what to do for this fundraiser.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, right! Why don’t we go out and see what we can find?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Sure.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: …And lastly, the permits that need to be brought to city hall have already been prepared.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: The only thing I need to do is ask the mayor to sign them.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Either way, that should give us what we need to go around town posting posters and handing out flyers.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa! You got in with the mayor that quick?! What kind of connections do you have, Gramps?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Hehe, Dad has been in this business for a long time~ He knows lots of people!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *ahem* Anyway, I will be travelling to town today, and—
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, Dad! Can I ask you to run some errands along the way?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Of course. What do you need?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Mr. Springfield and Mr. Fitzpatrick made great progress on the posters and brochures yesterday. They even finished a first draft!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: We just need to make samples now, but our printer is running low on ink, so we need more to produce everything!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Alright, I’ll be sure to pick some up while I’m out.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh, Gramps! Since you’re going to the store, mind grabbing some extra ingredients we need for the bake sale?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I thought you already got groceries yesterday?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: W-Well… We kinda added something new to the cookies we're making, so we need a few things!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Alright, fine. What do you need?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Already got ya covered! Here’s a list!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: This is quite the list…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Haha, don’t worry, Gramps! I guarantee these cookies will be a hit!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Fine.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: U-Umm… I-If I may add something to the list, sir?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I’m going all out anyway. Might as well, Yoshinori.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: The wheels on the wagon we'll use for our door-to-door activity are a little rusted and might need lubrication...
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Understood. Anything else?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Nope! That’s all, Gramps! Thanks a bunch!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: On second thought, Sir Goro… Maybe I should join you.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I think it would be better if you had someone to help you carry everything around.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: It's fine, you’re busy too. Just stay on your schedule and continue with your tasks.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Alright…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Relax, Yoshi. Check out Gramps’ guns, he can handle it!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Yeah, my dad usually does groceries back at home anyway~ Believe it or not, he’s pretty good with chores.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *ehem* if that’s all, then I think it's best if I head off now.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: All of you should go ahead and continue with your designated activities.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Roger that, sir!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Seeya later, Gramps!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: It looks like no one's doing their activities in the campgrounds right now.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah, let’s look somewhere else to see what we can help with.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* I probably should’ve let Yoshinori join me. This list is long.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! Good morning, Sir Goro!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Ah, good morning, Mr. Nagame, Mr. Akatora. Are you two heading for your activity now?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Actually, sir, we don’t have a specific activity yet… But we did go around and help everyone with theirs yesterday!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm… I see.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Do you need help with anything, Sir Goro? Taiga and I are available!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Well, I suppose you two are free and have no obligations today…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I do have some errands to run, would you boys care to help me out then?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, sir! We’d be happy to!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: What kind of errands are they?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Well, I need to visit city hall to collect some permits, and make a trip to the grocery store to pick up some supplies for your scoutmasters.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: You two can help me finish my shopping faster so I can attend my other appointments in time.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh, so that means we get to go around town? Awesome!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I assume you two are both ready too, so let’s get going?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Excellent, now follow me.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I never expected Sir Goro to ask us for help like this. He really has been softening up the last few days!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Heh, yeah – he used to be pretty scary, but lately he’s just been like a chill grandpa!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga! Shh!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: You boys coming?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yes, sir!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s go, Taiga!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: U-Umm, sir…? I was just looking at this shopping list and there’s a lot here.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: And you said you had stuff to do after too. Good thing we tagged along, huh?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Yes. That's why I asked you boys to join me.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* I’ve explained to your scoutmasters multiple times about being prepared and planning ahead, but sometimes the lessons don’t sink in.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Oh well, lucky for them, the grocery store is along the way to city hall…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: As long as these errands don’t make me late for my meeting, then it’s fine.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: If you don’t mind me asking, what are you going to do in city hall, sir?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Oh, the first reason is simple—we are applying for a permit to post information about the camp around town, as well as for door-to-door solicitation.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Huh? Do you really need permission for all of that?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Of course! If you don’t require permits, then just anyone can go around town posting whatever they want, or harassing people in their homes.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: We don’t want Camp Buddy to give that impression to our potential recruits.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s true… I guess I never thought of it like that…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah, but it all sounds like a hassle. Shouldn’t this be the kind of thing that’s done online nowadays?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Well, you’re correct that it is a time-consuming task, but it’s an important one. And don’t underestimate the power of doing something in person.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: People respect you much more when you’re willing to meet them face to face.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Besides, I need the signature of the mayor anyway, and while I’m meeting him I want to discuss a sponsorship from the city.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Woah, that would be big for the camp, right? Do you think we'll get one?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: There’s no guarantee, but I think it's worth a try. People might surprise you!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Besides, this is the least I can do—your scoutmasters are doing an excellent job of making sure you all have a great experience at Camp Buddy.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I don’t want to interrupt their progress, so it’s best that I handle these other responsibilities.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don't you want to do the fun activities too, sir?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: It’s not that I don’t want to, I just think that your scoutmasters can do a better job interacting with you, the newer generation, than I ever could.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I’m pretty sure most of the scouts still find me intimidating, so I prefer to watch over behind the scenes and provide guidance as needed.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: And besides, the role of president has many obligations to fill anyway!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-That makes sense…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Although… I think everyone is thankful for the work you do, and aren’t intimidated anymore, sir!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: After all, you’ve already given us things like the beach and waterfall trip this summer!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: All of us behaving and listening just means that we respect you!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Heh, you have a way with words, Mr. Nagame. I can definitely see now what Yoshinori saw in you.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Hehe, you can say that again. He worked his magic on me too.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: That’s true, Mr. Akatora. I’m well aware of your situation and developments this term. You had a rough start, but I’m glad to see that things have worked out for you.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: S-Sorry… I know I’ve been a real pain in the ass…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone has low points in life, what’s important is how you grow out of them. It’s part of the journey to becoming a better person.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I know Mr. Nagame and Yoshinori had some contribution to your change, but believe it or not, it’s always been in your own hands. And other people can only guide you to it.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Sir…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: If you don’t mind, I’d like to know more details as to how everything unfolded.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve only been able to judge your situation based on Yoshinori’s account and my own observations. I would very much like to hear your side.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: A-Are you sure…?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Most definitely. Don’t worry, we have time. It’s still quite a way ahead.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Seeing Sir Goro open up like this was such a surprise…{/i}
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But now, he’s listening to Taiga with sincerity and understanding… I’m glad to see him becoming so comfortable around us!{/i}
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}After talking for a while, we all arrived at the grocery store.{/i}
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Alright, my meeting is soon, and I need us to get through this quickly.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: We have quite a few items on the list, so let’s split up and make this a quick trip.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can handle the baking supplies, Sir Goro!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Are you sure? They’ll be heavy.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I noticed the list didn’t specify which brands to get, and I’m pretty familiar with the stuff that Sir Aiden and Hiro use in the kitchen. So, I think it’s best that I do it!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Alright. Take a cart with you and call me if you need any help.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Mr. Akatora, you go to the hardware department and get the lube for the cart.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Alright.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: I’ll go and collect the ink and paper. We’ll meet at the cash register in fifteen minutes.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Goro
text: Is that clear?
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: Yes sir!
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s see… I already have two dozen eggs… three bags of sugar…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Next on my list… five bags of flour.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow... This is a lot for some tiny cookies...
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess it makes sense since we're trying to sell a lot of them.
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Now, if I remember correctly from yesterday, Sir Aiden and Hiro used almond flour for their recipe…
label: day21_taiga

speaker: Keitaro

text: I’ve wasted my time being friends with you! I shouldn’t have wasted my time on you both—
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Not… another… word…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: I really liked you, Taiga… More than you could have realized!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: To me, you were more than just a friend, especially after you saved me from those bullies!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: But now, look at you… You’ve become just as horrible as the ones who’ve hurt you last year! I’d even say you’re worse!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: You need to think about all the mistakes you’ve made at camp so far, instead of blaming it all on everyone else.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Maybe then you could realize why everyone loves Keitaro and not you.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: Pick yourself up, Taiga. I know you’re better than this.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: There are people who love you, even if you don’t realize it.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: Kkh!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Lee
text: He didn’t seem to be responding positively to us, Eduard…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Eduard
text: I know… But I can only hope we knocked some sense into him at least…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Keitaro…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Sheesh… There’s no way we can fix this. Just look how burnt it is.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Shut up, Torch-head! You’re not making it any better.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… some of the pictures are still intact at least…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t believe Taiga actually burned your journal, Keitaro… That’s terrible.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess it’s because we let our guard down since he’d been quiet the last few days.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch. I knew that runt wouldn’t give up so easily!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: Why didn’t you kick some sense into him, Wolfboy?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You think I just sat there and let it happen?! I was about to smash his skull in, but it’s a good thing Keitaro stopped me…!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m surprised, Yoichi… I would have expected you to beat Taiga up for sure… Even I would’ve lost control in a situation like that…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I have to say, his bullying has really gotten out of hand… Shouldn’t we tell the scoutmasters about this?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Natsumi… We really shouldn’t involve the scoutmasters…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: I agree… We just finished proving Keitaro’s innocence… Another issue might make Sir Goro reconsider the expulsion…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: So, we’re just gonna keep letting that prick have his way?!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Please don’t get me wrong, guys… I’m really angry and upset about what Taiga did…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Even I have my own limits as well…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah… That journal really meant a lot to you, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* I think I need some time alone to think about this. I’m gonna go outside and get some fresh air.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I… I’ve never seen Keitaro so disappointed…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: M-Maybe we should go after him…?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Let him be… If he wanted some company, he would have stayed here.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Let’s give Keitaro some time to think for himself.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: O-Oh… You’re probably right, Yoichi…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s so rare to see him down like that… I really hope he’ll be alright…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can't believe I'm back here, after what just happened, but… the sound of the crickets and frogs really help calm me down…){/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe all of my precious memories are gone… just like that.){/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And here I thought… I would have something to look back to…){/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(What if I forget about this place…? The people I met here… and maybe even all the good times I’ve spent with everyone…){/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’m letting myself drown in my own thoughts… I just wanna yell and scream…){/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: K-Keitaro…!?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: What are you doing here?!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: I’m just getting some fresh air!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll just head back to my cabin…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Wait!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I… um…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Will you stay for a minute…?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: P-Please…?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: You must really hate me now, huh…?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: After everything I’ve done to you…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Umm… Well…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I hate to say it, but… yeah, I am really upset…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can’t pretend to know what you’re going through because… maybe I really was wrong the whole time…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I tried so hard to change you… But maybe that was just a waste of time…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: But… I really want to understand why you had to burn my journal… Especially when you knew how important it was to me.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Do you really hate me that much…?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I still forgive you for what you did… We all have our own monsters inside us, anyways…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: Why, Keitaro…? Why would you still forgive me? Why can’t you hate me?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: Any sane person would’ve despised me by now…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: Like everyone else did back then…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess… everybody has a reason for the things they do…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I try to think about what I would do if I were in your shoes, and if I would act the same way…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I just really want to understand people more, so that I can see the way they see…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You might think that I’m just pretending to be nice… but… who would I be fooling? We’re the only ones here…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: No… I already know that you’re not trying to pretend anymore… Even back then…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: And I’ve been thinking about all the things you told me before…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: If… If I was in your shoes… I would be furious. I don’t think I’d ever forgive you if you’d done what I’ve done…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: Eduard was right… I’m no better than the people who made me like this…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Can you tell me what happened to you...?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: M-Maybe if you told me the truth, I could really help you...
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: When I first joined Camp Buddy last year… I was so happy…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I met a lot of new people… I learned a lot of cool things and I got to have fun with everyone…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… everything just… fell apart…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I was blamed for something I didn’t do…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I had to defend myself and the friends who tried to protect me, but then everyone saw it so differently…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I didn’t want to hurt anyone… Everyone was so convinced I was the bad guy… And everyone hated me…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s why I tried so hard to prove to everyone I wasn’t like that…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: But… all my efforts weren’t enough… It just got worse every day…!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: When I was about to give up… Scoutmaster Yoshi and the friends I had left raised me up… That’s when I realized that I want to be here more than anything else…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I begged Scoutmaster Yoshi to let me join again this year, hoping things would turn out differently for me this time.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s just so unfair… The only thing I wanted was acceptance… I worked so hard to earn it and it all just went down the drain…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: But it was so easy for you… Everyone already loved and accepted you in just one day… I was so jealous!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… I slowly started to realize why…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I couldn’t forget all those things you did for me…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: Just like how you saw through me during the sportsfest when we were competing against each other… Or when you stopped Sir Goro from expelling me…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: Today, I did the worst thing I could possibly do to you… and you still defended me, even though I didn’t deserve it…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: And now you’re here beside me, choosing to listen to me, and forgiving me even before I can explain myself…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: You’ve always been optimistic about everyone here at camp. You’ve given me more chances than anyone else to be your friend…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I wanted to be like you so bad that I couldn’t see past my own anger…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I kept blaming everyone for my own mistakes… I was so stupid…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: *sniff*
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I… I’m really sorry, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry I tried to make your stay here a living hell…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Taiga… I still forgive you. There’s no reason to hate you, even now. It wouldn’t do either of us any good…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: N-Nobody’s ever talked to me like this before…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I don’t deserve your friendship, not after everything… but… I… I’m more than willing to be your friend…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m just so sorry for everything, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright… You don’t have to say you’re sorry, Taiga…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Taiga
text: *cries*
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But you don’t know how happy I am that you did.{/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hi, everyone… I’m back.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Feelin’ any better?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: We were worried that you might have wanted some company…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: But stupid Wolfboy told us you needed some space!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You guys really don’t know when to shut your mouths, do you?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Please don’t worry, I’m fine… Thank you, guys.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Are you sure, Keitaro?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hiro
text: If you need somebody to vent to, you can always talk to us!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yup! I’m really alright – today was just tiring, with so many things happening.
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It really sucks that my journal was burnt up like that but… there’s nothing we can do about it now!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Actually, we have plenty of time left at the camp for me take new pictures and start all over again!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s amazing how you’re still so optimistic about all this, Keitaro…
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Looks like Keitaro always keeps the third Buddy Law: “A buddy always shows a bright smile on his face!” on his mind!
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Seriously, Mr. Perfect?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Anyway! If Keitaro says he’s fine, then he’s fine! After all he’s been through, this is nothing to him! Isn’t that right, Keitaro?
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: R-Right…! T-Thank you, everyone… *sniff*
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Everyone was really worried about me…{/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}They really do try so hard to make me feel better whenever I’m down… I don’t know what I would do without them…{/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}This must be the warmth Taiga was yearning for… {/i}
label: day21_aftersxyoichi

speaker: Goro
text: Alright, we have gathered here today to discuss the camp’s future!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: We’re all aware of the camp’s current situation. We have to make some changes around here if we want to keep this place open, and we need to make them fast.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: The main problem is with the camp’s finances. With no sponsors to back us up, we are barely holding this place together with the funds we have in reserve.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Can’t we cut down on the bills or something? Maybe we can save some money on water or power!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: We’ve already lowered the electricity usage to the bare minimum.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: The cabins not in use don’t even have any power or water going to them, and all of the scouts already know to conserve.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Cutting down on expenses won’t solve this situation. We’re bound to close down if we don’t get a new investor.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You’re right, sir. With minimal funds, we’ll be struggling with our monthly bills and we may not be able to provide a variety of activities for our campers in the future.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Precisely. If we settle for fewer, half-hearted activities, campers will only lose interest.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: And with less interest in the camp, we’d have fewer and fewer enrollees…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: And with fewer enrollees… we won’t even have the budget to pay our bills… We’ll run out of funds eventually and…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: That’s right. We’ll be bankrupt.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Isn’t there anything we can do then? Don’t you have investor friends, Gramps?!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Aiden, it doesn’t work like that… Investing in a place like Camp Buddy means a lot of money.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: In addition, persuading an investor might be out of the question right now, considering our reputation and the recent shutdown of our two other branches.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: How about we focus instead on getting more recruits for the next summer while we look for probable investors?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m sure if we gather enough enrollees, the funds will allow us to run the camp for another year. We can keep it running like that until we find an investor.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: That is the only option we have given the circumstances.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: But then again, based on this year’s statistics, the amount of enrollees has dropped significantly.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: It may be due to last year’s events and the closing down of our two branches.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: How can we possibly turn that around?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I have an idea, sir.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: How about we overhaul the current camp setup?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We can improve our existing facilities and conceptualize new activities, and on top of that, we make a full-blown ad campaign to generate publicity for Camp Buddy!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: Isn’t that too risky, Yoshi..? Using the only funds we have left on something that might not work?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: That is true, dear. Although, I believe it’s a risk worth taking.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah...! If we don’t take this chance, we’ll be forced to close down, anyway! So, why not go all out now?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We don’t have to use up all our reserved funds! I was going to suggest that we have some sort of fundraising campaign!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We could get the community involved to help out the camp!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: You can’t be serious, Yoshinori. Everyone in town has heard the rumors about the camp.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: They’ll laugh in our faces when we ask them for help, and I can’t blame them!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: This was a bad idea… I shouldn’t have dragged you all into this as well.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-Wait, sir! You shouldn’t have to shoulder this burden alone!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Everyone needs to do their part too! After all, we're a family here, remember?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We just need to do our best and get everyone to work as a team.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Then tell me… Just how do you plan to carry out this fundraising campaign?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We can go door to door! Our scouts can participate in these activities as well! Together, we’ll get people to support the camp!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Y-You’ve got to be kidding me! Can we really stoop so low?! It’s humiliating to go door to door and beg!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: Actually, Dad, it’s not that uncommon. There are quite a few organizations that go around town asking for help from the general public!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: And besides, it wouldn’t just be to earn donations – we could also spread information about the camp to the community to draw in more recruits!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s right, Yuri! We can make some flyers like we used to do! If I remember correctly, most of our enrollees this year only joined the camp thanks to those old flyers!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: But hiring someone to produce new flyers… that would be even more expensive! We’d just be sinking money into something without a guaranteed pay-off…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s not true, Dad! We have lots of campers here who are quite talented and would be more than happy to participate in making some posters!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: In fact, I believe Mr. Springfield and Mr. Fitzpatrick would both be excited to have an art project to work on!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh, and I could make some baked goods to sell! Everybody loves a good cookie or cupcake~
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: What better way to wash out the bad taste of our old reputation than with sweets?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: I’m still not sure…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: These are time-consuming tasks, and I don’t know if I can organize them all alone…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: You’re not alone, Gramps! We’re your loyal scoutmasters, here to support you!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: You can leave announcing the activities to me and Aiden, Dad! I’m sure they’ll all be thrilled to help!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: This is exciting! Come on, Aiden! Let’s go gather the scouts now!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: W-Whoa!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Y-Yuri-! *sigh*
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: *ehem*
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: I’ll be focusing on scouting potential investors while you all are busy!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s a great idea, sir! I can begin upgrading some of the camp’s facilities in the meantime!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You can leave all the supervision work to me! You don’t have to worry about this at all, sir!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: Alright, Yoshinori. I’m counting on you. You’re dismissed!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yes, sir!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Goro
text: You’ve really grown to be such a dependable leader, Yoshinori.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Aiden
text: Rise and shine, sleepyheads! It’s time to get the day started!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s right! We have a special activity planned for you all today!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! Good morning, Sir Aiden, Ms. Yuri!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: I-I apologize, we must have overslept this morning!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: That’s alright, Natsumi! Go and wake everyone up then gather them in the mess hall.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yuri
text: We’ll be on our way to go and wake the other scouts as well so don’t take too long, okay?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, ma’am!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Everyone, it’s time to wake up! The scoutmasters have an activity planned for us!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: *yawn* What kind of activity, Natsumi?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well… To be honest, I’m not sure. The scoutmasters didn’t say!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: It’ll probably be something lame like arts and crafts.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m surprised to see you up, Yoichi!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Shut up, Mr. Perfect.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Good morning, everyone…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh hey, Hunter! You’re up early too!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s unusual to see you so unsurprised by Hunter now, Hiro.

label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Tch. Now you two are starting to sound like that idiot!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: Can you just please give yourself a moment to think and see who the real idiot is?!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: Keitaro isn’t really the person you think he is…!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: He’s kind and compassionate… He’s completely different from who you said he was!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Lee
text: It’s true… Your judgment on Keitaro was incorrect. There is no reason to continue hostilities.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: You guys are beyond help. You’re already brainwashed by that little runt!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I’ve wasted my time being friends with you! I shouldn’t have wasted my time on you both—
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: Not… another… word…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: I really liked you, Taiga… More than you could have realized!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: To me, you were more than just a friend, especially after you saved me from those bullies!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: But now, look at you… You’ve become just as horrible as the ones who’ve hurt you last year! I’d even say you’re worse!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: You need to think about all the mistakes you’ve made at camp so far, instead of blaming it all on everyone else.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: Maybe then you could realize why everyone loves Keitaro and not you.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: Pick yourself up, Taiga. I know you’re better than this.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: There are people who love you, even if you don’t realize it.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Kkh!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Lee
text: He didn’t seem to be responding positively to us, Eduard…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Eduard
text: I know… But I can only hope we knocked some sense into him at least…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Sheesh… There’s no way we can fix this. Just look how burnt it is.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… some of the pictures are still intact at least…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t believe Taiga actually burned your journal, Keitaro… That’s terrible.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess we let our guard down since he’d been quiet the last few days.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch. There was no way that little runt had given up that easily!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why didn’t you kick some sense into him, Torch-head?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I was going to, but Keitaro stopped me.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I’ve never wanted to punch someone as bad as I did right then…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I have to say, his bullying really has gotten out of hand… Shouldn’t we tell the scoutmasters about this?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Natsumi… We really shouldn’t involve the scoutmasters…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: I agree… We just finished proving Keitaro’s innocence… Another issue might make Sir Goro reconsider the expulsion…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: So, we’re just gonna let this prick keep having his way?!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Please don’t get me wrong, guys… I’m really angry and upset about what Taiga did…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Even I have my own limits as well…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah… We know how much that journal meant to you, Keitaro…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch… I guess I can understand how hard it is to lose something important to you…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* I think I need some time alone to think about this. I’m gonna go outside and get some fresh air.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: I… I’ve never seen Keitaro so disappointed…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: M-Maybe we should go after him…?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: N-No, Hunter… If he wanted some company, he would have stayed here.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Let’s give Keitaro some time to think for himself.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s so rare to see him down like that… I really hope he’ll be alright…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Me too, Hunter. Me too…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can't believe I'm back here, after what just happened, but… the sound of the crickets and frogs really help calm me down…){/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe all of my precious memories are gone… just like that.){/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And here I thought… I would have something to look back to…){/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(What if I forget about this place…? The people I met here… and maybe even all the good times I’ve spent with everyone…){/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’m letting myself drown in my own thoughts… I just wanna yell and scream…){/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: K-Keitaro…!?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: What are you doing here?!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro & Taiga
text: I’m just getting some fresh air!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll just head back to my cabin…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Wait!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I… um…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: W-Will you stay for a minute…?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: P-Please…?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: You must really hate me now, huh…?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: After everything I’ve done to you…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Umm… Well…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I hate to say it, but… yeah, I am really upset…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can’t pretend to know what you’re going through because… maybe I really was wrong the whole time…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I tried so hard to change you… But maybe that was just a waste of time…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: But… I really want to understand why you had to burn my journal… Especially when you knew how important it was to me.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Do you really hate me that much…?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I still forgive you for what you did… We all have our own monsters inside us, anyways…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Why, Keitaro…? Why would you still forgive me? Why can’t you hate me?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Any sane person would’ve despised me by now…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Like everyone else did back then…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess… everybody has a reason for the things they do…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I try to think about what I would do if I were in your shoes, and if I would act the same way…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I just really want to understand people more, so that I can see the way they see…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: You might think that I’m just pretending to be nice… but… who would I be fooling? We’re the only ones here…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: No… I already know that you’re not trying to pretend anymore… Even back then…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: And I’ve been thinking about all the things you told me before…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: If… If I was in your shoes… I would be furious. I don’t think I’d ever forgive you if you’d done what I’ve done…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Eduard was right… I’m no better than the people who made me like this…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Can you tell me what happened to you...?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: M-Maybe if you told me the truth, I could really help you...
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: When I first joined Camp Buddy last year… I was so happy…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I met a lot of new people… I learned a lot of cool things and I got to have fun with everyone…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… everything just… fell apart…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I was blamed for something I didn’t do…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I had to defend myself and the friends who tried to protect me, but then everyone saw it so differently…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I didn’t want to hurt anyone… Everyone was so convinced I was the bad guy… And everyone hated me…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s why I tried so hard to prove to everyone I wasn’t like that…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: But… all my efforts weren’t enough… It just got worse every day…!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: When I was about to give up… Scoutmaster Yoshi and the friends I had left raised me up… That’s when I realized that I want to be here more than anything else…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I begged Scoutmaster Yoshi to let me join again this year, hoping things would turn out differently for me this time.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s just so unfair… The only thing I wanted was acceptance… I worked so hard to earn it and it all just went down the drain…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: But it was so easy for you… Everyone already loved and accepted you in just one day… I was so jealous!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: But then… I slowly started to realize why…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I couldn’t forget all those things you did for me…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Just like how you saw through me during the sportsfest when we were competing against each other… Or when you stopped Sir Goro from expelling me…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: Today, I did the worst thing I could possibly do to you… and you still defended me, even though I didn’t deserve it…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: And now you’re here beside me, choosing to listen to me, and forgiving me even before I can explain myself…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: You’ve always been optimistic about everyone here at camp. You’ve given me more chances than anyone else to be your friend…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I wanted to be like you so bad that I couldn’t see past my own anger…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I kept blaming everyone for my own mistakes… I was so stupid…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: *sniff*
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I… I’m really sorry, Keitaro…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry I tried to make your stay here a living hell…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Taiga… I still forgive you. There’s no reason to hate you, even now. It wouldn’t do either of us any good…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: N-Nobody’s ever talked to me like this before…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I don’t deserve your friendship, not after everything… but… I… I’m more than willing to be your friend…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m just so sorry for everything, Keitaro…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright… You don’t have to say you’re sorry, Taiga…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Taiga
text: *cries*
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But you don’t know how happy I am that you did.{/i}
label: day22_hiro

text: Hi, everyone… I’m back.
label: day22_hiro

text: Hey, Keitaro! How are you feeling?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: We wanted to let you have some space while you calmed down…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: We were worried that you might have wanted some company…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: But stupid Torch-head told us you needed the time alone!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: H-Hey! Stop it you guys! We don’t have to tell Keitaro all of that!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Don’t worry about them, Keitaro. Have you calmed down some?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, I’m fine… Thank, guys.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Are you sure, Keitaro?
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: If you need somebody to vent to, you can always talk to us!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yup! I’m really alright – today was just tiring, with so many things happening.
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: It really sucks that my journal was burnt up like that but… there’s nothing we can do about it now!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Actually, we have plenty of time left at the camp for me take new pictures and start all over again!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s amazing how you’re still so optimistic about all this, Keitaro…
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Looks like Keitaro always keeps the third Buddy Law: “A buddy always shows a bright smile on his face!” on his mind!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m glad to see you okay, Keitaro. After all you’ve been through, I knew you’d get through this!
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-thank you, everyone… *sniff*
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Everyone was really worried about me…{/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}They really do try so hard to make me feel better whenever I’m down… I don’t know what I would do without them…{/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}This must be the warmth Taiga was yearning for… {/i}
label: day22_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh*

label: day22_hunter

label: day22_hunter

label: day22_hunter
