text: Aww, that’s too bad. You can borrow mine sometime, if you want! We gotta keep it a secret though.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh* Seto, I’ve warned you about your gadgets. If any of the scoutmasters finds out about them, you’ll get in trouble.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Seto
text: Haha well, it’s almost the end of the term, and I haven’t been caught yet.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Anyway, what are you guys up to? Shouldn’t you be working with Scoutmaster Yoshi?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Indeed. And if I recall correctly, Taiga was partaking in this activity as well. Why is he absent?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, he’s just back at the old cabin working! We’re running a few errands for now!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: We actually need something from you, Natsumi.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh? What is it?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Well, there’s a bunch of old graffiti on the walls in the cabin, and we’re trying to get it removed.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi mentioned you knew where some stronger cleaning supplies are?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, of course! There’s a solvent in the shed I can get for you two, along with a rag and wire brush.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Apply the solvent to the stained area with the rag, then scrub it off with the wire brush!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s exactly what we need!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Let me just get it for you guys then!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: *sigh*
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Why are you shaking your head, Lee?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: I’m simply baffled over this detrimental approach to stain removal.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh. Why’s that?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: The procedure advised by Natsumi will result in multiple contusions and abrasions on the surface of the wall.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: You would be defacing the very property you are seeking to repair!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Seto
text: I don't think anyone will notice scratches like that...
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: I’m just commenting on what is the most ideal solution to this predicament.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Never fear, as I have an alternate proposal for you all!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: You should instead simply use a power washer, set with a twenty-five-degree multipurpose tip at 2000 psi and blasted at 24 inches away for maximum effect!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Uhh… What?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Seto
text: *sigh* Come on, Lee, you know the camp doesn’t have anything fancy like that.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Seto
text: We even had to call Natsumi’s brother for the camera that we needed.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: That is a completely valid argument. This camp is indeed poorly equipped with adequate tools…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Seto
text: Can’t you just use a rag instead to wipe it off? Sure, it takes more time, but that shouldn’t leave any scratches, right?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh… That makes sense.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Haha, I can’t believe we didn’t think of that! That’s really practical, Seto!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: If scrubbing the whole day is practical, then be my guest. My proposal is much more time and energy efficient.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Seto
text: For the last time, Lee! We don’t have a power washer!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Here you go, you two! These chemicals are a little strong, so be careful using them.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: I would advise wearing safety gear such as face masks to avoid unintentional inhalation of substances hazardous to your health.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh… yeah… since you guys will be using this indoors, it’s kinda hard on the nose…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Natsumi
text: You guys should go and see Ms. Yuri for some paint masks! She has all of them right now!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Sure! We’ll go and ask her!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thanks, guys~ Sorry to butt in on your activity!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Seto
text: No problem! We should really keep filming though… The weather is perfect right now, so we’d better take advantage of it.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Lee
text: Indeed! Good luck on your assignment, Kieran and Keitaro! Pass along my salutations to Taiga!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Bye guys!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Haha, Lee and Natsumi are just like I remember… Natsumi was always going out of his way to help everyone.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Meanwhile Lee's as opinionated as always... But it seems like he's actually listening to other people's ideas now!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: It's a good thing Seto's there to make sure they get along too.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Yeah, he seems like a cool guy! It's really nice seeing some new and old faces!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: And it’s completely different from last year... Everyone had their own cliques and stayed away from each other’s groups as much as possible...
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh yeah… I think Natsumi and Yoichi mentioned something like that before too…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: That's why I'm glad that's not the case anymore!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Anyway! I guess we need to go to… Ms. Yuri’s group? Isn’t she the camp president’s daughter?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, have you met her before?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I don’t think so… She wasn’t around the camp last year, at least not very often.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I think I might have seen her once or twice at events back then, but we never really interacted.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: T-There were some interesting rumors about her though… even way back then.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-Hehe, well… You just have to meet her and see for yourself. She’s probably in our cabin with Hunter and Eduard.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Alright, let’s go!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hello, Ms. Yuri!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Hi, Keitaro! What brings you h—
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh my!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: You must be the new volunteer!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Yes, ma'am! My name is Kieran Moreno! I used to be a camper here, but now I'm back to help with the fundraiser!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: I knew you looked familiar! How could I forget such a sweet-looking boy like you, Mr. Moreno~?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Mr. Fitzpatrick wasn’t kidding about you being tall, dark, and handsome either~
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: A-Ah, thank you for your compliments, ma’am.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Save the formalities~! Please call me Ms. Yuri!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Anyway, I also heard that you were a close friend of Taiga! Kyaaaaaa~! Yet another childhood-friend trope in the works!!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: But wait… why isn’t he with you then?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: *gasp* Could it be?!!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Does this scenario contain the forbidden tag?!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: W-What…?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: What else could it be other than the controversial yet weirdly popular NTR genre…?!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: T-The w-what…?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Keitaro!!! Have you forsaken your fiery passion for Mr. Akatora?!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ack…!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Wait… Maybe I’m thinking of this in the wrong way… Maybe it’s much simpler than that…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Something… something… that involves three people...
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: …A love triangle!!!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: G-Gah! No, Ms. Yuri!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh my goodness, I can’t believe I’m finally getting the chance to witness it in real life!!!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: In come the complications and the frustrations, laced with intense happiness and a flow of bitterness!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Such endeavor could only result in the inevitable, where one could succeed and the other left in pain and heartbreak!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Uhh… I’m seriously confused… What’s going on?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: …Or better yet… this could be a polyamorous open relationship!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: Keitaro, you greedy boy, I never imagined you in a three-way!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: M-Ms. Yuri, no…!! What are you thinking?!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Hehe, I guess the rumors were true…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* I told you…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: This is making me overflow with ideas! Ahh~ Why is forbidden love such a desirable genre?!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: I can just imagine all three of you burning with affection and exploding with rivalry as to who wins another's attention!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: S-Shouldn’t we do something about this, Keitaro…?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Err….
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: I just can’t!!!! There are so many possible outcomes!!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yuri
text: *faints*
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: W-Well… that’s something you don’t see every day…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Is she gonna be alright there?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: This happens all the time… I think everyone’s already used to it.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: S-So this is a normal thing?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes… Unfortunately.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Hehe, it’s kinda funny though… She imagines the strangest things.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: We’re baaaack~! We're done with-
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: …Oh.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Ms. Yuri’s drooling all over the floor… Did she get overwhelmed again?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Looks like it.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Hello, Eduard and Hunter!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: I think we just found the culprits of this crime scene.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, hi, Keitaro and Kieran!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: What brings you two heartthrobs here?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, we were here to get some paint masks from Ms. Yuri.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well… before she fainted.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I can’t believe we’re just letting her lie down on the floor passed out, though…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: S-She’ll be fine… Believe it or not, she’s actually conscious…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: From what I can see here, she probably said a bunch of stuff and spiraled into fantasyland.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Hopefully she didn't make you feel uncomfortable, Kieran...
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: It’s alright, I really didn’t mind that much. She seems really entertaining, honestly.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: I-It does start out that way, at least.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Anyway, you guys can use the paint masks over there. We ended up not using spray paint, so we didn’t need them.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: What do you guys need them for? Are you guys going to do an art project too?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, actually the opposite, we’re gonna remove some paint on the wall of the old cabins.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Then we’re going to refurnish the whole place!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, I see! Then you guys will need these too.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Huh? What is this?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s wood varnish. You should apply this to the area where you remove the paint to make it look polished and brand new!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh wow! Thank you, Hunter!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: No problem.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: You guys seem pretty busy with your fundraising activity too!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Yes, we’re actually in charge of making the posters and brochures. We’ve already started printing our designs, so we’re just keeping that up!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: Yassss, just look at how beautiful they turned out, too! Hunter here is his own little Peek-ass-o~
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Oh, wow! That poster does look really good!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Eduard guided me along the way. Taiga and Keitaro helped some too!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Wait… Is this the same one that Yoichi’s team has been posting around town?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: Yes, it is! We worked hard to make them as eye-catching as possible!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Anyway, you guys should better get going before Ms. Yuri wakes up and freaks out again.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, you’re probably right, Hunter.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Thanks for helping us get what we needed, guys!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: No problem, Mr. Handsome!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: *wink*
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: H-Hehe…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Eduard
text: So, what should we do with her?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hunter
text: *sigh* I’ll get the water bucket…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: How was your first meeting with Ms. Yuri, Kieran?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Well... it was definitely an experience.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: It's good to see that Eduard is making friends just like Lee, though! I would have never expected to see him working together with someone.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, Hunter is really easy to get along with, but it’s true they didn’t start off as friends either.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: They don’t have a lot in common, but they’re both creative at least!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Anyway, we got the varnish, masks, and paint solution… We just need the blueprints, right?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, yeah! Scoutmaster Yoshi said that Sir Aiden would have those… He should be in the kitchen with Hiro!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Alright! Then let’s head over there!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hello, Sir Aiden and Hi-
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: WAH!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, hey there, you two!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-Hiro! What are you wearing?!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Isn’t it cool? Bro-Aiden had a spare apron for me! It’s just my size!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: B-But you aren’t wearing any-
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Aww, come on, Keitaro! The little dude just needed to cool off!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Well… it is pretty hot in here… and… it’s probably not just the temperature.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh? Is that Kieran with you? Hey, buddy!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: It’s been forever since I’ve seen you around! How have you been?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I’m good, Sir Aiden! I’m here volunteering for the fundraiser!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah, Yoshi told me! That’s great to hear – we need all the help we can get!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Thanks for taking care of him, Keitaro! I’m sure Kieran appreciates having someone show him around the camp!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: What are you guys here for though? Lunch’s already served out there.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Actually, we’re working on our fundraiser activity right now! Scoutmaster Yoshi sent us out to grab a few things we needed.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: He mentioned that you have some blueprints for us, Sir Aiden.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh yeah! I grabbed them from the office this morning when I saw Yoshi had left them behind.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: I think I placed them on one of the cabinets in the storage. I’ll go get them for you guys real quick.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: So, how’s the activity going, guys? Don't tell me you have another new best friend, Keitaro!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* Hiro…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Oh, I've been meaning to ask - how did you two get the idea to go to camp together?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: I actually signed us both up for the entire summer! It’s a good thing Keitaro didn’t mind, haha~
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, I’m glad you did. It’s been a lot of fun so far!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Haha! Maybe I should have done it that way with Taiga – it took forever for me to convince him to come.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: It’s cool how close you guys are, even when you’re not in the same cabin together.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph, if I had it my way, Keitaro would be right back in ours, but ever since that stupid sportsfest bet, he started to stay with Taiga!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Oh yeah... Taiga told me about that too... I was actually surprised he asked something that unreasonable…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: I know right?! You’re lucky you didn’t see Taiga when he was a total douchebag!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-Hiro…!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I still find it hard to believe that Taiga would go around doing mean stuff like that… He never did things like that before…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well, I’m sure he had his reasons. What’s important now is that he’s learned and is making up for it!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: See, Kieran? We had to deal with Keitaro being this protective about Taiga for the first half of the term.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Haha, I guess Keitaro here is a really thoughtful person to look out for Taiga like that!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: That I can agree on!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* Y-You guys…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Anyway, it smells delicious in here! What are you guys cooking? Isn’t lunch already served?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, we’re making cookies to sell for our part of the activity!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: And it’s going great so far! We’re finishing one more batch then opening up our booth again!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: You’re not gonna go out there selling them dressed like that… right?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Hahaha, of course not! We’d get arrested if we go around outside butt naked!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Hiro
text: Although Bro-Aiden did say we’d get more sales looking like this…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: And here we go! One set of bed blueprints for our little carpenters!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, thank you, sir!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Great! Good luck building those! The plans are pretty old, but they should be pretty solid!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Thanks, Sir Aiden! We’ll let you guys get back to cooking!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Aiden
text: Seeya later! Grab a cookie on your way out!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright! Thank you again, Sir Aiden and Hiro!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}After getting everything we needed, Kieran and I made our way back to the cabin.{/i}
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Spending the whole morning with Kieran was actually fun… He even made sure to keep me from getting lost in thought.{/i}
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Somehow, it feels reassuring to get closer to someone Taiga used to be with…{/i}
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hey guys, we’re back-
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: …Oh, Yoichi! What are you doing here?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: I just got done putting those posters up with Gramps and it was soooo boring!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: He wouldn’t let me stick them anywhere fun, so breaking a bunch of wood like this is way more exciting!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yoichi, I already told you…. we’re measuring and cutting the wood…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Meh, same thing. Besides, you needed my help here!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: How else are you gonna get it done with all these skinny weaklings?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Just look at Snoopy McDroopy over there! He’s all skin and bones!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Haha, you’re just as wild as I remember, Yoichi~
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph, well I don’t remember anything about you. Other than you following Dynamite around like a lost puppy.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Hehe, I guess I didn’t make much of an impression last year…
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, have you boys retrieved the supplies?
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, yes sir! We got the blueprints, paint-removing solution, some face masks, and varnish!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Great! Way to think a step ahead, you two!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: While you boys were gone, Taiga and I have been measuring and cutting these boards as well.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We finished right before you both arrived! Taiga is quite talented at this!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I-It’s not that complicated, you know.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I’m not surprised. Taiga has always been a crafty guy.
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Indeed, he is! He really made my work faster!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That being said, I think we’re about ready to start the next steps!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We’re going to start removing the graffiti, repairing holes, and fixing the ceiling!
label: day23_taiga

speaker: Yoichi
text: What?! No more karate-chopping planks?

text: You have to try and see beyond what Scoutmaster Yoshi tried to tell you.
label: day31_natsumi

text: You can't just give up either.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You can’t just give up either, Natsumi…
label: day31_natsumi

text: It won't help if you keep thinking that way.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: It won’t help if you keep thinking this way, though…
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’ve come too far and worked too hard to let yourself stop now.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: There are still a few days left in camp. I’m sure we’ll find out what that missing thing was!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t worry! We’ll convince Scoutmaster Yoshi that you deserve to be a scoutmaster, just like I always thought!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro…
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: We can do this, Natsumi! And you can count on me to be with you the whole way too!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Y-You’re right, Keitaro…! I’ll keep trying!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: If you believe in me this much, then it’s not impossible for everyone else to think so too!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright then! All that paperwork in the office got me really hungry! I’m sure you are too!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, y-yeah, kind of.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hehe! I’m sure a nice meal will cheer you up a lot! We can get your favorite this time!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I'd like that, Keitaro.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s go have dinner, then!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh! There you are, you two! C’mon and have a seat!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Good evening, guys!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Where have you two been? We haven’t seen you all day…
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Psh. Should we be even asking at this point? Or you want me to tell you guys like always?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, it’s not what you’re thinking, Yoichi.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: We were actually at the scoutmaster’s office, sorting out all the pre-registration forms and handling documents and stuff~
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: It’s the afterparty! You guys need to chill out like me!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha yeah, we didn’t really do anything but rest today. But I guess we did earn it after all that hard work we did for the fundraising.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Well, I guess we can expect Natsumi not to take a day off like us, you two.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: Did you guys really spend the entire day working on all that mail?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, I was already expecting a lot, but I was still surprised! At this rate, I’m sure next year’s gonna have way more recruits!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Yikes! How are the scoutmasters even gonna handle all that next year?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, that’s actually a part of why we were there, Hiro. We had a little talk about it with Scoutmaster Yoshi.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Pfft. Mr. Perfect’s probably got on his knees for a scoutmaster position or something.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: E-Eh? How’d you know that, Yoichi?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What the… No way! I was just joking!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Whoa! Is that for real, Natsumi?! You’re actually gonna be a scoutmaster?!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Ah… Not really, you guys. But it is true that I’m planning to be one.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: You? A scoutmaster? What, am I supposed to be under you now?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I wouldn’t mind at all if Natsumi became an official scoutmaster for the camp. He’s already like one, after all.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I mean, he’s reliable, hardworking, and really smart too!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Psh, anybody who’s good enough at talking to people could be a scoutmaster! Kissing up to the Sheriff will probably get you the job just like that.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s not true! You don’t even know what it takes to be a scoutmaster, Yoichi… You need to be responsible and knowledgeable of the camp you’re running.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, but you take it way too far and stress yourself out too much.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Natsumi’s not like that anymore, Yoichi…
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, I’m just sayin’. If Mr. Perfect here becomes a scoutmaster, the guys under him actually need to like him so that they follow what he says!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m not telling y’all he can’t make it… But he needs to be a guy who follows his gut instead of the rules all the time.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: No wants a tense, boring nagger watching over them all the damn time.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Ah, I think Yoichi is just trying to tell you what is his opinion of a scoutmaster should really be.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: He means, a scoutmaster should make sure everyone gets along and works together despite their differences.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I believe a scoutmaster isn't just someone you look up to. They're there to guide and care for you too.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: I see…
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Are you sure you really wanna do this next year, Natsumi?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m not saying that I hate it or anything… but don’t you think it’s too early for you to be going for jobs like these?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-Well, it’s not a full-time job, Hiro. I’ll only need to come during the summer vacation.
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: That’s my point, dude. Are you sure you even want to use your whole summer vacation on something like this…?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: That is true. If you start working as a scoutmaster next year, will that mean you’ll too be busy to hang out with us?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well… I think I can still hang out with you guys even if I’m a scoutmaster. I mean, I’ll still be at camp with all of you, right?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, we get that and everything, but you’ll have scoutmaster stuff to do. We were hoping we could have more fun with you, you know!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh… S-So, you guys think I shouldn't go for it then?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, you should, Natsumi! It’s what you want!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: And guys, I’m sure Natsumi can still find time to hang out with all of us even if he gets the job!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Keitaro
text: We should support Natsumi no matter what! It what’s we’re supposed to do as his friends, right?
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hiro
text: Well, if Keitaro thinks so, then I’m all for it, Natsumi!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Hunter
text: I think you’ll do great too! Please do your best!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Just don’t let it get to your head. You got that?!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Natsumi
text: Right…! Thank you, everyone!
label: day31_natsumi

speaker: Kieran
text: Turns out I couldn’t get any sleep at all…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Hngh… My head is spinning with all these thoughts…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I thought walking around out here would clear my mind, but I just can’t help but feel anxious…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, Kieran! You’re up early!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: A-Ah…! Good morning, sir.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: If you’re looking for an activity, don’t worry, there’s not one today!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We decided to use these last few days of camp for recreation and to allow the scouts to spend time with each other.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Everyone has been working hard for the fundraiser and is exhausted from last night’s party after all!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: T-That’s good to hear, sir.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Time really flew by, didn’t it? I can’t believe we’re almost at the end of this year’s term!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: O-Oh… That’s right…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: What’s the matter, Kieran? You seem troubled.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: A-Ah… I just realized I don’t have much time left…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: What for?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: To tell you the truth, I didn’t come back here just to help Camp Buddy… I wanted to settle things with someone…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I-I’m sorry, sir…! I don’t want my motives for volunteering to sound insincere…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Please don’t worry about that, Kieran! No matter what your reasons were, you still helped us out in our time of need!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’ve seen just how much effort and care you put into our cause here, so I’d be happy to help with your concerns!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You’ve always been a part of Camp Buddy, and as your scoutmaster and a friend, I want you to know that I’m here to listen.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Ah… Thank you for understanding, sir…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: It’s just like you said though… with the fundraiser completed and the term almost over, I realized this might be my last chance…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: There are so many questions I want answers to, but I'm so scared of what will happen if I ask them...
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hmm… That does seem complicated… I know how it feels to be in that position…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: R-Really, sir?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yes… I’m sure you remember the whole incident last year, when the camp was in such a terrible state.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I-I do…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ever since then, Camp Buddy has been at risk of closing forever, and I’ve never felt so lost before.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As someone who grew up with this place and worked hard to keep it alive, I thought I was going to lose my purpose.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I was at a crossroad just like you… I had to decide between accepting that Camp Buddy was over, or trying to save it, knowing that there was a chance I would just fail again.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I will admit, I considered giving up since I was afraid that if I fought so hard, I might end up disappointing everyone at camp, or worse, putting them through something they don’t deserve.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: After losing so much, I didn’t want to make things worse than they already were.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: T-That’s how I feel too, sir…!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: But... I heard from Taiga and Keitaro that there was another sportsfest this year...
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: And with everything that happened before... how did you know that this time would be different?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I didn’t, Kieran. I took a chance, not knowing what’s ahead of me and trusting that things will turn out for the better.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: After all, it wasn’t fair to myself or to everyone that counted on me to expect that it would fail…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That would mean I had given up hope.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: S-So… you think I should take the riskier path too?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well… it really depends on your situation, but the most important thing is to follow your heart.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I see…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Think about it this way, Kieran…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Don’t you believe there’s much more to lose by not taking a risk at all?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: By doing nothing, you’ll only be left wondering about what could’ve been.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Y-You're actually the second person to tell me that... And I think you're both right...
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well… I think it’s good to understand that in life, there will always be decisions to make that could lead to either failure or success.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Just like here at Camp Buddy... Almost everyone thought that we were done for after such a hard fall.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yet here we are, slowly getting back on our feet! We just have to learn from our mistakes.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: …It also reminds me of your good friend Taiga. We both know how hard he worked to redeem himself from all the trouble he caused back then.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Although, he's had a tough time this year as well... He had issues with plenty of the campers, even with me…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A huge reason for all these misunderstandings was a lack of communication and patience with each other.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But look at him now, and he’s more mature than he ever was. He has finally let go of his anger and, most importantly, learned from his past mistakes…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: …A-Are you alright, Kieran?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: So… all this time, Taiga never told anyone about it...?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: H-Huh?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: The riot back at the sportsfest… The one who caused it…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: …It was me.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: It was because of my selfishness that I put the whole camp in jeopardy…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-Wait… You mean the camper that showed up and said he was beat up by Taiga-
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: It wasn’t true… I set it all up to put the blame on Taiga…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: We had personal problems with each other and I ended up framing him to be hated by everyone else…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I didn’t plan for things to end up the way they did...
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Seeing everyone hurt Taiga thinking he was the bad guy, I was so scared about what I’d done…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So he was just trying to defend himself… And everyone else was just made to believe it was his fault…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Everything makes sense now…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That must be why you left camp early… You must’ve been so afraid…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Kieran… As unfortunate as this truth is… it’s already in the past.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But it’s never too late to make things right…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can only give you advice, Kieran, and it’s up to you how you take it.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Yoshinori
text: In the end, it’s still your choice to make.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh man… My head hurts…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I really went all out partying last night…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: And I guess I’m not the only one… Keitaro’s still passed out over there.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: O-Oh, Taiga…! You’re awake.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Hey, Kieran. You’re up and dressed early, are we having an activity today?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: A-Ah, not really…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Do you have time to talk though?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah, what’s up?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I mean privately… If that’s okay with you…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Uh… Sure. Let me just get changed.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: So, what did you want to talk about, Kieran?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: …Why didn’t you tell anyone what really happened at the sportsfest last year?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: W-What…? Where did that come from…?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi and everyone else thinks it was your fault…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: So why…?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Why did you take the blame…?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I… don’t know…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: No matter how it started, I still got into a fight and hurt someone… I had it coming either way…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Come on, Kieran. Is that really what you wanted to talk abou-
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: You did it to cover up for me, didn’t you, Taiga?!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: You knew that if you told everyone, they would’ve hated me or worse, hurt me instead!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: What was I supposed to do then..?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: You were already gone, and I was stuck there dealing with all of it.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: But you didn’t have to take it all on yourself…! I had already caused you so much pain and yet you still tried to protect me?!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: S-So what if I did…? It doesn’t really matter either way…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: O-Of course it does, Taiga! None of that would’ve happened if I hadn’t set you up like that…!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s all behind us now… just forget about it, Kieran…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m over it…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: But I’m not…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Ever since we parted ways, I’ve been ridden with guilt over what I did to you…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Not a single day has passed that I didn’t regret my actions and hate myself for being so stupid…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: There was no way I could’ve moved on, so I punished myself every day, telling myself that I didn’t deserve to be happy…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: They were the darkest days of my life…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: But then… I met you again…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Finding out that you enrolled in Camp Buddy even after what happened, I was so relieved that you didn’t destroy yourself like I did…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: That’s why I had to come back here and see you again… I wanted to apologize and try my hardest to make it up to you…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: You didn’t have to do all that, Kieran… I already let go of the past…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I-I know… but…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Being with you here the past week, it reminded me of when we were still together…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: All the happy memories we used to share, I never thought I could relive them…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: ...For once in such a long time, you gave me a reason to be happy again.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: But you’re right… It’s not about the past anymore…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: The real reason I wanted to talk to you is because I need to tell you something very important…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: H-Huh…?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: You’ve grown so much in just a year without me…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I got to see a whole new side of you that's compassionate and kind.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: All the things I could ever wish for and more, you had them all…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I was so happy to be with you here that I couldn’t help but to…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: ...fall in love with you again.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: K-Kieran…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I-Is there any chance we can be together again…?
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I can’t…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry, Kieran…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I thought about this as soon as you came back to camp…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: And I always knew what my answer would be, in case you asked…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I see…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: So, I never really stood a chance to begin with…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I can’t believe I made you put up with me again, I’m a horrible person for expecting that after everything I’ve done to you.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: What I did was unforgivable after all… and you have the scar to prove it…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran, that’s not what I meant…!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s just… What we had between us… I’ve moved on…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: …And I hoped you had too.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: *sniff*
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: K-Kieran…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I’m so sorry, Taiga…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: …For everything.
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran, wait…!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: Damn it…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: What the hell was I thinking, getting my hopes up like that?!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I should have known Taiga would never want to be with me again… after all I’ve done to him…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: *sniff* I-I’m so stupid…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: All this time... I kept wondering if I could get a second chance...
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Taiga was already happy here without me... but I still tried to force my way back into his life…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: Why am I so selfish?!
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: *cries*
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: *sniff* T-Taiga doesn’t deserve to have me burdening him like this forever…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: He’s already moved on, while I can’t…
label: day31_taiga

speaker: Kieran
text: I should have never come back here in the first place…

label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Hi, Mom!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: H-Hiro?!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Hehe, you surprised to see me? And look who I brought with me!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hi, Mrs. Akiba!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: K-Keitaro! Oh, dear! What a pleasant surprise!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: I had no idea you were coming by! Let alone with Keitaro! I- *cough*
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Take it easy, Mom! Don’t get up. It’s alright~
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: You really are going to give me a heart attack! How on earth did you two get here? A-And how did you know I was here in the city..?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Well… Aunt Himiko sent me a letter and told me you'd been moved.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: *sigh* I told her not to tell you just yet… She must’ve fetched you and brought you here, is that right?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Actually, Scoutmaster Yoshi offered to drive us here when he heard the news…!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Oh, that’s wonderful! Is he here with you? I want to thank him for bringing you to see me!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Not right now! He had some errands to run!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: But he said he’ll be back after a while to come and pick us up! I’m sure you’ll get to see him then.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Oh, I see! I’ll be sure to thank him before you both leave.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Anyway, Keitaro! How have you been? It’s been such a long time!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: I’ve really missed you so much!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Hiro is always going on and on about you, all the time!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m doing really well, Mrs. Akiba! We’ve been having tons of fun together at Camp Buddy!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, and that reminds me! We brought you some cookies! Hiro made them with me and one of the scoutmasters!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: And guess what, we used your recipe too, Mom! We even sold them around town for a fundraiser, and they were a huge hit!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: They’re adorable! I love the little raccoons~ Those always were your favorite, Hiro.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: You must have added lots of the secret ingredient, didn’t you, Hiro?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Of course, Mom! I’ve got lots of it in the camp, especially with Keitaro around~
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Aww, aren’t you two just precious? It’s such a shame I’ve been trapped in here! I would love to come and visit you at the camp!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t worry, Mrs. Akiba! I’m sure you’ll get to come and visit the camp once you’ve recovered!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: And besides, after this term in Camp Buddy, I also promised Hiro that I’d stop by your place more often! Just like the good old days!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Oh my…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-Is everything alright…? Did I say something wrong…?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: N-No, not at all, dear! I just remembered that I need to take my medicine soon!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Keitaro, would you be a dear and ask the nurses to prepare it for me?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh! Sure thing, Mrs. Akiba! Do you want to come, Hiro?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: It’s alright, Keitaro. I’ll stay here for a minute with Mom.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh, Um… Alright!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: *sigh* Hiro, dear…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Why didn’t you tell him that we won’t be going back to our old house…?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: W-Well… I couldn’t bring myself to tell him yet…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: You told me that you wanted to go with Keitaro this summer to say goodbye to him, didn’t you? You knew that we would be moving away, after all.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I know, I know! But… ever since summer camp started, we’ve been having so much fun together… There were some difficult times, but we got through it all together!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I think… I… fell for him all over again…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: And now, I don’t have the heart to tell him that we’ll be moving away after this summer… I’m sure it’ll break his heart when he finds out…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: *sigh* You’re still the same as ever…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Hiro… You’re making things more difficult for yourself… You’ve always hid things from him, ever since you two met.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: And now you’re scared that you’re running out of time.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: You two have been friends for as long as I can remember… Don’t you think it’s about time you stopped hiding things from him?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Keitaro deserves to know the truth…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* You’re right, Mom…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Although… I expected this to happen…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Y-You did…?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: I am your mother. Of course, I would know everything about you, my dear.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: T-Then why didn’t you stop me from going before?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: All I wanted was to see you happy, Hiro. I’m willing to try and overcome my sickness in exchange for that sweet smile of yours.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: When I saw how sad you were after you were separated from Keitaro because of me, I just knew that I had to let you go to Camp Buddy with him...
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: And now that I'm putting you in the same situation again... It makes me think that I’m not doing a good job as your mother...
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: I’m sorry I couldn’t give you more time… I did try my best to recover…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Don’t say that, Mom... It's not your fault at all...
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I should be the one who understands your situation the most... It's really selfish of me to ask you for more time... knowing about your condition.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Ah! What am I doing? I don't see you for a whole month and the first thing I do is lecture you and make you feel sorry for me!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I don’t mind at all, Mom... I've actually missed your lectures...
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: What's holding you back from telling him, anyway?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: I... I'm just scared that he might get upset with me...
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: But Keitaro is such a sweet boy... I’m sure he won’t be upset with you, especially after everything you two have been through together.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* In the end, you’re right, Mom... I should've just told him instead of hiding it...
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: There’s no use fretting over that, Hiro… We both know why you couldn’t bring yourself to tell what you feel for him.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: But cheer up, dear! There’s still time!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Alright, Mom… I promise I’ll come up with a way to tell him.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Sorry, that took so long! The nurses were teasing me…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Don’t worry, Keitaro! Hiro and I were just having a little chit chat.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: And don’t mind them, they’re just bored! The hospital can be quiet during days like this, so they like to mess with visitors.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: But enough about this dull place! Tell me what you’ve been up to these last few months, Keitaro!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: How has camp been so far? Hiro hasn’t told me anything about what you’ve done this summer!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, it’s been really fun!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah! We have tons of stories to tell you from camp, Mom!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Why don’t we start with the first day, Hiro?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh yeah! You were so late, so Mom had already left by the time you got there…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}We spent the rest of the afternoon chatting with Mrs. Akiba about what had happened since camp started.{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}How we met our friends, and all the ups and downs that we’ve been through these past few weeks!{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Hiro was really eager to tell Mrs. Akiba about our adventures at Camp Buddy... It was really sweet to be able to spend time with them like a family!{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: And then we snuck out late at night and broke into the scoutmaster’s office!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Oh, my! You’ve been a little troublemaker, haven’t you, Hiro?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey! We were just trying to clear Keitaro’s name!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Haha! I know, I know. In any case, it sounds like you’ve made some great new friends since coming to camp!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: It seems like quite a lot has happened since I dropped you off there!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah! And we’re just getting started! You won’t believe what happened when Sir Goro found out who really took that picture!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: *cough* *cough*
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: A-Ah..! Mom..!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: I-I’m fine..! *cough* *cough*
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I’ll go call the nurse…!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: N-No need, Keitaro… I’m fine, really!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: M-Maybe you shouldn’t have forced yourself to chat so much with us…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: D-Don’t worry about me, dear. I’m really okay…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Well… The fact that you were moved here to the city earlier than we both expected is enough proof that you’re not…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Hiro, dear… Don’t say that…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good evening, Mrs. Akiba.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi, you’re back!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Oh, Mr. Yoshinori Nagira! It’s a pleasure to finally meet you!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: The boys have told me a lot of great things about you and the camp. Thank you for taking good care of them.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah, it’s my pleasure! But I would like to give my deepest gratitude to your son as well!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: He and Keitaro have contributed a lot to the camp!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Haha, these two are quite the team! No obstacle is too hard when they’re together.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Which is why— *cough* *cough*
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: O-Oh, Mrs. Akiba? Are you alright?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Ahh… I’m fine… I’m very sorry if I’m making you all worry…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Please don’t force yourself, ma’am! Your health is our utmost priority!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: How about we let Mrs. Akiba take her rest now? You two must’ve drained her with all your stories!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And it’s almost sundown too… We’ll be on the road until evening at this rate.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Ah, yes! It’s about time that you all go back to camp. You guys still have a long way to go after all.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: B-But… I’m not done with my stories…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t worry, Hiro! You can always tell your mom about everything next week when you see her! At least now you know that she’s doing alright!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Aww… I guess you’re right, Keitaro.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: But Mom! You got to promise you’ll be a lot better, alright?!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Yes, dear… I will keep doing my best.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Alright then! We will be taking our leave now, Mrs. Akiba!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: On behalf of the scoutmasters and the scouts of Camp Buddy, I express our sincere wishes for your speedy recovery!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Thank you again.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Alright. Let’s get moving, boys!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Keitaro, wait..!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, Mrs. Akiba?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: I want to thank you too for always making my son happy.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: It seems that he’s learned plenty of good things after just a month of staying at Camp Buddy.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: I believe I owe most of it to you. You’re the reason why he’s grown up to be such a fine young man.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I don’t know what to say, Mrs. Akiba…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hina
text: Let’s not be too formal here. You can just call me Mom too, dear!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ahh…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey! What’s the holdup? The nurses are starting to flirt with Scoutmaster Yoshi out there!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: R-Right! Thank you again for having us…! I hope that you get well soon!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It was really great to get to see Mrs. Akiba! It’s been so long since I’ve seen her.{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}She seemed so happy I visited her with Hiro… I really will have to try and make the time to visit her more often after the summer camp!{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It was well after dark when we finally arrived back at camp.{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Whew! That was such a long ride!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah, I'm so exhausted...
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh. Welcome back, you two! I didn't expect you both to be back tonight!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: We heard from Sir Aiden about your mom, Hiro. Is she feeling better?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Well... She looked like she was doing well when we visited her... So I guess my aunt was right about not worrying.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: And your mom was really happy to see us too! I'm glad we went!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Aww, that's really nice!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, it was! What about you guys? What did you do today?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Actually, I just did chores all day long. Camp Buddy is really boring without you two around.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: I helped Sir Aiden with the laundry after you two left, and then I finished a book I was reading. It was a quiet day.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: What about Wolfboy? I haven't seen him since we got back!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: What? Did ya miss me, Torch-head?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yoichi! What's that smell? You stink! Just what on earth have you been doing?!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: None of your business, Mr. Perfect! So, did you two bring us something good from the capital?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: No way, Wolfboy! We went to see my mom, not to shop for you!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: That's lame! I saw Sheriff Brokeback carrying bags in, and I thought you might've brought something cool back!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yoichi, you're getting mud everywhere! I just cleaned these floors!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Fine! Fine! I'm gonna take a bath just so you can quit your yapping, Mr. Perfect!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh* I guess I'll go and mop up this mud.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Why don't you two go ahead and sleep? I'm sure you're both tired from that long drive!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, I'm actually pretty exhausted... I guess an early bed time is fine!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Umm, Hiro? If you ever need to talk to us, just remember your friends are always here for you, okay?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: A-Ah..! What’s with the sudden tone, Hunter? Haha! I’m really fine!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… We all know what you’re going through with your mom is really tough…
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s true. I can’t imagine how I would feel if I were in your place... So don’t hesitate to approach us whenever you’re feeling down, alright?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Meh. Torch-head’s gonna be fine. And I’m sure his mom will too.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hunter
text: Haha. You really came back just to comfort Hiro too?
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: What?! No! I just forgot to get my towel!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Natsumi
text: Aww, you don’t have to lie about it, Yoichi~ I’m sure you’re just as worried as us.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: T-Thank you… You guys are really awesome!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s what friends do for each other after all.
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Yoichi
text: UGH! Would you all stop this cheesy cringe-fest already?!
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}All of our friends were so worried about Hiro... I'm glad that he means so much to everyone!{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Hiro really seemed to relax after we got back to Camp too... Maybe today was all he needed to get back to his usual, cheery self!{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I really hope we can make the most out of our last few days here at Camp Buddy!{/i}
label: day32_hiro

speaker: Hiro
text: Mmm~ Lunch is so yummy as always!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: I agree, Hiro! I'm glad Hunter's parents were still able to get a taste of Sir Aiden’s cooking before they left last night.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: And speaking of Twinkerbell, he barely opened his mouth since last night.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Come on and spill already. Did we just waste all that time complimenting him in front of his folks last night or what?
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: U-Umm… How should I say this…?
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Hunter’s been a little quiet since this morning… It looks like he’s still thinking a lot about last night…){/i}
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: W-Well… I'm honestly not sure, guys. They left right after I told them…
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hiro
text: That doesn’t sound good.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Did they say no…?
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: They actually didn’t decide on it just yet… But I don't think they liked the idea of me going to art school at all.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I should’ve known, though… Ever since I was little, they already had plans for my future and never settled for anything else…
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: But do you think there’s still a slight chance they can send you to art school, Hunter?
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: Seeing it in their eyes last night… I just know this isn’t what they want for me…
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I can’t even remember any other time I’ve tried convincing them to do anything like this either… This is the first time I’ve ever asked for something so big...
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hiro
text: That’s so weird… Your parents really seemed happy with how things were going for you and your art when we were talking about it with them, Hunter…
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: W-Well, they are… It’s just… I think they were caught off guard by what I was asking.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: But even though they said they’d consider it… I just know that they’re not going to agree to something so big...
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph. Well, if you ask me, they’re just being stubborn and selfish as hell.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Y-Yoichi! You’re not making Hunter’s situation any better!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey, I’m just telling it like it is. We all know how much Twinkerbell here wants to go to an art school or something like that.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: I don’t think you even need to ask anyone’s permission for stuff about your own life!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: Just do what you gotta do to get what you want, Twinkerbell!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh come on, Wolfboy! They’re his parents! Hunter doesn’t wanna disappoint them!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hiro
text: Hunter loves his art as much as he loves his parents. That’s why he wants to make them proud too!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hiro
text: Instead of getting what he ‘wants’, Hunter’s gotta decide what makes him happy first! Whether he follows his parents or not!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: But try to think of it this way, guys… Hunter’s parents really are the best people to know what’s right for him.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Adding to that, Hunter is their only son. So it’s only natural for them to be careful about his future.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: From what I see, it is quite thoughtful of Hunter's parents to have worked on a solid path in the future set for him!
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Everyone’s having different advice about this matter... I should say something before he gets too frustrated or confused.){/i}
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Everyone’s having different advice about this matter... I should say something before he gets too frustrated or confused.){fast}{/i}
label: day32_hunter

text: Yoichi has a point.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: You guys... I think Yoichi might have a point.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hunter's parents are being a bit selfish. They know what he wants now… but they might know they’re only seeing things their way.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Yoichi
text: See? Even Frogboy knows I'm right.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hiro
text: I get what you mean, but that doesn’t mean Hunter has to go against his parents.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah… Besides, wouldn’t that make things worse? Hunter’s parents might think he’s actually rebelling.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well, I didn’t say I agree with everything Yoichi said…
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Keitaro
text: I still think Hunter should ask his parents’ permission for his school, of course.
label: day32_hunter

speaker: Hiro
text: Maybe we can ask Hunter what he thinks about this.
