text: {i}We stayed together on the pier, sitting close and holding hands until the sun had completely set…{/i}
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah…?
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know I said this a lot of times already, but I’m really sorry again for snooping through your journal…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I already forgave you, Keitaro…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: And like I said, my mind was just cloudy after Kieran left… And I couldn’t figure out what my feelings were yet…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: I wasn't sure that you'd be able to forgive me, but I'm really glad that you were able to look past it...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: It wasn’t all your fault though… I have some things to apologize for too…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: If only I’d been a little more honest with you from the beginning, you wouldn't have felt left in the dark…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ahh…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well… if it makes you feel any better, I never actually got to read all of your journal…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: It's fine, Keitaro. Even if you did, I’d still forgive you.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: N-No, I mean… the last part of it was actually torn out. I only read up until the sportsfest…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh… Right…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I remember doing that…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-You were the one who torn off that page…?
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah, way back last year…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Ms. Yuri gave me this journal for the same reason she gave you yours. She wanted me to write down all the good memories I had here.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: But as I got near the end, things took a turn for the worse, and it didn't feel right to leave them in there...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: So, I tore it out… hoping to get rid of my worst memory for good…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I see…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I guess part of the reason I held on to the rest of the journal was because I couldn’t accept the way things ended up last year…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I kept telling myself that I’d moved on, but in reality, I wasn’t ready to let go of my past…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: But now... I realize how selfish it was for me to act like nothing happened, expecting it wouldn't affect the present...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: And knowing that I wrote the journal from my point of view, it was even more unfair to the other people I wrote about in there...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Especially Kieran... Anyone who reads the journal would think he was the bad guy.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I have to be honest… It did actually confuse me, Taiga…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: When I first met Kieran, nothing really added up… especially not the way you described him in the journal.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I had plenty of shortcomings with Kieran… Even at the beginning of the journal, I never even mentioned that we were together…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I was so absorbed by how popular I’d gotten during my first days at camp that I didn’t want anyone to know about my relationship with him…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: For some reason, I guess I thought if people knew we were a couple, it would make things awkward around us.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran is the kind of guy who just goes with the flow, so he didn’t really mind.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: But as the attention grew and I got closer to my new friends, I ended up enjoying myself so much that I really neglected him.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Since he was my boyfriend at the time, it was only natural for Kieran to feel left out...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Eventually, it got so bad that I completely pushed him to the side in exchange for attention, and that made him take his frustrations out on me…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s hard looking back on it…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: But I’ve spent too long hiding it from everyone, including myself.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s time that I told you the truth, Keitaro…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: After having an argument with Kieran… my ego got the best of me and I decided not to team up with him.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: But as soon as the sportsfest started, we were up against Kieran’s team…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: …Someone showed up covered in bruises, claiming that I threatened him not to participate so that our team would win by default.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: That person even said that I'd been bullying him and warned him not to tell on anyone since the beginning of camp… which wasn’t true at all…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Everyone there that day was shocked... And I didn't understand why someone would accuse me of something like that.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran's teammates furiously approached me and demanded that I explain, and even though I tried to tell them that it wasn't me, it just made them angrier...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: No one was willing to hear me out, and things got even more heated the more I defended myself…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Suddenly, someone hit me, and I found myself ganged up… I had to fight back, and that only made things worse.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: The scoutmasters tried their best to control the situation, but nobody was willing to listen, so they did what they could to stop the violence.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: They had to cancel the entire event and take care of those who got injured…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: After that, the staff's reputation took a big hit for failing to stop the bullying in time to prevent the mess...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: But things didn’t stop there…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: The camp went into turmoil as the event started spreading in the news, deeming the place unsafe and a bad influence on scouts…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Even the scoutmasters had a falling out... Some of them wanted to avoid being involved in the scandal, while the rest tried to focus on damage control for the camp...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Pretty much everyone involved, including me, was never punished for it – they were so busy trying to handle the public that they didn’t have time for the real cause of the problem.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Meanwhile, Kieran and I had been in a gray area until the guy who claimed to have been beaten up by me decided to leave camp… but not without telling me the truth…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: After seeing how everything had turned out, he couldn’t take the guilt of lying anymore, and told me that Kieran was the one who set me up.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I couldn’t believe what I heard, so I went straight to Kieran and confronted him about it.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran was so afraid of how bad everything had gotten that he didn’t deny it… He never expected that it would end so violently…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I was furious at that point, and in total disbelief that he would try to ruin me like that… That’s when things started to get heated.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Instead of trying to settle things, we just kept on pointing at each other, refusing to acknowledge our mistakes…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran kept trying to argue that he wouldn’t have done any of it if I hadn’t neglected him and taken our relationship for granted…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Knowing that it was what drove him to betray me, I couldn’t contain myself and shoved him out of anger…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran was so enraged that he fought back, and we both ended up hurting each other…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s where the scar on my face came from…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran was horrified at what he’d done… He backed away as soon as he saw my face bleeding…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: He immediately tried to apologize, but I couldn’t forgive him then… So I broke up with him.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: That was the last time I saw Kieran… The next day, he left without saying a word.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga… I… didn’t know… That’s terrible…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Everything completely fell apart for me soon after that...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: As the situation at the camp got worse, I was involved in more fights with people who never knew the truth…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: B-But, if everyone at camp, even the scoutmasters, never even mentioned Kieran, does that mean that you-
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah… I had to keep it a secret… I wanted to take responsibility for what happened with me and Kieran…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: Knowing how it feels to have everyone against me… I couldn’t bear to put him in the same situation…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: And I plan to keep it that way…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: I see… Now I understand why you didn’t want to let anyone know...
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m really sorry I made you relive that memory…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s okay, Keitaro… I can’t just keep running away from my past…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I have to accept that it happened... and at the same time, not let it define me.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: If anything, all of my mistakes have helped to shape me into who I am today.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: And now that I’m with you… there’s much more in the future to look forward to…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: I think… this is the start of a new chapter in my life.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Taiga
text: And I want you to be in it with me, Keitaro…
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, Taiga. I’ll be with you through it all.
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Now that Taiga’s finally let go of his past, we can truly start over…{/i}
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It's hard to believe that all this happened in just a few weeks.{/i}
label: day32_taigage

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}And in that short time I’ve known him, Taiga has changed from a bully… to a friend… and now to my lover… I can’t believe that we’ve come this far together…{/i}
label: day32_taigage

text: Taiga…
label: day32_taigape

text: I came to apologize to you again...

text: You’ve chosen to bury your past from everyone, including yourself, for a reason…

text: Keitaro…

speaker: Taiga
text: There’s no way I wouldn’t forgive you over this…

speaker: Taiga

speaker: Taiga
text: And it hurts so much to think that everything you learned in there about me would ruin what I worked so hard for...

speaker: Taiga

label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Will I always have to fear what's behind me?
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: …And have I really come this far for nothing?

text: N-No, Taiga... You've grown so much, and I was there for all of it...

text: I may have found out some things about you from your journal, but that's not why I chose to stay by your side all this time...

label: day32_taigape

text: Every hurdle I overcame that helped me grow as a person, I couldn’t help but be glad that you were a part of it…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga

label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga

label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga…?
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: What I was most afraid of when you found out the truth was losing you...
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: And this feeling burning in my chest is all because…

text: I love you, Keitaro…

text: But as the attention grew and I got closer to my new friends, I ended up enjoying myself so much that I really neglected him.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Since he was my boyfriend at the time, it was only natural for Kieran to feel left out...
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Eventually, it got so bad that I completely pushed him to the side in exchange for attention, and that made him take his frustrations out on me…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s hard looking back on it…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: But I’ve spent too long hiding it from everyone, including myself.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s time that I told you the truth, Keitaro…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: After having an argument with Kieran… my ego got the best of me and I decided not to team up with him.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: But as soon as the sportsfest started, we were up against Kieran’s team…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: …Someone showed up covered in bruises, claiming that I threatened him not to participate so that our team would win by default.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: That person even said that I'd been bullying him and warned him not to tell on anyone since the beginning of camp… which wasn’t true at all…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Everyone there that day was shocked... And I didn't understand why someone would accuse me of something like that.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran's teammates furiously approached me and demanded that I explain, and even though I tried to tell them that it wasn't me, it just made them angrier...
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: No one was willing to hear me out, and things got even more heated the more I defended myself…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Suddenly, someone hit me, and I found myself ganged up… I had to fight back, and that only made things worse.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: The scoutmasters tried their best to control the situation, but nobody was willing to listen, so they did what they could to stop the violence.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: They had to cancel the entire event and take care of those who got injured…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: After that, the staff's reputation took a big hit for failing to stop the bullying in time to prevent the mess...
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: But things didn’t stop there…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: The camp went into turmoil as the event started spreading in the news, deeming the place unsafe and a bad influence on scouts…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Even the scoutmasters had a falling out... Some of them wanted to avoid being involved in the scandal, while the rest tried to focus on damage control for the camp...
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Pretty much everyone involved, including me, was never punished for it – they were so busy trying to handle the public that they didn’t have time for the real cause of the problem.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Meanwhile, Kieran and I had been in a gray area until the guy who claimed to have been beaten up by me decided to leave camp… but not without telling me the truth…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: After seeing how everything had turned out, he couldn’t take the guilt of lying anymore, and told me that Kieran was the one who set me up.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: I couldn’t believe what I heard, so I went straight to Kieran and confronted him about it.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran was so afraid of how bad everything had gotten that he didn’t deny it… He never expected that it would end so violently…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: I was furious at that point, and in total disbelief that he would try to ruin me like that… That’s when things started to get heated.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Instead of trying to settle things, we just kept on pointing at each other, refusing to acknowledge our mistakes…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran kept trying to argue that he wouldn’t have done any of it if I hadn’t neglected him and taken our relationship for granted…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Knowing that it was what drove him to betray me, I couldn’t contain myself and shoved him out of anger…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran was so enraged that he fought back, and we both ended up hurting each other…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s where the scar on my face came from…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Kieran was horrified at what he’d done… He backed away as soon as he saw my face bleeding…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: He immediately tried to apologize, but I couldn’t forgive him then… So I broke up with him.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: That was the last time I saw Kieran… The next day, he left without saying a word.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga… I… didn’t know… That’s terrible…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Everything completely fell apart for me soon after that...
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: As the situation at the camp got worse, I was involved in more fights with people who never knew the truth…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: B-But, if everyone at camp, even the scoutmasters, never even mentioned Kieran, does that mean that you-
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah… I had to keep it a secret… I wanted to take responsibility for what happened with me and Kieran…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: Knowing how it feels to have everyone against me… I couldn’t bear to put him in the same situation…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: And I plan to keep it that way…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: I see… Now I understand why you didn’t want to let anyone know...
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m really sorry I made you relive that memory…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s okay, Keitaro… I can’t just keep running away from my past…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: I have to accept that it happened... and at the same time, not let it define me.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: If anything, all of my mistakes have helped to shape me into who I am today.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: And now that I’m with you… there’s much more in the future to look forward to…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: I think… this is the start of a new chapter in my life.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Taiga
text: And I want you to be in it with me, Keitaro…
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, Taiga. I’ll be with you through it all.
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Now that Taiga’s finally let go of his past, we can truly start over…{/i}
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It's hard to believe that all this happened in just a few weeks.{/i}
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}And in that short time I’ve known him, Taiga has changed from a bully… to a friend… and now to my lover… I can’t believe that we’ve come this far together…{/i}
label: day32_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Can we please talk about what happened...?
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t want to end the term like this…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: What about everything we’ve been through…?
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: *sigh*
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: Keitaro, look...
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m really confused right now...
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: When Kieran confessed to me yesterday... I was so sure of my answer to him...
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: But... as soon as it was over, I began to feel something that I couldn’t explain…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: I was so sure that I'd moved on from him and everything in my past... so what's this feeling in my chest that's making me so anxious?
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: In the back of my head, I kept telling myself that I did the right thing and trusted my decision.
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: And then I found out that you did something like this to me…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: It really hurts...
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Is… there any way for me to fix this, Taiga…?
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: How am I supposed to know, Keitaro….?
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: I can’t understand why you would even do this to me in the first place…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: Because I couldn’t accept all the things that happened to me, I tried to hide my past from everyone, including myself...
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: And to find out that you kept digging it up behind my back... It makes me feel like everything between us was just a lie...
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-That’s not true, Taiga…!
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m really sorry, Keitaro… But now I feel like I made the wrong choice…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: I can’t shake this feeling in my heart…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga… Do you… still have feelings for Kieran…?
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I don’t know, Keitaro…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: Some things are meant to be buried in the past and I tried my best to forget about it…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: But when Kieran showed up… everything just came back…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: It just proves that… just like Kieran, I wasn’t able to move on…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: It made me realize why I was so broken and filled with hate before…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: But… you came along and distracted me from all of it…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I… see…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: If… that’s how you truly feel, Taiga… I… apologize…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I just wish… I had known sooner…
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry, Keitaro, but… I need to be alone right now.
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll… respect your decision, Taiga.
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}In the end, the only thing I could do was turn my back and hear Taiga cry as I walked away…{/i}
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I can’t believe that, all this time… I was just a distraction to him…{/i}
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Deep inside, I was hoping that there was much more between us… but I guess that wasn’t possible from the start…{/i}
label: day32_taigawe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I guess… we failed to be honest with each other after all…{/i}
label: day32_taigawe

text: *yawn*

text: H-Huh…? I wonder where everyone is today…

text: Good morning, Keitaro!

text: Hello, Natsumi! Are we having an activity today?

text: Ah, I’ll go get dressed and see what Yoichi’s up to then!

text: What’s wrong? Y-You look upset…

text: Yuki… I-I can’t find her anywhere…

text: W-What? Didn’t we tie her up at her doghouse last night? Is she not there?

text: She must have run away…

text: Have you asked Scoutmaster Yoshi if he’s seen her yet? M-Maybe he just walked Yuki outside..?

text: N-No, Keitaro… I passed by him a while ago when I was looking for Yuki, and I didn’t tell him anything yet…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m afraid the old man might go ballistic again if he found out Yuki was off her leash and out causing trouble…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: W-What should I do, Keitaro? This is the first time Yuki’s ever done something like this…!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sure we can find her just like we did before! Have you at least tried tracking her scent?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I can’t… This stupid weather is messing with my nose!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s split up so we can find her faster..!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Y-You’re right…!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’ll head into the woods! I have a feeling she might have run off there!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll go search for her around the camp and ask the scoutmasters for help too…! I’ll catch up to you as soon as we find her!
label: day32_yoichi

text: Got it…! Thanks, Keitaro.
label: day32_yoichi

text: {i}(Yuki… Please be okay…!){/i}

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Does Yoichi know that she’s missing?

text: Y-Yes, sir… He’s the one who told me, and he’s out there looking for her right now.

text: Then I think it’s clear what needs to happen – Mr. Yukimura’s dog must be located as soon as possible.
label: day32_yoichi

text: Do you want me to come too, Yoshi?

speaker: Yoshinori
text: No, it’s alright, Aiden! Yuki can’t have gone too far. The two of us and Yoichi should be able to find her.

text: Keitaro, let’s go!

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yes, sir!

text: This is bad… It’s definitely going to rain soon. Are you sure Yoichi headed this way, Keitaro?

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yes, sir…!
label: day32_yoichi

text: That makes sense… We couldn’t find Yuki anywhere in the camp. It’s no wonder Yoichi would look for her here in the woods…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I just hope they’re both alright….
label: day32_yoichi

text: E-Eh…? What’s that sound?

text: Yuki must have given birth already!
label: day32_yoichi

text: And there’s Yoichi over there…!
label: day32_yoichi

text: Yoichi! There you are…! Did you find Yu-

text: Y-Yoichi…? W-What happened…?

text: *sobs*
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yuki…! Yoichi… D-Did she…?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why…? Why did this have to happen…?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: She was… she was doing just fine yesterday… We were having so much fun together…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-How…? How did it turn out like this…?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yoichi…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I thought… you guys said she’d be alright… So, why…?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why was she taken away from me…?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-Yoichi… P-Please listen. Nobody wanted this to happen—
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Enough… I don’t want to hear anymore…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Please… just… leave me alone…
label: day32_yoichi

text: Yoichi, please don’t push us away… We’re here to help…
label: day32_yoichi

text: And we can’t leave you like this… What about the puppies? They might get sick if we stay here any longer-
label: day32_yoichi

label: day32_yoichi

text: I’ll find a safe spot to bury Yuki…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Please… Don’t make this harder for me than it already is…
label: day32_yoichi

text: {i}(Yoichi’s entire world fell apart right before our eyes…){/i}
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(His eyes were dead. His voice was full of grief…){/i}
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’ve always known how Yuki meant the world to Yoichi… What would this do to him?){/i}

label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I shouldn’t have trusted you with Yuki! Now she’s gone!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yuki has always been strong! I know she wouldn’t die to something like this!
label: day32_yoichi

text: Yoichi… Please, listen to me…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Let go of me! You murderer!!!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yoichi… I would never do that to you…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You know I loved Yuki as much as you did…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can’t stand to see you suffering like this…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Please, don’t hold back… I know you must be so devastated…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You have every right to be hurt and angry…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: *cries*
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: THIS IS SO UNFAIR!!!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: Please tell me this is just a fucking nightmare!!!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yoichi… I’m so sorry… If there was any way to change this, I would do it without hesitation…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But we have to accept the truth… Yuki has left us for a better place now…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: I don’t understand…! Why did she have to leave me too?!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoichi
text: What did I do to deserve all of this? Haven’t I suffered enough already?!
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You’re right, Yoichi… You don’t deserve this… No one does…
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But please remember that you’ll never be alone… We’re all here for you. Always…

speaker: Yoichi
text: *cries*
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: *huff* *huff*
label: day32_yoichi

text: Oh, no… Oh, no… What should I do…?!

text: Hey, Keitaro! What happened to-

text: W-Whoa! Are those Yuki’s puppies?!

text: S-Sir Aiden, please help!
label: day32_yoichi

text: Y-Yuki’s out there and I think she’s dead…! And Yoichi… and Scoutmaster Yoshi… All of these puppies… and… and…

text: Whoa, whoa. Calm down, Keitaro!
label: day32_yoichi

text: Take a deep breath and tell me what exactly happened.
label: day32_yoichi

text: Scoutmaster Yoshi and I were looking for Yoichi and Yuki in the forest… but when we got there, it was already too late…

text: Oh, no… She must’ve passed away after giving birth….

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What should I do with these puppies, Sir Aiden? I… I don’t know what to d—

text: Don’t panic, Keitaro. Here, let me take care of those for you.
label: day32_yoichi

text: You go inside the cabin and change into something dry, alright? If you stay out here for too long, you’ll get a fever again.
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Keitaro
text: B-But what about the puppies…?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: Don’t worry, Keitaro. I’ve got them.
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: You’re still in shock… Go and calm yourself down first. Got it?
label: day32_yoichi

speaker: Aiden
text: I’ll make sure nothing bad happens to these puppies. I promise.

text: {i}(There he is…!){/i}

label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi...
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I hope you don’t mind if I sit here…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-You’re all wet… Can we get your clothes changed at least…?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: U-Umm… Yoichi… I’m really sorry about what happened…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know you’re feeling devastated right now, but… I really want you to know that…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m right here to help you get through all this—
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Don’t bother… It doesn’t matter now anyway…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: The only family I have left is gone…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m just back to where I started… Being alone. It’s what I’m used to anyway…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yoichi…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I know this may not be the best time to ask, but… what exactly happened in your past?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: All throughout the camp term, I’ve been learning more and more about you, but I still felt like something was missing…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I hope you don’t take this the wrong way. I really am grateful for everything you’ve said to me…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s wrong of me to try and force you to tell me… But this time… I really want to help you…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: And the only way for me to help is if I know the truth about what happened…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Why did you have to live alone in the streets in the first place…? Where is your family…?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch! I don’t know and I don’t care! What I had doesn’t have the right to be called a family after all the bullshit they put me through!
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Why do you hate your family so much…?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: How could I not? I’m an only child but my so-called mother kept calling me a curse!
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What do you mean, Yoichi…?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Every time she looked at me, she was always disgusted by how much I looked like my father.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: That was reason enough for her to hate me… She would hit me all the time for no reason…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I never met my father, so all I know is how much my mother hated him…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I… I’m sorry… I didn’t know… I-Is that why you ran away from home, Yoichi…?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: No… Even after all that, I still saw her as my mother.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: But no matter what I did, she never saw me as her son. She always looked at me like I was some kind of monster…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-That’s terrible…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: B-But how did you end up in the streets if you didn’t run away from home…?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I’m sorry… I shouldn’t be forcing you to tell me all of this…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: No… It’s alright… I was planning on telling you eventually, anyway…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: You deserve to know everything…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: For the longest time, my mom was cruel and mean to me.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Then one day, she was suddenly nice to me and told me to pack up all our things, so we could go on a trip and I could have a treat along the way.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I was gullible and stupid… Once we got to the pier, she gave me some money to buy some ice cream. By the time I got back, she was just…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Gone…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I was crying and panicking when I tried to look for her until finally, I saw her on a ferry. Sailing away…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: She looked down right at me while I was screaming for her, and then she just turned away.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: That’s when I realized that she had left me to rot… alone…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yoichi… I’m so sorry… I had no idea you had to go through all of that…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I learned to fend for myself and tried to get by alone every single day. Then I met Yuki…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I saw so much of myself in her… She was the best thing to ever happen to me…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: But now Yuki is gone… And I’m alone again…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I lost the only family I had…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What about us? Don’t you see us as your family too?
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know that no one can ever replace what Yuki was to you… But you’re not alone, Yoichi…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi cares about you… Your friends care about you… and of course… I care about you…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ve never felt the pain and suffering you have throughout your life, so I'll never fully understand what you're feeling right now…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: But one thing’s for sure, it’s never easy to lose a loved one…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You've stayed so strong your whole life, even after everything that you've been through...
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That's what I've always admired about you...
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yuki wouldn’t want to see you sad like this… I’m sure that’s why she tried to get away with her last breath… She didn’t want you to see her like that…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Goodbyes are always painful… but… it’s not all over, Yoichi…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Try not to dwell on sadness and look at what Yuki left for you instead…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: She died to give birth to her puppies, and I’m sure she’s counting on you to take care of them just like you took care of her…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know it’s unfair to ask you to move on, but I just wanted to remind you that Yuki’s passing doesn’t mean that you’re alone.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You have a family here who’ll never leave you, no matter what.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: And of course… I’m here…
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I really want to have a family with you.
label: day32_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s how much I love you.
label: day32_yoichipe

text: You’re right…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Even though I’m sad that Yuki is gone, you made me realize that there’s still a lot ahead of me…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Yuki has left me with her puppies… I’m sure she’s counting on me to take care of them the same way I did for her!

text: That’s the Yoichi I know~!
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: W-What happened to them by the way…? I couldn’t even think straight earlier…

text: They’re safe and being well taken care of! Sir Aiden is looking after them right now. And I’m sure Scoutmaster Yoshi is helping too.
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Thank goodness… I’ll have to thank them both later…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so proud of you, Yoichi…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-Huh…?
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Well, earlier you said you only trust me, but you trust Scoutmaster Yoshi and Sir Aiden enough to leave the puppies with them.
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: And the fact that you still care about the puppies despite what happened shows how responsible you are now.
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Of course! Like you said, they’re the only thing Yuki left behind. I’ll treasure them with all my heart!

text: Do you want to see them now…?
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Nah, if Yoshi is taking care of them… then they’re in good hands… Right now, I should just focus on picking myself up.
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Wait a minute. Did you just call Scoutmaster Yoshi by his name? This is the first time I’ve heard you not calling him by a nickname..!
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: D-Did I…? I guess it just came out by itself.
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Does that mean that you like Scoutmaster Yoshi too…?
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: W-Well, it’s not that I like him… I see him more as a really responsible father…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I should be more like him if I want to be a good dad to my puppies…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: And besides… I need to take care of you too…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Look who’s talking~ You’re the one I need to take care of right now!
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph… I promise I will repay what you did for me someday…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What do you say? Do you wanna have a family with me…?
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! Wasn’t I the one who said that in the first place?
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m just making sure you’re really serious about this! Being a parent is no joke, you know!
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re making it sound like the puppies are our children.
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Of course they are! So do you want to be their mom or not?!
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: E-Eh? Can’t we be both dads?
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: GAH! You know I hate talking about corny shit like this! So, just answer me!
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I do, Yoichi.
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Good…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: {i}(Seeing Yoichi finally smiling again… It made me feel sure that he’d find true happiness…){/i}
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: So, should we go back to the cabin now? Your clothes are still soaked from the rain, and I don’t want you getting sick…
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

text: Can we stay here a little longer…?
label: day32_aftersxyoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure, Yoichi…

text: Why do you keep saying that you’ve always been alone?

label: day32_yoichiwe

label: day32_yoichiwe

text: And the only way for me to help is if I know the truth about what happened…
label: day32_yoichiwe

text: Do you seriously think that talking about my past will make me feel any better right now?
label: day32_yoichiwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I never deserved what happened to me…! Or to have Yuki taken away from me!
label: day32_yoichiwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I’m sorry, Yoichi… That was the wrong thing to ask…
label: day32_yoichiwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I know what you’re trying to do, Keitaro, and I appreciate it… But you’ve already helped me enough.
label: day32_yoichiwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: There’s no way for me to just pretend that everything is fine. Not without Yuki.
label: day32_yoichiwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Just please… Leave me alone.
label: day32_yoichiwe

text: You know I can’t do that… I promised I’d always be there for you, didn’t I?

text: I…

text: You don’t have to explain yourself. I appreciate all the times we spent together, but I’ve always known that they weren’t meant to last anyway…
label: day32_yoichiwe

label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well… We can still send messages, call each other…
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: And I’m sure this isn’t going to be last time we’ll see each other either! We’ll find a way somehow!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: I see…
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Best friends…){/i}
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I was so certain Hiro felt something more for me than just that, especially after everything we’d been through…){/i}
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But then when I heard those words from him… I was mistaken all along…){/i}
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(When I looked at him, I could see the regret in his eyes…){/i}
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I wanted to say something, hoping things would be better between us before we separate, but I was too afraid…){/i}
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Maybe Hiro and I were just meant to be friends…){/i}
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I guess… this is what I get for making him wait for too long…){/i}
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro! Hiro!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Hunter
text: We were so worried about you two… How did your talk go?
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Guessing by that response, it went pretty bad, huh?
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh no… Don’t tell me you two had a fight…?
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah! No, Natsumi…! Not at all…!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro is right… We’re fine…
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Come on. You’re not fooling anybody.
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: Umm…
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Would you two get over your drama already? We only have a day left before camp’s over, so don’t spoil the fun for everyone else!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Y-Yeah! Imagine all the fun we can still have together!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Hunter
text: That’s right. So, please cheer up, you two!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: T-Thanks, everyone...
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, how about we get some rest? I’m sure you two are already exhausted!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: R-Right… Good night, everyone!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Hunter
text: I-I’m really worried about those two…
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Was Keitaro that disappointed by how Hiro said his goodbye?
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I doubt it’s just that. Keitaro had already slowly realized Hiro’s feelings for him.
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Yoichi
text: And to think that Hiro would just drop him like that… it’s freaking stupid.
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Both of them made mistakes, and they probably settled them in their talk.
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Yoichi
text: But meh! Just give those two some time to cool down, and I’m sure they’ll be fine!
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Y-Yoichi…
label: day33_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn*
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hmm? Hunter’s already awake…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Good morning, Hunter…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh…! You’re…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Ah, good morning, Keitaro. I’m… I’m just packing my bags. My parents will be here soon.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: P-Please, don’t worry, Keitaro… I’ve been thinking a lot since yesterday…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: I kinda understand why my parents decided to do this…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: The fact that they would do so much just to secure my future… even I can see how much this means to them.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: So… please don’t worry about it! I’m sure it’ll turn out fine for me either way!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Let’s just try to be happy with the time we have left and not focus on the bad things…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: R-Right…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hunter… Are you really leaving today…?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah… Isn’t there anything we can do to change your parents' mind?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Unfortunately, I don’t think so. My parents already decided what they want for me, and I don’t really have any choice but to accept it…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: So what, Twinkerbell? That doesn't mean you just throw in the towel like that.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Besides, the term's about to end anyway! You're just gonna leave a little earlier than the rest of us.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: But with Hunter leaving like this 'cuz of his parents… are they even gonna let him come back to camp next year?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh! I’m trying to lighten up the mood here, Torch-head! Get a clue, will ya?!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Y-Yeah, Yoichi is right… I really don’t want you guys to be sad just because I’m leaving a little earlier.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: And it is the end of the term, like he said. I’ve probably already gone through all the great things Camp Buddy had to offer.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: So I was hoping we could spend the time left here having fun instead…!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Attention, buddies!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: O-Oh! Good morning, Scoutmaster Yuri! Are we going to have an activity today?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: W-Well, not exactly an activity. More like a farewell party for our beloved Hunter!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: F-Farewell party…?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Yes, Hunter. We wanted to do something just for you before you left the camp!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: But didn’t my parents say that they'd fetch me first thing in the morning?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Well, after I talked with your parents a little bit more on the phone, they said that they'd be just as fine picking you up by the end of the day after the party.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Besides, you did so much to help us get the camp back on its feet! It’s only fair we dedicate a little appreciation event to acknowledge that~!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Y-You really don’t have to do all this for me, Ms. Yuri…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww, of course we do! You’re part of the Camp Buddy family after all!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: B-But—
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, come on, Twinkerbell! Didn’t you just say that we gotta have fun while you’re still here?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: This party is perfect just for that, right?!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah! A party for Hunter actually does sound like a lot of fun!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Come to think of it, we've never had farewell parties during any of the previous terms. So, I’m really excited for this too!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: You boys can go change into your uniforms! We’ll be waiting for you at the mess hall!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ha! Last one there won't get any pizza!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: W-Wha! There’s pizza?! No way I'm ending up last!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, those two never change, do they?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Shall we go too, Hunter? Let’s enjoy this party as much as we can with everyone!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Y-Yes, Natsumi…!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aren’t you gonna get changed too, Keitaro?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, yes, Ms. Yuri…!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: It’s alright, Keitaro… We all know how you must feel about Hunter leaving.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I… I can understand him leaving early. But his parents didn't even give him a chance to do what he wanted… That's what really makes me feel so sad…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I thought what we did was enough to show them just how much Hunter wanted to follow his dreams… But I guess it wasn’t…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Please don’t blame yourself like this, Keitaro… We did everything we could for Hunter's dreams.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: At this point, we all know for sure this really was just a personal struggle for Hunter.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: We have to understand that his parents know what’s best for him. And that being sad about this won’t help Hunter at all…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: I’m sure you've noticed by now that everyone is doing their best to be strong for Hunter…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: So… let’s do our part and make Hunter’s last day here at the camp worth remembering!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re right, Ms. Yuri…! I’ll do my best… for Hunter!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Thank you, Keitaro. I’m glad you understand.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yuri
text: Now, please get changed as well. I’ll see you boys again at the mess hall.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: I can’t believe the scoutmasters went to all this trouble to throw me a party…!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha, they sure did~! Bro-Aiden cooked stuff extra special for you!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hell yeah, this pizza's good! Thanks for the party, Twinkerbell!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: H-Hey, don't hog it all, Wolfboy! Let Hunter have some!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, it's alright, Hiro. I managed to save a few slices here!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, thanks so much, Natsumi!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: How about you, Keitaro? Wanna get something to eat too?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh! Sure, Natsumi…!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, Keitaro. I just noticed you brought your camera with you. Are you planning to take pictures today?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah… Yeah!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Don't you think now's the best time to snap some photos? Everyone's having tons of fun at the party, after all!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Maybe you can even give some of the photos to Hunter, so he can have lots of happy memories to remember us by!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s a great idea, Natsumi! I’ll definitely do that…!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Wahh… You’d really let me have some photos, Keitaro?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course! You can look at them whenever you miss us!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey! What are you dorks doing over there!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh! Oh! I think Keitaro’s gonna take a picture!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah! Yeah, guys! Gather round and let’s take a group photo!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Say cheese!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: All
text: Cheese!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! A perfect shot!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Here, Hunter! You can have this one!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Aww! Thank you, Keitaro!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: G-Guys! I… I just heard the news!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: Is it true, Hunter? Are you really leaving after this party?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Idiot. That’s what this whole thing is for!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: H-Hey…! I didn’t know that…!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Ah… Yes, Taiga… unfortunately, I am.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Seto
text: Aww, man! That sucks! And right before the end of the term too?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Felix
text: Yeah… it’s gonna be a little strange without you here…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Felix
text: Even if the camp term is ending soon, I do wish you didn't have to leave early…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: Can't say a Hunter-free Camp Buddy is going to be nearly as fun… So sad to see you sashay away…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Lee
text: I bid you farewell, my esteemed friend. I wish you luck as we part ways!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: I-It’s alright, guys! M-Maybe we’ll meet again someday!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: I really had fun with you guys the past couple weeks! Even if it was a bumpy ride, I enjoyed so much of it!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: *sigh* Just when I started having real friends…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Well, we’ll still be friends even after I leave!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Speaking of… what are everybody’s plans after the term, by the way? Camp is about to end, after all.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmm, I’ll probably just stay with my mom~ I live pretty close by so, I might drop by every now and then.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: How about you guys?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’ll probably just go back to my studies like usual.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I live pretty close to this area too! so I can always pass by Camp Buddy whenever I’m heading to school.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, good for you, Natsumi!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’ll definitely miss all of you though… I’ve never gotten close to anyone like this before.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I won't be lonely since my big brother will be there to hang out with me.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: At least, I’ll have him while you guys aren’t around.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What? You mean, there’s two of you?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Have I never told anyone about him?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: I don’t think so, Natsumi. It’s the first time we’re hearing about it.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: What’s he like?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Probably just a lame cardboard cutout of the same dork!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ahaha, well, I guess I’ll let you get to know all about him in my route.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What did you say?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: N-Nothing. Nevermind~
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Enough about me. What about you, Yoichi? Any plans after Camp Buddy?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Huh? Didn’t I tell you guys already?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m afraid you haven’t yet, Yoichi…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, I’ll be stuck here by myself without all of you guys around. I don’t have anywhere else to go, after all.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not that it’s a bad thing. I get to have free food here.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Plus, Sheriff Brokeback could always use some help with all the stuff for next year's batch.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: What?! You mean you live here at Camp Buddy?! How come you never told us that?!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Now you know. It’s no big deal.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, now the reason you’re enrolled here every year makes sense!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Enough of that! Frogboy, you haven’t told us what your plans after the summer are!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Nothing special – I’ll just be going back to school!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Though, I was really hoping we could still meet each other after the summer…! You know, maybe to hang out together?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: Hmm… I’m not so sure about that, Keitaro. I’ll most likely be flying back abroad to my hometown soon.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh… I see…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: T-There’s lots of ways we can keep in touch, though…! We can send letters, and e-mails! We can even call each other if you guys want!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Seto
text: Oh! If you guys want, I could make a Dicksword group server for us! That way, we can all just chat online!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That sounds like a great idea! Let’s go do that!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I'm kind of curious - Taiga, Eduard and Lee have been pretty quiet and haven't told us their plans yet.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: A-Ah..! We’re just not used to being in a large group of friends like this.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: But we’re really enjoying listening to your stories. We never really got the chance to know about this stuff until now!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t be shy! Tell us your plans for after camp too! We all want to hear them!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, if you insist~ I’ll be the one to go first~!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: Lee and I actually go to the same school~ So, just like everybody else, we’ll be busy with all that again!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: But if you’re going to ask me personally, I wanna pursue my dream and try to join a modeling agency~!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: I wanna be proud of who I am, and I don’t care what anybody else thinks!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: Soooo… Yeahhh… Wish me luck~
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Lee
text: As for me, I’ve recently noticed that I’ve been focusing too much on my mental strength for the past few years.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Lee
text: I realized that my physical well-being is just as important! So I’m planning to get myself into shape!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Lee
text: I’ll definitely try to build my body to be big and strong just like Taiga!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Lee
text: With my intellectual prowess, I’m sure I’ll be able to create a fitness program that fits my capacity!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s really interesting, you guys! I hope it all goes well!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: Thanks~
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: Anyways, since we’re talking about this. I’m curious! What are you doing after camp, Taiga?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: E-Eh? Me?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Lee
text: Yes! You never told us anything about yourself outside of Camp Buddy!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: Well… I kinda want to apply and do volunteer work here at Camp Buddy.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: This place already means a lot to me… So I want to take care of it too.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Eduard
text: Say whaaaat?!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Lee
text: I know my vision is impaired, but are my ears defunct as well?!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hahaha! You got us with that one, Taiga!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I’m not joking… I’m really serious about it.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: I never expected to hear that from you, Taiga…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: WHAT?! Then that means I’m gonna be stuck with this guy for the rest of the year until you guys come back?!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Isn’t that great, Yoichi? You’ll get some company!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: I promise I won’t cause trouble, Yoichi! I’ll do my best to be useful around here!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What the hell… You’re starting to sound like Mr. Perfect.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Now I kinda want the old one back. But minus the jerk factor, of course!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww~ Don’t say that about Taiga. He’s a really good guy now!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: Maybe if we got closer last year, Yoichi, I wouldn’t have ended up doing all those bad things.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: HA! There’s no way we would’ve gotten close! It was ‘every man for himself’ last year!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yoichi, that’s all in the past now! We all get along now, thanks to Keitaro!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph! He started it!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: W-What..?! I didn’t mean it like that!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Bleh.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: Ack! Keitaro, how do you even deal with this guy?
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: You better get used to his obnoxiousness if you’re gonna stick with him for the whole year, Taiga~
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: *sigh*
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Aww~ Now, you guys are getting me teary again! I’m going to miss all of these little dogfights!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Here’s a tip, you can bully this dork all the time, and he won’t mind! I’ll teach you a bunch of ways you can tease someone without getting into trouble!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Taiga
text: Heh~ That should be fun!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hunter
text: You better not have Taiga revert back to his old self while we’re gone, Yoichi…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh* Just when I thought we wouldn’t have any more troublemakers next year…
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: All
text: Hahaha!
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Even if this was a party to say goodbye to Hunter… we all did our best to make sure he had fun and laughed along with us!{/i}
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}We didn’t want this to be a sad last day for him… But we couldn't help but all feel a little uneasy for what was going to come after.{/i}
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}As soon as the party was over, we headed back to the cabin to help Hunter pack all of his stuff...{/i}
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Natsumi
text: There we go… that should be all of Hunter’s stuff.
label: day33_hunterbe

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* This is really it, huh?

text: I’m so proud of how strong a person our son has grown up to be. Even after just a short time here in Camp Buddy.
label: day33_hunterge

text: I really like the way you think, Keitaro.

speaker: Archer
text: Hunter…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: When I first got to Camp Buddy, I barely talked to anyone…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I didn’t know how to make friends because I grew up spending all of my time indoors…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: But someone reached out to me… and taught me how to express myself to everyone.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I actually grew some confidence. I… was happy and… loved...
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I learned that I didn’t want everything to be served to me on a silver platter… because that would mean missing out on so much of what I could experience in life…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: We never knew…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: D-Do you think we’re bad parents, Hunter…?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Mom, Dad… I never said that… But this is about me too…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: And I just wanted you guys to hear my feelings as well…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I won’t force anything anymore. I will follow what you guys think is best for me.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I think… I just needed to say what I thought was best for myself…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: *looks at Archer*
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: *nods his head*
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww, Keitaro… Cheer up…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sorry, everyone… I’m just going to miss him so much.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: We understand, Keitaro… I know I can’t help but feel sad he’s gone too…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* It’s too bad Hunter didn’t even get to finish this camp term with us.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh… Come on! Don’t you dorks start crying again! Or I’m seriously gonna get pissed.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: G-Guys!!!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-Hunter?! W-Wha… What are you doing back here?!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, dear. Did you forget something?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: N-No, I didn’t forget anything!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m not leaving camp anymore!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What?!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, my… now this is a surprise!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: What happened, Hunter?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: We’ve change our minds.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: We’ve decided to let Hunter stay and finish the term.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: My husband and I realized how much this camp means to Hunter, his friends, his confidence…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: We understand that his happiness really did come from here… in Camp Buddy.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: I’m so proud of how strong a person our son has grown up to be. Even after just a short time here in Camp Buddy.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: We apologize for all the confusion and distress. We ended up misjudging all the good, nourishing people around Hunter out of panic.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: We thought we were doing the right thing… but Hunter proved us wrong.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: The truth is, and as unfortunate as it sounds… you all know our son better than we do…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: None of you were influencing him or meddling with us… you were only trying to support Hunter’s happiness.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: And Hunter… we’re so sorry for how blind and neglectful your father and I have been all these years.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: We almost lost sight of the very thing we were working so hard for…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: Thank you for reminding us that you’ve got your own path to follow, Hunter.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Archer
text: We want you to know that we love you… and hope nothing but the best for you.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: We’re also sorry… for trying to take you from the one place that’s built you up so much.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Heather
text: You really have grown up and… we’re proud to see you stand so tall like this now.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Mom… Dad…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}We weren’t expecting to hear such words to come from Hunter then… {/i}
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It was almost a miracle that Hunter was able to convince his parents to stay in Camp Buddy.{/i}
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It probably took all his courage to change their minds with honesty like that. I was so proud of Hunter… {/i}
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Damn, Twinkerbell. You sure know how to fake an exit!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, I can’t believe you’re actually still here eating with us, Hunter!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hiro
text: I was so sure that we were gonna have to spend the rest of the term without you!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh. I seriously thought I’m gonna have to deal with Mr. Waterworks until camp was over! He’s been sobbing like you died or something!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: H-Hey…! It’s just my way of dealing with Hunter leaving us so soon.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: O-Oh… I’m so sorry I made you guys feel that sad…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: But seeing you guys care for me so much is really sweet! I’m glad to be back!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so happy everything turned out well! I really didn’t know there was any way for your parents to change their minds.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I thought so too, but… I really have you to thank for it all, Keitaro…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: The advice you gave me last night… That’s the reason I suddenly understood why my parents did what they did…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I just needed to tell them my side of the story too…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Things do get easier once we learn to speak up and to listen.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s true. It’s the reason why we all got so close to you here at camp.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m just glad you’re back to spend the last few days of this camp term with us.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: By the way, Hunter… did your parents tell you if they changed their mind about art school yet?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Well, I’ve been wanting to ask about it before they left but… I guess I just didn’t want to push my luck…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: They were already kind enough to let me stay despite everything…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Well, maybe they will think about it. I mean, they pretty much know what you want now, right?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I sure hope they will!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: At first, I was only following them because they were my parents.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: But now, I’m following them because I understand them a lot better now!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, now that sounds like the Hunter I know!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh, let’s not get mushy again, got it? Twinkerbell’s back, and we’re all happy about it. The end.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Felix
text: I thought we were gonna go to the scoutmaster’s office? Why are we at the mess hall…?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Eduard
text: Ugh, I told you! I’m just gonna get me some cucumbers for my facial mud mask later!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Lee
text: In addition, the scoutmasters were preoccupied with some unforeseen circumstance from a while ago, Felix. We may just return later.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Seto
text: Why don’t we just get something to eat while we’re—
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Hunter! W-What are you doing here?! I thought you left!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Ah… Well…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: His parents decided on letting him finish the camp term, Taiga!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Seto
text: Sheesh, Taiga! Don’t just scream like that out of nowhere!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Eduard
text: You can say that again! My weave was damn near snatched…!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Taiga
text: But it is serious, guys! I was sure Hunter was already gone!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Lee
text: Oh, but it indeed appears that our silent friend has never left the premises. This turn of events was certainly unprecedented!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Eduard
text: Guess who’s back in the house!~ It’s Hunter~ Welcome back, blondie!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: T-Thanks, guys! I’m really happy that I don’t have to leave…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: And to think, I had to leave just after I started getting close with all of you guys…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Felix
text: Whew, I’m glad you’re back, Hunter… I thought for sure I was going to lose such a close friend like you…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Seto
text: Haha, Felix was really sad when he found out you were leaving. He seriously thought that he was gonna be the odd one out.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, come on! Every freakin’ one of you is a weirdo.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hiro
text: What are you guys up to, anyway? I heard you were all heading to the scoutmaster’s office?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh, Felix here just wanted some company on the way to the scoutmaster’s office. I think he wanted to make a phone call or something…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Felix
text: Ahh, well… I kinda wanted to invite my dad over for personal reasons.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Geez, what is this, “Bring Your Parents to Camp” Week?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Felix
text: Haha, it’s nothing like you’re thinking, Yoichi. I just thought of something that might help out the camp and all…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Felix
text: But, it’s really not that serious. And I’m still not sure about the details until I talk to my dad.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But why did you guys head here to mess hall then?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Seto
text: Well, Eduard needed a pickle or something for who knows why.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Eduard
text: It’s a cucumber! Ugh! You guys just don’t know the importance of keeping those dark circles around your eyes at bay!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Lee
text: Technically, Eduard, pickles could be cucumbers too. But just to clear out any confusion, the pickle itself is more aptly named after its process of preservation in a jar with--
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Eduard
text: What-ever! Look, we didn’t want to interrupt the scoutmasters, alright? They were off chatting about something important or whatever.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Hey, guys. I just had an idea…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Why don't we have a meal together since we're all here now?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure, Taiga! That sounds awesome!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Having a meal to share with Hunter and everyone without anything else to worry about… This was exactly what Camp Buddy was supposed to feel like!{/i}
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I never thought we’d all be talking and laughing at the same table like this!{/i}
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}We could all finally breathe easy and enjoy the rest of the term knowing Hunter was still with us!{/i}
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Once we were all done with dinner, we headed back to our cabins. {/i}
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Fwah~ It’s so nice to be back! I thought I’d never be able to lie down on this bed again…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: So much happened today it feels like we’ve been up forever, huh?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: And speaking of, I should really update my journal! I haven’t really written in it much because of everything that’s happened recently.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, that sounds like a great idea, Keitaro!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You wanna scribble on the pages, Hunter? Just like old times?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’d love to, Keitaro!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s been a while since I last drew in your journal, Keitaro.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, it’s actually Taiga’s journal, to be fair. You guys made this together with him, after all.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, yeah! I still can’t believe everything finally worked out in the end.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
