text: You know, Hunter… I was really nervous when I saw your parents again at the camp entrance…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It really did feel like it was the last time we were gonna see each other.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Haha, me too, but…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: We are gonna be apart soon enough… It is almost the end of the term after all.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: In the end, I guess it didn’t matter too much whether I left with my parents or not.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: D-Don’t say that! Of course it matters!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: If your parents left thinking we were all still bad influences on you… you’d never be able to come back!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: That’s a good point, Keitaro~ I guess it does!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I really like the way you think, Keitaro.
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Man, time really flies, doesn’t it, Hunter?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Well, yeah, Keitaro. I mean, we did have a lot of fun…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Think you’ll come back next term, Keitaro?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Definitely! How about you, Hunter?
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… I think my chances are pretty good. Especially now that I was able to convince my parents about Camp Buddy…
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Hunter
text: But personally, I’d love to come back and be with you again!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m really glad you could stay and finish the term!
label: day33_hunterpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: There we go… that should be all of Hunter’s stuff.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hunter’s really leaving us early, huh…?
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, you’re all leaving here in a couple days anyway, aren’t you?
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, I know. It's just sad that one of us have to leave like this…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hiro
text: And I don’t think Hunter will be coming back next summer either…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh* Just thinking about it makes me really sad…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What happened with you and Twinkerbell last night anyway, Frogboy?
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I suppose you and Hunter had a talk after he found out about his parents’ decision, Keitaro…?
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah… Hunter was so down that I couldn’t convince him to do anything anymore.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: If I pushed him more, I was scared he just would go against his parents. And that wouldn’t have ended well…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Can’t blame you, Frogboy. It’s all family stuff for Twinkerbell at this point, anyway.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hiro
text: I hope Hunter can still be happy after this…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Guys… We did everything we could to support Hunter… Even though things didn’t turn out like we’d hoped, we shouldn’t stop trying to help him out…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: …I agree, Natsumi. I just want Hunter to know that we’ll all still be there for him no matter what happens after this summer…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m back, guys...!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, Hunter! Were you able to say goodbye to everyone?
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah… I went to the office to give all my thanks to Sir Goro and Scoutmaster Yoshi.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I also dropped by our other friends to say goodbye.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m… really gonna miss you guys.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Aww… I’m not really the type who’s good at goodbyes… You’re gonna make me cry, Hunter!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Jeez, get a grip! Twinkerbell’s not dying or anything!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, besides, we can still try and get together outside the camp after the summer!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I know… It’s just… after seeing Hunter grow so much as my friend here in camp, I’m gonna miss him so much…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m… I’m really happy I was able to meet and grow with you guys.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Everyone here has done so much for me as friends I never thought I’d have. So, please don’t feel too sad.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: You guys are the one who taught me to be stronger, after all.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hunter…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Ah, the scoutmaster’s whistle…! My parents must be here.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Thank you so much for all the good times, guys. And all the lessons you’ve taught me here in camp.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll never forget any of them!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Goodbye, Hunter!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hiro
text: Don’t forget to call us, alright? You’ve got all our numbers!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yoichi
text: And don’t let your parents cut us off, alright? It’s bad enough they’re taking you out of this dump so soon!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll do my best…!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Anyway… I’ll go ahead now, guys…!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Hunter..! Let me help you with your bags!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: Hunter should be on his way here. Please wait for a moment.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Archer
text: Of course.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: If I may… I just want to apologize for any inconvenience that our faculty or scouts may have caused about this matter.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: It wasn’t our intention to meddle or interfere with what you had planned for your son.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Heather
text: It’s alright, Ms. Nomoru. I know you were all only just doing your jobs.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Archer
text: It’s just, we’re just not sure it’s in our best interests to let Hunter stay somewhere that decides on such unconventional things for his future.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Archer
text: I’m sure you understand.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: I certainly do…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Heather
text: I just hope Hunter doesn’t hold any hard feelings against us…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Archer
text: We just had to do what needed to be done. This is all for the best.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh there you are, Hunter…! Are you all set and ready to go?
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Y-Yes, Ms. Yuri… I’ve already said my goodbyes to everyone.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, that’s good.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Umm… Before I go, Keitaro…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I just wanted to say…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Thank you…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ve had so much fun here at camp with you… And I’m going to miss you so much…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: M-Me too, Hunter…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m ready, Mom and Dad…!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Heather
text: Alright, dear… Let’s go.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Archer
text: I’ll put your things into the car.
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Hunter
text: Goodbye, Keitaro and Ms. Yuri…! Have fun with the rest of the summer term! I hope we see each other again someday!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: G-Goodbye, Hunter…!
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sniff*
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww, Keitaro… Don’t cry…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: You know all of us were gonna leave this camp soon enough… It just so happened Hunter went home a little earlier….
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I… I can understand him leaving early…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: But what’s making me feel so sad is how his parents didn't even give him a chance to do what he wanted…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I thought what we did was enough to show them just how much Hunter wanted to follow his dreams… But I guess it wasn’t…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Yuri
text: Please don’t blame yourself like this, Keitaro… You did everything you could for Hunter's happiness…
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *cries*
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It felt so sad to say goodbye to Hunter like this…{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s true that all good things come to an end.{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But the reason it hurt so much for me is because I never told Hunter just how much I really loved him… {/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Almost a year has passed, and it’s almost time for summer vacation again…{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I was so busy with my school life that it’s been rare for me to keep in touch with Hunter or any of the friends I met in Camp Buddy.{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Unfortunately, I haven’t heard from Hunter ever since...{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I guess… Hunter’s parents totally stopped him from communicating with us…{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I received mail from Camp Buddy right after the school semester ended, inviting me to join again this summer.{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But I thought to myself…{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}What’s the point of coming back if Hunter won’t be there with me…?{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Things will never be the same without him…{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}And with that, I decided to decline the offer, and let things stay as they are.{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I guess everything that happened last summer… {/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}May have just been the greatest memory I will someday forget…{/i}
label: day33_hunterwe

speaker: Natsumi
text: N-Naoto…!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I was just on my way to your room...! W-Why are you out here…?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-And… those bags... Don’t tell me you’re-
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Naoto
text: I’m leaving, Natsumi.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-What…?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Naoto
text: I already talked to the scoutmasters yesterday. I’m withdrawing from the job they offered me here in camp.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Why would you do that…?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Naoto
text: I think it’s for the best, Natsumi. I don’t want to damage my relationship with you any more than I already have.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-Wait, Naoto...! Let’s-
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Naoto
text: We can always talk again and sort things out back at home. But for now, please try to enjoy this last day at camp with everyone.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Naoto
text: Alright. I’ll be on my way now. I’ll see you after the camp term, alright?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh… You guys are already awake?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Ah, yeah… We were really worried about Natsumi, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-Huh? What happened?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: I don’t know, but he got up earlier than usual and walked out of the cabin…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Tch… He hasn’t even said a word since he got back here last night.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: And he’s still trying to avoid us this morning…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: He’s… still not okay, huh?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Aww, this really sucks… Are we really gonna end our camping days here like this?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: Isn’t there anything we can do…?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Should we all go talk to him together? Maybe he’s a lot calmer now.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I don’t think so. He’s probably scared to see us after we heard all that stuff yesterday.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: Then maybe we shouldn’t ‘all’ go to talk to him… Out of all of us, he trusts Keitaro the most.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: So, you think Keitaro should give it one more shot?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m not sure what else I could say, but I can try…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Wake up, scouts! It’s time for-
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Whoa! You’re all up already!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: O-Oh! Good morning, Scoutmaster Yoshi! Are we going to have an activity today?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-Well, not exactly an activity. More like a farewell party for everyone since this is our last day.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh! That doesn’t sound too bad.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess it’ll be nice to spend time with everyone before we leave.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: As long as there are some games, count me in!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Then please get dressed! Everyone else is already gathered at the mess hall!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’ll see you boys there!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Did you guys hear that? Everyone’s at the mess hall!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh yeah…! That means Natsumi must be there too!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Then what are we waitin’ for? Let’s go there now!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, everyone!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp! That also means that we don't really know if we'll see each other again next year.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir, if you will?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: Right! Ehem…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: So as a means of showing our gratitude, we’ve prepared a final activity for all of you!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, dear?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, yes! Scouts, I’m pleased to announce we will be having a little farewell party! Just like the one we had to welcome you all here!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Aiden
text: The food has already been prepared, and we made sure to include all your favorite meals for you to enjoy on this last day!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yuri
text: We hope that this little event will mean as much to everyone as it means to us, your scoutmasters!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It's unfortunate to know we'll all be parting ways tomorrow with no guarantee that we'll see each other again...
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But what truly matters most is that we create the greatest memories we can possibly make here and now!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So, campers! Please enjoy your final day here at Camp Buddy!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Taiga
text: Haha! Pretty cool they prepared something like this for us on our last day, huh?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Eduard
text: I was hoping they had something fancier for us, though~ Like a stage play! That would be soooooo lovely~
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Lee
text: I prefer engaging in something more educational like a science fair or a research symposium!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Felix
text: Ah… It sure is nice to be gathered like this with everyone.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Taiga
text: Hmm… Hold on, isn’t someone missing?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Seto
text: Oh, yeah! Where’s Natsumi?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yeah… Have you guys seen him? We thought he’d be here at the party with everyone else.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Lee
text: I don’t think we encountered him at all this morning.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Felix
text: I-Is everything alright…? He’s not sick or anything, right?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Eduard
text: And I haven’t seen his hunky big brother too! Ahh… Where’s a Prince Charming when I need one?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Taiga
text: Well, I’m sure those two are just around helping with the party hosting or something!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Taiga
text: Let’s go and start eatin’!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Lee
text: W-Wait for us, Taiga!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Seto
text: I’ll see ya guys later~! Come on, Felix! Let’s get some food before it runs out!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Guys… I’m really worried about Natsumi…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah, Keitaro… Should we go and look for him?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hiro
text: It’s really weird that Naoto isn’t around either.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hate to say it, but my gut is telling me something else happened with those two.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ll try asking Scoutmaster Yoshi first. Maybe he knows something.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: Alright, Keitaro. We’ll be right here.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi…!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, Keitaro! What’s up?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-Have you seen Natsumi? I didn’t see him or Naoto at all here at the party…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah… About that…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Natsumi’s by the docks, getting some fresh air. I believe he’s still upset over yesterday’s events…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: H-How did you know about that, sir…?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well… Naoto talked to me yesterday about him getting into an argument with Natsumi over him becoming a scoutmaster.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: He has decided to turn down the scoutmaster position we gave him and left the camp this morning.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh no…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know this news is upsetting… And I’m really disappointed that I didn’t foresee something like this would happen. Especially over this particular matter.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I tried talking to Natsumi about it this morning and invited him to join us for this party, but he asked me to allow him to skip this event.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I didn’t want to force him, so I let him take his time…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I need to talk with him, Scoutmaster Yoshi…!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: If you think that would be best, then please do, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Please excuse me…!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Natsumi! There you are! I… I’ve been looking everywhere for you…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I heard about your brother. I’m so sorry things turned out that way.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: You must think it’s my fault too, huh…?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What?
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I already know, Keitaro. I shouldn’t have planned on being a scoutmaster in the first place…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s only because of my stupid insecurity that I went as far as pushing my brother away…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: P-Please don’t beat yourself up like this, Natsumi…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: This is our last day in camp and everyone’s having a party back there…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s make this day count! Join in and have fun with us!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t just go back there pretending like nothing happened!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don’t even have the guts to show my face to our friends anymore, Keitaro! Especially after they heard the things I said!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can barely even talk to you about all of this right now…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: But we understand, Natsumi! We won’t change the way we see you because of that…!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: It may not have changed anything for you guys… but it’s different for me, Keitaro!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I feel disgusted at myself for being so selfish all this time!
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: And to know I only found out about this now, just shows how horrible I’ve really been…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: It really makes sense why Scoutmaster Yoshi didn’t think I deserved to be a scoutmaster now…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: All I wanted was attention, and I used everyone around me to feel better about myself. That’s the truth.
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Natsumi…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m sorry our last day together here at camp had to be like this, Keitaro….
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: There’s just so much I need to learn… I really want to change, but I know I can’t do that overnight…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I have to reflect on everything I’ve done and make sure that I face everyone only when I finally know how I can make things right…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sorry too, Natsumi… Please know that I’ll always be here for you no matter what…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Thank you, Keitaro…
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}And I sat there with Natsumi, waiting for him to calm himself down completely.{/i}
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I made sure I brought him back to the farewell party with me, and we were able to spend the rest of the day together with everyone.{/i}
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Seeing Natsumi’s bittersweet smile as he tried his best to enjoy the last day of camp really broke my heart.{/i}
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Maybe things were meant to be like this… Maybe there really was nothing I could do to truly help him in the end…{/i}
label: day33_natsumibe

speaker: Hunter
text: Wow, Natsumi… I never knew…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Sheesh, yeah. That sounds rough… I don’t even have any siblings, so I wouldn’t know how hard that’s gotta be.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: If that was me, I probably would’ve gone even crazier than Mr. Perfect here.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I’m glad I know how to deal with it now… My brother never meant to do me any wrong, anyway.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m sure he had a good reason for doing things that way, and it was my problem for being so insecure in the first place.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn*
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Good morning, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Morning, guys. What are you all talking about…?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Ah, Natsumi was just filling us in on what happened last night and all the stuff about his brother.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… I see…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Man, you two really love hiding stuff from us, huh…? You should’ve told us about this sooner!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah… If we knew how Natsumi really felt around his brother, we would’ve been more careful with our words.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro was right. I should’ve trusted you guys about this too.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Natsumi. I know you were only afraid of what we’d think about you when we overheard the talk between you and your brother.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I gotta say, Mr. Perfect. That fight you had with your bro got really messy.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah. We never thought the two of you could even explode like that at each other.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: It can’t be helped. Natsumi and Mr. Naoto always looked like they just got along really well…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well… we really did. But I just wasn’t honest with him… or anyone else.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I tried to keep everyone from seeing my flaws. I just wanted to keep being ‘perfect’ in front of all of you.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But instead of making me closer with everyone, it just did the opposite.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: At least now you’ve finally learned to trust everyone else like you trusted me.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, and the only thing left now is for me to settle things with my brother once and for all.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, is that why you’re all dressed up already?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes. I don’t want to waste any more time. I know exactly what I need to say to him now.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I just need to be honest about everything, and I’m sure things will work out!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: You can do it, Natsumi. If anything happens, we’ll be right here, okay?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Right! I’ll go and talk to him now, you guys!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Did he really think we were stupid enough to diss him after all that? I’ve done way worse, and I’m still here!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess Natsumi was just afraid it would change the way we saw him.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: He cares that much about what people think about him? If he just stopped giving a fuck for a minute like me, he’d be way better off!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, but everyone in camp thinks you’re a smelly jerk, Wolfboy.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ha! And I’m proud of that!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Haha, but I don’t think you should be, Yoichi.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Looks like everyone’s feeling alright even after everything that happened with Natsumi.{/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}At this rate, I’m sure Naoto will be able to understand him too. I know that they will be able to talk things out better now.{/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whew… Here goes nothing…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: A-Ah, Natsumi! Y-You’re here!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh…! I was just headed to the office to talk to you, Naoto.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Really? I was on my way to your cabin for you too… Kinda funny we bumped into each other here, huh?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I’ve calmed down since yesterday. And there’s a lot I want to talk about with you…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I guess we really are brothers, huh? Having the same thoughts and all.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Come on, let’s sit down for a while and settle this…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, Naoto…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I wanted to apologize for what happened yesterday. I let my anger get the best of me.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Even though I was only telling you how I really felt… it’s really not an excuse to be that mean to you.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I know I can’t take back what I said, and I’m sure there were better ways for me to have told you how I felt.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Natsumi…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: To be honest, you haven’t done anything wrong to me… In fact, you’ve always been a good brother to me.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I kept telling myself the opposite, and convinced myself that you were trying to hurt me all this time…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I was the one who was wrong for thinking like that for so long…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: And you were only thinking for my sake by telling me the things I needed to hear…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, I hope you can forgive me…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Don’t worry, Natsumi. I already have…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I can’t blame you for feeling that way about me because I’ve made my own mistakes too.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I got so used to having you depend on me and look up to me in everything, that I did my best to be the most perfect big brother.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: And when people started comparing us to each other, I wasn’t even sensitive enough to notice how awful that made you feel.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: If you hadn’t spoken up yesterday, I never would’ve known I was doing you more bad than good…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Besides, I let my emotions take over and started accusing you of things I didn’t even know about too.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I’m not supposed to be your judge, or your rival… If anything, I should’ve been always on your side, because we’re family.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I’m really sorry if I failed you as your big brother…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: You never failed me, Naoto… You’ve always wanted to help me in every way you could, and it’s my fault for not seeing that before…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Even so, I want you to know that I would do anything to make it up to you, Natsumi…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: That’s why I’ve decided to turn down the scoutmaster position and leave Camp Buddy as well…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: H-Huh?! But why…?!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I’ve been thinking about it, and I believe you need to have your own place to grow… without the pressure of having me around.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: And you were right when you told me that I’ve taken so much from you already… This is the least that I could do…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: But please, don’t take this the wrong way!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: It doesn’t mean that I want to get away from you or anything. I promise I don’t have any hard feelings at all!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I just want you to be happy…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Naoto, if you do that… then I wouldn’t have learned anything at all. We would be just avoiding the problem, instead of solving it…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I have to understand where I went wrong and find a way to move forward without having you to lead
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, please… stay and be a scoutmaster. I want you to be there and watch over me become better each day…!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: And more importantly, I’d love to spend another summer with you just like we used to!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, let’s have some fun, alright big bro?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: You got it, Natsumi…!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ack…! You’re hugging too tight, Naoto…!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: It’s been so long since you called me “big bro” like that…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I promise, I won’t ever let you down again!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Me too, big bro…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whew… I’m so glad that went better than I thought.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! There’s Natsumi!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hey there, guys! Where are you all off to?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: We were actually going to the mess hall to get some food, ‘til we ran into you!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: I thought you were gonna meet up with your brother, Natsumi?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I did. I just finished talking with him, actually.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: How did it go, Natsumi?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, a lot better than I’d hoped. I think we’ve really both come to terms with each other.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: We apologized for how we acted yesterday and really tried to understand each other this time.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wah, that’s great news!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Whew… I’m so glad you guys made up….
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: He told us he was gonna leave camp, though! Does that mean he’ll be staying with us for good now?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes! He’ll definitely be taking the job offer! You guys better get used to seeing him from now on.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Can this chit-chat wait ‘til we get to the mess hall? I’m starving!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, right, right! I’ll tell you guys all about it there!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Last one there’s a rotten egg!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey! Don’t just bolt like that, Wolfboy!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: W-Wait for me!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m really glad everything turned out well for you and your brother, Natsumi.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, me too. Thanks so much for all your help, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I wouldn’t have even considered making up with my brother if you hadn’t talked to me yesterday.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s my pleasure, Natsumi! I am kinda curious about what he said, though.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, at first he said he wasn’t going to take up the offer to be a scoutmaster because he wanted me to be happy…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I told him he didn’t have to do that. And that I’d rather have him here in Camp Buddy with us instead.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I finally feel close with my brother again… And I’m actually looking forward to seeing him as a scoutmaster next year!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: So, does that mean you aren’t that upset about him getting the job first now?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: It was so unreasonable for me to have been bitter about it in the first place.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Naoto deserved to be a scoutmaster, and I didn’t. At least not yet.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m sure my time will come. But until then, I’ll work my hardest to really earn it.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s really great to hear from you, Natsumi!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, why don’t we go get some brunch now? You must be hungry!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! I am, actually! Let’s go!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh…! Felix!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Hi, guys…!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: We’re heading over to the mess hall for brunch. Do you wanna come along with us?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I’m sorry, but I can’t tag along right now. I’m waiting for my dad to show up.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Your father? Is he picking you up early?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Umm… It’s not like that. My dad is actually just visiting to check out the camp.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I’ve been telling him stories about how much fun I’ve been having here. I figured it’d be nice to invite him here before the term ends so he can see for himself.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! That’s really nice, Felix!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I’m kind of worried there aren’t any scoutmasters to welcome him, though.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: He might just think they’re being lazy and aren’t taking care of the camp…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! I don’t think your dad will assume anything like that, Felix!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: If you want, we could inform the scoutmasters of his visit! We’ll come with you too!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: W-Well, if it’s alright with you guys…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, of course, Felix! Anytime!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Come on and let’s go to the office then!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Good morning, sir!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Oh! Good morning, boys. What brings you here so early in the morning?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Sir Goro, if you aren’t busy, Felix here wanted to ask you something.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm? What is it, lad?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Ah..! Y-Yes..! Well…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I invited my dad to visit Camp Buddy today to check it out… And I was wondering if at least one of the scoutmasters could welcome him and give him a tour…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: No problem, Felix. I’ll go and tell Yuri and the others to attend to your father, alright?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Let me just finish my morning coffee, and I’ll get on it right away.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: You boys run along and enjoy the rest of the day.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: T-Thank you, sir..!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: See, Felix? There’s nothing to worry about after all~
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you again, sir! We’ll be on our way!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: A parental visit, eh? It’s been a while since that happened.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I have to look at his data sheet first so I’ll know how to cater to him properly while we give him a tour…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: *yawn*
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm… let’s see… Who was that scout again…?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Ah, Felix Clermont…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Clermont…?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: WHAT?!!!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Thanks for coming with me, guys.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: No problem, Felix!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I’m not used to talking up front to people like that. My dad can be just as intimidating as Sir Goro.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Older people are always so serious and busy…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmm.. that makes me wonder. What does your dad do, Felix?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my dad is an author with his own publishing company.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s awesome! I've always admired people who could write!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, so I’m guessing your dad loves literature quite a lot, huh?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I guess you could say that… He has sold over a million books worldwide and sponsored a lot of other independent authors as well.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, so that explains why you’re so… ummm… affluent, Felix!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But now I’m curious… Out of all the places you could go to, why did you choose an adventure-themed program like Camp Buddy?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… I was always bullied at school for getting special treatment from the teachers, even though I went to an exclusive private school…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: My dad thought it was best to have private tutors come over, so I’ve been taught at home for a really long time.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I got so used to staying at home that I didn’t even go outside anymore… It made my dad worry so much that he thought he might have been depriving me of any fun.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: That’s when he came across an online article about this place and asked me if I wanted to spend my summer vacation here.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I thought trying something new like this may not be so bad, so I agreed to do it.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: However, I tried to keep my family profile a secret since I didn’t want the same thing that happened to me at school to happen here…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… Are you sure it’s alright for you to tell us all of this, Felix?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: It’s okay. You guys are my friends. Even if you did know, I don’t think it would have changed the way you see me.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I’m just happy to get the same treatment as everyone else and finally feel like a normal person.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, of course not, Felix. But I’ll admit, I always thought you lived a life where you got to have whatever you wanted whenever you wanted it.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: That may be true, Natsumi… But there are a lot of things I missed out too… I never had real friends until I met all of you guys…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I know I’m not good at socializing… And on top of that I know I was obnoxious at first, complaining about almost everything…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: If it were any other people, they would’ve left me right away. In fact, the people who stuck around me back then were only after my money…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my father’s money…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: But like I said..! Everything is different here! I couldn’t really ask for more.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so glad that you think that way, Felix! All of us learned a lot from each other here!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: You’re right. That’s why I thought my dad should really see this place for himself!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: He needs to see just how good of an investment Camp Buddy can be!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ehh…? What do you mean, Felix?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… When everyone was busy with the fundraising and advertisement campaign, I wanted to help out in any way I could too…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I know the campaign was successful, but I still didn’t want to leave the camp without helping…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I explained the situation to my dad and asked him if he could help out the camp financially…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-Wait… You did what?!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s unbelievable, Felix..! Did you tell the scoutmasters about this yet?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I haven’t yet… I didn’t have enough time to explain it fully to Sir Goro before.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: That’s why I’m really worried about my dad’s visit. I wanted to impress him enough to persuade him to sponsor the camp.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh wow, Felix, that’s great news! I’m sure the scoutmasters will impress him!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Let’s just hope we don’t run into any trouble…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: A-Anyway! I’m sorry for taking up so much of your time, you guys! Please go and have your meal!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Thank you so much for helping me, Natsumi and Keitaro! You guys are the best!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I need to prepare for my dad’s arrival! See you guys later!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I guess we should go catch up to our friends. They must be waiting for us already.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, right! Hiro and Yoichi might scold us again, haha!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I-I… I can’t believe this! I can’t believe HE is actually going to visit our camp!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: D-Dad! Calm down! Tell us what’s going on first!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yeah, sir. I haven’t seen you this excited in a long time.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Sheesh, Gramps! Is that guy like a supermodel or something?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Weren’t you three listening? Mr. William Clermont will be visiting the camp!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: W-What?! The ‘Sir William Clermont’?!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m sorry, but I’m not following. Who is this William Clermont?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: He’s an award-winning novel author and publisher! And if I’m not mistaken, he’s also one of the top ten wealthiest personalities in the world!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: My dad is an absolute, die-hard fan of Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Actually, I have to say, his works are really top-notch! I’ve read most of them from Dad’s collection!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Are you sure this is the same person, sir?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m definitely sure! I pulled up our records and it seems that Mr. Clermont’s only son is enrolled in this batch!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! You mean Felix?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: That’s right!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Hmm… That explains why Felix seems to be new to everything that’s going on around here…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: I wonder why someone so wealthy would send their only son to such a run-down camp like this, though?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To be fair, the camp had a great reputation up until last year! We’ve been an outstanding, model summer camp for the last two decades!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can understand Mr. Clermont entrusting his son to us! But what I’m not sure of is why he would want to visit us.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m not sure either, but it doesn’t matter! I get to finally meet Mr. Clermont in person!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Don’t get your hopes up too much, Dad. He’s probably here to visit his son, not the camp.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I might actually get him to sign my collection of his books while he’s here!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve actually just bought and finished his newest work!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Relax, Gramps!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Now we know where Yuri's obsession over things came from…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess you could say that, Aiden.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Anyway! Let’s make sure the entire camp is spotless and everything is in order before he arrives!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: We have to make sure and impress him!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* You guys came in late again… Your food’s already cold.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Sheesh! Having quickies again at the weirdest times?!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, we actually got caught up helping Felix on our way here.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, did he run into trouble?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, nothing like that, Hunter. He was just waiting for his dad to show up.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh? His dad is coming here?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah. We actually visited the scoutmasters with him to let them know about the visit.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why? Is Snowball going home early or something?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s what we thought too, but he told us his dad just wanted to check out our camp before this term ended!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Felix told us there was a chance his dad could sponsor Camp Buddy. Who knows? Maybe he could really help!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Whoa! Really?! Just who is Felix’s dad anyways?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, Mr. Clermont is one of the best-selling authors around the world. He’s a billionaire.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-How could you say that with a straight face?!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: W-What? Really?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: How did you know about that, Hunter? Did Felix tell you before?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: No. I’ve known about it since I heard Felix’s last name. I’ve read some of his father’s books.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh. Well, I guess now we know why Felix acts that way.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: We all knew he was rich. But not this rich!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s great news that his father is a potential investor, though. If he offers a sponsorship, that would probably help liquidate all the camp’s financial liabilities.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: There we go again. Spouting business words that only you guys can understand.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Heh~ I know, right Wolfboy? Let’s just pretend we understand! Haha!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hahaha! All Hunter is saying is that we could really use the help Felix’s dad can give if he sees Camp Buddy as a worthwhile investment.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m not sure why Mr. Clermont would think otherwise! Camp Buddy is a great place after all!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Do the scoutmasters know about this already?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think so, but it shouldn’t matter! They treat all visitors with the same amount of respect, no matter who they are!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s right! Mr. Clermont can also see for himself just how friendly and well mannered the campers are!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Hey, guys! Having lunch too, I see~
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, hi there, Naoto! Why don’t you join us?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Sure thing! I was just looking for a table too, haha!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: What’d you get for lunch, bro?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Hmm… Some rice, fish and vegetables!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Whoa! You guys’ plates look exactly the same!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: Haha! I guess we really are brothers~
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh… It’s so corny hearing that now.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… you should get used to it, Yoichi. Naoto’s our scoutmaster now after all!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Naoto
text: I was kinda thinking too… maybe we could do some chores together, little bro! You know, just like the good ol’ days~!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Of course, I don’t mind!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I guess things really are back to normal now. I’m glad everything turned out this way in the end!){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Once we were done eating, it was just another day in camp for us, having fun without anything to worry about at all…{/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I knew this was all something I was definitely going to miss once the summer is over…{/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Oh, and speaking of good times… I should really update my journal! I don’t think I’ll have any other day to write an entry! {/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! I’ve finished updating my journal!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe that this new journal is almost full as well.){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(When I first came to Camp Buddy, the only thing on my mind was to make as many great memories as possible.){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I wanted to keep those memories forever with the pictures I took and everything I wrote in my journal.){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But when my first journal was ruined, I thought the memories I tried to preserve were gone as well.){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I was wrong.){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Everyone put their heart into making this new journal. It’s proof that all the times we spent together were remembered and always will be.){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that all of this happened in just the one month I’ve been staying here.){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And now that there’s just a day left before the camp ends…){/i}
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Phew…! I guess I’m thinking about this a lot more than I should.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Looks like Natsumi isn’t back from his chores with Naoto. Maybe I should go and help them out—
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: And here’s one of the lodging cabins for our campers!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Complete with all basic facilities every camper needs and always well maintained!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Interesting. It seems like everything is in good shape around here.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, indeed! Ahaha…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Oh, Keitaro! You’re here!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! I’d like you to meet Keitaro! He’s one of my friends that I told you about!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Ah, Keitaro! I’ve heard a lot of stories about you.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Keitaro here is like a leader among us! I can safely say that, if it weren’t for him, I wouldn’t be so close with everyone else!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Felix. It’s not like that, really...
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I really want to be like Keitaro, Dad! He listens to everyone’s opinions and always tries to understand his fellow campers!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I can’t help but agree with you, Felix. Keitaro here is a shining example of the spirit of this camp.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: I can see that. I’ve never seen my son introduce someone with such confidence.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, please accept my personal gratitude for being a true friend to my son.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Aah… You’re welcome, sir. But really, I can’t take all the credit.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Here at Camp Buddy, we all work together, scoutmasters and scouts alike.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! I admire your humility!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: But if you’d pardon the shift in topic, I can’t help but notice that book you’re carrying, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s my journal, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: A journal, you say? I see we may have an aspiring writer here then.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s nowhere near as good as your professional works, Mr. Clermont! I usually just write about all the memories I’ve shared with everyone here in Camp Buddy!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I get a little help from all my friends too whenever I update my journal! So it’s really a team effort!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! Keitaro here is quite the photographer as well!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Oh really? That explains that camera then.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir! It’s a little hobby of mine, and I use some of the pictures I take to decorate my journal like a scrapbook!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: This journal was actually a welcoming gift from the scoutmasters too!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Impressive. I didn’t know how nurturing you were of your scouts’ creativity here, Mr. Nomoru!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: It’s not just creativity, Mr. Clermont! We let our campers engage in activities that fit all their interests in order for them to excel at what they are most passionate about!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: I see!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: I know it’s your personal article, Keitaro. But may I take a peek?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure thing, Mr. Clermont! You’re just in time, since I finished updating it before you guys entered!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: *hands over the journal*
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Mmmhhhmm…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Very interesting.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: U-Umm… Mr. Clermont…? We can continue the tour now…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Hold on.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Hahaha…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Hey… Mr. Clermont seems to be enjoying your journal… Just what did you write in there…?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: U-Umm… Well—
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Haha! You’re quite a passionate writer, Keitaro!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: I enjoyed the stories you put in your journal! They give off that innocent, boyhood expression that I feel is lacking in my own books.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! It’s an honor to hear that from you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: You and your friends have done well!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Ah, I really wish that I could just sit back and read what you’ve cooked up in this little book of yours!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh I don’t really mind, Mr. Clermont! You can borrow it if you like!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I won’t be adding any entries for the rest of the day, anyway!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Oh, splendid! You truly are one interesting boy!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Mr. Nomoru, is it possible that you escort me to a quarter where I can just enjoy this book with a nice cup of tea by my side?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: But Mr. Clermont, the tour isn’t finished yet…!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! It’s quite alright. I’ve seen enough!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, I will return your journal as soon as I finish reading it! Thank you very much again for lending it to me!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re welcome, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: William
text: Now, if you’ll excuse us.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: This way, please.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Whew… I wasn’t expecting that…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh well. I guess I’ll go help Natsumi out now!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: What happened, Dad? Why do you look so down?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* I’m just thinking about my tour with Mr. Clermont.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, how did it go?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I-It went alright… He just stopped halfway through the tour.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Huh…? What happened?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Well… I was just showing him around the camp the whole day. It was uneventful until we arrived at Cabin One.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: We met Keitaro inside, and he was holding his journal. Mr. Clermont was intrigued and asked Keitaro if he could borrow it for a while.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: He then halted the tour just to rest and read Keitaro’s journal with some tea.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: What’s wrong with that, sir? It sounds like it went well to me.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m just afraid that I might have overworked him or something…
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Dad, I think you’re being too paranoid about it! I’m sure he just really enjoyed Keitaro’s journal!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Or maybe he read something inappropriate! Like the time where Taiga snapped a photo of your butt!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Aiden! You’re not helping!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Let’s not worry about it too much, sir. Maybe he’s tired, just like you said. He’s a pretty busy man after all.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Yoshi’s right! And you’ve had a long day too!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: So, why don’t you go and get some sleep, Dad? We still have huge plans for the campers tomorrow after all!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Maybe I should send him an email apologizing at lea-
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Sleeeeeeeep.
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Hehe~ Your dad is a total fanboy of this Clermont guy, eh?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: I guess it runs in the blood!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: You’re making it sound like it’s a bad thing, Aiden! Hmph!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, let’s all get some rest as well. We have to be ready tomorrow for our final activity with the scouts!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah, you’re right! I’m already beat from cleaning the entire place for that Clermont guy!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Well, I should close up this place before I head out—
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, who could that be…?
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: E-Eh?! Mr. Clermont?!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Y-Yes! I’ll go get my dad right away!
label: day33_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Wow, Natsumi… I never knew…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Sheesh, yeah. That sounds rough… I don’t even have any siblings, so I wouldn’t know how hard that’s gotta be.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: If that was me, I probably would’ve gone even crazier than Mr. Perfect here.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I’m glad I know how to deal with it now… My brother never meant to do me any wrong, anyway.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m sure he had a good reason for doing things that way, and it was my problem for being so insecure in the first place.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn*
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Good morning, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Morning, guys. What are you all talking about…?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Ah, Natsumi was just filling us in on what happened last night and all the stuff about his brother.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… I see…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Man, you two really love hiding stuff from us, huh…? You should’ve told us about this sooner!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah… If we knew how Natsumi really felt around his brother, we would’ve been more careful with our words.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Keitaro was right. I should’ve trusted you guys about this too.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Natsumi. I know you were only afraid of what we’d think about you when we overheard the talk between you and your brother.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I gotta say, Mr. Perfect. That fight you had with your bro got really messy.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah. We never thought the two of you could even explode like that at each other.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: It can’t be helped. Natsumi and Mr. Naoto always looked like they just got along really well…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well… we really did. But I just wasn’t honest with him… or anyone else.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I tried to keep everyone from seeing my flaws. I just wanted to keep being ‘perfect’ in front of all of you.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But instead of making me closer with everyone, it just did the opposite.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: At least now you’ve finally learned to trust everyone else like you trusted me.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, and the only thing left now is for me to settle things with my brother once and for all.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, is that why you’re all dressed up already?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes. I don’t want to waste any more time. I know exactly what I need to say to him now.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I just need to be honest about everything, and I’m sure things will work out!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You can do it, Natsumi. If anything happens, we’ll be right here, okay?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Right! I’ll go and talk to him now, you guys!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Did he really think we were stupid enough to diss him after all that? I’ve done way worse, and I’m still here!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess Natsumi was just afraid it would change the way we saw him.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: He cares that much about what people think about him? If he just stopped giving a fuck for a minute like me, he’d be way better off!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, but everyone in camp thinks you’re a smelly jerk, Wolfboy.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ha! And I’m proud of that!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Haha, but I don’t think you should be, Yoichi.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Looks like everyone’s feeling alright even after everything that happened with Natsumi.{/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}At this rate, I’m sure Naoto will be able to understand him too. I know that they will be able to talk things out better now.{/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whew… Here goes nothing…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: A-Ah, Natsumi! Y-You’re here!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh…! I was just headed to the office to talk to you, Naoto.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Really? I was on my way to your cabin for you too… Kinda funny we bumped into each other here, huh?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I’ve calmed down since yesterday. And there’s a lot I want to talk about with you…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I guess we really are brothers, huh? Having the same thoughts and all.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Come on, let’s sit down for a while and settle this…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, Naoto…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I wanted to apologize for what happened yesterday. I let my anger get the best of me.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Even though I was only telling you how I really felt… it’s really not an excuse to be that mean to you.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I know I can’t take back what I said, and I’m sure there were better ways for me to have told you how I felt.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Natsumi…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: To be honest, you haven’t done anything wrong to me… In fact, you’ve always been a good brother to me.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I kept telling myself the opposite, and convinced myself that you were trying to hurt me all this time…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I was the one who was wrong for thinking like that for so long…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: And you were only thinking for my sake by telling me the things I needed to hear…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, I hope you can forgive me…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Don’t worry, Natsumi. I already have…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I can’t blame you for feeling that way about me because I’ve made my own mistakes too.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I got so used to having you depend on me and look up to me in everything, that I did my best to be the most perfect big brother.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: And when people started comparing us to each other, I wasn’t even sensitive enough to notice how awful that made you feel.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: If you hadn’t spoken up yesterday, I never would’ve known I was doing you more bad than good…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Besides, I let my emotions take over and started accusing you of things I didn’t even know about too.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I’m not supposed to be your judge, or your rival… If anything, I should’ve been always on your side, because we’re family.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I’m really sorry if I failed you as your big brother…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: You never failed me, Naoto… You’ve always wanted to help me in every way you could, and it’s my fault for not seeing that before…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Even so, I want you to know that I would do anything to make it up to you, Natsumi…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: That’s why I’ve decided to turn down the scoutmaster position and leave Camp Buddy as well…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: H-Huh?! But why…?!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I’ve been thinking about it, and I believe you need to have your own place to grow… without the pressure of having me around.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: And you were right when you told me that I’ve taken so much from you already… This is the least that I could do…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: But please, don’t take this the wrong way!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: It doesn’t mean that I want to get away from you or anything. I promise I don’t have any hard feelings at all!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I just want you to be happy…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Naoto, if you do that… then I wouldn’t have learned anything at all. We would be just avoiding the problem, instead of solving it…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I have to understand where I went wrong and find a way to move forward without having you to lead.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, please… stay and be a scoutmaster. I want you to be there and watch over me become better each day…!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: And more importantly, I’d love to spend another summer with you just like we used to!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: So, let’s have some fun, alright big bro?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: You got it, Natsumi…!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ack…! You’re hugging too tight, Naoto…!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: It’s been so long since you called me “big bro” like that…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I promise, I won’t ever let you down again!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Me too, big bro…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whew… I’m so glad that went better than I thought.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! There’s Natsumi!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hey there, guys! Where are you all off to?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: We were actually going to the mess hall to get some food, ‘til we ran into you!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: I thought you were gonna meet up with your brother, Natsumi?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I did. I just finished talking with him, actually.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: How did it go, Natsumi?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, a lot better than I’d hoped. I think we’ve really both come to terms with each other.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: We apologized for how we acted yesterday and really tried to understand each other this time.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wah, that’s great news!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Whew… I’m so glad you guys made up….
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: He told us he was gonna leave camp, though! Does that mean he’ll be staying with us for good now?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes! He’ll definitely be taking the job offer! You guys better get used to seeing him from now on.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Can this chit-chat wait ‘til we get to the mess hall? I’m starving!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, right, right! I’ll tell you guys all about it there!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Last one there’s a rotten egg!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey! Don’t just bolt like that, Wolfboy!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: W-Wait for me!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m really glad everything turned out well for you and your brother, Natsumi.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, me too. Thanks so much for all your help, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I wouldn’t have even considered making up with my brother if you hadn’t talked to me yesterday.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s my pleasure, Natsumi! I am kinda curious about what he said, though.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, at first he said he wasn’t going to take up the offer to be a scoutmaster because he wanted me to be happy…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I told him he didn’t have to do that. And that I’d rather have him here in Camp Buddy with us instead.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I finally feel close with my brother again… And I’m actually looking forward to seeing him as a scoutmaster next year!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: So, does that mean you aren’t that upset about him getting the job first now?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: It was so unreasonable for me to have been bitter about it in the first place.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Naoto deserved to be a scoutmaster, and I didn’t. At least not yet.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m sure my time will come. But until then, I’ll work my hardest to really earn it.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s really great to hear from you, Natsumi!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, why don’t we go get some brunch now? You must be hungry!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! I am, actually! Let’s go!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh…! Felix!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Hi, guys…!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: We’re heading over to the mess hall for brunch. Do you wanna come along with us?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I’m sorry, but I can’t tag along right now. I’m waiting for my dad to show up.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Your father? Is he picking you up early?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Umm… It’s not like that. My dad is actually just visiting to check out the camp.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I’ve been telling him stories about how much fun I’ve been having here. I figured it’d be nice to invite him here before the term ends so he can see for himself.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! That’s really nice, Felix!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I’m kind of worried there aren’t any scoutmasters to welcome him, though.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: He might just think they’re being lazy and aren’t taking care of the camp…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! I don’t think your dad will assume anything like that, Felix!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: If you want, we could inform the scoutmasters of his visit! We’ll come with you too!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: W-Well, if it’s alright with you guys…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, of course, Felix! Anytime!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Come on and let’s go to the office then!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Good morning, sir!
