label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Oh! Good morning, boys. What brings you here so early in the morning?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Sir Goro, if you aren’t busy, Felix here wanted to ask you something.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm? What is it, lad?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Ah..! Y-Yes..! Well…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I invited my dad to visit Camp Buddy today to check it out… And I was wondering if at least one of the scoutmasters could welcome him and give him a tour…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: No problem, Felix. I’ll go and tell Yuri and the others to attend to your father, alright?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Let me just finish my morning coffee, and I’ll get on it right away.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: You boys run along and enjoy the rest of the day.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: T-Thank you, sir..!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: See, Felix? There’s nothing to worry about after all~
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you again, sir! We’ll be on our way!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: A parental visit, eh? It’s been a while since that happened.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I have to look at his data sheet first so I’ll know how to cater to him properly while we give him a tour…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: *yawn*
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm… let’s see… Who was that scout again…?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Ah, Felix Clermont…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Clermont…?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: WHAT?!!!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Thanks for coming with me, guys.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: No problem, Felix!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I’m not used to talking up front to people like that. My dad can be just as intimidating as Sir Goro.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Older people are always so serious and busy…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmm.. that makes me wonder. What does your dad do, Felix?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my dad is an author with his own publishing company.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s awesome! I've always admired people who could write!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, so I’m guessing your dad loves literature quite a lot, huh?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I guess you could say that… He has sold over a million books worldwide and sponsored a lot of other independent authors as well.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, so that explains why you’re so… ummm… affluent, Felix!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But now I’m curious… Out of all the places you could go to, why did you choose an adventure-themed program like Camp Buddy?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… I was always bullied at school for getting special treatment from the teachers, even though I went to an exclusive private school…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: My dad thought it was best to have private tutors come over, so I’ve been taught at home for a really long time.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I got so used to staying at home that I didn’t even go outside anymore… It made my dad worry so much that he thought he might have been depriving me of any fun.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: That’s when he came across an online article about this place and asked me if I wanted to spend my summer vacation here.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I thought trying something new like this may not be so bad, so I agreed to do it.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: However, I tried to keep my family profile a secret since I didn’t want the same thing that happened to me at school to happen here…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… Are you sure it’s alright for you to tell us all of this, Felix?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: It’s okay. You guys are my friends. Even if you did know, I don’t think it would have changed the way you see me.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I’m just happy to get the same treatment as everyone else and finally feel like a normal person.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, of course not, Felix. But I’ll admit, I always thought you lived a life where you got to have whatever you wanted whenever you wanted it.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: That may be true, Natsumi… But there are a lot of things I missed out too… I never had real friends until I met all of you guys…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I know I’m not good at socializing… And on top of that I know I was obnoxious at first, complaining about almost everything…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: If it were any other people, they would’ve left me right away. In fact, the people who stuck around me back then were only after my money…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my father’s money…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: But like I said..! Everything is different here! I couldn’t really ask for more.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so glad that you think that way, Felix! All of us learned a lot from each other here!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: You’re right. That’s why I thought my dad should really see this place for himself!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: He needs to see just how good of an investment Camp Buddy can be!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ehh…? What do you mean, Felix?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… When everyone was busy with the fundraising and advertisement campaign, I wanted to help out in any way I could too…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I know the campaign was successful, but I still didn’t want to leave the camp without helping…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I explained the situation to my dad and asked him if he could help out the camp financially…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-Wait… You did what?!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s unbelievable, Felix..! Did you tell the scoutmasters about this yet?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I haven’t yet… I didn’t have enough time to explain it fully to Sir Goro before.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: That’s why I’m really worried about my dad’s visit. I wanted to impress him enough to persuade him to sponsor the camp.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh wow, Felix, that’s great news! I’m sure the scoutmasters will impress him!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Let’s just hope we don’t run into any trouble…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: A-Anyway! I’m sorry for taking up so much of your time, you guys! Please go and have your meal!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Thank you so much for helping me, Natsumi and Keitaro! You guys are the best!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I need to prepare for my dad’s arrival! See you guys later!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I guess we should go catch up to our friends. They must be waiting for us already.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, right! Hiro and Yoichi might scold us again, haha!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I-I… I can’t believe this! I can’t believe HE is actually going to visit our camp!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: D-Dad! Calm down! Tell us what’s going on first!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yeah, sir. I haven’t seen you this excited in a long time.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Sheesh, Gramps! Is that guy like a supermodel or something?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Weren’t you three listening? Mr. William Clermont will be visiting the camp!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: W-What?! The ‘Sir William Clermont’?!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m sorry, but I’m not following. Who is this William Clermont?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: He’s an award-winning novel author and publisher! And if I’m not mistaken, he’s also one of the top ten wealthiest personalities in the world!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: My dad is an absolute, die-hard fan of Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Actually, I have to say, his works are really top-notch! I’ve read most of them from Dad’s collection!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Are you sure this is the same person, sir?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m definitely sure! I pulled up our records and it seems that Mr. Clermont’s only son is enrolled in this batch!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! You mean Felix?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: That’s right!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Hmm… That explains why Felix seems to be new to everything that’s going on around here…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: I wonder why someone so wealthy would send their only son to such a run-down camp like this, though?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To be fair, the camp had a great reputation up until last year! We’ve been an outstanding, model summer camp for the last two decades!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can understand Mr. Clermont entrusting his son to us! But what I’m not sure of is why he would want to visit us.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m not sure either, but it doesn’t matter! I get to finally meet Mr. Clermont in person!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Don’t get your hopes up too much, Dad. He’s probably here to visit his son, not the camp.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I might actually get him to sign my collection of his books while he’s here!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve actually just bought and finished his newest work!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Relax, Gramps!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Now we know where Yuri's obsession over things came from…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess you could say that, Aiden.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Anyway! Let’s make sure the entire camp is spotless and everything is in order before he arrives!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: We have to make sure and impress him!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: *sigh* You guys came in late again… Your food’s already cold.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Sheesh! Having quickies again at the weirdest times?!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, we actually got caught up helping Felix on our way here.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, did he run into trouble?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, nothing like that, Hunter. He was just waiting for his dad to show up.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh? His dad is coming here?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah. We actually visited the scoutmasters with him to let them know about the visit.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why? Is Snowball going home early or something?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s what we thought too, but he told us his dad just wanted to check out our camp before this term ended!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Felix told us there was a chance his dad could sponsor Camp Buddy. Who knows? Maybe he could really help!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Whoa! Really?! Just who is Felix’s dad anyways?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, Mr. Clermont is one of the best-selling authors around the world. He’s a billionaire.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-How could you say that with a straight face?!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: W-What? Really?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: How did you know about that, Hunter? Did Felix tell you before?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: No. I’ve known about it since I heard Felix’s last name. I’ve read some of his father’s books.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh. Well, I guess now we know why Felix acts that way.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: We all knew he was rich. But not this rich!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s great news that his father is a potential investor, though. If he offers a sponsorship, that would probably help liquidate all the camp’s financial liabilities.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: There we go again. Spouting business words that only you guys can understand.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Heh~ I know, right Wolfboy? Let’s just pretend we understand! Haha!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hahaha! All Hunter is saying is that we could really use the help Felix’s dad can give if he sees Camp Buddy as a worthwhile investment.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m not sure why Mr. Clermont would think otherwise! Camp Buddy is a great place after all!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Do the scoutmasters know about this already?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think so, but it shouldn’t matter! They treat all visitors with the same amount of respect, no matter who they are!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s right! Mr. Clermont can also see for himself just how friendly and well mannered the campers are!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Hey, guys! Having lunch too, I see~
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, hi there, Naoto! Why don’t you join us?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Sure thing! I was just looking for a table too, haha!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: What’d you get for lunch, bro?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Hmm… Some rice, fish and vegetables!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Whoa! You guys’ plates look exactly the same!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Haha! I guess we really are brothers~
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh… It’s so corny hearing that now.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Well… you should get used to it, Yoichi. Naoto’s our scoutmaster now after all!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I was kinda thinking too… maybe we could do some chores together, little bro! You know, just like the good ol’ days~!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Of course, I don’t mind!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I guess things really are back to normal now. I’m glad everything turned out this way in the end!){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Once we were done eating, it was just another day in camp for us, having fun without anything to worry about at all…{/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I knew this was all something I was definitely going to miss once the summer is over…{/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Oh, and speaking of good times… I should really update my journal! I don’t think I’ll have any other day to write an entry! {/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! I’ve finished updating my journal!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe that this new journal is almost full as well.){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(When I first came to Camp Buddy, the only thing on my mind was to make as many great memories as possible.){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I wanted to keep those memories forever with the pictures I took and everything I wrote in my journal.){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But when my first journal was ruined, I thought the memories I tried to preserve were gone as well.){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I was wrong.){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Everyone put their heart into making this new journal. It’s proof that all the times we spent together were remembered and always will be.){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that all of this happened in just the one month I’ve been staying here.){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And now that there’s just a day left before the camp ends…){/i}
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Phew…! I guess I’m thinking about this a lot more than I should.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Looks like Natsumi isn’t back from his chores with Naoto. Maybe I should go and help them out—
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: And here’s one of the lodging cabins for our campers!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Complete with all basic facilities every camper needs and always well maintained!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Interesting. It seems like everything is in good shape around here.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, indeed! Ahaha…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Oh, Keitaro! You’re here!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! I’d like you to meet Keitaro! He’s one of my friends that I told you about!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Ah, Keitaro! I’ve heard a lot of stories about you.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Keitaro here is like a leader among us! I can safely say that, if it weren’t for him, I wouldn’t be so close with everyone else!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Felix. It’s not like that, really...
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I really want to be like Keitaro, Dad! He listens to everyone’s opinions and always tries to understand his fellow campers!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I can’t help but agree with you, Felix. Keitaro here is a shining example of the spirit of this camp.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: I can see that. I’ve never seen my son introduce someone with such confidence.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, please accept my personal gratitude for being a true friend to my son.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Aah… You’re welcome, sir. But really, I can’t take all the credit.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Here at Camp Buddy, we all work together, scoutmasters and scouts alike.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! I admire your humility!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: But if you’d pardon the shift in topic, I can’t help but notice that book you’re carrying, Keitaro.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s my journal, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: A journal, you say? I see we may have an aspiring writer here then.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s nowhere near as good as your professional works, Mr. Clermont! I usually just write about all the memories I’ve shared with everyone here in Camp Buddy!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I get a little help from all my friends too whenever I update my journal! So it’s really a team effort!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! Keitaro here is quite the photographer as well!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Oh really? That explains that camera then.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir! It’s a little hobby of mine, and I use some of the pictures I take to decorate my journal like a scrapbook!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: This journal was actually a welcoming gift from the scoutmasters too!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Impressive. I didn’t know how nurturing you were of your scouts’ creativity here, Mr. Nomoru!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: It’s not just creativity, Mr. Clermont! We let our campers engage in activities that fit all their interests in order for them to excel at what they are most passionate about!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: I see!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: I know it’s your personal article, Keitaro. But may I take a peek?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure thing, Mr. Clermont! You’re just in time, since I finished updating it before you guys entered!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *hands over the journal*
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Mmmhhhmm…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Very interesting.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: U-Umm… Mr. Clermont…? We can continue the tour now…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Hold on.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Hahaha…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Hey… Mr. Clermont seems to be enjoying your journal… Just what did you write in there…?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: U-Umm… Well—
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Haha! You’re quite a passionate writer, Keitaro!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: I enjoyed the stories you put in your journal! They give off that innocent, boyhood expression that I feel is lacking in my own books.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! It’s an honor to hear that from you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: You and your friends have done well!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Ah, I really wish that I could just sit back and read what you’ve cooked up in this little book of yours!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh I don’t really mind, Mr. Clermont! You can borrow it if you like!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I won’t be adding any entries for the rest of the day, anyway!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Oh, splendid! You truly are one interesting boy!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Mr. Nomoru, is it possible that you escort me to a quarter where I can just enjoy this book with a nice cup of tea by my side?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: But Mr. Clermont, the tour isn’t finished yet…!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! It’s quite alright. I’ve seen enough!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, I will return your journal as soon as I finish reading it! Thank you very much again for lending it to me!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re welcome, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: William
text: Now, if you’ll excuse us.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: This way, please.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Whew… I wasn’t expecting that…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh well. I guess I’ll go help Natsumi out now!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: What happened, Dad? Why do you look so down?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* I’m just thinking about my tour with Mr. Clermont.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, how did it go?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I-It went alright… He just stopped halfway through the tour.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Huh…? What happened?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Well… I was just showing him around the camp the whole day. It was uneventful until we arrived at Cabin One.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: We met Keitaro inside, and he was holding his journal. Mr. Clermont was intrigued and asked Keitaro if he could borrow it for a while.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: He then halted the tour just to rest and read Keitaro’s journal with some tea.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: What’s wrong with that, sir? It sounds like it went well to me.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m just afraid that I might have overworked him or something…
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Dad, I think you’re being too paranoid about it! I’m sure he just really enjoyed Keitaro’s journal!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Or maybe he read something inappropriate! Like the time where Taiga snapped a photo of your butt!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aiden! You’re not helping!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Let’s not worry about it too much, sir. Maybe he’s tired, just like you said. He’s a pretty busy man after all.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Yoshi’s right! And you’ve had a long day too!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: So, why don’t you go and get some sleep, Dad? We still have huge plans for the campers tomorrow after all!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Maybe I should send him an email apologizing at lea-
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Sleeeeeeeep.
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Hehe~ Your dad is a total fanboy of this Clermont guy, eh?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: I guess it runs in the blood!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: You’re making it sound like it’s a bad thing, Aiden! Hmph!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, let’s all get some rest as well. We have to be ready tomorrow for our final activity with the scouts!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah, you’re right! I’m already beat from cleaning the entire place for that Clermont guy!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Well, I should close up this place before I head out—
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, who could that be…?
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: E-Eh?! Mr. Clermont?!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Y-Yes! I’ll go get my dad right away!
label: day33_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: O-Oh… Keitaro.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Taiga…? Are you feeling any better…?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: A little bit, yeah…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: I guess I overreacted to you yesterday…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry if I said anything rash…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I understand, Taiga… I’ve broken your trust, after all…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: So, I’m sorry too…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: I think it’s best we just forget about it and act like it never happened.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Are you sure about that, Taiga…?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah… I think that would be best for both of us.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-If that would make you feel better… I’ll do it.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Thanks, Keitaro…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Today is our last day here at camp after all… I don’t want our summer to end on a bad note…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re right…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: Hey, guys…!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh, hey there, Eduard.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: Scoutmaster Yoshinori has requested that everyone assemble in the mess hall – he has a special announcement for us, apparently!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright, we’ll get ready and go…!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: Okay! We’ll go let Seto and Felix know too! See you guys at the mess hall!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Well… I guess that’s our cue.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Looks like the scoutmasters have something planned out for us.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: I guess… that’s at least something to look forward to today.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Come on, let’s get dressed up.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Okay...!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Even though Taiga said he was okay… everything feels… a little sad…{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Maybe it’s because Taiga never really said that he forgives me… {/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}And… it’s too bad he’s trying to forget about everything again…{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I guess… this is the best I could ask for with Taiga… I should be happy that he’s doing what he can to be alright… {/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, everyone!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp! That also means that we don't really know if we'll see each other again next year.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir, if you will?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: Right! Ehem…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: So as a means of showing our gratitude, we’ve prepared a final activity for all of you!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, dear?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, yes! Scouts, I’m pleased to announce we will be having a little farewell party! Just like the one we had to welcome you all here!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Aiden
text: The food has already been prepared, and we made sure to include all your favorite meals for you to enjoy on this last day!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yuri
text: We hope that this little event will mean as much to everyone as it means to us, your scoutmasters!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It's unfortunate to know we'll all be parting ways tomorrow with no guarantee that we'll see each other again...
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But what truly matters most is that we create the greatest memories we can possibly make here and now!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So, campers! Please enjoy your final day here at Camp Buddy!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Seto
text: Haha! Pretty cool they prepared something like this for us on our last day, huh?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: I was hoping they had something fancier for us, though~ Like a stage play! That would be soooooo lovely~
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: I prefer engaging in something more educational like a science fair or a research symposium!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Felix
text: Ah… It sure is nice to be gathered like this with everyone.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh*
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: What's with the sigh, Natsumi?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah… I was just thinking… I’m really going to miss all of this.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t believe this is the last time we’re all going out together.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: To be honest, this has been the only camp term that I didn’t want to end.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, I have to admit, it’ll be way more boring without you guys around.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, that reminds me. What are you guys going to do after the camp?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll probably fly back to my country with my parents and continue my studies.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Will you be able to come back next year, though?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: I hope I can. It will depend on if my parents are going to work here again next summer or not.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m really going to miss all the fun I had here at Camp Buddy. It’s pretty quiet back at home, and I don’t really have friends there.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: So, I’ll do everything I can to convince them to let me come back.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: How about you, Natsumi?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’ll probably just go back to my studies like usual.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Unlike Hunter, I live pretty close to this area so I can always pass by Camp Buddy whenever I’m heading to school.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, good for you, Natsumi!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’ll definitely miss all of you though… I’ve never gotten close to anyone like this before.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I won't be lonely since my big brother will be there to hang out with me.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: At least I’ll have him while you guys aren’t around.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: How about you, Yoichi?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, I’ll be stuck here by myself without all of you guys around. I don’t have anywhere else to go, after all.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not that it’s a bad thing. I get to have free food here.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Plus, Sheriff Brokeback could always use some help with all the stuff for next year's batch.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: What?! You mean you live here at Camp Buddy?! How come you never told us that?!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Now you know. It’s no big deal.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: How about you, Keitaro?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Nothing special – I’ll just be going back to school too!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I guess most of us are just gonna do the same thing.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Same with me! I’ll be back at school, but I’ll probably swing by and hang out with Keitaro some, since he lives pretty close by!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, that’s cool! You guys should invite us to come over too when you hang out!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: If that’s the case, I should try to convince my parents to stay here longer so I can join you guys.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: I bet it would be fun to spend time together outside of camp too!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: What about you, Eduard and Lee?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: If you’re going to ask me personally, I wanna pursue my dream and try to join a modeling agency~!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: I wanna be proud of who I am and I don’t care what anybody else thinks!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: Soooo…. Yeahhh… Wish me luck~
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: As for me, I noticed that I’ve been focusing on my mental strength the past few years.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: I realized that my physical well-being is just as important! So I’m planning to get myself into shape!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: I’ll definitely try to build my body to be big and strong just like Taiga!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: With my genius prowess, I’m sure I’ll be able to create a fitness program that fits my capacity!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s really interesting, you guys! I hope it all goes well!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: Thanks~
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: B-By the way, I know this is a bit off topic, but all this talk about after-camp plans made me wonder...
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: What happened to Kieran?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh yeah... He just kinda left without saying goodbye, didn't he? Did something happen?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, well, he just figured since the fundraiser was over, his volunteering time was up.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah, but he could have at least said goodbye! Leaving like that is too sudden!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Psh, yeah. Just look what it did to Dynamite over there. He looks like he’s gonna shit his pants!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, now, you two, leave Taiga alone. I'm sure Kieran had a good reason to leave so quickly.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yeah...! Really, don't worry about it, guys... Kieran was only here to help us with the fundraiser after all!
label: day33_taigabe

text: Welp, good enough for me. That's enough time wasted talking, so let's get partying!

text: Too late!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Gah!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: Hehe, those two really couldn’t sit still for long.

text: Yeah, but who’s even surprised at this point?

text: Some games did sound fun though! Do you guys want to go and try a board game?

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m not really good at games, but sure I’ll try…!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Felix
text: I-If that’s the case, I’ll tag along too…!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Alright, let’s go!

text: Well, that whole group thing didn’t last long.

text: Indeed, but I suppose everyone desires to make the most of their last hours.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: Perhaps we should engage in activities as well? What do you say, Taiga?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: …You guys go ahead. I’m gonna get a little fresh air.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: *sigh* Looks like he’s still upset from yesterday, huh?

text: That is most unfortunate… I truly wished to engage in cheerful camaraderie with Taiga on this last day.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: Yeah, but like, what can you do? I know we won’t be able to help him this time…

speaker: Lee
text: True. If even Keitaro could not assist him, then only Taiga himself can fix this…

speaker: Eduard
text: Want to come get some food with us, Keitaro? You don’t have to be miserable too.

speaker: Keitaro
text: N-No thanks, guys… You can get some! I’ll just stay here for a while.

speaker: Lee
text: Alright. We will be nearby if you change your mind.

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thanks, guys…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* Are things really going to end between us like this, Taiga?

speaker: Keitaro
text: No, I can’t let that happen...!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Things might not have turned out like I hoped, but maybe we can still part ways on good terms...!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh, Keitaro...! Why did you follow me?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m fine out here…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I just wanted to talk with you one last time, at least before the term ends…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: If you’re going to apologize again, you don’t have to.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: I forgive you, Keitaro…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: But... I still need time to sort out everything…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Thinking about everything we shared here at camp, and then realizing the feelings I kept buried for so long… It’s really something I need to reflect on…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I understand Taiga, but…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t want things to end like this… I can’t leave camp knowing that I left you in this state.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: What I’m feeling now is honestly not your fault, Keitaro…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: But… you’re right.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Huh?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: It’s not fair for me to be sulking here like it’s the end of the world…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: There are plenty of good times we had with everyone here at camp, and now’s the time to celebrate that…!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m sorry again for not figuring myself out sooner…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Either way, I really had an amazing time with you this summer, Keitaro!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Taiga…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Let’s go back inside and do our best to have fun tonight!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Taiga walked with me back to the mess hall and started to enjoy the party with everyone.{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I'm glad he was able to forgive me for the mistakes I made... And him setting his thoughts aside to spend a fun night with everyone was all I could have asked for.{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Fwaah… I’m so full…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: Me too… I can’t believe we ran out of marshmallows…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! That’s because Yoichi here ate around five bags of them!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Psh! Says the guy who kept serving me and everyone food!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Isn’t this exactly like our first outdoor camping trip together?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha! Yeah, you’re right! Except this time Keitaro was taking photos like crazy!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: My camera batteries are almost empty and I have just one roll of film left from all the pictures I took tonight!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: You’re gonna need another journal for all those new pictures then, Keitaro!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! You’re right, Taiga! It was just so fun getting to hang out with you guys.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Seto
text: Hehe~ It was pretty good while it lasted, huh?
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Felix
text: I have no regrets about joining this camp.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* I can’t believe this really is our last night together at Camp Buddy…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Seto
text: I know this sounds corny, but I can say for sure this was the best summer I’ve ever had.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Felix
text: If it weren’t for this place, I wouldn’t have met all of you…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Lee
text: Precisely! I have never experienced such companionship until today!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Eduard
text: Only in here have I felt accepted for everything that I am.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Taiga
text: Even if things started out really bumpy, it all turned out better than I could ever have hoped for.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Natsumi
text: This is where I really belong… A place where everyone appreciates and cares for each other…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hunter
text: I can’t help but be grateful for all the friends I’ve made here.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoichi
text: So, this is what it feels like to have a real family…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Hiro
text: We’ve gone through so much together. And it all made us grow for the better.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Everyone…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww… Look at our boys. They’re really going to miss each other. It’s so sweet…
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yuri
text: I’m in tears over the bond that everyone has created here at the camp!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yuri
text: But let’s all remember the third buddy law!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yuri
text: A buddy always shows a bright smile on his face~
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know this night has passed by quicker than we all thought.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But we saw that all of you were making the most out of this day, talking to each other, having fun together as a big family.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can’t help but feel a little sad too, knowing that it’s not certain that all of us will meet one another in the near future.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But then, I feel happy thanks to all the time we’ve all spent together here and I’m excited for what lies ahead for each of us, and for Camp Buddy.
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So, let’s celebrate this moment with all we’ve got!
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’ve come a long way since I joined Camp Buddy…{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Remembering all of the events that happened during my stay here… it all feels just like yesterday.{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Making new friends… Going out on adventures… Doing exciting camp activities… Celebrating and partying like a big family…{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s amazing what can happen in such a short period of time.{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I used to feel afraid when I think that I might forget all of these things in the future…{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But this place has made me realize that what’s truly important is to enjoy the moment to the fullest with the people around me.{/i}
label: day33_taigabe

speaker: Keitaro

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph.

speaker: William

speaker: William
text: What industrious, gifted, and helpful scouts you are!

text: I’m glad to see that this camp allows its scouts to explore their own talents and specialties!

text: Your compliments and kindness are greatly appreciated, Mr. Clermont.

speaker: William

label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: We’ll be on our way!

speaker: Natsumi
text: Of course! It was nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont.

speaker: Hiro
text: See you later, Felix’s dad!

speaker: Hunter

text: What, you know that old geezer?

text: Ow!!!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Anyway, I hope he enjoys the tour…

text: Hehe, since Keitaro’s the one giving it, I’m sure it’ll be fine.

text: Oh..!

text: Good morning, sir! I didn’t realize we were having a guest today…!

text: Oh, not at all! Anyone is welcome to visit Camp Buddy and have a look around!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Though I wish I could’ve prepared a proper welcome!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: Haha, don’t worry, I’ve been well taken care of by Keitaro, Taiga, and my son here! I’ve been enjoying myself so far!

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah, thank you so much for handling it, boys!

speaker: William

label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, is there anything you’d like to know more about the camp? I’m happy to give you any information you might need!

text: In fact, there is, Mr. Nagira! May I know what kind of activity you are currently engaged in with your scouts?

text: Oh, well… since the camp term is about to end, we’re coming up with new and better activities for next year’s curriculum.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’ll admit that I’m not very up to date on what the new generation finds 'fun,' so I thought I’d get some ideas from them directly!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: That’s really ingenious and inclusive of you, Mr. Nagira!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank you! We’re in the middle of brainstorming which activities should be rendered obsolete while also proposing more modern ones!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

text: Didn’t know your dad was gonna come, Felix. It’s awesome to finally see him.

speaker: Felix

speaker: Felix
text: I was actually gonna ask for your help too, Seto… but you seemed busy a while ago.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Seto
text: Yeah, I really wanted Scoutmaster Yoshi to add some techie activities for next year, since this place is so behind.

speaker: Seto
text: I know this place is a summer camp, but they can’t seriously expect to avoid using stuff like phones and the internet forever.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

text: Are these your friends too, Felix?
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Felix
text: A-Ah, yes, Dad! Seto is my closest friend here at camp!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: Oh!! I’ve heard so many wonderful things about you, Seto!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: Felix here couldn’t stop talking about you every time we chatted on the phone.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: You’re a really fine lad, and thank you for taking exceptional care of my son!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Seto
text: A-Ah, yeah… No prob…
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Felix
text: Eduard and Lee here are also my friends! I just recently started hanging out with them!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: I am truly relieved that Felix has made so many friends here at camp!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: I have been nothing but impressed by everything that was shown to me.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: If you’d like, Mr. Clermont, I can finish the tour with you and introduce you to the camp president!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: No need! I wouldn’t want to interrupt your current activities.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: I have also seen everything that I needed, so I think it would be best to be on my way as well.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah, of course! We were glad to have you here!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, Taiga, thank you very much for the lovely tour. You two have been very hospitable and honest about everything in the camp.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re welcome, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: William

label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Felix
text: S-Sure, Dad…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Felix
text: See you later, guys!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, Mr. Clermont was a very nice man, and it seems like he really enjoyed his tour here.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank you both for showing him around! I’m so glad I can count on you two.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

text: No problem, Scoutmaster Yoshi!

speaker: Taiga
text: Didn’t think it’d go that well, to be honest.
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hahaha! You two make the perfect team!
label: day33_taigaaftersxge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And I have to mention… I’m really glad you’ve settled whatever differences you had…

text: Hey! We wanna know what happened too! Spill the tea!

speaker: Lee
text: My curiosity has peaked as well. Please impart to us how the events have turned around for the better between you two!

text: Wait, what’s going on?

speaker: Taiga
text: Mind your own business, you dweebs!

speaker: Taiga
text: Whatever!!

speaker: Keitaro

text: That’s a relief…

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, speaking of leaving!

text: It’s almost the end of the camp term, Keitaro. Aren’t you gonna come back to our cabin now?

text: I was positive that Keitaro would take the first opportunity to leave our cabin, yet he has stayed with us the entire term.

text: I hope you guys won’t be shocked with what I’m about to say… but…

text: Taiga and I… are dating now.

text: Oh, alright. That’s nice.

text: *continues eating*

text: Argh! Fuck…!!!

text: Y-You don’t want to know, Natsumi…

text: Pfft, even right now I can smell that stuff from-

speaker: Taiga
text: ARGH! SHUT UP, ALL OF YOU!

text: Hngh… This is so embarrassing…

text: Haha, I guess we don’t have a choice… I mean… we don’t have anything to do today anyway…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: *sigh* I’m not really good at stuff like this…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I-I’m sure it’ll be fine… We just have to stay calm and relax…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: The way you’re stuttering isn’t making things any better, Keitaro…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: W-Well, here we are, Dad! Camp Buddy! W-Welcome!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Uh-huh… It’s a little quiet in here… I expected summer camps to be livelier.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: F-Fun?! Of course! It's fun! What are you talking about!? It’s totally fun here! H-Hahaha…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: *sigh*
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! I’d like you to meet Keitaro and Taiga! They’re some of my friends that I told you about!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: H-Hey there…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont! Welcome to Camp Buddy!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Ah, you must be Keitaro! I’ve heard some stories about you.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: And Taiga? It’s nice to meet you as well!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: D-Dad, is it okay if I let my friends come with us on the tour?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Of course! Any friends of my son are always welcome!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: T-They know their way around here, s-so they’ll be better tour guides than me for sure…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Huh… I’ve never seen my son introduce people with such confidence.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Both of you, please accept my personal gratitude for being friends with him.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, it’s our pleasure, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Shall we start then?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: Of course!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}We began giving Felix’s dad a tour around the campgrounds… He was pretty quiet most of the time, almost as if he was rating the camp…{/i}
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: …And here’s the mess hall! This is where we have our meals…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Hehe, did you think he couldn’t figure that out himself?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Sshh, Taiga…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: It seems we’ve arrived at the perfect time. Looks like everyone is having their lunch.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: O-Our chef here actually serves the same, if not better, quality of food than any of the restaurants we’ve been to, Dad…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh yeah, ask anyone here and they’d agree with that.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: If Felix says so, that’s actually very impressive. My son here has a palate for fine dining after all!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Aiden
text: Oh hey! I didn’t know we had a visito-
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Gah! Not now, Aiden!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Aiden
text: E-Eh? What’s going on?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: That guy’s a potential investor, if he sees your butt, it’s over!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Aiden
text: Whoa! How did you guys hook one into coming here?!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: W-We’ll explain later! Just go away before he thinks you’re a streaker!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Aiden
text: Hehe, who knows, if he sees my junk, maybe he’ll toss more money our way~
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: J-Just get out of here!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Aiden
text: Fine, fine…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: What was that?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: N-Nothing…! I was just checking the lunch counter to see if the sausages and eggs are still warm!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: G-Gotta make sure everything’s at its top game around here…! H-Hahaha…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Ah, of course!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Phew…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Anyway, I expected that it’d be more crowded here during these hours.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Umm… There’s actually not many campers this year… B-But a lot have already applied for the next term!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Oh? How so?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: I-It’s like I told you, Dad. We just had a fundraising activity where all the campers and scoutmasters worked together to help raise funds and advertise the camp.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: How did it go then?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It actually went really well…! We baked some cookies for sale, went door-to-door and posted ads around town!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: …We even made a small video commercial and posted it online!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: That’s interesting. Who was responsible for organizing this event?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well… the scoutmasters thought it would be both a fun and productive activity. We were welcome to help in any way we could.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Everyone, including Taiga and I, was really busy!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I see. What kind of activity did you two participate in?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, since the advertising team was successful in getting the word out, we actually had a lot of pre-registration mail.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Since we were expecting more campers, we thought it would be nice to expand the lodgings.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: We decided to help repair some old run-down cabins. And we managed to restore three of them!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Really? You two successfully rebuilt three entire cabins?!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Well… we weren’t alone, there were three of us, and a scoutmaster to supervise.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: And all of this without any budget?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: We pretty much improvised. Our scoutmaster bought some lumber, but other than that, we cut and worked everything ourselves.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: We had tools, adhesives and paints already in stock, so we ended up using those too.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Incredible…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I cannot fathom how four people could successfully renovate three buildings with no professional help.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Well, our scoutmasters are all pretty good carpenters. They even had blueprints made to make the work easier.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: That’s very interesting! Would you mind giving me a tour of one of these cabins?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, of course! Just follow us, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Here it is, Mr. Clermont! If you wanna see what it looked like before, I actually took a picture!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I couldn’t believe it at first, but seeing it now is truly impressive! You really outdid yourselves with this!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: And judging from this picture you showed me, Keitaro, it must’ve taken at least two weeks to finish just one cabin…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Actually, it just took us eight days to finish all three…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: You two just keep on impressing me, huh?!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: O-Oh, a visitor!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I told you I picked up a new scent!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Guess Wolfboy’s nose is always on point.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: We’re sorry, a-are we interrupting something?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: And who are these fine lads?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: O-Oh, they’re my friends too, Dad! This is Natsumi, Hunter, Hiro and Yoichi!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I’m surprised to see you’ve made a lot of acquaintances here, Felix!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: I’m sorry guys, this is my dad! We’re showing him around camp…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, I see! I wasn’t aware that we would be having guests… Please excuse us—
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: No, no! Please stay. Don’t let my presence bother you.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Why are you all here anyway?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well… Since the scoutmasters are busy planning for next year, we decided to be productive and furnish the new cabins more!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I brought some extra sheets, pillows, and towels so that the cabins you guys fixed will be ready for new campers.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: I also brought some posters and picture frames to hang as decorations.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Those are lovely paintings, lad!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: They’re actually original works of his, sir!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: N-Natsumi! That’s embarrassing…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: No need to be shy. These artworks are beautiful, you should be proud of them!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: T-Thank you...
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: It looks like there’s quite a lot of stuff you boys have brought in here too.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: These dorks can’t hold shit with their noodle arms. Good thing I’m here to carry stuff around.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yoichi! Language! We have a guest here!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Haha, It’s quite alright.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: It looks like your scoutmasters have made sure that everyone is productive at all times.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Normally, yes! But today’s actually a free day, and we just volunteered!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not me. I just got dragged here.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Ugh… Don’t listen to him, mister. He’s just cranky when it comes to chores.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey! You’re just as lazy too! Go back to the kitchen and make me that sandwich!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Stop it, you two!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: And Yoichi, you should be grateful that Hiro’s still here helping even after working in the kitchen all morning.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Bleeeeh~
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: W-Wait… So you’re the one who cooks the meals that my son was praising so highly!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: O-Oh, kinda…! I just help out – Bro-Aiden’s the real chef!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I'm assuming you volunteer to work there too?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yup! Cooking is one of my passions, so I’m really glad they let me help around here~
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! That is very impressive!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: This is a huge compliment, Hiro…! M-My dad's tried plenty of upscale restaurants!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh wow… I’m honored! I hope you get to try my cooking for yourself!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I definitely am looking forward to that!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: What industrious, gifted, and helpful scouts you are!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I’m glad to see that this camp allows its scouts to explore their own talents and specialties!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Your compliments and kindness are greatly appreciated, Mr. Clermont.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: It’s my pleasure. Although I have bothered you lads enough and it looks like you have a lot to finish around here!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: We’ll be on our way!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Of course! It was nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: See you later, Felix’s dad!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: We’ll keep showing him around, so we’ll see you guys later too!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Sure thing, Keitaro!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s so cool that Mr. Clermont is visiting the camp… I’ve always wanted to meet him.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What, you know that old geezer?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah, it’s Mr. William Clermont. He’s one of the best-selling authors around the world. He’s a billionaire.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-How could you say that with a straight face?!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-What? I never knew…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: How did you know about that, Hunter? Did Felix tell you before?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: No. I’ve known about it since I heard Felix’s last name. I’ve read some of his father’s books.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, Felix’s attitude all makes sense….
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Maybe we can score some dough if we hold Snowball for ransom!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: *bonks Yoichi’s head*
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ow!!!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hehehe… Serves you right, Wolfboy.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Anyway, I hope he enjoys the tour…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hehe, since Keitaro’s the one giving it, I’m sure it’ll be fine.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Exactly! Now come on, we need to get started working!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoichi
text: If you need me, I’ll be sleeping in one of the beds.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Hiro
text: Ugh…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I think this is the last place you haven’t seen, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Ah, so this is where the sportsfest that Felix was talking about was held?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, we also have most of our physical activities here too!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: No wonder all of you look so healthy and fit!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So, do you really think it would be a good idea if we put more streamers here, Eduard?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Eduard
text: Duh! This place is where physical stuff happens! Colorfulness gives more energy, you know! Plus, streamers make people pumped up~!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess that makes sense…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Lee
text: Perhaps now we can consider my suggestion about including more educational and brain-centric activities?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As long as it’s enjoyable for everyone, then we’ll definitely consider it!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Seto
text: Umm… Guys? I think someone’s over there…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh..!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, sir! I didn’t realize we were having a guest today…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Oh, I apologize for showing up without proper notice. I am Mr. William Clermont, Felix’s father.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s a pleasure to meet you, Mr. Clermont. I am one of the head scoutmasters, Yoshinori Nagira.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: The pleasure is mine! My son invited me to tour around your campgrounds. I hope we didn’t cause any trouble.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, not at all! Anyone is welcome to visit Camp Buddy and have a look around!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Though I wish I could’ve prepared a proper welcome!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Haha, don’t worry, I’ve been well taken care of by Keitaro, Taiga, and my son here! I’ve been enjoying myself so far!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah, thank you so much for handling it, boys!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: You have guided and trained them very well! Your leadership truly shows in their discipline!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank you for the compliments, sir! But I can’t take all the credit – these boys have worked hard to be excellent scouts on their own!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, is there anything you’d like to know more about the camp? I’m happy to give you any information you might need!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: In fact, there is, Mr. Nagira! May I know what kind of activity you are currently engaged in with your scouts?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, well… since the camp term is about to end, we’re coming up with new and better activities for next year’s curriculum.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’ll admit that I’m not very up to date on what the new generation finds 'fun,' so I thought I’d get some ideas from them directly!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: That’s really ingenious and inclusive of you, Mr. Nagira!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank you! We’re in the middle of brainstorming which activities should be rendered obsolete while also proposing more modern ones!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Seto
text: Didn’t know your dad was gonna come, Felix. It’s awesome to finally see him.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: I've been telling you that he might come soon… But you were too busy playing your game to listen, as usual.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Eduard
text: I guess bougie-ness runs in the family… I can’t believe he’s wearing a limited-edition Kucci designer suit!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Lee
text: On top of that, the way he articulates himself makes him appear as a seasoned intellectual…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: I was actually gonna ask for your help too, Seto… but you seemed busy a while ago.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Seto
text: Yeah, I really wanted Scoutmaster Yoshi to add some techie activities for next year, since this place is so behind.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Seto
text: I know this place is a summer camp, but they can’t seriously expect to avoid using stuff like phones and the internet forever.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Are these your friends too, Felix?
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: A-Ah, yes, Dad! Seto is my closest friend here at camp!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Oh!! I’ve heard so many wonderful things about you, Seto!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Felix here couldn’t stop talking about you every time we chatted on the phone.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: You’re a really fine lad, and thank you for taking exceptional care of my son!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Seto
text: A-Ah, yeah… No prob…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: Eduard and Lee here are also my friends! I just recently started hanging out with them!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I am truly relieved that Felix has made so many friends here at camp!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I have been nothing but impressed by everything that was shown to me.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: If you’d like, Mr. Clermont, I can finish the tour with you and introduce you to the camp president!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: No need! I wouldn’t want to interrupt your current activities.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: I have also seen everything that I needed, so I think it would be best to be on my way as well.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah, of course! We were glad to have you here!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, Taiga, thank you very much for the lovely tour. You two have been very hospitable and honest about everything in the camp.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re welcome, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: William
text: Felix, would you mind sending me off? I would like to have a father-son talk with you as well!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: S-Sure, Dad…!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Felix
text: See you later, guys!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, Mr. Clermont was a very nice man, and it seems like he really enjoyed his tour here.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Thank you both for showing him around! I’m so glad I can count on you two.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: No problem, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: Didn’t think it’d go that well, to be honest.
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hahaha! You two make the perfect team!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And I have to mention… I’m really glad you’ve settled whatever differences you had…
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Taiga
text: G-Gah! Can we not talk about that?!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Eduard
text: Hey! We wanna know what happened too! Spill the tea!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Lee
text: My curiosity has peaked as well. Please impart to us how the events have turned around for the better between you two!
label: day33_taigaaftersxpe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, don’t worry about me, guys…! I know we can’t just force Yoichi to talk if he doesn’t want to.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Taiga
text: Hey, guys! Sorry we’re late! We just finished getting ready for today’s party.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, hello everyone! The party hasn’t started yet. You haven’t missed anything!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Felix
text: Umm… I can’t help but notice that Yoichi is gone… Where is he?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh, yeah. We heard what happened… How is he doing?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Felix
text: We’ve been really worried about him too… His dog meant the world to him, after all…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: W-Well, guys… Yoichi is still pretty upset right now… He doesn’t want to talk to anyone about it either…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Eduard
text: Even Keitaro…?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Lee
text: I do not think there is much we can do. I’m certain that he asked to be left alone for a valid reason.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s right. Let’s leave him be for now. I’m sure Yoichi will get back to his old self if we just give him some time and space.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Seto
text: Well, we don’t have that much time either. It is our last day here at camp.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Seto
text: As much as I don’t wanna be that guy, we have to try and enjoy this last day together. We have no choice but to trust Yoichi to deal with this alone if that’s what he wants.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, this is like, totally depressing. Aren’t you guys normally all sunshine and rainbows?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hunter
text: Seto and Eduard have a point, guys. We’re not going to be happy if we just sit around quietly all day.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I guess that is the only thing we can do for now…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah! Let’s celebrate together! I wanna end the term having fun with all my new friends!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah! Come on. I’m sure Bro-Aiden’s cooked up something good!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I know everyone was trying to be positive, but I just couldn’t help but worry about Yoichi… {/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I guess they were looking at what really matters the most… We all hung out with each other… and we all tried to smile even when times were tough…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}If only I could have made Yoichi feel like he was a part of this warm family…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m really sorry, Yoichi…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: Greetings, scouts!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: It’s a pleasure to see you all gathered here like this… I know we don’t usually throw parties, but this term was truly exceptional!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: I know that today passed by quicker than we all thought, but we should be grateful for all the time we did get to spend together.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: I have to thank everyone here for helping to get Camp Buddy back on its feet!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: I am saddened to know that I may not see all of you again next year, but I’m so glad to have met and learned from each and every one of you!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: Now please, help yourselves to this delicious feast Scoutmaster Aiden has prepared for you!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah, grab however much you want, everyone! I’ve made plenty just for today!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: Now, let me have a taste of your cooking too.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Oho~ Right this way, sir!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yuri
text: Yoshi…? You alright…? I was expecting you to say something in front of the campers.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah… I-It’s nothing…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yuri
text: You’re worried about Yoichi, aren’t you…?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yuri
text: Your face says it all.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoshinori
