text: W-Well... It just feels wrong to be celebrating like this, after what happened yesterday…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I mean, look at this place… Yoichi isn’t even here…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yuri
text: W-Well… I know it’s sad… but… we’re doing this for the other campers. Let’s just let it go for now… For the sake of the rest of Camp Buddy…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yuri
text: We can talk to Yoichi later when the party is over, alright…?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *sigh* Alright, Yuri…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Seto
text: We seriously can’t just stand here, staring blankly at the party on our last day.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Seto
text: Come on, Felix! I think some of the campers are playing games over there. Let’s join them!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Felix
text: O-Okay…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Eduard
text: Oh~ I think I want to try that fabulously fruity-looking tart! Want to come with me, Lee?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Lee
text: I do not mind! I’m getting pretty hungry, anyway. How about you, Taiga?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Taiga
text: You guys go ahead, I’ll catch up!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Eduard
text: Bye-eee~
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Taiga
text: I know you guys are still worried about Yoichi… But we have to do our best and try to have fun today…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Taiga
text: I really hope you guys can enjoy your last day here with us, even with everything that’s going on…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Come on, guys!!! We can’t stay like this forever! Are we really gonna let the camp term end like this?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-Well, it just seems like none of us can help thinking about Yoichi…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: I know what will get our minds off of it – food! Come on. We can’t let the great food Bro-Aiden made go to waste!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I guess Hiro is right. Maybe we’re just feeling hungry!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hunter
text: D-Do you want something to eat too, Keitaro? It might make you feel better…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, well…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Here, I’ll get your dinner for you, Keitaro! Just stay here and relax! What do you want?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, thanks, Hiro… I’ll just have whatever you get too…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Alright, I’ll be right back! Don’t go anywhere~
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Hiro
text: Come on, guys~ Let’s get some food!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Hey there, buddy~!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, S-Sir Aiden!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: I couldn’t help but notice you sulking over here. You okay?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… I’m sorry, Sir Aiden… I’m just really worried about Yoichi…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: To be quite honest, I am too… He hasn’t even come by to see the puppies yet, you know.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh yeah, the puppies! How are they doing, sir?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Happy and being well taken care of! No need to worry about them!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: I just hope that Yoichi will come around and see them soon too… They’re what Yuki left him, after all…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: But I just have to be patient like you! We both know that Yoichi can get through this!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: As much as I want to help him… I just don’t know how…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Have you tried talking to him, though? He seems to listen to you more than anyone else.
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’ve been trying ever since yesterday, Sir Aiden… But he just keeps pushing himself away from everyone…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: *sigh* I figured…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Well… I know he told you that he wants to be alone right now, but…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: If we leave him like he is now, he may not be able to pull himself back up, you know?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What do you mean, Sir Aiden…?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, from watching the two of you, I can tell that Yoichi sees you as someone special….
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: If you can’t slap some sense into him, then nobody can!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-So you think that I should still go after him, Sir Aiden…?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, it’s easier said than done, but I believe in you two!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: I just don’t want you two to end your summer this way, knowing that you won’t be seeing each other starting tomorrow…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: At least try to get some closure with him maybe?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Goro
text: Aiden! We seem to have run out of refreshments over here – could you fetch more from the kitchen?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Woops! Sure thing, Gramps! Be right there!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: Looks like I gotta run, Keitaro – but try and cheer up, alright? It’s your last day after all!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Aiden
text: See ya!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I knew my friends told me to try and shake it off, but after talking to Sir Aiden, I realized what I really wanted to do…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I promised Yoichi that I’d be there for him no matter what…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m not going to leave you alone, Yoichi… Not today…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Y-Yoichi!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I finally found you, Yoichi…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: K-Keitaro… I already told you, I just want to be alone-
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can’t just let you sit here and drown in your thoughts, Yoichi!
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I promised I’d be here for you no matter what, didn’t I?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Everyone is so worried about you… You haven’t eaten or talked to anyone all day long…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It really hurts seeing you like this…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know asking you to move on isn’t easy, but… I’m really worried… I don’t want to leave this place with you suffering like this…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so sorry for what happened to Yuki… Believe me. I’m just as sad that she’s gone…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: But please… promise me… that you’ll be okay…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m sorry, Keitaro… But I just can’t imagine life without Yuki right now… I never thought that I’d lose her like this…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I know I’m ruining what time we have left together, and it sucks… but I just can’t help the way I feel…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I understand…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Can you at least let me stay here with you tonight…?
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: *cries*
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m so sorry, Keitaro… I can’t do it… I can’t move on just yet…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi…
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Yoichi and I sat together as he continued to cry without saying a word…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m sure neither of us wanted our summer to end this way… But at least he let me stay beside him on our last night together…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Maybe things were meant to be like this… Maybe there really was nothing I could do to help him recover…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Once again… I’m sorry, Yoichi…{/i}
label: day33_yoichibe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn*
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, Yoichi. You’re already up and ready?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, I wanted to check on the puppies before I did anything else today.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I've been waiting for you to get up before I leave… I want you to be with me when I see the puppies.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww~ That’s really sweet, Yoichi.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: T-That’s not why I’m doing this, dummy!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I just don’t want you to forget that you’re responsible for them too! You have to make sure and take care of them with me!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t worry, Yoichi! I made a promise to you, didn’t I? I’ll be with you every step of the way!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Y-Yeah…! Of course I remember that!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Now, quit with all this cheesy crap, and just come with me already!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, alright!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, I’ll get it!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, Keitaro, Yoichi!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You guys are just in time. We were just about to give milk to the puppies.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! Can we try too, Scoutmaster Yoshi?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Maybe we should let the boys feed the puppies, Yoshinori. Neither of us have a clue about what we’re doing anyway.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hehe, I suppose you’re right – Aiden was the one handling them yesterday, and he didn’t give us much for instructions before he left…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: You geezers are doing it all wrong! You’re supposed to hold the babies when you feed them!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Here, let me show you, Silverfox!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It looks like Yoichi’s back to his old self again… Thank goodness…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah… I guess he is, sir…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know he won’t be able to move on so easily, but at least he’s trying his best…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You’re right about that…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: On the bright side, you managed to help Yoichi out of a crisis once again. You really are amazing, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It was my pleasure, sir… I’m just happy that I was able to help him realize that he still has a family with us…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I believe you made a big difference yesterday too, sir. By the time I talked to Yoichi, he was so calm compared to when I left him in the forest.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: So… you have my thanks for that too, Scoutmaster Yoshi…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m only doing my job as a scoutmaster after all…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think it’s just that though, Scoutmaster Yoshi. The way you took care of Yoichi was as if he was your son…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi is really lucky to have you, sir.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess I could say the same about you. Yoichi sees you more than just as a fellow camper, I believe.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You seem to be great at influencing people towards the right path, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You know, that scoutmaster offer hasn’t expired yet~ I’d be honored to train you!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah… Well… I think I have a ways to go before then… But I’ll definitely think about it, sir!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Haha! That’s great!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *sigh* I can’t believe we’re already at the end of the term. I feel like I owe you so much… This camp wouldn’t be where it is now if it weren’t for you…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: You don’t owe me anything, Scoutmaster Yoshi! Everyone did their part to keep this camp alive!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I just wish there was something that I could do for you…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’ve done more than enough for all of us scouts, sir! Besides, it’s not like this is the last time you’ll see me! I’ll be back next term for sure!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good point! But if you ever need anything from me, please don’t hesitate to ask!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you, sir! I won’t!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: O-Oh, I see… So, you have to hold them like that while you are feeding them…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Of course! They’re still just pups! They’re too weak to move! Heck, I don’t think they can even see yet!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, everything seems to be going well here!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: This boy really knows what he’s doing. Honestly, this is the first time I’ve nursed an animal like this. They’re so fragile.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! I guess I’m more of a dad than any of you guys here!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey, guys~
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Doesn’t anyone knock anymore?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I-I’m sorry, Sir Goro! I told him to knock, but he just went straight in!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: It’s alright, Natsumi! We saw Yoichi and Keitaro coming in here, so we wanted to see what was going on.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah, what are you guys up to?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah~ I’m just teaching these oldies how to properly take care of a pup!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Aww, they’re so cute! Have you named them yet?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Actually, I was thinking about that this morning and I think I found the perfect names…!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Torch-head!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh? What do you want now?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m talking about the puppies! This one’s Torch-head, that one’s Twinkerbell, and this one’s Mr. Perfect!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I tried to name them based on their personalities! The loud and whiny one is Torch-head, since he’s just like Hiro~
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey!!! Wait… did you just call me by my name?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, since your nicknames belong to the puppies now, I don’t have any choice but to call you by your real names now~
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Are you sure, Yoichi? You always like to tease us with your nicknames!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll admit, it’ll be weird hearing Yoichi call us by our real names… I’m so used to being called Twinkerbell now…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: See? I have to come up with something new now to try and trigger you!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: What about the puppy Sir Goro is holding? What’s his name?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Heh, that one’s really special – he looks the most like Yuki, and he has green eyes, just like you, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I want you to name him for me.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Aww, that’s really sweet, Yoichi.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What? R-Really? Are you sure, Yoichi…?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well… I actually did spend some time thinking about what I would name them before, and I did come up with one name…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: What about Keichi?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Keichi, huh?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, it’s a combination of both of your names! That’s adorable!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph, isn’t that kinda cheesy?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Aww, I actually think it sounds really nice! I like it!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What do you think, Yoichi?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: It’s perfect! This little guy will be Keichi from now on!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Do you like that name, little guy? Huh, Keichi?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keichi
text: *whimpers*
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! He loves it!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: As flattered as I am that Yoichi named the puppies after us, how come Keitaro is the only one who gets to pick the name?!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: If you asked me to name one of the pups, I’d call him something cool like Fire Dragon!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Shut up, Hiro! You’re not as special as Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Hehe, I think Yoichi naming them after us is really sweet… It’s his way of saying thank you~
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: N-No, it’s not! Y-You’re just reading way too much into it, Hunter!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph! Like I’d want to thank you guys!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! Yoichi is adorable when he’s flustered like that~
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem… I’m sorry to interrupt, but this pup has finished drinking its milk…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: He’s a hungry little fella, isn’t he?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What? Already? I thought for sure that one bottle was good for all of them…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: All they can eat is milk, so they need tons of it!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah, you’re right! I’ll go get some more from the mess hall!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Maybe you should take the puppies with you? They can eat and sleep there, since it’s warm.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: You won’t have to keep running around like this either.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, and we can help you carry them, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: R-Right! Thank you all for the help!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Come on, guys. Let’s go!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-Hey…! That’s not how you’re supposed to carry them…!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..! Let’s go after them, Yoichi…!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Hold on, you two.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh… Yes, sir?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I just want to say a few things to Mr. Yukimura…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: What’s up, Silverfox?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m pleased to see you are recovering so well from what happened the other day…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I owe it to Keitaro and Yoshi. They both helped me see that there was a future beyond Yuki.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m glad to hear that, young man. You really have matured.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m sorry that I misunderstood you so much. I should have been more sensitive to how hard you had it growing up.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I know how hard it is to lose a loved one. I should have been more sympathetic with you from the beginning…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: But I admire how strong you’ve been this whole time. You really are a model scout in your own way.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: T-Thanks… I guess.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Ahem. That’s all I wanted to say, so please don’t let me hold you two back any longer-
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Oh…? They’re back already?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: U-Um, hello…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, Felix! That’s a surprise!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: What can I do for you, boy?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Ah, I just wanted to let you know that my father will be coming by the camp today, sir. He just informed me about it a little while ago.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Your father? Are you being picked up early, Felix? We still have another day of camp left, you know.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Umm… It’s not like that. My dad is actually just visiting to check out the camp.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I know this is a weird time for him to visit, but I’ve been telling him stories about how much fun I’m having here.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I figured it’d be nice to invite him here before the term ends so he can see for himself.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I actually asked him to come during the campaign, but he’s usually really busy, and he just recently got the free time to pass by.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I was wondering if at least one of the scoutmasters could welcome him and give him a tour…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: No problem. I’ll go and tell Yuri and the others to attend to your father.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Thank you very much, sir!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Alright. You boys run along to the mess hall now. I can take it from here.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: A parental visit, eh? It’s been a while since that happened.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I have to look at his data sheet first so I’ll know how to cater to him properly while we give him a tour…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm… let’s see… Who was that scout again…?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Ah, Felix Clermont…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Clermont…?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: WHAT?!!!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m impressed, Snowball. I thought you’d be too scared to go and talk to Silverfox like that.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Well, a few weeks ago I would have been for sure!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: But you really helped me to see that I can’t just be scared of everything. Sometimes I have to do things that I don’t want to.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I really took your advice to heart, Yoichi! I’m really grateful for all your help!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I-It's no big deal, Snowball...
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: B-By the way, Yoichi… are you alright now? I’m sure you were upset about… well… you know…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I'll be alright. It's thanks to everyone helping me out, especially Keitaro here.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I'm so glad to hear that!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: We knew we could count on Keitaro, given how well you two get along with each other.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Felix…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: W-Well, he’s not wrong! Keitaro and I are together with those puppies, just like a family!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi! Don’t say embarrassing stuff too!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: It’s alright, Keitaro! I’m just glad you two are ending the term so happy together~
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: AHEM! Anyway, it is a bit strange for your dad to be visiting so late in the term, Felix… Why did he wait till the end?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Well, like I said earlier, I wanted him to come during the campaign, but he was just so busy!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Older people are always so serious and busy…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: What does your dad do anyway?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my dad is an author with his own publishing company.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s awesome! I've always admired people who could write!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: So what? Is your dad some super-famous writer? I didn't even know writers could be famous.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I guess you could say that… He has sold over a million books worldwide and sponsored a lot of other independent authors as well.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, so that explains why you’re so filthy rich.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why are you at this run-down camp then? Shouldn’t you be off getting pampered somewhere?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… I was always bullied at school for getting special treatment from the teachers, even though I went to an exclusive private school…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: My dad thought it was best to have private tutors come over, so I’ve been taught at home for a really long time.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I got so used to staying at home that I didn’t even go outside anymore… It made my dad worry so much that he thought he might have been depriving me of any real life as a boy.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: That’s when he came across an online article about this place and asked me if I wanted to spend my summer vacation here.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I thought trying something new like this may not be so bad, so I agreed to do it.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: However, I tried to keep my family profile a secret since I didn’t want the same thing that happened to me at school to happen here…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… Are you sure it’s alright for you to tell us all of this, Felix?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: It’s okay. You guys are my friends. Even if you did know, I don’t think it would have changed the way you see me.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I’m just happy to get the same treatment as everyone else and finally feel like a normal person.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, good. It can only be good for you to be treated just like everyone else! Nobody should be super spoiled anyway!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: You’re right, Yoichi… I never had real friends until I met all of you guys…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I know I’m not good at socializing… And on top of that I know I was obnoxious at first, complaining about almost everything…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: If it were any other people, I knew they would’ve left me right away. In fact, the people who stuck around me back then were only after my money…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my father’s money…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: But like I said..! Everything is different here! I couldn’t really ask for more.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so glad that you think that way, Felix! All of us learned a lot from each other here!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: You’re right. That’s why I thought it was necessary for my dad to really see this place for himself!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: He needs to see just how good of an investment Camp Buddy can be!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ehh…? What do you mean, Felix?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Well… When everyone was busy with the fundraising and advertisement campaign, I wanted to help out in any way I could too…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I know the campaign was successful, but I still didn’t want to leave the camp without my own contribution…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I explained the situation to my dad and asked him if he could help out the camp financially…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Seriously?! Your dad’s going to just give away money like that?!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s unbelievable, Felix..! Did you tell the scoutmasters about this yet?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I haven’t yet… I didn’t have enough time to explain it fully to Sir Goro before.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: That’s why I’m really worried about my dad’s visit. I wanted to impress him enough to persuade him to sponsor the camp.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh wow, Felix! This is great news for the scoutmasters! I’m sure they’ll win his approval with flying colors!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Let’s just hope we don’t run into any trouble…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I hope you don’t mind if I see the puppies a little bit later…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Nah, it’s fine! They’re not going anywhere anyway!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: T-Thanks, Yoichi…!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Let’s go check on those dorks in the mess hall – I doubt they know how to handle the puppies properly.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, you’re right..! Let’s go!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! There they are!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: What took you guys so long?!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Sorry! We actually got caught up with Felix talking to Sir Goro before we could leave the office!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Where’s Scoutmaster Yoshi?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, he was called by Scoutmaster Yuri – apparently, it was something urgent!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Anyway, why did Felix come to the office? Did he get into some sort of trouble?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, no! Nothing like that. He was just telling Sir Goro that his father was going to visit our camp to check it out before this term ends!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh? Why would he wanna come here all out of the blue?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! That guy’s gonna give us tons of dough!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Huh? I thought we had plenty of food here… That seems like an odd thing to donate…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Dough means money, Natsumi—
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Money..? Why would Felix’s dad do that?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I don’t know. I just heard some big words from him and Keitaro. I didn’t really understand.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh, Felix told us about his dad planning to invest in Camp Buddy.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whoa! Really?! Just who is Felix’s dad anyways?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, Mr. Clermont is one of the best-selling authors around the world. He’s a billionaire.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: H-How could you say that with a straight face?!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-What? I never knew…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: How did you know about that, Hunter? Did Felix tell you before?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: No. I’ve known about it since I heard Felix’s last name. I’ve read some of his father’s books.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, everything about Felix makes sense…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s great news that his father is a potential investor, though. If he offers a sponsorship, that would probably help liquidate all the camp’s financial liabilities.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: There we go again. Spouting business words that only you guys can understand.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Heh~ I know, right Wolfboy? Let’s just pretend we understand! Haha!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hahaha! All Hunter is saying is that we could really use the help Felix’s dad can give if he sees Camp Buddy as a worthwhile investment.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m not sure why Mr. Clermont would think otherwise! Camp Buddy is a great place after all!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Do the scoutmasters know about this already?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think so. But it shouldn’t be a problem, though! They treat all visitors with the same amount of respect, no matter who they are!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s right! Mr. Clermont can also see for himself just how friendly and well mannered the campers are!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Enough of this stupid money talk. Where are my puppies?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh! They’re sleeping over there, next to the fridge.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: We tried to let them play earlier, but they just all curled up over there to sleep. They must like how warm it is!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: What?! That’s dangerous! Get them away from there!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha, relax Yoichi – it’s safe and clean over there!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Hehe, Yoichi’s so protective of his puppies~
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: A-At least put them in a box! There are other ways to warm them up, you know!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Sheesh, you dorks would make such awful parents!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Keitaro! Help me get them to a comfier spot!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Okay..!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It seems like everything is going well! I’m so happy to see that Yoichi back on his feet.{/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I can’t believe that the camp term will be ending so soon, though…{/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m really going to miss everyone here and the good times we spent together. {/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Oh, and speaking of good times… I should really update my journal! I don’t think I’ll have any other day to write an entry! {/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I-I… I can’t believe this! I can’t believe HE is actually going to visit our camp!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: D-Dad! Calm down! Tell us what’s going on first!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yeah, sir. I haven’t seen you this excited in a long time.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: Sheesh, Gramps! Is that guy like a supermodel or something?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Weren’t you three listening? Mr. William Clermont will be visiting the camp!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: W-What?! The ‘Sir William Clermont’?!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m sorry, but I’m not following. Who is this William Clermont?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: He’s an award-winning novel author and publisher! And if I’m not mistaken, he’s also one of the top ten wealthiest personalities in the world!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: My dad is an absolute, die-hard fan of Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Actually, I have to say, his works are really top-notch! I’ve read most of them from Dad’s collection!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Are you sure this is the same person, sir?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m definitely sure! I pulled up our records and it seems that Mr. Clermont’s only son is enrolled in this batch!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! You mean Felix?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: That’s right!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Hmm… That explains why Felix seems to be new to everything that’s going on around here…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: I wonder why someone so wealthy would send their only son to such a run-down camp like this, though?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To be fair, the camp had a great reputation up until last year! We’ve been an outstanding model summer camp for the last two decades!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can understand Mr. Clermont entrusting his son to us! But what I’m not sure of is why he would want to visit us.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m not sure either, but it doesn’t matter! I get to finally meet Mr. Clermont in person!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Don’t get your hopes up too much, Dad. He’s probably here to visit his son, not the camp.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I might actually get him to sign my collection of his books while he’s here!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve actually just bought and finished his newest work!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: Relax, Gramps!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: Now we know where Yuri's obsession over things came from…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess you could say that, Aiden.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Anyway! Let’s make sure the entire camp is spotless and everything is in order before he arrives!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: We have to make sure and impress him!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! I’ve finished updating my journal!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe that this new journal is almost full as well.){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(When I first came to Camp Buddy, the only thing on my mind was to make as many great memories as possible.){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I wanted to keep those memories forever with the pictures I took and everything I wrote in my journal.){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But when my first journal was ruined, I thought the memories I tried to preserve were gone as well.){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I was wrong.){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Everyone put their heart and soul into making this new journal. It’s proof that all the times we spent together were remembered and always will be.){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that all of this happened in just the one month I’ve been staying here.){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And now that there’s just a day left before the camp ends…){/i}
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Phew…! I guess I’m thinking about this a lot more than I should.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: And here’s one of the lodging cabins for our campers!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Complete with all basic facilities every camper needs and always well maintained!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Interesting. It seems like everything is in good shape around here.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, indeed! Ahaha…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Oh, Keitaro! You’re here!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! I’d like you to meet Keitaro! He’s one of my friends that I told you about!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Ah, Keitaro! I’ve heard a lot of stories about you.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Keitaro here is like a leader among us! I can safely say that, if it weren’t for him, I wouldn’t be so close with everyone else!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Felix. It’s not like that, really...
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I really want to be like Keitaro, Dad! He listens to everyone’s opinions and always tries to understand his fellow campers!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I can’t help but agree with you, Felix. Keitaro here is a shining example of the spirit of this camp.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: I can see that. I’ve never seen my son introduce someone with such confidence.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, please accept my personal gratitude for being a true friend to my son.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Aah… You’re welcome, sir. But really, I can’t take all the credit.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Here at Camp Buddy, we all work together, scoutmasters and scouts alike.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! I admire your humility!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: But if you’d pardon the shift in topic, I can’t help but notice that book you’re carrying, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s my journal, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: A journal, you say? I see we may have an aspiring writer here then.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s nowhere near as good as your professional works, Mr. Clermont! I usually just write about all the memories I’ve shared with everyone here in Camp Buddy!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I get a little help from all my friends too whenever I update my journal! So it’s really a team effort!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! Keitaro here is quite the photographer as well!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Oh really? That explains that camera then.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir! It’s a little hobby of mine, and I use some of the pictures I take to decorate my journal like a scrapbook!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: This journal was actually a welcoming gift from the scoutmasters too!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Impressive. I didn’t know how nurturing you were of your scouts’ creativity here, Mr. Nomoru!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: It’s not just creativity, Mr. Clermont! We let our campers engage in activities that fit all their interests in order for them to excel at what they are most passionate about!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: I see!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: I know it’s your personal article, Keitaro. But may I take a peek?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure thing, Mr. Clermont! You’re just in time, since I finished updating it before you guys entered!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: *hands over the journal*
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Mmmhhhmm…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Very interesting.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: U-Umm… Mr. Clermont…? We can continue the tour now…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Hold on.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Hahaha…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Hey… Mr. Clermont seems to be enjoying your journal… Just what did you write in there…?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: U-Umm… Well—
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Haha! You’re quite a passionate writer, Keitaro!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: I enjoyed the stories you put in your journal! They give off that innocent, boyhood expression that I feel is lacking in my own books.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! It’s an honor to hear that from you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: You and your friends have done well!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Ah, I really wish that I could just sit back and read what you’ve cooked up in this little book of yours!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh I don’t really mind, Mr. Clermont! You can borrow it if you like!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I won’t be adding any entries for the rest of the day, anyway!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Oh, splendid! You truly are one interesting boy!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Mr. Nomoru, is it possible that you escort me to a quarter where I can just enjoy this book with a nice cup of tea by my side?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: But Mr. Clermont, the tour isn’t finished yet…!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! It’s quite alright. I’ve seen enough!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, I will return your journal as soon as I finish reading it! Thank you very much again for lending it to me!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re welcome, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: William
text: Now, if you’ll excuse us.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: This way, please.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: What happened, Dad? Why do you look so down?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* I’m just thinking about my tour with Mr. Clermont.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, how did it go?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I-It went alright… He just stopped halfway through the tour.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Huh…? What happened?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Well… I was just showing him around the camp the whole day. It was uneventful until we arrived at Cabin One.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: We met Keitaro inside, and he was holding his journal. Mr. Clermont was intrigued and asked Keitaro if he could borrow it for a while.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: He then halted the tour just to rest and read Keitaro’s journal with some tea.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: What’s wrong with that, sir? It sounds like it went well to me.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m just afraid that I might have overworked him or something…
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Dad, I think you’re being too paranoid about it! I’m sure he just really enjoyed Keitaro’s journal!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: Or maybe he read something inappropriate! Like the time where Taiga snapped a photo of your butt!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Aiden! You’re not helping!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Let’s not worry about it too much, sir. Maybe he’s tired, just like you said. He’s a pretty busy man after all.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Yoshi’s right! And you’ve had a long day too!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: So, why don’t you go and get some sleep, Dad? We still have huge plans for the campers tomorrow after all!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Maybe I should send him an email apologizing at lea-
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Sleeeeeeeep.
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: Hehe~ Your dad is a total fanboy of this Clermont guy, eh?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: I guess it runs in the blood!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: You’re making it sound like it’s a bad thing, Aiden! Hmph!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, let’s all get some rest as well. We have to be ready tomorrow for our final activity with the scouts!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah, you’re right! I’m already beat from cleaning the entire place for that Clermont guy!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Well, I should close up this place before I head out—
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, who could that be…?
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: E-Eh?! Mr. Clermont?!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Y-Yes! I’ll go get my dad right away!
label: day33_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn*
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, Yoichi. You’re already up and ready?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, I wanted to check on the puppies before I did anything else today.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I've been waiting for you to get up before I leave… I want you to be with me when I see the puppies.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww~ That’s really sweet, Yoichi.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: T-That’s not why I’m doing this, dummy!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I just don’t want you to forget that you’re responsible for them too! You have to make sure and take care of them with me!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t worry, Yoichi! I made a promise to you, didn’t I? I’ll be with you every step of the way!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Y-Yeah…! Of course I remember that!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Now, quit with all this cheesy crap, and just come with me already!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, alright!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, I’ll get it!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, Keitaro, Yoichi!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You guys are just in time. We were just about to give milk to the puppies.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! Can we try too, Scoutmaster Yoshi?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Maybe we should let the boys feed the puppies, Yoshinori. Neither of us have a clue about what we’re doing anyway.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hehe, I suppose you’re right – Aiden was the one handling them yesterday, and he didn’t give us much for instructions before he left…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: You geezers are doing it all wrong! You’re supposed to hold the babies when you feed them!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Here, let me show you, Silverfox!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It looks like Yoichi’s back to his old self again… Thank goodness…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah… I guess he is, sir…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I know he won’t be able to move on so easily, but at least he’s trying his best…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You’re right about that…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: On the bright side, you managed to help Yoichi out of a crisis once again. You really are amazing, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It was my pleasure, sir… I’m just happy that I was able to help him realize that he still has a family with us…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I believe you made a big difference yesterday too, sir. By the time I talked to Yoichi, he was so calm compared to when I left him in the forest.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: So… you have my thanks for that too, Scoutmaster Yoshi…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m only doing my job as a scoutmaster after all…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think it’s just that though, Scoutmaster Yoshi. The way you took care of Yoichi was as if he was your son…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi is really lucky to have you, sir.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess I could say the same about you. Yoichi sees you more than just as a fellow camper, I believe.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You seem to be great at influencing people towards the right path, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You know, that scoutmaster offer hasn’t expired yet~ I’d be honored to train you!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah… Well… I think I have a ways to go before then… But I’ll definitely think about it, sir!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Haha! That’s great!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *sigh* I can’t believe we’re already at the end of the term. I feel like I owe you so much… This camp wouldn’t be where it is now if it weren’t for you…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You don’t owe me anything, Scoutmaster Yoshi! Everyone did their part to keep this camp alive!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I just wish there was something that I could do for you…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’ve done more than enough for all of us scouts, sir! Besides, it’s not like this is the last time you’ll see me! I’ll be back next term for sure!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good point! But if you ever need anything from me, please don’t hesitate to ask!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you, sir! I won’t!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: O-Oh, I see… So, you have to hold them like that while you are feeding them…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Of course! They’re still just pups! They’re too weak to move! Heck, I don’t think they can even see yet!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, everything seems to be going well here!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: This boy really knows what he’s doing. Honestly, this is the first time I’ve nursed an animal like this. They’re so fragile.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! I guess I’m more of a dad than any of you guys here!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey, guys~
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Doesn’t anyone knock anymore?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I-I’m sorry, Sir Goro! I told him to knock. but he just went straight in!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: It’s alright, Natsumi! We saw Yoichi and Keitaro coming in here, so we wanted to see what was going on.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Yeah, what are you guys up to?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah~ I’m just teaching these oldies how to properly take care of a pup!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Aww, they’re so cute! Have you named them yet?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Actually, I was thinking about that this morning and I think I found the perfect names…!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Torch-head!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh? What do you want now?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m talking about the puppies! This one’s Torch-head, that one’s Twinkerbell, and this one’s Mr. Perfect!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I tried to name them based on their personalities! The loud and whiny one is Torch-head, since he’s just like Hiro~
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey!!! Wait… did you just call me by my name?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, since your nicknames belong to the puppies now, I don’t have any choice but to call you by your real names now~
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Are you sure, Yoichi? You always like to tease us with your nicknames!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll admit, it’ll be weird hearing Yoichi call us by our real names… I’m so used to being called Twinkerbell now…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: See? I have to come up with something new now to try and trigger you!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: What about the puppy Sir Goro is holding? What’s his name?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Heh, that one’s really special – he looks the most like Yuki, and he has green eyes, just like you, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I want you to name him for me.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Aww, that’s really sweet, Yoichi.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What? R-Really? Are you sure, Yoichi…?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Well… I actually did spend some time thinking about what I would name them before, and I did come up with one name…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: What about Keichi?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Keichi, huh?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, it’s a combination of both of your names! That’s adorable!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmph, isn’t that kinda cheesy?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Aww, I actually think it sounds really nice! I like it!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-What do you think, Yoichi?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: It’s perfect! This little guy will be Keichi from now on!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Do you like that name, little guy? Huh, Keichi?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keichi
text: *whimpers*
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! He loves it!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: As flattered as I am that Yoichi named the puppies after us, how come Keitaro is the only one who gets to pick the name?!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: If you asked me to name one of the pups, I’d call him something cool like Fire Dragon!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Shut up, Hiro! You’re not as special as Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Hehe, I think Yoichi naming them after us is really sweet… It’s his way of saying thank you~
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: N-No, it’s not! Y-You’re just reading way too much into it, Hunter!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph! Like I’d want to thank you guys!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! Yoichi is adorable when he’s flustered like that~
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem… I’m sorry to interrupt, but this pup has finished drinking its milk…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: He’s a hungry little fella, isn’t he?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: W-What? Already? I thought for sure that one bottle was good for all of them…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: All they can eat is milk, so they need tons of it!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah, you’re right! I’ll go get some more from the mess hall!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Maybe you should take the puppies with you? They can eat and sleep there, since it’s warm.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: You won’t have to keep running around like this either.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, and we can help you carry them, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: R-Right! Thank you all for the help!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Come on, guys. Let’s go!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-Hey…! That’s not how you’re supposed to carry them…!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..! Let’s go after them, Yoichi…!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Hold on, you two.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh… Yes, sir?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I just want to say a few things to Mr. Yukimura…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What’s up, Silverfox?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m pleased to see you are recovering so well from what happened the other day…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I owe it to Keitaro and Yoshi. They both helped me see that there was a future beyond Yuki.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m glad to hear that, young man. You really have matured.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m sorry that I misunderstood you so much. I should have been more sensitive to how hard you had it growing up.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I know how hard it is to lose a loved one. I should have been more sympathetic with you from the beginning…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: But I admire how strong you’ve been this whole time. You really are a model scout in your own way.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: T-Thanks… I guess.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Ahem. That’s all I wanted to say, so please don’t let me hold you two back any longer-
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Oh…? They’re back already?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: U-Um, hello…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, Felix! That’s a surprise!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: What can I do for you, boy?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Ah, I just wanted to let you know that my father will be coming by the camp today, sir. He just informed me about it a little while ago.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Your father? Are you being picked up early, Felix? We still have another day of camp left, you know.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Umm… It’s not like that. My dad is actually just visiting to check out the camp.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I know this is a weird time for him to visit, but I’ve been telling him stories about how much fun I’m having here.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I figured it’d be nice to invite him here before the term ends so he can see for himself.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I actually asked him to come during the campaign, but he’s usually really busy, and he just recently got the free time to pass by.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I was wondering if at least one of the scoutmasters could welcome him and give him a tour…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: No problem. I’ll go and tell Yuri and the others to attend to your father.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Thank you very much, sir!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Alright. You boys run along to the mess hall now. I can take it from here.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: A parental visit, eh? It’s been a while since that happened.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I have to look at his data sheet first so I’ll know how to cater to him properly while we give him a tour…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm… let’s see… Who was that scout again…?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Ah, Felix Clermont…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Clermont…?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: WHAT?!!!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’m impressed, Snowball. I thought you’d be too scared to go and talk to Silverfox like that.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well, a few weeks ago I would have been for sure!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: But you really helped me to see that I can’t just be scared of everything. Sometimes I have to do things that I don’t want to.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I really took your advice to heart, Yoichi! I’m really grateful for all your help!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I-It's no big deal, Snowball...
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: B-By the way, Yoichi… are you alright now? I’m sure you were upset about… well… you know…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I'll be alright. It's thanks to everyone helping me out, especially Keitaro here.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I'm so glad to hear that!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: We knew we could count on Keitaro, given how well you two get along with each other.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Felix…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: W-Well, he’s not wrong! Keitaro and I are together with those puppies, just like a family!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yoichi! Don’t say embarrassing stuff too!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: It’s alright, Keitaro! I’m just glad you two are ending the term so happy together~
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: AHEM! Anyway, it is a bit strange for your dad to be visiting so late in the term, Felix… Why did he wait till the end?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well, like I said earlier, I wanted him to come during the campaign, but he was just so busy!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Older people are always so serious and busy…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What does your dad do anyway?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my dad is an author with his own publishing company.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s awesome! I've always admired people who could write!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: So what? Is your dad some super-famous writer? I didn't even know writers could be famous.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I guess you could say that… He has sold over a million books worldwide and sponsored a lot of other independent authors as well.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh, so that explains why you’re so filthy rich.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why are you at this run-down camp then? Shouldn’t you be off getting pampered somewhere?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… I was always bullied at school for getting special treatment from the teachers, even though I went to an exclusive private school…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: My dad thought it was best to have private tutors come over, so I’ve been taught at home for a really long time.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I got so used to staying at home that I didn’t even go outside anymore… It made my dad worry so much that he thought he might have been depriving me of any real life as a boy.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: That’s when he came across an online article about this place and asked me if I wanted to spend my summer vacation here.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I thought trying something new like this may not be so bad, so I agreed to do it.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: However, I tried to keep my family profile a secret since I didn’t want the same thing that happened to me at school to happen here…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… Are you sure it’s alright for you to tell us all of this, Felix?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: It’s okay. You guys are my friends. Even if you did know, I don’t think it would have changed the way you see me.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I’m just happy to get the same treatment as everyone else and finally feel like a normal person.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, good. It can only be good for you to be treated just like everyone else! Nobody should be super spoiled anyway!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: You’re right, Yoichi… I never had real friends until I met all of you guys…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I know I’m not good at socializing… And on top of that I know I was obnoxious at first, complaining about almost everything…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: If it were any other people, I knew they would’ve left me right away. In fact, the people who stuck around me back then were only after my money…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my father’s money…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: But like I said..! Everything is different here! I couldn’t really ask for more.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so glad that you think that way, Felix! All of us learned a lot from each other here!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: You’re right. That’s why I thought it was necessary for my dad to really see this place for himself!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: He needs to see just how good of an investment Camp Buddy can be!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ehh…? What do you mean, Felix?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Well… When everyone was busy with the fundraising and advertisement campaign, I wanted to help out in any way I could too…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I know the campaign was successful, but I still didn’t want to leave the camp without my own contribution…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I explained the situation to my dad and asked him if he could help out the camp financially…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Seriously?! Your dad’s going to just give away money like that?!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s unbelievable, Felix..! Did you tell the scoutmasters about this yet?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I haven’t yet… I didn’t have enough time to explain it fully to Sir Goro before.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: That’s why I’m really worried about my dad’s visit. I wanted to impress him enough to persuade him to sponsor the camp.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh wow, Felix! This is great news for the scoutmasters! I’m sure they’ll win his approval with flying colors!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Let’s just hope we don’t run into any trouble…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I hope you don’t mind if I see the puppies a little bit later…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Nah, it’s fine! They’re not going anywhere anyway!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: T-Thanks, Yoichi…!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Let’s go check on those dorks in the mess hall – I doubt they know how to handle the puppies properly.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, you’re right..! Let’s go!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! There they are!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: What took you guys so long?!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Sorry! We actually got caught up with Felix talking to Sir Goro before we could leave the office!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Where’s Scoutmaster Yoshi?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, he was called by Scoutmaster Yuri – apparently, it was something urgent!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Anyway, why did Felix come to the office? Did he get into some sort of trouble?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah, no! Nothing like that. He was just telling Sir Goro that his father was going to visit our camp to check it out before this term ends!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Huh? Why would he wanna come here all out of the blue?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! That guy’s gonna give us tons of dough!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Huh? I thought we had plenty of food here… That seems like an odd thing to donate…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Dough means money, Natsumi—
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Money..? Why would Felix’s dad do that?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I don’t know. I just heard some big words from him and Keitaro. I didn’t really understand.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh, Felix told us about his dad planning to invest in Camp Buddy.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whoa! Really?! Just who is Felix’s dad anyways?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, Mr. Clermont is one of the best-selling authors around the world. He’s a billionaire.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: H-How could you say that with a straight face?!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-What? I never knew…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: How did you know about that, Hunter? Did Felix tell you before?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: No. I’ve known about it since I heard Felix’s last name. I’ve read some of his father’s books.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, everything about Felix makes sense…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s great news that his father is a potential investor, though. If he offers a sponsorship, that would probably help liquidate all the camp’s financial liabilities.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: There we go again. Spouting business words that only you guys can understand.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Heh~ I know, right Wolfboy? Let’s just pretend we understand! Haha!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hahaha! All Hunter is saying is that we could really use the help Felix’s dad can give if he sees Camp Buddy as a worthwhile investment.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m not sure why Mr. Clermont would think otherwise! Camp Buddy is a great place after all!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Do the scoutmasters know about this already?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think so. But it shouldn’t be a problem, though! They treat all visitors with the same amount of respect, no matter who they are!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s right! Mr. Clermont can also see for himself just how friendly and well mannered the campers are!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Enough of this stupid money talk. Where are my puppies?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh! They’re sleeping over there, next to the fridge.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: We tried to let them play earlier, but they just all curled up over there to sleep. They must like how warm it is!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What?! That’s dangerous! Get them away from there!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha, relax Yoichi – it’s safe and clean over there!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Hehe, Yoichi’s so protective of his puppies~
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: A-At least put them in a box! There are other ways to warm them up, you know!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Sheesh, you dorks would make such awful parents!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Keitaro! Help me get them to a comfier spot!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Okay..!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It seems like everything is going well! I’m so happy to see that Yoichi back on his feet.{/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I can’t believe that the camp term will be ending so soon, though…{/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m really going to miss everyone here and the good times we spent together. {/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Oh, and speaking of good times… I should really update my journal! I don’t think I’ll have any other day to write an entry! {/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I-I… I can’t believe this! I can’t believe HE is actually going to visit our camp!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: D-Dad! Calm down! Tell us what’s going on first!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yeah, sir. I haven’t seen you this excited in a long time.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Sheesh, Gramps! Is that guy like a supermodel or something?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Weren’t you three listening? Mr. William Clermont will be visiting the camp!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: W-What?! The ‘Sir William Clermont’?!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m sorry, but I’m not following. Who is this William Clermont?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: He’s an award-winning novel author and publisher! And if I’m not mistaken, he’s also one of the top ten wealthiest personalities in the world!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: My dad is an absolute, die-hard fan of Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Actually, I have to say, his works are really top-notch! I’ve read most of them from Dad’s collection!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Are you sure this is the same person, sir?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m definitely sure! I pulled up our records and it seems that Mr. Clermont’s only son is enrolled in this batch!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! You mean Felix?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: That’s right!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Hmm… That explains why Felix seems to be new to everything that’s going on around here…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: I wonder why someone so wealthy would send their only son to such a run-down camp like this, though?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To be fair, the camp had a great reputation up until last year! We’ve been an outstanding model summer camp for the last two decades!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can understand Mr. Clermont entrusting his son to us! But what I’m not sure of is why he would want to visit us.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m not sure either, but it doesn’t matter! I get to finally meet Mr. Clermont in person!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Don’t get your hopes up too much, Dad. He’s probably here to visit his son, not the camp.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I might actually get him to sign my collection of his books while he’s here!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve actually just bought and finished his newest work!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Relax, Gramps!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Now we know where Yuri's obsession over things came from…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess you could say that, Aiden.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Anyway! Let’s make sure the entire camp is spotless and everything is in order before he arrives!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: We have to make sure and impress him!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! I’ve finished updating my journal!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe that this new journal is almost full as well.){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(When I first came to Camp Buddy, the only thing on my mind was to make as many great memories as possible.){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I wanted to keep those memories forever with the pictures I took and everything I wrote in my journal.){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But when my first journal was ruined, I thought the memories I tried to preserve were gone as well.){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I was wrong.){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Everyone put their heart and soul into making this new journal. It’s proof that all the times we spent together were remembered and always will be.){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that all of this happened in just the one month I’ve been staying here.){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And now that there’s just a day left before the camp ends…){/i}
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Phew…! I guess I’m thinking about this a lot more than I should.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: And here’s one of the lodging cabins for our campers!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Complete with all basic facilities every camper needs and always well maintained!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Interesting. It seems like everything is in good shape around here.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, indeed! Ahaha…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Oh, Keitaro! You’re here!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! I’d like you to meet Keitaro! He’s one of my friends that I told you about!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Ah, Keitaro! I’ve heard a lot of stories about you.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
