text: Keitaro here is like a leader among us! I can safely say that, if it weren’t for him, I wouldn’t be so close with everyone else!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Felix. It’s not like that, really...
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I really want to be like Keitaro, Dad! He listens to everyone’s opinions and always tries to understand his fellow campers!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I can’t help but agree with you, Felix. Keitaro here is a shining example of the spirit of this camp.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: I can see that. I’ve never seen my son introduce someone with such confidence.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, please accept my personal gratitude for being a true friend to my son.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Aah… You’re welcome, sir. But really, I can’t take all the credit.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Here at Camp Buddy, we all work together, scoutmasters and scouts alike.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! I admire your humility!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: But if you’d pardon the shift in topic, I can’t help but notice that book you’re carrying, Keitaro.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s my journal, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: A journal, you say? I see we may have an aspiring writer here then.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s nowhere near as good as your professional works, Mr. Clermont! I usually just write about all the memories I’ve shared with everyone here in Camp Buddy!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I get a little help from all my friends too whenever I update my journal! So it’s really a team effort!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! Keitaro here is quite the photographer as well!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Oh really? That explains that camera then.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir! It’s a little hobby of mine, and I use some of the pictures I take to decorate my journal like a scrapbook!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: This journal was actually a welcoming gift from the scoutmasters too!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Impressive. I didn’t know how nurturing you were of your scouts’ creativity here, Mr. Nomoru!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: It’s not just creativity, Mr. Clermont! We let our campers engage in activities that fit all their interests in order for them to excel at what they are most passionate about!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: I see!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: I know it’s your personal article, Keitaro. But may I take a peek?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure thing, Mr. Clermont! You’re just in time, since I finished updating it before you guys entered!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *hands over the journal*
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Mmmhhhmm…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Very interesting.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: U-Umm… Mr. Clermont…? We can continue the tour now…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Hold on.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Hahaha…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Hey… Mr. Clermont seems to be enjoying your journal… Just what did you write in there…?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: U-Umm… Well—
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Haha! You’re quite a passionate writer, Keitaro!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: I enjoyed the stories you put in your journal! They give off that innocent, boyhood expression that I feel is lacking in my own books.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! It’s an honor to hear that from you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: You and your friends have done well!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Ah, I really wish that I could just sit back and read what you’ve cooked up in this little book of yours!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh I don’t really mind, Mr. Clermont! You can borrow it if you like!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I won’t be adding any entries for the rest of the day, anyway!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Oh, splendid! You truly are one interesting boy!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Mr. Nomoru, is it possible that you escort me to a quarter where I can just enjoy this book with a nice cup of tea by my side?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: But Mr. Clermont, the tour isn’t finished yet…!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! It’s quite alright. I’ve seen enough!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, I will return your journal as soon as I finish reading it! Thank you very much again for lending it to me!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re welcome, Mr. Clermont!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: William
text: Now, if you’ll excuse us.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: This way, please.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: What happened, Dad? Why do you look so down?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* I’m just thinking about my tour with Mr. Clermont.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, how did it go?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I-It went alright… He just stopped halfway through the tour.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Huh…? What happened?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Well… I was just showing him around the camp the whole day. It was uneventful until we arrived at Cabin One.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: We met Keitaro inside, and he was holding his journal. Mr. Clermont was intrigued and asked Keitaro if he could borrow it for a while.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: He then halted the tour just to rest and read Keitaro’s journal with some tea.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: What’s wrong with that, sir? It sounds like it went well to me.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m just afraid that I might have overworked him or something…
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Dad, I think you’re being too paranoid about it! I’m sure he just really enjoyed Keitaro’s journal!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Or maybe he read something inappropriate! Like the time where Taiga snapped a photo of your butt!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aiden! You’re not helping!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Let’s not worry about it too much, sir. Maybe he’s tired, just like you said. He’s a pretty busy man after all.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Yoshi’s right! And you’ve had a long day too!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: So, why don’t you go and get some sleep, Dad? We still have huge plans for the campers tomorrow after all!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: *sigh* Maybe I should send him an email apologizing at lea-
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Sleeeeeeeep.
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Hehe~ Your dad is a total fanboy of this Clermont guy, eh?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: I guess it runs in the blood!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: You’re making it sound like it’s a bad thing, Aiden! Hmph!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Anyway, let’s all get some rest as well. We have to be ready tomorrow for our final activity with the scouts!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Yeah, you’re right! I’m already beat from cleaning the entire place for that Clermont guy!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Well, I should close up this place before I head out—
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Oh, who could that be…?
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: E-Eh?! Mr. Clermont?!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Y-Yes! I’ll go get my dad right away!
label: day33_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! I’ve finished updating my journal!
label: day34_hirobe

text: {i}I’ve come a long way since joining Camp Buddy.{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Remembering all of the events that happened during my stay here… It all feels just like yesterday.{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Making new friends… Going out on adventures… Doing exciting camp activities… Celebrating and partying like a big family…{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s amazing what can happen in such a short period of time.{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I used to feel afraid when I think that I might forget all of these things in the future…{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But this place has made me realize that what’s truly important is to enjoy the moment to the fullest with the people around me.{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Even without all those pictures I’ve taken, I don’t think I’ll ever forget everything that has happened.{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Especially all the great times I spent with Hiro… We might be going our separate ways after this summer…{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But I know that all of the memories I’ve shared with him and everyone else in Camp Buddy will always be in my heart!{/i}
label: day34_hirobe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *yawn*
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, wow… I woke up pretty late again…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Good morning, Keitaro~
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wah…! What are you doing in my bed, Hiro?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: We slept together, silly~ I was waiting for you to wake up!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..! Where’s everybody?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh! They’re already at the mess hall having breakfast! I told them to let you sleep in a little longer, as always~
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww, you didn’t have to do that. You keep spoiling me, Hiro.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey, I’m just making the most of our time together! Like you said, we only have a little while left before we all leave camp.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t say it like that, Hiro. I’m sure we’ll find a way to keep seeing each other even after Camp Buddy!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Anyway, let’s get dressed and catch up with everybody else! I’m sure you’re hungry too!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha, I guess you really do know me like the back of your hand! That’s my Keitaro~
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Oh! Hi, guys.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hello, Felix!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: We’re heading over to the mess hall for breakfast. Do you want to come along with us?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I’m sorry, but I can’t tag along right now. I’m waiting for my dad to show up.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Eh? Is he gonna pick you up early?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Umm… It’s not like that. My dad is actually just visiting to check out the camp.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I’ve been telling him stories about how much fun I’ve been having here. I figured it’d be nice to invite him here before the term ends so he can see for himself.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! That’s really nice, Felix!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I’m kind of worried, though… The scoutmasters aren’t here to welcome him… I don’t want my dad to think that the scoutmasters are lazy and don’t take care of the camp…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha! I don’t think your dad will assume anything like that, Felix!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, I know! How about we go to the scoutmaster’s office and tell the scoutmasters about your dad’s visit?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: That sounds good, Keitaro!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha! I guess you were just scared to go to the scoutmasters by yourself!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Good morning, sir!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Oh! Good morning, boys. What brings you here so early in the morning?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sir Goro, if you aren’t busy, Felix wanted to ask you something.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm? What is it, lad?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Ah..! Y-Yes..! Well…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I invited my dad to visit Camp Buddy today to check it out… And I was wondering if at least one of the scoutmasters could welcome him and give him a tour…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: No problem, Felix. I’ll go and tell Yuri and the others to attend to your father, alright?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Let me just finish my morning coffee, and I’ll get on it right away.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: You boys run along and enjoy the rest of the day.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: T-Thank you, sir..!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: See, Felix? There’s nothing to worry about after all~
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Thank you again, sir! We’ll be on our way!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: A parental visit, eh? It’s been a while since that happened.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I have to look at his data sheet first so I’ll know how to cater to him properly while we give them a tour…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: *yawn*
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Hmm… let’s see… Who was that scout again…?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Ah, Felix Clermont…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Clermont…?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: WHAT?!!!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Thanks for coming with me, guys.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: No problem, Felix!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I’m not used to talking up front to people like that. My dad can be just as intimidating as Sir Goro.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Older people are always so serious and busy…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmm.. that makes me wonder. What does your dad do, Felix?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my dad is an author with his own publishing company.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s awesome! I've always admired people who could write!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, so your dad is like famous or something?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I guess you could say that… He has sold over a million books worldwide and sponsored a lot of other independent authors as well.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, so that explains why you’re so rich, Felix!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Why did you join Camp Buddy, anyway? Someone like you should be in some kind of prestigious summer class, right?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Well… I was always bullied at school for getting special treatment from the teachers, even though I went to an exclusive private school…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: My dad thought it was best to have private tutors come over, so I’ve been taught at home for a really long time.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I got so used to staying at home that I didn’t even go outside anymore… It made my dad worry so much that he thought he might have been depriving me of any fun.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: That’s when he came across an online article about this place and asked me if I wanted to spend my summer vacation here.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I thought trying something new like this may not be so bad, so I agreed to do it.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: However, I tried to keep my family profile a secret since I didn’t want the same thing that happened to me at school to happen here…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh… Are you sure it’s alright for you to tell us all of this, Felix?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: It’s okay. You guys are my friends. Even if you did know, I don’t think it would have changed the way you see me.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I’m just happy to get the same treatment as everyone else and finally feel like a normal person.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha! It must be really nice living the dream life though, Felix! You get to have whatever you want, anytime you want it!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: That’s not true, Hiro… I never had real friends until I met all of you guys…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I know I’m not good at socializing… And on top of that I know I was obnoxious at first, complaining about almost everything…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: If it were any other people, they would’ve left me right away. In fact, the people who stuck around me back then were only after my money…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Well… my father’s money…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: But like I said..! Everything is different here! I couldn’t really ask for more.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so glad that you think that way, Felix! All of us learned a lot from each other here!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: You’re right. That’s why I thought my dad should really see this place for himself!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: He needs to see just how good of an investment Camp Buddy can be!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ehh…? What do you mean, Felix?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Well… When everyone was busy with the fundraising and advertisement campaign, I wanted to help out in any way I could too…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I know the campaign was successful, but I still didn’t want to leave the camp without helping…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I explained the situation to my dad and asked him if he could help out the camp financially…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: You did what?!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s unbelievable, Felix..! Did you tell the scoutmasters about this yet?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I haven’t yet… I didn’t have enough time to explain it fully to Sir Goro before.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: That’s why I’m really worried about my dad’s visit. I wanted to impress him enough to persuade him to sponsor the camp.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh wow, Felix, that’s great news! I’m sure the scoutmasters will impress him!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Let’s just hope we don’t run into any trouble…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I-I… I can’t believe this! I can’t believe HE is actually going to visit our camp!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: D-Dad! Calm down! Tell us what’s going on first!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yeah, sir. I haven’t seen you this excited in a long time.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Aiden
text: Sheesh, Gramps! Is that guy like a supermodel or something?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Weren’t you three listening? Mr. William Clermont will be visiting the camp!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: W-What?! The ‘Sir William Clermont’?!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I’m sorry, but I’m not following. Who is this William Clermont?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: He’s an award-winning novel author and publisher! And if I’m not mistaken, he’s also one of the top ten wealthiest personalities in the world!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: My dad is an absolute, die-hard fan of Mr. Clermont!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: Actually, I have to say, his works are really top-notch! I’ve read most of them from Dad’s collection!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Are you sure this is the same person, sir?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I’m definitely sure! I pulled up our records and it seems that Mr. Clermont’s only son is enrolled in this batch!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! You mean Felix?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: That’s right!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: Hmm… That explains why Felix seems to be new to everything that’s going on around here…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: I wonder why someone so wealthy would send their only son to such a run-down camp like this, though?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To be fair, the camp had a great reputation up until last year! We’ve been an outstanding, model summer camp for the last two decades!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can understand Mr. Clermont entrusting his son to us! But what I’m not sure of is why he would want to visit us.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I’m not sure either, but it doesn’t matter! I get to finally meet Mr. Clermont in person!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: Don’t get your hopes up too much, Dad. He’s probably here to visit his son, not the camp.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I might actually get him to sign my collection of his books while he’s here!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I’ve actually just bought and finished his newest work!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Aiden
text: Relax, Gramps!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Aiden
text: Now we know where Yuri's obsession over things came from…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I guess you could say that, Aiden.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Anyway! Let’s make sure the entire camp is spotless and everything is in order before he arrives!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: We have to make sure and impress him!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! There they are!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oi, Frogboy, Torch-head! We’re over here!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: We got you two some lunch. Sorry, it’s gotten a bit cold already…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Hunter! Thank you!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: You two woke up later than usual!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: Heh! They were probably fooling around in the cabin since no one else was around!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh shut up, Wolfboy! We’re not as wild as you!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: We actually got caught up helping Felix on our way here.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, did he run into trouble?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Nothing like that. He was just waiting for his dad to show up.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: His dad is going to visit the camp?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah. We actually visited the scoutmasters with him to let them know about the visit.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Apparently, his dad wants to check out our camp before this season ends!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: Huh? Why would he wanna come here out of the blue?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Felix told us about his dad planning to do some investment thingy in Camp Buddy. Who knows, maybe Felix’s dad could really help the camp with its money problems!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Whoa! Really?! Just who is Felix’s dad anyways?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, Mr. Clermont is one of the best-selling authors around the world. He’s a billionaire.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-How could you say that with a straight face?!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: W-What? I never knew…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: How did you know about that, Hunter? Did Felix tell you before?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: No. I’ve known about it since I heard Felix’s last name. I’ve read some of his father’s books.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Now, everything about Felix makes sense…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: We all knew he was rich. But not this rich!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s great news that his father is a potential investor, though. If he offers a sponsorship, that would probably help liquidate all the camp’s financial liabilities.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: There we go again. Spouting business words that only you guys can understand.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Heh~ I know, right Wolfboy? Let’s just pretend we understand! Haha!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hahaha! All Hunter is saying is that we could really use the help Felix’s dad can give if he sees Camp Buddy as a worthwhile investment.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m not sure why Mr. Clermont would think otherwise! Camp Buddy is a great place after all!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: Do the scoutmasters know about this already?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t think so, but it shouldn’t matter! They treat all visitors with the same amount of respect, no matter who they are!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: That’s right! Mr. Clermont can also see for himself just how friendly and well mannered the campers are!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: By the way, if you don’t mind me asking… What happened between you and Hiro yesterday…? We were really worried about the two of you…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh yeah… Hunter’s right! You two haven’t really told us anything! Now I’m really curious too!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Ahehe… Well… It’s kinda embarrassing…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Come on! You can tell us!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: K-Keitaro… help me out here, will you…?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ahh… Well…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hiro and I are kinda together now…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: *gasp*
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: No way! You two are finally official?!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: Why am I not surprised?
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m so happy for you two! We were so worried about the both of you yesterday… Looks like everything went well.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: We’ve been waiting for so long! So congratulations, you two!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-Thank you, everyone…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: You finally had the guts to confess, Torch-head!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Don’t say it out loud, Wolfboy… It’s embarrassing…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: I don’t mind if everyone knows about us, Hiro. I’m proud to be your boyfriend.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: This is so romantic! I’m so happy for the two of you!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah~ I wonder if I’ll ever find romance like this…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: I doubt that, Mr. Perfect. Unless you somehow find a way to hook up with a mop.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Maybe we should be together like them, Yoichi!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: EW! What the hell?! Get away from me!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Come on, Yoichi! Just a hug!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Yoichi
text: Don’t touch me, you weirdo! You’re creeping the hell out of me!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hunter
text: Rejected.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Hiro
text: Hahaha!!!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m so glad my friends are so supportive of me and Hiro.{/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I’m really going to miss everyone here and the good times we spent together.{/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Oh, and speaking of good times… I should really update my journal! I don’t think I’ll have any other day to write an entry! {/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go! I’ve finished updating my journal!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I can’t believe that this new journal is almost full as well.){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(When I first came to Camp Buddy, the only thing on my mind was to make as many great memories as possible.){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I wanted to keep those memories forever with the pictures I took and everything I wrote in my journal.){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But when my first journal was ruined, I thought the memories I tried to preserve were gone as well.){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I was wrong.){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Everyone put their heart into making this new journal. It’s proof that all the times we spent together were remembered and always will be.){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that all of this happened in just the one month I’ve been staying here.){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(And now that there’s just a day left before the camp ends…){/i}
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Phew…! I guess I’m thinking about this a lot more than I should.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: And here’s one of the lodging cabins for our campers!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Complete with all basic facilities every camper needs and always well maintained!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: William
text: Interesting. It seems like everything is in good shape around here.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Yes, indeed! Ahaha…
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Oh, Keitaro! You’re here!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah..!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Dad! I’d like you to meet Keitaro! He’s one of my friends that I told you about!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! It’s nice to meet you, Mr. Clermont!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: William
text: Ah, Keitaro! I’ve heard a lot of stories about you.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: Keitaro here is like a leader among us! I can safely say that, if it weren’t for him, I wouldn’t be so close with everyone else!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah, Felix. It’s not like that, really...
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I really want to be like Keitaro, Dad! He listens to everyone’s opinions and always tries to understand his fellow campers!
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I can’t help but agree with you, Felix. Keitaro here is a shining example of the spirit of this camp.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: William
text: I can see that. I’ve never seen my son introduce someone with such confidence.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: William
text: Keitaro, please accept my personal gratitude for being a true friend to my son.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Aah… You’re welcome, sir. But really, I can’t take all the credit.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Here at Camp Buddy, we all work together, scoutmasters and scouts alike.
label: day34_hiroge

speaker: William
text: Hahaha! I admire your humility!

label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hahaha! I can tell! You’re as red as a tomato!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But you know, Keitaro… you really are one of the best things that’s ever happened to me.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: And I promise I’ll always take care of you!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: *kisses Keitaro's lips*
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ahh…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! Now, you’re the one who’s all red, Keitaro!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: T-That’s because you kissed me out of nowhere! Someone could’ve seen us…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m just so glad that you chose me~ And I want the world to know that!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Stop it, Natsumi! That’s so cheesy...
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hahaha!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, look at you two lovebirds~ Just can’t keep yourselves from each other, huh?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: S-Sir Aiden!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: You two have been all over each other nonstop for the past couple of weeks. Does this mean things are finally official now?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: A-Ah…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, sir! Keitaro here is my boyfriend now!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wah, Natsumi! You didn’t have to say that out loud…!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Why not, dude? You should be happy that Natsumi here is proud of you two!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: *sigh* Unlike a certain someone that I’ve been trying to chase after.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! You have a special someone too, Sir Aiden?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: E-Eh…? Who’s that?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, it’s actually someone that you guys already know~ Someone you might have seen me sticking pretty close to the entire term.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I think I have an idea who it is… He’s a scoutmaster too, right?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! Is it-?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Yup! It’s none other than Mr. Sheriff Brokeback~! Or at least that’s what Yoichi calls him! Hahaha!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! It finally makes sense! That’s why you and Scoutmaster Yoshi have been so close all this time!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That’s amazing, Sir Aiden! I'm sure you guys would make a great couple!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Honestly... he’s not really a ‘boyfriend’ yet. But I am trying to get him there, ya know!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: I’m always making moves on him, but sometimes… I just wish he’d do the same! I guess he already knows but just doesn't want to put any labels on us.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: I’m ready to take it to the next level, but he’s just too busy to even notice!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: That’s why you two are so lucky to be where you are now!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hehe, thank you sir… I’m glad that you’re so supportive of us.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Of course! Ever since you and Keitaro got close, you’ve changed a lot for the better, dude!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: You’ve learned how to relax, how to stand up for what’s right, and how to stop being so hard on yourself!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I owe it to you for teaching me, sir! You’ve been an inspiration of how a real scoutmaster should be! I hope one day I’ll be as great as you!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Aww, you flatter me too much, Natsumi~ But I’m really glad I was able to influence you like that!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Like I told you back at the beach, it just makes me happy to know that I helped other people out.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, sir! I finally understand why you love your job so much!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: From now on, I’ll work hard to make sure I make the people around me happy and of course do things out of love!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Now you got it, Natsumi!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: That’s why this job is more fulfilling than anything else I can think of.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, that reminds me, sir – didn’t you tell us that you were just here to save enough money for your studies at the start of the year, sir?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Well, I was, but now that I’ve been promoted to scoutmaster, I don’t think there’s any reason for that now.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: I’ve already got my dream job!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so happy for you, sir!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Anyway, I’ve taken enough of you guys’ time. I still gotta finish preparing the rest of our meal too after all~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Congrats again on being an official couple, you two! I’m looking forward to seeing you both at camp again next year!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Thanks again, Sir Aiden!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: And, before I go, Keitaro~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Really proud of you for being able to handle something so long…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Must’ve felt reaaaaaal nice, huh?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: W-Wah!!!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Hahaha! Seeya!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hnnn… Sir Aiden sure knows what to say to tease me, huh?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m just so happy we can be so open with him about these things!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I guess you’re right… But it’s still a little embarrassing…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Hey there, you two! Am I interrupting something?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: N-No, of course not, Seto!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, Keitaro and I were just talking a little bit~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: I figured, haha! I’m gonna miss hanging around the two of you after today…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Hard to believe the camp term’s already over, huh?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, this year went by really quickly, much faster than the ones before!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Do you think you’ll be joining again next year, Seto? I know both Natsumi and I are!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Hmmm, not too sure… It’ll really depend on my parents.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: It was actually by accident that I came here thanks to my brother, but I’m glad I did!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: If you guys want, I can give you guys my contact info and my address. We can totally hang out after camp.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That sounds great, Seto!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Awesome! We can even head over to my school – they have a really fancy sports complex, with a huge pool!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, so that must mean your school has a really successful swim team then, Seto!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Yeah! I think they made it all the way to some national competition last year.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, does that mean you weren’t on the swim team then, Seto?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Nope, not yet at least! I only swim for fun, but thanks to all the time I spent swimming with Natsumi here, I’m gonna try to make it more than that!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: That sounds great, Seto! Maybe we’ll see each other in competitions since I’m on the team at my school as well!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Haha, I hope so! Gotta say I can’t wait for another rematch!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: I wanna make sure I practice so that I can actually keep up with you next time, haha!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, I don’t think that’s going to be a problem, Seto. You’re already way faster than you think you are!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Even at the sportsfest, it took all my effort to win.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But don’t think that means that I’ll stop improving! I don’t want to lose to you either, after all!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Haha, sounds great, dude! I can’t wait~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Anyway, I guess I’d better get back to Felix before he comes looking for me – I wanna give him my contact info too before it’s too late.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Thanks again for all the good times this summer, guys! I’m really glad I came!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww, same here, Seto! See you later~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Bye~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s really nice to see Seto like that. When he first came to camp, he would keep to himself and his music or games.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: And now, he’s planning to be an athlete! Who knew?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hehe, I think that’s thanks to you, Natsumi. Seto just needed a rival to compete with and get him fired up.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I hope he does end up joining his swim team and compete with you!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Me too, Keitaro!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, isn’t that Hunter over there? What’s he doing?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: It looks like he’s drawing again. He must have wanted to sketch something out here while it’s still light out!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Let’s go catch up to him!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hey, Hunter! What are you drawing?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh, hey guys~ I was just sketching the sunset!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I wanted something to remember the last day of the trip by, so I thought it would be fun to sketch this!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Besides, I can show it to my parents when I tell them about camp!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m so excited when they see how much I’ve changed since camp started, I’ll be able to tell them all about the stories of what happened this year.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! I just had an idea! Why don’t we take a picture of the three of us together?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Then you can show your parents your new friends!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: O-Oh, are you sure you don’t mind, Keitaro?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, of course not, Hunter! I’ve already taken plenty of pictures for myself. I’d be happier if you were in more of them.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Alright, let’s do it then!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Say cheese!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: There we go~ What a great shot!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Aww, we look so cute together!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m gonna miss having you two around all the time!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I really hope my parents end up working in this country again next summer.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m sure they’ll consider letting you enroll back here after they see just how much you’ve come out of your shell!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Well, I kinda owe it to you guys for helping me.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: You two were like the big brothers I never had.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Aww, I’d be glad to have you as my little brother, Hunter!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh! And speaking of brothers, I’m really happy for you and Mr. Naoto!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m really looking forward to seeing you two together next term!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: And if you’re still planning to be a scoutmaster, Natsumi, you know I totally support that!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Thank you, Hunter! I promise I’ll work hard to earn that one day!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: A-Anyway, I think I'll head over to the other side of the campsite - it has the perfect angle for this drawing! Do you guys mind?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, not at all! Here’s the picture, Hunter! I don’t wanna forget to give it to you!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Thanks again, Keitaro~ And thanks for all the fun this summer, guys.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll see you both at dinner!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure thing! Bye, Hunter!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow, Hunter has gotten a lot more confident since camp started, hasn’t he?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah… I’m really happy to see how much he’s changed.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well, we all did change for the better this summer~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: *ahem* Excuse me, boys?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Oh, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Is it time to gather for dinner, sir? I can gather the other scouts-
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: A-Ah, no, not yet, Natsumi!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I actually just wanted to speak with you for a moment before this camp term officially ends.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, about what, sir?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s about what you asked me a few days ago. When you told me that you wanted to be a scoutmaster and when I told you that… umm…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah! I definitely understand what you meant that time now, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: There was a perfectly good reason I wasn’t ready to be a scoutmaster yet.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: My intentions that time weren’t in line for the vision Camp Buddy had.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: To think I’ve been here in camp for years and haven’t taken that into heart is proof enough that I still have plenty to learn, sir.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah… well, it looks like you took the words right out of my mouth.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You are definitely right about what you just said. But that doesn’t mean you won’t be able to learn these things in time.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want you to know that I’ll always be here as your scoutmaster, and your counselor for whatever I can help you with.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: The door to opportunity for you to become a scoutmaster yourself will never close.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Thank you so much for being my guide this whole time, sir…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: You and Keitaro were the reason I grew so much in my stay here…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I promise to always keep striving hard to be a better scout, a better friend, and a better person!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You don’t know how proud I am to hear that from you, Natsumi.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And for that, I’d like you to have this…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: A badge…?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s not just any badge, Natsumi. It’s a one-of-a-kind special token of my appreciation for you.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Throughout the years, you have been the most diligent, most considerate, and most reliable scout this camp has ever seen.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Even though this place has gone through a lot of obstacles, you’ve always stayed the same.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And during this term, you’ve only gotten better in ways I never expected.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s why you, in your own special way, will always be the best scout I’ve ever had.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: T-Thank you so much, Scoutmaster Yoshi…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: This means so much to me!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s my pleasure, Natsumi. I hope you wear it with pride by the next summer term!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, sir!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now, let’s head over to everyone else by the campfire! They’re waiting for us!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh, there you two are!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah, Scoutmaster Yoshi! Is it time for dinner?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Yes, let’s head over to everyone else by the campfire! They’re waiting for us!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}As soon as Scoutmaster Yoshi gathered everyone for dinner, our whole night turned into a huge party.{/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Everyone was having fun, playing games and enjoying food, and talking about all the good times we shared together here at Camp Buddy. {/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I couldn’t help but wish the day would never end.{/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Fwaah… I’m so full…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: Me too… I can’t believe we ran out of marshmallows…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! That’s because Yoichi here ate around five bags of them!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Psh! Says the guy who kept serving me and everyone food!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Isn’t this exactly like our first outdoor camping trip together?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha! Yeah, you’re right! Except this time Keitaro was taking photos like crazy!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: My camera’s battery is almost empty, and I only have one roll of film left after all the pictures I took tonight!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Taiga
text: You’re gonna need another journal for all those new pictures then, Keitaro!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! You’re right, Taiga! It was just so fun getting to hang out with you guys.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: Hehe~ It was pretty good while it lasted, huh?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I have no regrets about joining this camp.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* I can’t believe this really is our last night together at Camp Buddy…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: I know this sounds corny, but I can say for sure this was the best summer I’ve ever had.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: If it weren’t for this place, I wouldn’t have met all of you…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Lee
text: Precisely! I have never experienced such companionship until today!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Eduard
text: Only in here have I felt accepted for everything that I am.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Taiga
text: Even if things started out really bumpy, it all turned out better than I could ever have hoped for.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: This is where I really belong… A place where everyone appreciates and cares for each other…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I can’t help but be grateful for all the friends I’ve made here.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: So, this is what it feels like to have a real family…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: We’ve gone through so much together. And it all made us grow for the better.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Everyone…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww… Look at our boys. They’re really going to miss each other. It’s so sweet…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: I’m in tears over the bond that everyone has created here at the camp!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: But let’s all remember the third Buddy Law!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: A buddy always shows a bright smile on his face~
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know this night has passed by quicker than we all thought.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But we saw that all of you were making the most out of this day, talking to each other, and having fun together as a big family.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can’t help but feel a little sad too, knowing that it’s not certain that all of us will meet one another in the near future.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But then again, I feel happy thanks to all the time we’ve all spent together here, and I’m excited for what lies ahead for each of us, and for Camp Buddy.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem… May I have a word?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Our farewell isn’t the only reason why we have celebrated like this.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m very excited to announce to everyone that Camp Buddy has found a new investor!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: In other words, our camp has been sponsored for many years to come! Camp Buddy will be standing stronger than ever!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yuri
text: Congratulations to us for a very successful term!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: I was barely holding myself back from spilling the beans this morning!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Aiden
text: Yoshi here knew you guys would feel sad once the party was over, so he saved you all this last bit of great news to cheer you all up!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: We know this may sound sudden, and most of you might be wondering how this is all possible.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Our investor, Clermont Media Incorporated, saw the potential of the camp through this year’s batch of campers!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s desire to keep this home alive, were all discovered by our investor through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Goro
text: Mr. Nagame. I believe this belongs to you.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hiro
text: This is so unreal, Keitaro!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Hunter
text: I... I can’t believe it either…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t get over the fact that Camp Buddy has finally found a sponsor...!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not only that, Keitaro here is gonna be popular too! Haha!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s really great news..!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Eduard
text: Just how did this happen?!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Lee
text: Hold on… Isn’t Clermont Felix’s family name?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Seto
text: O-Oh! That’s right! Don’t tell me it was your dad who invested in Camp Buddy, Felix?!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: I-I didn’t know he already did it… I only had him visit the camp yesterday to see if it could be sponsored…
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Felix
text: He didn’t tell me he actually went through with it… I can’t believe that my dad has already read through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Taiga
text: Keitaro, you saved the camp..!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That journal was something that all of us made.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s all thanks to the great memories we’ve shared together!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It was truly an unbelievable thing to happen, especially on our last day.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And adding to that, the founder of Clermont Media has made plans to publish a new book inspired from the story of this year’s batch.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We were sent a letter requesting the author’s approval.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So what do you say, Keitaro?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I say yes, sir! I want the world to know that Camp Buddy is an amazing home for everyone!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You really are an amazing person, Keitaro.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want to express my sincere gratitude for reminding your scoutmasters and showing your fellow campers what this place is truly about.
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To celebrate this last moment and lighten your spirits up, how about we gather around once more and have a little campfire song?
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I believe it’ll be a moment we can all remember!
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’ve come a long way since I joined Camp Buddy and met Natsumi.){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Remembering all of the events that happened during my stay here… it all feels just like yesterday.){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Making new friends… Going out on adventures… Doing exciting camp activities… Celebrating and bonding like one big family… ){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(After everything Natsumi and I had gone through this term, we always made sure to be there for each other.){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that our relationship would reach a point where we would confess our love for each other…){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(It's amazing what can happen in such a short period of time.){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I used to feel afraid when I thought that I could forget all of these things in the future…){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But this place has made me realize that what's truly important, is enjoying every moment to the fullest with people you love and care for.){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Even without all the pictures I've taken, I don't think I can ever forget everything that's happened.){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I know that all of the memories I’ve shared with Natsumi and everyone else at Camp Buddy will always be in my heart!){/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It feels bittersweet to say goodbye to everyone. Especially to Natsumi.{/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s true that all good things come to an end.{/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I now accept that.{/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Because I know that in the end will always be a new beginning.{/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}A brand new chance to make even more great memories!{/i}
label: day34_natsumige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I just finished cleaning up over here, Naoto!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Great! I’m just about finished here too!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Okay! Let me help you!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Ahh~ It’s such a nice day out! No wonder why you like this place so much.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah. It’s really peaceful here in the morning~
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I guess we should enjoy it before things get too lively again later~! This is the last day of the term, after all.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: A lot sure has happened in the few weeks I’ve been here… I gotta say, I’m really gonna miss all this!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I bet you’re gonna miss it a lot more, though. You have been here a lot longer than I have.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, yeah. But it’s not like we’re not coming back next summer!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: You’ve got a point. I’m sure it’ll be summer again before we know it.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: By the way, Natsumi, any plans after camp? Or are you just gonna head back home like usual?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I mean, I guess I’ve still got school after all this too.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Oh, right. You still got studies to worry about, haha!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: How about you? I guess you’ll be going back to your old jobs, right?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Well, I’ve been thinking about it… And I’ve gotta say, Camp Buddy’s been a really unique experience for me.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: It’s been so refreshing here, and the thought of going back to my other jobs… actually feels kinda weird in a way, haha!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I guess I’ll just focus on what I’ve got here in camp, even during the off-season. Just laying low for now, you know?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: And maybe spending a lot more time with my li’l bro! I mean, it’s been so long since we last hung out together, right?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yeah, I remember how much fun we used to have playing together.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Oh! Tell you what, why don’t we go out for a vacation trip one of these days?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Ah, I remember when we used to go to the beach and just swim the day away…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Those were great times~!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: That actually sounds really nice, Naoto! I’m always up for a swim!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Haha, I guess some things never change. You always did love the water~
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Then I guess it’s a deal!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: We’re definitely gonna go swimming after the term ends and before your school year begins! You leave all the planning to me.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Sure, Naoto! I’m looking forward to it!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! You guys are up early today!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Haha, yeah! Natsumi and I are just about done with our morning chores, Yoshi.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Guess there’s no stopping you brothers from being the most reliable boys here, huh?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I sure hope we can find more people like you to help around the camp for the next term!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, before I forget, Scoutmaster Yoshi… are we going to have an activity for our last day in camp today?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Actually, we do! I was on my way to wake the scouts up for that very announcement, Natsumi.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s something quite big, and I hope you’re all excited for it.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: In that case, I’ll head to the cabins and wake the scouts!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: You can leave Cabin One to me, big bro! I can take care of them!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s really helpful, you two! Tell everyone to be in their uniforms and assemble here in the campgrounds! I’ll gather the other scoutmasters here as well!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Looks like you three are already awake!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hehe~ I guess we were all excited, Natsumi. It’s the last day of camp!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I was about to wake you guys up and ask you to prepare for an announcement.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, there’s another announcement, Natsumi?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: We’re not getting another scoutmaster again, are we?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, I’m sure it’s nothing like that!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi told me it was for a big activity! So, you guys better get ready~
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: If it’s anything like the announcement the day before, I’m actually really curious to see what it is!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Ugh… Even on the last day, you guys won’t give me a break in the morning, will you?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Wow! You were already awake too, Yoichi? That’s surprising!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Looks like everyone is really excited for our last day together.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! That’s right, Hunter!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I wish I’d always woken up this early. I can’t believe how much stuff in the morning I’ve been missing because of my sleeping habits.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Don’t worry, Keitaro! Nothing much happens this early, anyways!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Well, other than Natsumi doing chores and stuff… You know, the usual! Haha!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Alright, guys! I think you should—
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, yeah, we know already! I’ll go take a bath.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hahaha! It’s one surprise after the other from Yoichi today!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess he’s just as excited as we are.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: What are we waiting for then? Let’s go!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m really, really excited for today’s announcement!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: I sure hope it’s something awesome for our last day!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh. Does Camp Buddy have some kind of tradition for the end of the term?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! Yeah! The one where they send the campers back to their homes once this is all over!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, I guess they’re taking things up a notch this time, Yoichi.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: Are you guys excited for today’s activity?!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! Good morning, Taiga!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Wait a minute. Did you just say ‘activity’?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah! I heard from the scoutmasters that we’re doing something away from the camp today!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: Away from the camp? You mean like a camping trip?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: That doesn’t sound right… The scoutmasters usually tell us ahead of time if we’re going on an outdoor camping trip to give us time to prepare.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: Well, it’s what I heard.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Eduard
text: Aren’t you all excited? They might bring us somewhere fancy like a theater or an opera house! That would be soooooo lovely~
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Lee
text: I prefer going to someplace educational like a science emporium or a planetarium!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh god, please no. Both of those ideas will literally kill me.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Seto
text: I bet we’re going somewhere cool like a gaming convention!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: It’d be nice if we can have a stay-cation in a five-star hotel. I know a good place.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh hi, Seto and Felix!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Seto
text: Hehe! I guess you guys are just as curious as us about this ‘special event!’
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: I know, right?! I know they’re up to something!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don’t think the scoutmasters would do anything that involves too much work since this is our last day.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: Either way, if it’s alright, I really want to spend this last day with you guys…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, we’d love to! Isn’t that right, everyone?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s still so hard to believe how much Taiga has changed these past few days.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: Don’t get me wrong… I’m still embarrassed about everything bad I’ve done…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh come on, Taiga, we’ve been telling you over and over - that’s all in the past!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m really thankful you all chose to see through my mistakes.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: What the hell, man?! Don’t tell me you’re gonna keep moping about that on our last day?!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! Yoichi’s right, Taiga! It’s best to use this chance to have fun together, as friends!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Eduard
text: Oh dear~ Hearing that all of us are besties now is like a dream come true!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Lee
text: I never thought we’d be able to truly unite this summer.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Seto
text: Well, if you guys hadn’t made it so hard at the beginning, we would have all been buddies from day one!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: I guess things really were just meant to happen this way.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: What matters is that everything’s okay now!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Attention!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! The scoutmasters are ready to make the announcement! Line up, everyone!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, everyone!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp! That also means that we don't really know if we'll see each other again next year.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir, if you will?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Right! Ehem…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: So as a means of showing our gratitude, we’ve prepared a final activity for all of you!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, dear?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, yes! We will be going back to our roots! We’re going to have a little bonfire party!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: We’ll take a short hike to get to the location, and then be all together like one, big, happy family!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: You can say that this is more of a farewell party!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: It’s been a while since we’ve held an outdoor activity together without worrying about anything, after all!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: And you guys don’t have to worry about the food we’re having either!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Aiden
text: I got that all prepped up! All you have to bring is yourselves!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yuri
text: We hope that this little event will mean as much to everyone as it means to us, your scoutmasters!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It's unfortunate to know we'll all be parting ways tomorrow with no guarantee that we'll see each other again...
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But what truly matters most is that we create the greatest memories we can possibly make here and now!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now follow me, campers!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can’t believe this! We’re really having a big party before camp ends!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmm…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-Huh? W-What’s with that stare, Torch-head? Why are you looking at me like that?!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Isn’t this the part where you’ll say: “Oh great! Another lame camping trip! I thought it was something blah blah blah!”
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hahaha! That’s so accurate, Hiro! I was waiting for Yoichi to say that too!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey! I wasn’t gonna say anything like that!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess Yoichi has changed too after all.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph! You guys are always making me sound like the bad guy!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! We’re just kidding, Yoichi!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I have to say, I’m really surprised that the scoutmasters prepared something extra special before we all go our separate ways.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Seto
text: It’s nice to know we don’t have to do a thing but enjoy the party today!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: I don’t feel like we deserve this much from them…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Seto
text: Of course we do, dude! We all love this place, and we worked together to keep it running!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Felix
text: That’s right. Now we can just appreciate this event and have fun together with the time we have left.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Eduard
text: Oh my gosh! I just remembered! If this is going to be an outdoor party, I have to bring my oil cleanse, hydrating face masks, my makeup kit… Oh! And my firming body lotion too!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Lee
text: Why would you need all of that, Ed?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, duh! I have to take care of my fabulous face~
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Taiga
text: We don’t have the time for that, you two. Everyone’s already heading to the entrance arch to leave.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hunter
text: O-Oh! Taiga’s right! We should go now!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright, guys! Let’s go!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Natsumi? Aren’t you coming along?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hmmm… I was just wondering if my brother was going to come along.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, you’re right. Come to think of it, I didn’t see him with the scoutmasters either.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Hey, you two! What are you still doing here?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Everyone’s already heading out the entrance!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Ah, Naoto! Aren’t you coming with us?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: That’s alright, Natsumi! I talked to Yoshi and asked if I could just stay here and watch over the camp.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: What? Why?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Well, since this is your last day, I really want to make this special for you and for your friends.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: And I’m doing that by giving you the space you need for this last activity, Natsumi!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Besides, we’ll have lots of time to spend together after the camp, unlike your friends and scoutmasters who only have you for this last day!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: A-Are you sure about this?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: I’m positive! I mean, somebody has to watch over the camp while everyone else is gone, right? And I did say I can handle whatever you throw at me!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha, that is true.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Now, hurry and catch up with the everyone!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: R-Right! I’ll go on ahead, Naoto!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: See you later, Naoto! We’ll be back soon!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Naoto
text: Of course! Enjoy, you guys!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Alright! Everyone’s here!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Remember! Just follow your scoutmasters until we reach our destination!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Our last adventure of the summer begins!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: One, two, three, MARCH!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Gotta take plenty of pictures while we’re still all together!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: GAH! Would you stop that, Frogboy?! You’re gonna blind me with all those flashes!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Hahaha! Let him be, Wolfboy! You know how much Keitaro loves taking pictures!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Eduard
text: Yoohoo, Keitaro~ Your model’s over here!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh yeah! I don’t have any pictures of you yet, Eduard!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Eduard
text: You’re like totally missing out then~ Go ahead. I’ll bring it to the runway~
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Eduard

speaker: Seto
text: Bye~

text: And now, he’s planning to be an athlete! Who knew?

text: Hehe, I think that’s thanks to you, Natsumi. Seto just needed a rival to compete with and get him fired up.

text: Me too, Keitaro!

text: Let’s go catch up to him!

text: Hey, Hunter! What are you drawing?

speaker: Hunter

text: Oh! I just had an idea! Why don’t we take a picture of the three of us together?

label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Say cheese!
label: day34_natsumipe

text: There we go~ What a great shot!

speaker: Hunter

speaker: Hunter
text: I really hope my parents end up working in this country again next summer.

text: Ah! I definitely understand what you meant that time now, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
