speaker: Natsumi
text: My intentions that time weren’t in line for the vision Camp Buddy had.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: To think I’ve been here in camp for years and haven’t taken that into heart is proof enough that I still have plenty to learn, sir.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Ah… well, it looks like you took the words right out of my mouth.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You are definitely right about what you just said. But that doesn’t mean you won’t be able to learn these things in time.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want you to know that I’ll always be here as your scoutmaster, and your counselor for whatever I can help you with.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: The door to opportunity for you to become a scoutmaster yourself will never close.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Thank you so much for being my guide this whole time, sir…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: You and Keitaro were the reason I grew so much in my stay here…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I promise to always keep striving hard to be a better scout, a better friend, and a better person!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You don’t know how proud I am to hear that from you, Natsumi.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And for that, I’d like you to have this…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: A badge…?
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s not just any badge, Natsumi. It’s a one-of-a-kind special token of my appreciation for you.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Throughout the years, you have been the most diligent, most considerate, and most reliable scout this camp has ever seen.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Even though this place has gone through a lot of obstacles, you’ve always stayed the same.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And during this term, you’ve only gotten better in ways I never expected.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: That’s why you, in your own special way, will always be the best scout I’ve ever had.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: T-Thank you so much, Scoutmaster Yoshi…
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: This means so much to me!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s my pleasure, Natsumi. I hope you wear it with pride by the next summer term!
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: Yes, sir!

speaker: Yuri

text: I know this night has passed by quicker than we all thought.

text: But we saw that all of you were making the most out of this day, talking to each other, and having fun together as a big family.

text: I can’t help but feel a little sad too, knowing that it’s not certain that all of us will meet one another in the near future.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But then again, I feel happy thanks to all the time we’ve all spent together here, and I’m excited for what lies ahead for each of us, and for Camp Buddy.

text: Ehem… May I have a word?

text: Our farewell isn’t the only reason why we have celebrated like this.

speaker: Goro
text: I’m very excited to announce to everyone that Camp Buddy has found a new investor!

speaker: Yoshinori
text: In other words, our camp has been sponsored for many years to come! Camp Buddy will be standing stronger than ever!

speaker: Yuri
text: Congratulations to us for a very successful term!

text: Yoshi here knew you guys would feel sad once the party was over, so he saved you all this last bit of great news to cheer you all up!

speaker: Goro
text: Our investor, Clermont Media Incorporated, saw the potential of the camp through this year’s batch of campers!

speaker: Goro

text: It’s all thanks to the great memories we’ve shared together!

text: It was truly an unbelievable thing to happen, especially on our last day.
label: day34_natsumipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We were sent a letter requesting the author’s approval.

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So what do you say, Keitaro?

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want to express my sincere gratitude for reminding your scoutmasters and showing your fellow campers what this place is truly about.
label: day34_natsumipe

text: To celebrate this last moment and lighten your spirits up, how about we gather around once more and have a little campfire song?

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I believe it’ll be a moment we can all remember!

text: Congratulations to us for a very successful term!

text: I guess it’s thanks to everyone that he decided to support us!

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m so excited! With Mr. Clermont’s help, Camp Buddy is really saved!
label: day34_taigage

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It was truly an unbelievable thing to happen, especially on our last day.
label: day34_taigage

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And adding to that, the founder of Clermont Media has made plans to publish a new book inspired from the story of this year’s batch.

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want to express my sincere gratitude for reminding your scoutmasters and showing your fellow campers what this place is truly about.
label: day34_taigage

text: To celebrate this last moment and lighten your spirits up, how about we gather around once more and have a little campfire song?

text: I believe it’ll be a moment we can all remember!

label: day34_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}A brand new chance to make even more great memories!{/i}
label: day34_taigape

speaker: Keitaro
text: Good morning, everyone!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! Yoichi, you’re up early again!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, I went to check on the puppies.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: How are they doing this morning?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, they’re sleeping, just like little angels.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! Looks like you two are awake as well!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: It’s really interesting to see you wake up so early, Yoichi~! Good for you!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: It can’t be helped, Natsumi. This is our last day at camp after all.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: And Yoichi has puppies to take care of now, too!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hnnn… what’s going on…?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: You’re up the latest. That’s what’s going on~!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Good morning, Hiro~! You still seem a little sleepy… Today’s our last day, so we have to make it count!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: H-Hey! You guys were the ones always waking up late all throughout camp!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Whatever, Hiro!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hngh… It still feels weird to hear Yoichi call me by my name…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Didn’t you do it just now, too?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: GAH! Why is this so weird?!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Wake up, scouts! It’s time for-
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Whoa! You’re all up already!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yes, sir!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hahaha! Perfect timing! I want you all to get into your uniforms! We’ll have everyone gather in the mess hall shortly!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Roger that!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Okay, guys! Let’s-
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yeah, yeah, we know already! I’ll go take a bath.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hahaha! It’s one surprise after the other from Yoichi today!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess he’s just as excited as we are.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: What are we waiting for then? Let’s go!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I wonder why the scoutmasters gathered us today.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Well, it’s our last day. Maybe they’ve planned something special!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Oh. Does Camp Buddy have some kind of tradition for the end of the term?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hah! Yeah! The one where they send the campers back to their homes once this is all over!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’m afraid Yoichi is right. It was just a regular day when the camp term ended last year.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Are you guys excited for today’s activity?!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! Good morning, Taiga!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Wait a minute. Did you just say ‘activity’?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Yeah! I heard from the scoutmasters that we’re doing something away from the camp today!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Away from the camp? You mean like a camping trip?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: That doesn’t sound right… The scoutmasters usually tell us ahead of time if we’re going on an outdoor camping trip to give us time to prepare.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Well, it’s what I heard.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Aren’t you all excited? They might bring us somewhere fancy like a theater or an opera house! That would be soooooo lovely~
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: I prefer going to someplace educational like a science emporium or a planetarium!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Oh god, please no. Both of those ideas will literally kill me.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Seto
text: I bet we’re going somewhere cool like a gaming convention!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: It’d be nice if we can have a stay-cation in a five-star hotel. I know a good place.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh hi, Seto and Felix!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Seto
text: Hehe! I guess you guys are just as curious as us about this ‘special event!’
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: I know, right?! I know they’re up to something!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don’t think the scoutmasters would do anything that needs too much work considering this is our last day.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Either way, if it’s alright, I really want to spend this last day with you guys…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, we’d love to! Isn’t that right, everyone?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: It’s still so hard to believe just how much Taiga has changed these past few days.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Don’t get me wrong… I’m still embarrassed about everything bad I’ve done…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Are you seriously still thinking about that, Dynamite?! We’ve told you a million times to forget about it!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m really thankful you all chose to see through my mistakes.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: What the hell, man?! Don’t tell me you’re gonna keep that drama up on our last day?!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! Yoichi’s right, Taiga! It’s best to use this chance to have fun together! As friends!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Oh dear~ Hearing that all of us are besties now is like a dream come true!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: I never thought we’d be able to truly unite this summer.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Seto
text: Well, if you guys hadn’t made it so hard at the beginning, we would have all been buddies from day one!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I guess things really were just meant to happen this way.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: What matters is that everything’s okay now!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Attention!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! The scoutmasters are ready to make the announcement! Line up, everyone!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, everyone!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp! And that partly means none of us really know if we’ll all see each other again next year.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir, if you will?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Right! Ehem…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: So as a means of showing our gratitude, we’ve prepared a final activity for all of you!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, dear?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, yes! We will be going back to our roots! We’re going to have a little bonfire party!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: We’ll take a short hike to get to the location, and then be all together like one, big, happy family!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: You can say that this is more of a farewell party!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: It’s been a while since we’ve held an outdoor activity together without worrying about anything, after all!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: And you guys don’t have to worry about anything, especially about the food we’re having there!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: I got that all prepped up! All you have to bring is yourselves!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: We hope that this little event will mean as much to everyone as it means to us, your scoutmasters!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Knowing we’ll all be parting ways tomorrow without the promise of seeing each other again is unfortunate…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But what truly matters most is that we create the greatest memories we can possibly make here and now!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now follow me, campers!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I can’t believe this! We’re really having a big party before camp ends!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hmm…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: H-Huh? W-What’s with that stare, Hiro? Why are you looking at me like that?!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Isn’t this the part where you’ll say: “Oh great! Another lame camping trip! I thought it was something blah blah blah!”
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Hahaha! That’s so on point, Hiro! I was waiting for Yoichi to say that too!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey! I wasn’t gonna say anything like that!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I guess Yoichi has changed too after all.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmph! You guys are always making me sound like the bad guy!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! We’re just kidding, Yoichi!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Though I’m worried about something…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: If we’re gonna go out, who’s gonna take care of the pups?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Actually, I was about to bring that up too, Yoichi...
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Based on what they said, it looks like the scoutmasters will be coming along.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Then let’s just bring the puppies with us!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: N-No way! They’re still too little! That’s gonna stress them out way too much!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Maybe we should ask Scoutmaster Yoshi about it! I’m sure he’s found a way to take care of them while we’re out.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I guess you’re right. I’ll go ask him before we leave. As long as they're fine, then I can party!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Speaking of which, I have to say, I’m really surprised that the scoutmasters prepared something extra special before we go our separate ways.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Seto
text: Nice to know we don’t have to do a thing but enjoy the party today!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: I don’t feel like we deserve this much from them…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Seto
text: Of course we do, dude! We all love this place, and we worked together to keep it running!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: That’s right. Now we can just appreciate this event and have fun together with the time we have left.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Oh my gosh! I just remembered! If this is going to be an outdoor party, I have to bring my oil cleanse, hydrating face masks, my makeup kit… Oh! And my firming body lotion too!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: Why would you need all of that, Ed?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, duh! I have to take care of my fabulous face~
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: We don’t have the time for that, you two. Everyone’s already heading to the entrance arch to leave.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: O-Oh! Taiga’s right! We should go now!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Alright, guys! Let’s go!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Alright! Everyone’s here!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Scoutmaster Yoshi! We wanted to ask you something before we go.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Haha, don’t worry about the puppies, you two! They’re being well taken care of tonight!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: W-Wha… We haven’t even said anything yet!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Well, I’m really trying my best to know you better, Yoichi! And like Keitaro said, you can be pretty predictable.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But listen to me when I say you have nothing to worry about~ The puppies are in good hands and being well taken care of.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And besides, we won’t be gone for long~ We’ll be back by nighttime!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: A-Are you sure…?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I promise! You can trust me, Yoichi!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: F-Fine…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now then! If you guys are all set, we can leave immediately!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Remember! Just follow your scoutmasters until we reach our destination!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Our last adventure of the summer begins!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: One, two, three, MARCH!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Gotta take plenty of pictures while we’re still all together!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: GAH! Enough with those flashes, Keitaro!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hahaha! Let him be, Wolfboy! You know how much Keitaro loves taking pictures!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Yoohoo, Keitaro~ Your model’s over here!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh yeah! I don’t have any pictures of you yet, Eduard!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: You’re like totally missing out then~ Go ahead. I’ll bring it to the runway~
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: I’m serving you that sassy but never shady, prim and preppy model scout look~
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: WORK.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: SLAY.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Lee~ I need my retouch please!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Brrrr… That Spaghetti-boy never fails to give me chills.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: *sigh* He’s always like this.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Oh come on, Eduard. You’re gonna have Keitaro run out of film with just pictures of you.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s alright, Taiga! I brought extra!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! I finally have a picture of you too, Taiga!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: W-What? You seriously don’t have a single picture of me?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha, I was too afraid to take a picture of you back then!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I was worried you might hit me if I tried.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: I-I wouldn’t go that far, you know…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Y-You can take as many pictures of me as you want anyway…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey, Keitaro! How about you take a picture of me and Natsumi together?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh sure thing, Hiro!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Aww~ Hiro! Now that you mentioned it, we really don’t have any pictures of just the two of us together!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: How about we get a hug shot? That would be so adorable!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Say cheese!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: What a good shot!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: Ahh… I just remembered the first time Keitaro hiked in the forest with us. He kept taking pictures just like this.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah! Except this time we’re with more people! Isn’t this fun?!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: *sigh*
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: What's with the sigh, Natsumi?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Ah… I was just thinking… I’m really going to miss all of this.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t believe this is the last time we’re all going to be together.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: To be honest, this has been the only camp term that I didn’t want to end.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Time flies when you’re having fun, after all.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Though I have to admit, it’ll be way more boring without you guys around.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh, that reminds me. What are you guys going to do after the camp?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I’ll probably fly back home with my parents and continue my studies.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Will you be able to come back next year, though?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I hope so. It all depends on my parents coming to work here again next summer.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I’m really going to miss all the fun I had here at Camp Buddy. It’s pretty quiet back at home, and I don’t really have friends there.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: So, I’ll do everything I can to convince them to let me come back.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: How about you, Natsumi?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I'll resume my studies as usual.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Unlike Hunter, I live pretty close to this area, so I can always pass by Camp Buddy whenever I’m heading to school.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Oh, good for you, Natsumi!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I’ll definitely miss all of you, though… I’ve never gotten this close to guys like you before.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: But I can’t say that I’ll be completely lonely. I have my big brother at home to hang out with!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: At least I’ll have him while you guys aren’t around.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: How about you, Keitaro?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Nothing special – I’ll just be going back to school!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Well, I guess most of us are just gonna do the same thing.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Same with me! I’ll be back at school, but I’ll probably swing by and hang out with Keitaro some, since he lives pretty close by!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, that’s cool! You guys should invite us to come over too when you hang out!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: If that’s the case, I should try to convince my parents to stay here longer so I can join you guys.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I bet it would be fun to spend time together outside of camp too!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Guess I’ll really be stuck here by myself without all of you guys around. I don’t have anywhere else to go, after all.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not that it’s a bad thing. I get to have free food here. And my puppies are here to keep me company.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Yoshi could always use some help with all the stuff for next year's batch, anyway.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: What?! You mean you live here at Camp Buddy?! How come you never told us that?!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Well, now you know. It’s no big deal.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh, now the reason you’re always enrolled here every year makes sense!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That actually had me a bit worried…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Maybe I could stay here during the off season too? To help take care of the puppies?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Don’t be stupid! I’m no baby! I know you have your own life out there to deal with!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: I’ll be fine here!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Instead of hanging around Hiro, you can just come here instead!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: Hey! Don’t listen to him, Keitaro!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: You know you’re not a prisoner here, Yoichi - you can always join us when we hang out too.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hmm… I’ve never really been invited to come and hang out before. That’s all pretty new to me.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: That sounded like something I would say…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: How about you three? You guys have been awfully quiet!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: A-Ah..! We’re just not used to being in a large group of friends like this.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: But we’re really enjoying listening to your stories. We never really got the chance to know about this stuff until now!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Don’t be shy! Tell us your plans for after camp too! We all want to hear them!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Well, if you insist~ I’ll be the one to go first~!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Lee and I actually go to the same school~ So, just like everybody else, we’ll be busy with all that again!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: But if you’re going to ask me personally, I wanna pursue my dream and try to join a modeling agency~!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: I wanna be proud of who I am, and I don’t care what anybody else thinks!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Soooo… Yeahhh… Wish me luck~
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: As for me, I’ve recently noticed that I’ve been focusing too much on my mental strength for the past few years.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: I realized that my physical well-being is just as important! So I’m planning to get myself into shape!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: I’ll definitely try to build my body to be big and strong just like Taiga!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Lee
text: With my intellectual prowess, I’m sure I’ll be able to create a fitness program that fits my capacity!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Wow! That’s really interesting, you guys! I hope it all goes well!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Thanks~

text: We’ve gone through so much together. And it all made us grow for the better.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: Everyone…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww… Look at our boys. They’re really going to miss each other. It’s so sweet…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: I’m in tears over the bond that everyone has created here at the camp!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: But let’s all remember the third Buddy Law!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: A buddy always shows a bright smile on his face~
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know this night has passed by quicker than we all thought.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But we saw that all of you were making the most out of this day, talking to each other, and having fun together as a big family.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can’t help but feel a little sad too, knowing that it’s not certain that all of us will meet one another in the near future.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But then again, I feel happy thanks to all the time we’ve all spent together here, and I’m excited for what lies ahead for each of us, and for Camp Buddy.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem… May I have a word?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Our farewell isn’t the only reason why we have celebrated like this.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: I’m very excited to announce to everyone that Camp Buddy has found a new investor!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: In other words, our camp has been sponsored for many years to come! Camp Buddy will be standing stronger than ever!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yuri
text: Congratulations to us for a very successful term!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: I was barely holding myself back from spilling the beans this morning!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Aiden
text: Yoshi here knew you guys would feel sad once the party was over, so he saved you all this last bit of great news to cheer you all up!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: We know this may sound sudden, and most of you might be wondering how this is all possible.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Our investor, Clermont Media Incorporated, saw the potential of the camp through this year’s batch of campers!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s desire to keep this home alive, were all discovered by our investor through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Goro
text: Mr. Nagame. I believe this belongs to you.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hiro
text: This is so unreal, Keitaro!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Hunter
text: I... I can’t believe it either…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t get over the fact that Camp Buddy has finally found a sponsor...!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not only that, Keitaro here is gonna be popular too! Haha!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s really great news..!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Eduard
text: Just how did this happen?!
label: day34_yoichige

text: Hold on… Isn’t Clermont Felix’s family name?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Seto
text: O-Oh! That’s right! Don’t tell me it was your dad who invested in Camp Buddy, Felix?!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: I-I didn’t know he already did it… I only had him visit the camp yesterday to see if it could be sponsored…
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Felix
text: He didn’t tell me he actually went through with it… I can’t believe that my dad has already read through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Taiga
text: Keitaro, you saved the camp..!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: That journal was something that all of us made.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s all thanks to the great memories we’ve shared together!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It was truly an unbelievable thing to happen, especially on our last day.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And adding to that, the founder of Clermont Media has made plans to publish a new book inspired from the story of this year’s batch.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We were sent a letter requesting the author’s approval.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So what do you say, Keitaro?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: I say yes, sir! I want the world to know that Camp Buddy is an amazing home for everyone!
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You really are an amazing person, Keitaro.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want to express my sincere gratitude for reminding your scoutmasters and showing your fellow campers what this place is truly about.
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To celebrate this last moment and lighten your spirits up, how about we gather around once more and have a little campfire song?
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I believe it’ll be a moment we can all remember!
label: day34_yoichige

text: {i}It feels bittersweet to say goodbye to everyone, especially Yoichi.{/i}

text: {i}It’s true that all good things come to an end.{/i}
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I now accept that.{/i}
label: day34_yoichige

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Because I know that in the end will always be a new beginning.{/i}

speaker: Lee

text: Good morning, everyone!

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp! And that partly means none of us really know if we’ll all see each other again next year.

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir, if you will?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Right! Ehem…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, dear?

speaker: Yuri

text: But it’s thanks to you that he’s so much more positive and open now!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro

label: day34_yoichipe

label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: GAH! Stop that, Keitaro! You know I don’t like this kind of corny crap!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Hahaha!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Anyway, I was thinking…
label: day34_yoichipe

text: Hmm? What is it, Yoichi?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: There’s something I gotta do…
label: day34_yoichipe

text: Huh, what do you mean?
label: day34_yoichipe

text: Just follow me…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: O-Okay…!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Hey! Yoshi!
label: day34_yoichipe

text: Oh, Yoichi? What brings you here? Are you hungry?
label: day34_yoichipe

text: Or is our last party getting a little too boring for you? Haha!
label: day34_yoichipe

text: *hugs Yoshinori*
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-Yoichi…?!
label: day34_yoichipe

text: T-Thank you… For everything…

speaker: Yoshinori
text: O-Oh…! For what, Yoichi?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Is your tummy upset? You’re acting rather unusual right now!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: S-Shut up and just listen to what I have to say, got that?!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: O-Of course, Yoichi… Here, I’m listening.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: You… *gulp*
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Y-You’ve really been there for me more than most people ever have…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: I really… I… I look up to you…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Y-Yoichi…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: It’s 'cuz of you that I got to know what it’s like to have a dad.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You’ve never said anything like this before…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: W-Well, don’t expect me to say that again! I-I just figured that… after everything that’s happened…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: GAH! You know what I’m trying to say!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I do, Yoichi. And I’m so glad to hear that from you.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It’s an absolute honor that you see me as your father!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Haha! So this is what having a son feels like!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Stop making this more cheesy than it already is, you old man!!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now you’re really making me feel old, hahaha!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Aww~ This is so precious…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not you too, Keitaro! And did you just take a picture?!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Yeah! You hugging Scoutmaster Yoshi is the cutest thing ever!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Oh! Please give me a copy, Keitaro! Something so rare might not ever happen again! Hahaha!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: *sigh* I give up. You two are the lamest guys ever.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Haha, now come on and let’s all go sit around the campfire together!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Let’s make this last night in Camp Buddy the best ever!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Hey there, you two! It’s already to time to gather up around the campfire! Everything is all set up!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Follow me!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}As soon as Scoutmaster Yoshi gathered everyone for dinner, our whole night turned into a huge party.{/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Everyone was having fun, playing games and enjoying food, and talking about all the good times we shared together here at Camp Buddy. {/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I couldn’t help but wish the day would never end.{/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Fwaah… I’m so full…
label: day34_yoichipe

text: Me too… I can’t believe we ran out of marshmallows…

label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Psh! Says the guy who kept serving me and everyone food!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Isn’t this exactly like our first outdoor camping trip together?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: Haha! Yeah, you’re right! Except this time Keitaro was taking photos like crazy!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: My camera’s battery is almost empty, and I only have one roll of film left after all the pictures I took tonight!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Taiga
text: You’re gonna need another journal for all those new pictures then, Keitaro!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Haha! You’re right, Taiga! It was just so fun getting to hang out with you guys.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Seto
text: Hehe~ It was pretty good while it lasted, huh?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I have no regrets about joining this camp.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: *sigh* I can’t believe this really is our last night together at Camp Buddy…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Seto
text: I know this sounds corny, but I can say for sure this was the best summer I’ve ever had.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: If it weren’t for this place, I wouldn’t have met all of you…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Lee
text: Precisely! I have never experienced such companionship until today!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Eduard
text: Only in here have I felt accepted for everything that I am.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Taiga
text: Even if things started out really bumpy, it all turned out better than I could ever have hoped for.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: This is where I really belong… A place where everyone appreciates and cares for each other…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: I can’t help but be grateful for all the friends I’ve made here.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: So, this is what it feels like to have a real family…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: We’ve gone through so much together. And it all made us grow for the better.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Everyone…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Aww… Look at our boys. They’re really going to miss each other. It’s so sweet…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: I’m in tears over the bond that everyone has created here at the camp!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: But let’s all remember the third Buddy Law!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: A buddy always shows a bright smile on his face~
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I know this night has passed by quicker than we all thought.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But we saw that all of you were making the most out of this day, talking to each other, and having fun together as a big family.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can’t help but feel a little sad too, knowing that it’s not certain that all of us will meet one another in the near future.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But then again, I feel happy thanks to all the time we’ve all spent together here, and I’m excited for what lies ahead for each of us, and for Camp Buddy.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem… May I have a word?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Our farewell isn’t the only reason why we have celebrated like this.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: I’m very excited to announce to everyone that Camp Buddy has found a new investor!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: In other words, our camp has been sponsored for many years to come! Camp Buddy will be standing stronger than ever!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yuri
text: Congratulations to us for a very successful term!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: I was barely holding myself back from spilling the beans this morning!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Aiden
text: Yoshi here knew you guys would feel sad once the party was over, so he saved you all this last bit of great news to cheer you all up!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: We know this may sound sudden, and most of you might be wondering how this is all possible.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Our investor, Clermont Media Incorporated, saw the potential of the camp through this year’s batch of campers!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s desire to keep this home alive, were all discovered by our investor through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Goro
text: Mr. Nagame. I believe this belongs to you.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Hiro
text: This is so unreal, Keitaro!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Hunter
text: I... I can’t believe it either…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t get over the fact that Camp Buddy has finally found a sponsor...!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not only that, Keitaro here is gonna be popular too! Haha!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s really great news..!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Eduard
text: Just how did this happen?!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Lee
text: Hold on… Isn’t Clermont Felix’s family name?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Seto
text: O-Oh! That’s right! Don’t tell me it was your dad who invested in Camp Buddy, Felix?!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: I-I didn’t know he already did it… I only had him visit the camp yesterday to see if it could be sponsored…
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Felix
text: He didn’t tell me he actually went through with it… I can’t believe that my dad has already read through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Taiga
text: Keitaro, you saved the camp..!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: That journal was something that all of us made.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s all thanks to the great memories we’ve shared together!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It was truly an unbelievable thing to happen, especially on our last day.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And adding to that, the founder of Clermont Media has made plans to publish a new book inspired from the story of this year’s batch.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We were sent a letter requesting the author’s approval.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So what do you say, Keitaro?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I say yes, sir! I want the world to know that Camp Buddy is an amazing home for everyone!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You really are an amazing person, Keitaro.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want to express my sincere gratitude for reminding your scoutmasters and showing your fellow campers what this place is truly about.
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To celebrate this last moment and lighten your spirits up, how about we gather around once more and have a little campfire song?
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I believe it’ll be a moment we can all remember!
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’ve come a long way since I joined Camp Buddy and met Yoichi.){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Remembering all of the events that happened during my stay here… it all feels just like yesterday.){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Making new friends… Going out on adventures… Doing exciting camp activities… Celebrating and partying like a big family…){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(At first, everyone at camp thought Yoichi was just a troublemaker… But I always believed that there was more to him than met the eye…){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Once I got to know him, I saw that Yoichi was actually sincere and kind, and that his toughness was just a mask he put on to hide his past…){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Before long, we were close. And I realized that I had fallen in love with him…){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(After everything we’d been through, I’m so glad to know he feels the same for me!){/i}

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(It's amazing what can happen in such a short period of time.){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I used to feel afraid when I thought that I could forget all of these things in the future…){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But this place has made me realize that what's truly important, is enjoying every moment to the fullest with people you love and care for.){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Even without all the pictures I've taken, I don't think I can ever forget everything that's happened.){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I know that all of the memories I’ve shared with Yoichi and everyone else at Camp Buddy will always be in my heart!){/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It feels bittersweet to say goodbye to everyone, especially Yoichi.{/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s true that all good things come to an end.{/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I now accept that.{/i}
label: day34_yoichipe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Because I know that in the end will always be a new beginning.{/i}

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}A brand new chance to make even more great memories!{/i}

text: Haha! That’s right, Hunter!

text: Are you guys excited for today’s activity?!

text: Oh! Good morning, Taiga!

text: Wait a minute. Did you just say ‘activity’?

text: I know, right?! I know they’re up to something!

speaker: Natsumi
text: I don’t think the scoutmasters would do anything that involves too much work since this is our last day.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Taiga
text: Either way, if it’s alright, I really want to spend this last day with you guys…
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: Of course, we’d love to! Isn’t that right, everyone?

text: It’s still so hard to believe how much Taiga has changed these past few days.

text: Don’t get me wrong… I’m still embarrassed about everything bad I’ve done…

text: Oh come on, Taiga, we’ve been telling you over and over - that’s all in the past!

speaker: Taiga
text: I’m really thankful you all chose to see through my mistakes.

speaker: Yoichi
text: What the hell, man?! Don’t tell me you’re gonna keep moping about that on our last day?!

speaker: Natsumi
text: Haha! Yoichi’s right, Taiga! It’s best to use this chance to have fun together, as friends!

speaker: Eduard
text: Oh dear~ Hearing that all of us are besties now is like a dream come true!

speaker: Lee
text: I never thought we’d be able to truly unite this summer.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Seto
text: Well, if you guys hadn’t made it so hard at the beginning, we would have all been buddies from day one!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Felix
text: I guess things really were just meant to happen this way.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Keitaro
text: What matters is that everything’s okay now!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Attention!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! The scoutmasters are ready to make the announcement! Line up, everyone!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, everyone!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp! That also means that we don't really know if we'll see each other again next year.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir, if you will?
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Right! Ehem…
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: So as a means of showing our gratitude, we’ve prepared a final activity for all of you!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, dear?
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, yes! We will be going back to our roots! We’re going to have a little bonfire party!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: We’ll take a short hike to get to the location, and then be all together like one, big, happy family!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: You can say that this is more of a farewell party!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: It’s been a while since we’ve held an outdoor activity together without worrying about anything, after all!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Aiden
text: And you guys don’t have to worry about the food we’re having either!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Aiden
text: I got that all prepped up! All you have to bring is yourselves!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yuri
text: We hope that this little event will mean as much to everyone as it means to us, your scoutmasters!
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It's unfortunate to know we'll all be parting ways tomorrow with no guarantee that we'll see each other again...
label: day35_hiroge

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But what truly matters most is that we create the greatest memories we can possibly make here and now!
label: day35_hiroge

text: Now follow me, campers!

text: I can’t believe this! We’re really having a big party before camp ends!

text: Hmm…

text: H-Huh? W-What’s with that stare, Torch-head? Why are you looking at me like that?!

text: Isn’t this the part where you’ll say: “Oh great! Another lame camping trip! I thought it was something blah blah blah!”

text: I know this night has passed by quicker than we all thought.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But we saw that all of you were making the most out of this day, talking to each other, having fun together as a big family.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I can’t help but feel a little sad too, knowing that it’s not certain that all of us will meet one another in the near future.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But then again, I feel happy thanks to all the time we’ve all spent together here, and I’m excited for what lies ahead for each of us, and for Camp Buddy.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Goro
text: Ehem… May I have a word?
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Goro
text: Our farewell isn’t the only reason why we have celebrated like this.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Goro
text: I’m very excited to announce to everyone that Camp Buddy has found a new investor!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: In other words, our camp has been sponsored for many years to come! Camp Buddy will be standing stronger than ever!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yuri
text: Congratulations to us for a very successful term!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Aiden
text: I was barely holding myself back from spilling the beans this morning!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Aiden
text: Yoshi here knew you guys would feel sad once the party was over, so he saved you all this last bit of great news to cheer you all up!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Goro
text: We know this may sound sudden, and most of you might be wondering how this is all possible.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Goro
text: Our investor, Clermont Media Incorporated, saw the potential of the camp through this year’s batch of campers!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s desire to keep this home alive, were all discovered by our investor through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Goro
text: Mr. Nagame. I believe this belongs to you.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Hiro
text: This is so unreal, Keitaro!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Hunter
text: I... I can’t believe it either…
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Natsumi
text: I can’t get over the fact that Camp Buddy has finally found a sponsor...!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoichi
text: Not only that, Keitaro here is gonna be popular too! Haha!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Taiga
text: That’s really great news..!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Eduard
text: Just how did this happen?!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Lee
text: Hold on… Isn’t Clermont Felix’s family name?
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Seto
text: O-Oh! That’s right! Don’t tell me it was your dad who invested in Camp Buddy, Felix?!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Felix
text: I-I didn’t know he already did it… I only had him visit the camp yesterday to see if it could be sponsored…
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Felix
text: He didn’t tell me he actually went through with it… I can’t believe that my dad has already read through Keitaro’s journal.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Taiga
text: Keitaro, you saved the camp..!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: That journal was something that all of us made.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: It’s all thanks to the great memories we’ve shared together!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It was truly an unbelievable thing to happen, especially on our last day.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: And adding to that, the founder of Clermont Media has made plans to publish a new book inspired from the story of this year’s batch.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We were sent a letter requesting the author’s approval.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: So what do you say, Keitaro?
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: I say yes, sir! I want the world to know that Camp Buddy is an amazing home for everyone!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: You really are an amazing person, Keitaro.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I want to express my sincere gratitude for reminding your scoutmasters and showing your fellow campers what this place is truly about.
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: To celebrate this last moment and lighten your spirits up, how about we gather around once more and have a little campfire song?
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Yoshinori
text: I believe it’ll be a moment we can all remember!
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I’ve come a long way since I joined Camp Buddy with Hiro.){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Remembering all of the events that happened during my stay here… it all feels just like yesterday.){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Making new friends… Going out on adventures… Doing exciting camp activities… Celebrating and partying like a big family…){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Even through those challenging times and moments when we misunderstood each other, Hiro was always by my side.){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that our relationship would reach a point where we would confess our love for each other…){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(It’s amazing what can happen in such a short period of time.){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I used to feel afraid when I thought that I could forget all of these things in the future…){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But this place has made me realize that what's truly important, is enjoying every moment to the fullest with people you love and care for.){/i}

text: {i}(Even without all the pictures I've taken, I don't think I can ever forget everything that's happened.){/i}

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I know that all of the memories I’ve shared with Hiro and everyone else at Camp Buddy will always be in my heart!){/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It feels bittersweet to say goodbye to everyone. Especially to Hiro.{/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s true that all good things come to an end.{/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I now accept that.{/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Because I know that in the end will always be a new beginning.{/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}A brand new chance to make even more great memories!{/i}
label: day35_hirope

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Ever since our talk at the pier, Hiro and I have been a little distant from each other... {/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Before I knew it, it was time for us to leave Camp Buddy, but things never got the chance to settle between us.{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I had hoped Hiro and I wouldn't part ways like this...{/i}

text: Hey, Keitaro! Why are you just standing here? Everyone’s already left!

speaker: Keitaro
text: Oh! I was just thinking about how much fun we had here in Camp Buddy.

label: day35_hirowe

text: Who knows? Maybe your mom will recover soon!
label: day35_hirowe

text: Haha! I sure hope so!
label: day35_hirowe

text: U-Umm… Keitaro?
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: What’s up, Hiro?

text: About the other day… I know I haven’t talked to you much since then…
label: day35_hirowe

text: But I’ve been doing a lot of thinking… And I wanted to apologize for the way I acted and the things I said…
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Ah...! P-Please don’t worry about that! I… I’m sorry for what happened back then too…
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I’m sorry if I said some things that might have hurt you…
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: No, it’s alright… I understand why you had to say those things… And I really am over it.
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: I just didn’t want our last day here to be awkward is all…
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Well… I’m actually more worried about you, Hiro…
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: You’re not upset, are you?
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: Of course not! L-Like I said, I’m already over it.
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: I’m actually just relieved you didn’t get mad at me after I lied to you like that.
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: That’s the reason I’m apologizing now…
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: I told you already, Hiro. I understand why you did that.
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: Keitaro…
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: Thank you for always doing your best to understand me!
label: day35_hirowe

text: We’re best friends, remember?

speaker: Hiro
text: R-Right!
label: day35_hirowe

label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: So… I guess this is goodbye for us, huh?

speaker: Hiro
text: Yeah…
label: day35_hirowe

text: I’m gonna miss you so much, Keitaro.

text: Me too, Hiro.
label: day35_hirowe

text: Now, go! Your aunt is calling for you!

text: I’ll contact you as soon as I get there, alright?!

speaker: Keitaro
text: Sure thing, Hiro!
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Hiro
text: Bye, Keitaro!
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: Take care!

text: I promise I’ll have enough courage to tell you everything the next time we meet, Keitaro!!!

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Almost a year has passed, and it’s almost time for summer vacation again…{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I've been so busy with my school life that it’s been rare for me to keep in touch with Hiro or any of the friends I met in Camp Buddy.{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Unfortunately, Mrs. Akiba’s condition hasn’t improved since then, and Hiro has always been busy taking care of her.{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I received mail from Camp Buddy right after the school semester ended, inviting me to join again this summer.{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}But I thought to myself…{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}What’s the point of coming back if Hiro won’t be there with me…?{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Things will never be the same without him…{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}And with that, I decided to decline the offer, and let things stay as they are.{/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I guess everything that happened last summer… {/i}
label: day35_hirowe

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}May have just been the greatest memory I will someday forget…{/i}

text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.

text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!

text: {i}(I’ve come a long way since I joined Camp Buddy and met Hunter.){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Remembering all of the events that happened during my stay here… it all feels just like yesterday.){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Making new friends… Going out on adventures… Doing exciting camp activities… Celebrating and partying like a big family…){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(After everything Hunter and I had gone through this term, we always made sure to stick by each other’s sides.){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(To think that our relationship would reach a point where we would confess our love for each other…){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(It's amazing what can happen in such a short period of time.){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I used to feel afraid when I thought that I could forget all of these things in the future…){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(But this place has made me realize that what's truly important, is enjoying every moment to the fullest with people you love and care for.){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(Even without all the pictures I've taken, I don't think I can ever forget everything that's happened.){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}(I know that all of the memories I’ve shared with Hunter and everyone else at Camp Buddy will always be in my heart!){/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It feels bittersweet to say goodbye to everyone. Especially to Hunter.{/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}It’s true that all good things come to an end.{/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}I now accept that.{/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}Because I know that in the end will always be a new beginning.{/i}
label: day35_hunterge

speaker: Keitaro
text: {i}A brand new chance to make even more great memories!{/i}

speaker: Natsumi
text: Oh! The scoutmasters are ready to make the announcement! Line up, everyone!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Good morning, everyone!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: As you all know, today is the last day of the summer camp! That also means that we don't really know if we'll see each other again next year.
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We have never really held any farewell events like this in the past, but things have changed now.
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: We scoutmasters wanted to say something to all of you, our precious scouts.
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Sir, if you will?
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: Right! Ehem…
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: This year has been one of the most special terms for us!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: I honestly expected this year’s batch to be the last as I was certain that Camp Buddy would be closing down for good.
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: But you all proved me wrong.
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: We have been through ups and downs, and I wanted to thank all of you for believing that this place is worth fighting for!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: Everyone’s resolve and cooperation are what made things turn around for the better!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: So as a means of showing our gratitude, we’ve prepared a final activity for all of you!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Goro
text: Yuri, dear?
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: Ah, yes! We will be going back to our roots! We’re going to have a little bonfire party!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: We’ll take a short hike to get to the location, and then be all together like one, big, happy family!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: You can say that this is more of a farewell party!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: It’s been a while since we’ve held an outdoor activity together without worrying about anything, after all!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Aiden
text: And you guys don’t have to worry about the food we’re having either!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Aiden
text: I got that all prepped up! All you have to bring is yourselves!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yuri
text: We hope that this little event will mean as much to everyone as it means to us, your scoutmasters!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: It's unfortunate to know we'll all be parting ways tomorrow with no guarantee that we'll see each other again...
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: But what truly matters most is that we create the greatest memories we can possibly make here and now!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Yoshinori
text: Now follow me, campers!
label: day35_hunterpe

speaker: Keitaro

text: And I’ll be following wherever my parents go.

text: But if they decide that I can go to art school then that would make me really, really happy!

text: My parents know how much I’ve grown here in Camp Buddy. And I’m sure they want nothing more for me than to continue learning great things in here.

speaker: Hunter
text: And even if they did say no… with Keitaro here, I know I’d find a way.

text: But if you’re going to ask me personally, I wanna pursue my dream and try to join a modeling agency~!

speaker: Eduard
text: I wanna be proud of who I am, and I don’t care what anybody else thinks!

speaker: Eduard
text: Soooo… Yeahhh… Wish me luck~

text: I realized that my physical well-being is just as important! So I’m planning to get myself into shape!

speaker: Lee
text: I’ll definitely try to build my body to be big and strong just like Taiga!

speaker: Lee
text: With my intellectual prowess, I’m sure I’ll be able to create a fitness program that fits my capacity!
